local local_class = newclass('FarmDecorationSnowman')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour
	self.farm_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'snowman')
	if data_key == '' or data_key == nil then
		data_key = 'snowman'
	end
	self.spine_changed = false
	self.character_cache = nil
	self.original_character = user_party_leader
	self.transformer_data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)
	self.transform_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	self.is_interacting = false
	self.timer_bar = nil
	self.interact_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.transformer_data.interact_sfx, '01_plate_01')
	self.transform_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.transformer_data.transform_sfx, '02_druid_change_02')
	self.transform_end_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.transformer_data.transform_end_sfx, nil)
	self.interact_duration = 1
	self.transform_duration = 10
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.transformed = false
	music_player:PreloadSfx(self.transform_sfx_name)
	music_player:PreloadSfx(self.interact_sfx_name)
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self.fo = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
	self.farm_system = nil
end

-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_building(data, pooled_object)
end

function local_class:remove_building(building_Id)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	--fixme
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		return false
	end
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		self.original_character = leader
		self.is_interacting = true
		character_util.reset_action_state(self.original_character)

		local look_dir
		if self.original_character.Position.x < self.fo.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end

		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.original_character, look_dir)

		local interact_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(self.original_character, self.fo)
		message_system:SendSync(self.original_character, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(interact_state))

		self.interact_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.interact_sfx_name, parent = leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

		local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('eat', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
		local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.original_character, req)
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

		state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
		message_system:SendSync(self.original_character.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

		local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

		if self.timer_bar == nil then
			self.timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.interact_duration);
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

			self.time_passed = 0
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_routine()
	self:transformer_start()
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	if self.interact_sfx then
		self.interact_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.original_character, 'none')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_routine, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	if self.interact_sfx then
		self.interact_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.original_character)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.original_character, 'none')
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false

	return true
end


function local_class:get_target_character()
	if self.character_cache == nil then
		self.character_cache = stage:GetCharacter(self.transformer_data.spine_asset_name)
		if self.character_cache == nil then
			local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("Characters"):GetSpec(self.transformer_data.specId)
			local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
			coroutine.yield(loader)
			self.character_cache = loader.Character
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character_cache, 'disabled')
			self.character_cache.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.character_cache.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour()
			self.character_cache.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
			self.character_cache.Pushable = CS.Oak.RegisterPushable()
			self.character_cache.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.character_cache.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			self.character_cache.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
			self.character_cache.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local;
			self.character_cache.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0;
			stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(self.character_cache)
			stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(self.character_cache)
		end
	end
	return self.character_cache
end

function local_class:transformer_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = false
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:DisableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)
	character_util.reset_action_state(self.original_character)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	-- 현재 배틀액션을 모두 취소해준다.
	self.original_character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	stage.ProjectileManager:ClearProjectiles()

	-- 타겟으로 바꿈
	local target_character = self:get_target_character()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.original_character)
	target_character.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	target_character.Position = self.original_character.Position
	target_character.Direction = self.original_character.Direction
	target_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ChangeHpToFixedValue(target_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP)
	target_character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.ManualTouchCharacterController()
	target_character.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact)
	user_party:Remove(self.original_character)
	user_party:Add(target_character)
	coroutine.yield(target_character:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
	self.original_character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectController.Instance
	character_util.set_active_state(target_character, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.original_character, 'disabled')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.transform_sfx_name, parent = self.target_character, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	self.transform_effect:Instantiate(target_character.Position)
	if self.transform_end_sfx_name ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.transform_end_sfx_name, parent = self.target_character, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	end

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ChangeActionButton)
	self.transformed = true
end

-- 다시 사람으로 변신을 해제함.
function local_class:transformer_end()

	local target_character = self:get_target_character()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target_character)
	self.original_character.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	self.original_character.Position = target_character.Position
	self.original_character.Direction = target_character.Direction
	target_character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectController.Instance
	self.original_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ChangeHpToFixedValue(self.original_character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP)
	self.original_character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.ManualTouchCharacterController()
	user_party:Remove(target_character)
	user_party:Add(self.original_character)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			self.original_character:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
	character_util.set_active_state(self.original_character, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(target_character, 'disabled')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.transform_sfx_name, parent = self.original_character, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	self.transform_effect:Instantiate(self.original_character.Position)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:EnableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseNavigationBarButtons = true
	self.transformed = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_interacting then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.interact_duration then
			self.is_interacting = false
			self.time_passed = 0

			local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.original_character, self.fo)
			command_util.execute_cmd(command)
		else
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		end
	end

	if self.transformed then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.transform_duration then
			self.time_passed = 0
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.character_cache, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar = nil
			self:transformer_end()
		else
			if self.timer_bar == nil then
				local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.character_cache, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

				self.timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(60)
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.transform_duration)
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite.Transform.position = self.character_cache.Position - unity_class.vector3(0,0,0.2)

				self.time_passed = 0
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
			else
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end


return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

function local_class:screen_play_routine()
	-- 무기 감춤
	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true, 'slime_pool')

	-- 뽕! 하고 튀어나옴
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	local slime_jelly_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.fo.Bounds.center,
		target = user_party.Leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.LockedDirection) * 0.5,
		itemid = 20086,
		notforinven = true,
		amount = 1,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 먹는 연출
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	local holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

	local time_passed = 0
	while (time_passed < 1.5) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / 1.5)
		slime_jelly_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)
		slime_jelly_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 다 먹음
	holder:FadeOut(0.2)
	slime_jelly_item:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 완식 후 만-족
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success', loop = false }, { name = 'awesome' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	-- 연출 종료 준비

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Interactor, leader) then
		-- 임시
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
			return false
		end

		self.is_interacting = true
		self.interactor = e.Interactor
		character_util.reset_action_state(self.interactor)

		local look_dir
		if self.interactor.Position.x < self.fo.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end

		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, look_dir)

		local interact_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(interact_state))

		self.interact_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.interact_sfx_name, parent = leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

		local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('eat', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
		local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.interactor, req)
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

		state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

		local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

		if self.timer_bar == nil then
			self.timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.interact_duration);
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.prev_time_passed = 0
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	if self.interact_sfx then
		self.interact_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	if self.interact_sfx then
		self.interact_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screen_play_routine, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_interacting then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.interact_duration then
			self.is_interacting = false
			self.time_passed = 0

			local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
			command_util.execute_cmd(command)
		else
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		end
	end

	if self.transformed_character ~= nil then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.transform_duration then
			self.time_passed = 0

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.transformed_character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar = nil

			self:reset_state()
		else
			if self.timer_bar == nil then
				local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.transformed_character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

				self.timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(60)
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.transform_duration)
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite.Transform.position = self.transformed_character.Position - unity_class.vector3(0,0,0.2)

				self.time_passed = 0
				self.prev_time_passed = 0
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
			else
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:screen_play_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end
	local spec =  CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(cached_leader)

	-- 무기 감춤
	character_util.hide_weapon(cached_leader, true, 'cauldron')

	-- 뽕! 하고 튀어나옴
	local side_offset = direction_util.to_vector3(cached_leader.LockedDirection) * 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	local potion = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.fo.Bounds.center,
		target = cached_leader.Position + side_offset,
		itemid = self.pop_item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		amount = 1,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.8)


	local holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drinking_01', parent = cached_leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	if spec.OriginId == 13 or spec.OriginId == 244 then
		-- 먹는 연출
		character_util.set_anim(cached_leader, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

		local time_passed = 0
		while (time_passed < 1.8) do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / 1.5)
			potion.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)
			potion.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 다 먹음
		potion:ConsumeComplete()
		holder:FadeOut(0.2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	elseif spec.OriginId == 338 or spec.OriginId == 428 then
		potion:ConsumeComplete()

		character_util.set_anim(cached_leader, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right', loop = true, scale = 0.4 })
		cached_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2',
				game_data_service.GetData('ItemData'):GetSpec(self.pop_item_id_rotated).SpriteName)

		wait_for_sec(1.8)

		cached_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

		-- 다 먹음
		holder:FadeOut(0.2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	else
		potion:ConsumeComplete()

		character_util.set_anim(cached_leader, { name = 'dualgun_attack_right', loop = true, scale = 0.4 })
		cached_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2',
				game_data_service.GetData('ItemData'):GetSpec(self.pop_item_id_rotated).SpriteName)

		wait_for_sec(1.8)

		cached_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

		-- 다 먹음
		holder:FadeOut(0.2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader, { name = 'dead1', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = cached_leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = cached_leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 캐릭터 생성
	local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 5)
	local position = cached_leader.Position
	local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(self.transformation_spec_list[rand])
	coroutine.yield(loader)
	local character = loader.Character
	character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.ManualTouchCharacterController()
	character.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour()
	character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	character.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local;
	character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0;
	character.Position = position
	character.Transform:SetParent(stage.StageTransform)
	character.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact)
	stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(character)
	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(character)

	coroutine.yield(character:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())

	-- 연출 종료 준비
	character_util.hide_weapon(cached_leader, false, 'cauldron')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(cached_leader, 'none')

	-- 변신 이펙트
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_druid_change_02', parent = cached_leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	self.transformed_character = character
	self.original_character = cached_leader
	self.original_character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.transformed_character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	user_party:Remove(self.original_character)
	user_party:Add(self.transformed_character)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cached_leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.transformation_sfx_list[rand], parent = cached_leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ChangeActionButton)

	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:DisableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)
end

function local_class:reset_state()
	local position = user_party.Leader.Position

	self.transformed_character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.original_character.Position = self.transformed_character.Position
	self.original_character.Direction = self.transformed_character.Direction
	self.original_character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	user_party:Remove(self.transformed_character)
	user_party:Add(self.original_character)

	stage.CharacterManager:UnRegisterCharacter(self.transformed_character)
	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(self.transformed_character)

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.transformed_character.gameObject)
	self.transformed_character = nil
	self.original_character = nil

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_druid_change_02', parent = cached_leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })

	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:EnableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmHomePartyScreenPlay')

--region Base Function
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.farm_system = farm_util.get_farm_system()

	-- 데이터 세팅
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.npc_type = {
		hero = 0,
		sns_follower = 1,
		farm_npc = 2
	}

	self:generate_npc_list()
	self.spawn_npc_num = #self.data.seat_position_x - 1

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
end

function local_class:get_available_villager_list()
	-- farm villager
	local npc_specs = CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmData.Value:GetAllNpcSpec()
	-- 배치된 주민 리스트
	local selected_npc_list = self.farm_system.NpcManager:GetSelectedNpcList()
	local result = {}

	for _,spec in pairs(npc_specs) do
		if spec.VillagerType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmNpcSpec.FarmVillagerType.Normal then
			local contains = false
			for i = 0, selected_npc_list.Count - 1 do
				local npc_spec = selected_npc_list[i]
				if npc_spec.Id == spec.Id then
					contains = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not contains then
				table.insert(result, spec)
			end
		end
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:generate_npc_list()
	local characters_specs = CS.Oak.Characters.Value:GetOriginCharacterSpecs()
	local npc_specs = CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmData.Value:GetAllNpcSpec()
	-- 유저가 얻은 팔로워만 등장하도록 수정
	local follower_specs = CS.Oak.UserProgress.Instance:GetHeavenHoldVisitFollowers()
	self.npc_data_list = {}

	for _,spec in pairs(characters_specs) do
		if spec.OriginId < 100000 and spec.SortingNumber ~= -1 and spec.Rank == 0 and spec.OriginId > 2 then
			table.insert(self.npc_data_list, {
				type = self.npc_type.hero,
				id = spec.OriginId,
				asset_name = spec.SpineAssetName,
				skin_name = spec.SpineSkinName
			})
		end
	end
	for _,spec in pairs(npc_specs) do
		if spec.VillagerType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmNpcSpec.FarmVillagerType.Normal then
			table.insert(self.npc_data_list, {
				type = self.npc_type.farm_npc,
				id = spec.Id,
				asset_name = spec.CharacterSpec.SpineAssetName,
				skin_name = spec.CharacterSpec.SpineSkinName
			})
		end
	end

	for i = 0, follower_specs.Count - 1 do
		local spec = follower_specs[i]
		if spec.HeavenholdVisitRegard then
			table.insert(self.npc_data_list, {
				type = self.npc_type.sns_follower,
				id = spec.Id,
				asset_name = spec.SpineAssetName,
				skin_name = spec.SpineSkinName
			})
		end
	end

	self:shuffle(self.npc_data_list)
end

function local_class:start(tier, _, npc_id) -- 아이템은 여기서 처리 안 함
	if tier == 2 then
		self.coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.home_party_screen_play_tier3, self))
	elseif tier == 1 then
		self.coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.home_party_screen_play_tier2, self))
	elseif not npc_id or npc_id == -1 then
		self.coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.home_party_screen_play_tier1_a, self))
	else
		self.coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.home_party_screen_play_tier1, self, npc_id))
	end

	return self.coroutine
end

function local_class:init_screen_play(tier, npc_id)
	local party_id = farm_util.get_building_data_with_type(CS.Oak.FarmBuildingType.HomeParty).Id;
	self.fo = self.farm_system.BuildingManager:GetBuildingById(party_id);
	self.side_dir_list = {}
	self.reset_attachment_list = {}

	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true, 'home_party')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	if tier ~= 3 then
		self.spine_list = self:place_all_participants(tier, npc_id)
		if self.spine_list == nil then
			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			return
		end
	else
		self:place_player(tier, math.random(4))
	end

	-- 카메라 이동
	local cam_move_duration = 7
	local cam_start_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.fo.Bounds.min.x, self.fo.Bounds.center.y, self.fo.Bounds.center.z)
	local cam_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.fo.Bounds.max.x, self.fo.Bounds.center.y, self.fo.Bounds.center.z)
	local cam_target_size = 4
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(cam_target_size, 0)
	stage_camera:Move(cam_start_pos, 0, null, true)
	coroutine.yield()
	stage_camera:Move(cam_end_pos, cam_move_duration, null, true)

	-- bgm 정보
	local bgm_name = self.data.tier_bgm[tier]
	self.bgm_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	self.bgm_info.sfxName = bgm_name
	self.bgm_info.loop = false
	self.bgm_info.targetChannel = CS.Oak.SfxChannelFilter.FarmOverlay

	self.farm_system.SoundManager:ActivateOverlayChannel(self.cs_behaviour)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:reset_attachment()
	if not self.reset_attachment_list then
		return
	end

	-- attachment 초기화
	for i,callback in pairs(self.reset_attachment_list) do
		callback()
		self.reset_attachment_list[i] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:end_screen_play()
	-- npc 연출 종료
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	if self.spine_list then
		for i, spine in pairs(self.spine_list) do
			if not is_unity_null(spine) and spine then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(spine.gameObject)
				self.spine_list[i] = nil
			end
		end
		self.spine_list = nil
	end

	-- 플레이어 복구
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.original_position
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	self:reset_attachment()
	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false, 'home_party')

	-- 카메라 복구
	local cam_original_size = 5
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(cam_original_size, 0)
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = '01_stage_in_teleport_01'
	sfx_info.loop = false
	sfx_info.targetChannel = CS.Oak.SfxChannelFilter.FarmOverlay
	music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- bgm 복구
	local data = {
		state = 'field',
		mix = 0.5
	}
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(data)
	self.farm_system.SoundManager:ResetOverlayChannel(self.cs_behaviour)

	self:clear_temp_var()
end

function local_class:home_party_screen_play_tier1(npc_id)

	-- 내레이션 박스

function local_class:home_party_screen_play_tier1_a()

function local_class:update_character_move(time_passed)
	for _,data in pairs(self.side_dir_list) do
		if time_passed > data.next_time then
			local spine = data.spine
			data.next_time = data.next_time + data.duration
			if spine.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			else
				spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:place_player(tier, seat_index)
	local seat_data = self.data.tier_anims[tier][math.floor((seat_index - 1) / 2) + 1]
	local anim_data = seat_data[math.random(#seat_data)]
	local spine = user_party.Leader.SpineController
	if not spine:HasAnimation(anim_data.anim, anim_data.direction) then
		anim_data = {
			anim = self.data.alt_anim.anim,
			loop = self.data.alt_anim.loop,
			emot = self.data.alt_anim.emot,
			attachment = self.data.alt_anim.attachment,
			attach_slot = self.data.alt_anim.attach_slot,
			direction = anim_data.direction
		}
	end

	self.original_position = user_party.Leader.Position
	if anim_data.look_side_duration then
		table.insert(self.side_dir_list,
				{ spine = spine, duration = anim_data.look_side_duration,
				  next_time = anim_data.look_side_duration })
	end
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.fo.Position +
			unity_class.vector3(self.data.seat_position_x[seat_index],
					self.data.seat_position_y[seat_index], self.data.seat_position_z[seat_index])
	user_party.Leader.Direction = anim_data.direction
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader,
			{ name = anim_data.anim, loop = anim_data.loop,
			  scale = anim_data.time_scale and anim_data.time_scale or 1 }, { name = anim_data.emot })

	if anim_data.attachment then
		local attachment_data = anim_data.attachment

		if attachment_data.bone then
			local item_container = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('item_container_'..seat_index)

			local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = unity_class.vector3.zero, itemid = attachment_data.id, notforinven = true,
					  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = attachment_data.scale })
			if item.ShadowTransform then
				item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
			local original_parent = item.SpriteTransform.parent
			item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(item_container.transform)

			local bone_follower = item_container:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
			bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = spine.SkeletonAnimation
			bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon1_side')

			local flip = user_party.Leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and 1 or -1
			item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, flip * attachment_data.rotation, 0)
			item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(flip,1,1) * attachment_data.scale
			item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(flip * attachment_data.offset.x, attachment_data.offset.y, attachment_data.offset.z)
			if attachment_data.show_on_top then
				item:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
			end

			table.insert(self.reset_attachment_list, function()
				item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(original_parent)
				item:ConsumeComplete()
				CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(item_container)
			end)
		else
			spine:SetAttachment(anim_data.attach_slot,
					game_data_service.GetData('ItemData'):GetSpec(anim_data.attachment).SpriteName)

			table.insert(self.reset_attachment_list, function()
				spine:SetAttachment(anim_data.attach_slot, 'empty')
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:place_all_participants(tier, npc_id)
	local object_position = self.fo.Position
	local spine_list = {}
	local spawn_npc_num = self.spawn_npc_num
	local selected_npc_list = self.farm_system.NpcManager:GetSelectedNpcList()
	local villager_id = npc_id

	-- 1티어 보상을 재화로 받을 경우 보유중인 주민 뽑음
	if tier == 1 and (npc_id == nil or npc_id == -1) then
		local villagers = farm_util.get_current_user_data().Villagers
		local villager_list = {}

		for i = 0, villagers.Count - 1 do
			local villager = villagers[i]
			local contains = false
			for j = 0, selected_npc_list.Count - 1 do
				local npc_spec = selected_npc_list[j]
				if npc_spec.Id == villager then
					contains = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not contains then
				table.insert(villager_list, villager)
			end
		end

		local count = #villager_list
		if count > 0 then
			villager_id = villager_list[math.random(#villager_list)]
		end
	end

	local npc_list = self:pick_npc(spawn_npc_num, selected_npc_list, villager_id)
	for _,data in pairs(npc_list) do
		local spine = self:load_npc(data)
		table.insert(spine_list, spine)
	end

	-- 좌석 랜덤
	local seat_index_list = {1,2,3,4}
	self:shuffle(seat_index_list)

	self:place_player(tier, seat_index_list[4])
	table.remove(seat_index_list, 4)

	for spine_index, i in ipairs(seat_index_list) do
		local spine = spine_list[spine_index]
		local seat_data = self.data.tier_anims[tier][math.floor((i - 1) / 2) + 1]
		local anim_data = seat_data[math.random(#seat_data)]

		if spine then
			if not spine:HasAnimation(anim_data.anim, anim_data.direction) then
				anim_data = {
					anim = self.data.alt_anim.anim,
					loop = self.data.alt_anim.loop,
					emot = self.data.alt_anim.emot,
					attachment = self.data.alt_anim.attachment,
					attach_slot = self.data.alt_anim.attach_slot,
					direction = anim_data.direction
				}
			end

			if anim_data.look_side_duration then
				table.insert(self.side_dir_list,
						{ spine = spine, duration = anim_data.look_side_duration, next_time = anim_data.look_side_duration })
			end

			spine.transform.position = object_position +
					unity_class.vector3(self.data.seat_position_x[i], self.data.seat_position_y[i], self.data.seat_position_z[i])
			spine.Direction = anim_data.direction

			spine:SetAnimation(1, anim_data.anim, anim_data.loop, anim_data.time_scale and anim_data.time_scale or 1)
			if CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(spine, '[base]face') then
				spine:SetEmotion(anim_data.emot, true)
			end

			if anim_data.attachment then
				local attachment_data = anim_data.attachment

				if attachment_data.bone then
					local item_container = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('item_container_'..i)

					local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
							{ pos = unity_class.vector3.zero, itemid = attachment_data.id, notforinven = true,
							  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = attachment_data.scale })
					if item.ShadowTransform then
						item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
					end
					local original_parent = item.SpriteTransform.parent
					item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(item_container.transform)

					local bone_follower = item_container:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
					bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
					bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = spine.SkeletonAnimation
					bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon1_side')

					local flip = spine.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and 1 or -1
					item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, flip * attachment_data.rotation, 0)
					item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(flip,1,1) * attachment_data.scale
					item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(flip * attachment_data.offset.x, attachment_data.offset.y, attachment_data.offset.z)
					if attachment_data.show_on_top then
						item:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
					end

					table.insert(self.reset_attachment_list, function()
						item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
						item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(original_parent)
						item:ConsumeComplete()
						CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(item_container)
					end)
				else
					spine:SetAttachment(anim_data.attach_slot,
							game_data_service.GetData('ItemData'):GetSpec(anim_data.attachment).SpriteName)

					table.insert(self.reset_attachment_list, function()
						spine:SetAttachment(anim_data.attach_slot, 'empty')
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return spine_list
end

function local_class:pick_npc(num, selected_npc_list, npc_id)
	local picked_data_list = {}
	local spawn_npc_num = num

	-- 넘겨 받은 npc_id 미리 넣어둠
	if npc_id and npc_id ~= -1 then
		spawn_npc_num = spawn_npc_num - 1
		local spec = CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmData.Value:GetNpcSpec(npc_id)

		if spec ~= nil then
			table.insert(picked_data_list, {
				type = self.npc_type.farm_npc,
				id = spec.Id,
				asset_name = spec.CharacterSpec.SpineAssetName,
				skin_name = spec.CharacterSpec.SpineSkinName
			})
		end
	end

	for _ = 1, spawn_npc_num do
		local picked_spine_data
		local fail_count = 0
		repeat
			local length = #self.npc_data_list

			if length == 0 then
				if fail_count > 1 then
					return picked_data_list
				end

				self:generate_npc_list()
				length = #self.npc_data_list
				fail_count = fail_count + 1
			end

			picked_spine_data = self.npc_data_list[length]
			table.remove(self.npc_data_list, length)

			if picked_spine_data then
				-- 이미 고른 npc 리스트에 있으면 제외
				for _,data in pairs(picked_data_list) do
					if data.asset_name:Equals(picked_spine_data.asset_name) then
						picked_spine_data = nil
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if picked_spine_data then
				-- 스테이지 배치한 npc 리스트에 있으면 제외
				for _, spec in pairs(selected_npc_list) do
					if picked_spine_data.asset_name:Equals(spec.CharacterSpec.SpineAssetName) then
						picked_spine_data = nil
						break
					end
				end
			end
		until picked_spine_data ~= nil

		table.insert(picked_data_list, picked_spine_data)
	end

	return picked_data_list
end

function local_class:load_npc(args)
	local asset_name = args.asset_name
	local skin_name = args.skin_name

	if self.container == nil then
		self.container = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('home-party-character-container')
	end

	local prefab
	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(asset_name,
			function(p) prefab = p end
		))

	if prefab == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
	local spine_controller = go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	if spine_controller then
		spine_controller.Transform:SetParent(self.container.transform, false);
		spine_controller.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		spine_controller.SkinName = skin_name;
	end

	return spine_controller
end

function local_class:shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

function local_class:clear_temp_var()
	self.original_position = nil
	self.side_dir_list = nil
	self.reset_attachment_list = nil
	self.fo = nil
	self.bgm_info = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:clear_temp_var()

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
	self.res_holder:Dispose()
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.farm_system = nil

	self.data = nil
	self.npc_data_list = nil
	self.spawn_npc_num = nil
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

function local_class:start_screenplay(pooled_object, result_data)
	local result = result_data.Result
	local items = result_data.AddedItems
	local materials = result_data.Materials

	self.animator = pooled_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 연출 테스트용
	if self.test_mode then
		self.tmp_count = self.tmp_count + 1
		if self.tmp_count <= 2 then
			result = CS.Oak.FarmRecipeCraftResult.Fail
		elseif self.tmp_count == 3 then
			result = CS.Oak.FarmRecipeCraftResult.Success
		elseif self.tmp_count == 4 then
			result = CS.Oak.FarmRecipeCraftResult.GreatSuccess
		else

	elseif result == CS.Oak.FarmRecipeCraftResult.Accident then

	elseif result == CS.Oak.FarmRecipeCraftResult.Success then

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PreloadSfx("01_bingo_cell_01");
end

function local_class:machine_play(paramList)
	local drawNumbers = paramList[0]
	local bingoCellManager = paramList[1]
	local isBonusRound = paramList[2]
	return util.cs_generator(self.machine_play_routine, self, drawNumbers, bingoCellManager, isBonusRound)
end

function local_class:machine_play_routine(drawNumbers, bingoCellManager, isBonusRound)
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:MixLobbyMusic("bgm_bingo_machine_02")
	self.item.bingoMachine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, "start", false)
	self.item.rootAnimator:Play("bingo_characters_play")
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_bingo_machine_01")

	local startDuration = self.item.bingoMachine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_crowd_clap_02")

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(startDuration))

	self.item.bingoMachine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, "play", true)

	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_start.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_light_start.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.4))

	local waitTime = 0.6
	local ballMoveDuration = 0.08
	if (drawNumbers.Length == 1) then
		waitTime = 1.2
	end

	if (isBonusRound) then
		waitTime = waitTime / 2
		ballMoveDuration = ballMoveDuration / 2
	end

	for i = 0, drawNumbers.Length -1 do
		local index = drawNumbers[i] - 1
		local ballPos = self.item.bingoBallTransforms[i].position

		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_result.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		if (drawNumbers.Length == 1) then
			ballPos = self.item.bingoBallSingleTransform.position
		end

		self.item.ballGameObjects[index]:SetActive(true)
		self.item.ballAnimators[index]:Play("bingo_ball_spin")
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_bingo_ball_01")

		local passedTime = 0
		local startPos = self.item.bingoBallStartTransforms.position
		local targetPos = ballPos

		while passedTime < ballMoveDuration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			passedTime = passedTime + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(passedTime, 0, 1, ballMoveDuration)
			local pos = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(startPos, targetPos, progress)
			self.item.ballGameObjects[index].transform.position = pos

			if ballMoveDuration - passedTime <= CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Epsilon then
				break
			end
		end

		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_start.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_result.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		bingoCellManager:CheckCellItem(drawNumbers[i])
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_select_gender_01")

		local cellPosition = bingoCellManager:GetCellPositionByCellNumber(drawNumbers[i])
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check1.transform.position = cellPosition
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check1:SetActive(true)
		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(waitTime))
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check1:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_result.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.bingoMachine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, "idle", true)
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_light_start.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.item.rootAnimator:Play("bingo_characters_idle")
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_bingo_ball_02")
	for i = 0, self.item.ballGameObjects.Length -1 do
		self.item.ballAnimators[i]:Play("bingo_ball_end")
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.5))

	for i = 0, self.item.ballGameObjects.Length -1 do
		self.item.ballGameObjects[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.ballGameObjects[i].transform.localScale = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(1, 1, 1)
	end
end

function local_class:draw_pattern_line(paramList)
	local patternId = paramList[0]
	local patternDictionary = paramList[1]
	local bingoCellManager = paramList[2]
	return util.cs_generator(self.draw_pattern_line_routine, self, patternId, patternDictionary, bingoCellManager)
end

function local_class:draw_pattern_line_routine(patternId, patternDictionary, bingoCellManager)
	if CS.System.Object.ReferenceEquals(self.item.CurrentLineRenderer, nil) then
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local cellIndexList = patternDictionary[patternId]
	bingoCellManager:SetCompleteSprite(cellIndexList[0])

	local rewardCellPos = bingoCellManager:GetRewardCellPosition(patternId)
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect1.transform.position = rewardCellPos
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect1.transform.localRotation = self:get_axis_line_effect(patternId)
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect1.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local startCellPos = bingoCellManager:GetCellPosition(cellIndexList[0])
	self.item.CurrentLineRenderer:SetPosition(0, startCellPos)
	local duration = self.item.lineDrawDuration / cellIndexList.Length

	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2[0].transform.position = startCellPos
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2[0]:SetActive(true)

	for i = 0, cellIndexList.Length - 2 do
		local currentPos = bingoCellManager:GetCellPosition(cellIndexList[i])
		local targetPos = bingoCellManager:GetCellPosition(cellIndexList[i + 1])
		local passedTime = 0

		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_bingo_line_01")
		while passedTime < duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			if self.item.CurrentLineRenderer.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
				self.item.CurrentLineRenderer.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end

			passedTime = passedTime + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(passedTime, 0, 1, duration)
			local pos = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(currentPos, targetPos, progress)
			self.item.CurrentLineRenderer:SetPosition(1, pos)

			if duration - passedTime <= CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Epsilon * 10 then
				bingoCellManager:SetCompleteSprite(cellIndexList[i + 1])
				self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2[i + 1].transform.position = pos
				self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2[i + 1]:SetActive(true);
				break
			end
		end
	end

	self.item.currentLineIndex = self.item.currentLineIndex + 1
	bingoCellManager:CheckRewardCellItem(patternId)
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_bingo_cell_01")

	self.fx_check_index = self.fx_check_index + 1
	if self.fx_check_index > self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2.Length - 1 then
		self.fx_check_index = 0
	end

	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2[self.fx_check_index].transform.position = rewardCellPos
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2[self.fx_check_index].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2[self.fx_check_index].gameObject:SetActive(true)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.2))
	self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect1.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	for i = 0, self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2.Length -1 do
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:draw_pattern_line_direct(patternId, patternDictionary, bingoCellManager)
	if CS.System.Object.ReferenceEquals(self.item.CurrentLineRenderer, nil) then
		return
	end

	local cellIndexList = patternDictionary[patternId]
	local startCellPos = bingoCellManager:GetCellPosition(cellIndexList[0])
	local endCellPos = bingoCellManager:GetCellPosition(cellIndexList[cellIndexList.Length - 1])

	self.item.CurrentLineRenderer:SetPosition(0, startCellPos)
	self.item.CurrentLineRenderer:SetPosition(1, endCellPos)

	if self.item.CurrentLineRenderer.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
		self.item.CurrentLineRenderer.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.item.currentLineIndex = self.item.currentLineIndex + 1
	bingoCellManager:CheckRewardCellItem(patternId)
end

function local_class:reset_line_renderer()
	self.item.currentLineIndex = 0

	for i = 0, self.item.lineRenderers.Length - 1 do
		self.item.lineRenderers[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2.Length -1 do
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:get_axis_line_effect(patternId)
	local axisZ = 0
	if patternId == 1 then
		axisZ = -45
	elseif patternId == 2 then
		axisZ = 45
	elseif patternId > 7 then
		axisZ = -90
	end
	return CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.Euler(0, 0, axisZ)
end

function local_class:game_end()
end

function local_class:reset_fx()
	for i = 0, self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2.Length -1 do
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_line_effect2[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2.Length -1 do
		self.item.fx_ui_bingo_check2[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('BossSpeech')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	self.speech_frame_count = 0
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.label_bg_01 = item.transform:Find("Content/SpeechBox/Background01"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))
	self.label_bg_02 = item.transform:Find("Content/SpeechBox/Background02"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))
end

function local_class:set_speech(key, text, text_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, label_bg_color, dialogue)
	local play_dialogue
	if dialogue ~= nil then
		play_dialogue = dialogue
	else
		play_dialogue = true
	end

	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(
			self.item,
			util.cs_generator(self.speech_routine, self, key, text, text_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, label_bg_color, play_dialogue))
end

function local_class:set_speech_async(key, text, text_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, label_bg_color, dialogue)
	local play_dialogue
	if dialogue then
		play_dialogue = dialogue
	else
		play_dialogue = true
	end

	self:speech_routine(key, text, text_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, label_bg_color, play_dialogue)
end

function local_class:speech_routine(key, text, text_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, label_bg_color, dialogue)
	-- speech_routine이 시작할때 frame_count 저장
	-- 중간에 self.speech_frame_count와 frame_count 다르면 코루틴 종료 되도록해야함
	self.speech_frame_count = CS.UnityEngine.Time.frameCount
	local frame_count = self.speech_frame_count

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.item.label.color = text_color

	if font_size > 0 then
		self.item.label.fontSize = font_size
	else
		self.item.label.fontSize = 24
	end

	self.label_bg_01.color = label_bg_color
	self.label_bg_02.color = label_bg_color

	-- 보이스 관련
	local dialogue_voice_holder
	if dialogue and key then
		dialogue_voice_holder = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlayDialogue(key)
	end

	local voice_playing = false
	if dialogue_voice_holder then
		voice_playing = dialogue_voice_holder.IsUsing
	end

	if type_speed <= 0 then
		self.item.label.text = text
	else
		self.item.label.text = ""

		for i = 1, #text do
			local time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < type_speed do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				time_passed = time_passed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			end

			-- 대사 출력 도중 다른 대사 나오면 현재 루틴 종료
			if frame_count ~= self.speech_frame_count then
				if voice_playing then
					dialogue_voice_holder:Stop()
				end
				return
			end

			self.item.label.text = string.sub(text, 1, i)
		end
	end

	-- 대기시간과 보이스 출력 동안 기다림
	local time_passed = 0
	while(time_passed < wait_time or voice_playing) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		-- 대사 출력 도중 다른 대사 나오면 현재 루틴 종료
		if frame_count ~= self.speech_frame_count then
			if voice_playing then
				dialogue_voice_holder:Stop()
			end
			return
		end

		-- 보이스 재생 상태 체크
		if voice_playing then
			if not dialogue_voice_holder.IsUsing then
				voice_playing = false
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
	end

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.label_bg_01 = nil
	self.label_bg_02 = nil

	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	self.boss_speech = nil

function local_class:load_resource_async()
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	coroutine.yield(self.resholder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Oak.UI.BossSpeech.AssetName,
			function(p)
				local speech_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
				self.boss_speech = speech_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.BossSpeech)).GetControllerLuaTable
				speech_go:SetActive(false)
			end))
	self.is_array = function(table)
		return table ~= nil and type(table) == 'table' and table[1] ~= nil
	end
end

function local_class:play_boss_speech(string_key, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, label_color, bg_color, dialogue)
	local text
	local key
	if self.is_array(string_key) then
		text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:FormatWithReservedKeywords(table.unpack(string_key))
		key = string_key[1]
	else
		text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(string_key)
		key = string_key
	end

	self.boss_speech:set_speech(key, text, label_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, bg_color, dialogue)
end

	local key
	if self.is_array(string_key) then
		text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:FormatWithReservedKeywords(table.unpack(string_key))
		key = string_key[1]
	else
		text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(string_key)
		key = string_key
	end

	return self.boss_speech:set_speech_async(key, text, label_color, font_size, type_speed, wait_time, bg_color, dialogue)

	end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
		self.resholder = nil
	end

	self.boss_speech = nil
	self.is_array = nil

	-- onClick
	self.on_next_button = function()
		if self.item.IsTransition then
			return
		end

		if not self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:get_active_next() then
			return
		end

		-- 현재 마지막 위치인지
		local next_stage = self.current_click_stage_num + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.move_menu, self, next_stage, self.direct_next))

			return
		end

end

function local_class:load_effect_pool_progress()
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_liveevent_story_nextbutton_alarm')

	coroutine.yield(self:is_pool_loading())
end

function local_class:add_object_pool(preset_name)
	local object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_name)
	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:is_pool_loading()
	local is_loaded_all = true
	while true do
		is_loaded_all = true

		for k,v in pairs(self.pool_table) do
			if v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded and
					v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.LoadFailed then
				is_loaded_all = false
			end
		end

		if is_loaded_all then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:begin()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].OnClickedLua = self.on_button_click
	end

	local effect = self.pool_table['fx_ui_liveevent_story_nextbutton_alarm']:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:init_etc(effect, "idle")

	self:init_story_button()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function local_class:init_story_button()
	-- 스테이지 스펙에 맞게 셋팅
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if i >= self.item.eventStageSpecs.Count then
			break
		end

		self.item.storyButtons[i]:SetButton(self.item.eventStageSpecs[i])
	end

	local clear_stage_btn
	local states = self.item.states

	local cleared_state = states.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	if states.IsStageCleared then
		if cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
			clear_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, states.PrevStageName)
		end
	end

	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, states.PrevStageName)

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		local stage_num = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum

		if stage_num == self.messenger_stage_one then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				if not self.item.IsFirstEnter then
					self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
				end
			end
		-- FixMe: 스테이지 추가시
		elseif stage_num == self.messenger_stage_two or stage_num == self.messenger_stage_three
				or stage_num == self.messenger_stage_four then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		end

	end

	-- 별만 추가로 획득한 경우
	if states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
		local stage = stage_data:GetStage(states.PrevStageName)

		local stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(stage.Id))
		local state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(states.StageStateDiff))

		local stageState = stage_state & state_diff

		-- 연출에 의해 StageGrade 가 변화할 예정이므로 변하기 전의 값으로 별 상태를 업데이트 한다.
		-- FixMe: 스테이지 추가시
		prev_stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_state(stageState)
		if clear_stage_btn == nil and prev_stage_button.StageNum <= self.messenger_stage_four then
			self:force_world_sprite_move(prev_stage_button.StageNum)
		elseif self.item.IsNotStageState then
		-- 아무 행동없이 그냥 나온 경우
			if prev_stage_button.StageNum <= self.messenger_stage_four then
				self:force_world_sprite_move(prev_stage_button.StageNum)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:resume()
	if self.event_story_main == nil then
		return
	end

	local worldmap_bgm_name = self.event_story_main.CurrentLiveEventSpec.WorldMapBgmName

	music_player.SoundState = CS.Oak.SoundState.Lobby
	music_player.LobbyBgmName = worldmap_bgm_name

	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
end

function local_class:pause()

end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)

	local cleared_state = self.item.states.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	-- 이벤트에 처음 입장했을때 연출 작동
	if self.item.IsFirstEnter then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_first_enter_routine())
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.NextStageName)
		and self.item.states.PrevStageName ~= self.item.states.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName, self.item.states.NextStageName, self.item.states.IsStageCleared))
	elseif self.item.states.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		-- 스테이지 클리어 연출 작동
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName))
	elseif self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	else
		self.item.IsRoutine = false
	end

	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)

	self:update_new_stage()

	self:refresh_button()
end

-- 이벤트 처음 입장했을 때 연출
function local_class:stage_first_enter_routine()
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	end

	-- bg start
	self.item.bgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, self.bg_start_open_handle_Name, false)
	local duration = self.item.bgSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	-- menu start
	local animation_name = self.menu_open_handle_Name .. '_01'
	self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
	duration = self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	animation_name = self.bg_open_handle_Name .. '_01'
	self.item.bgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

	wait_for_sec(0.02)

	self.item.menuSpine.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

	wait_for_sec(duration - 0.02)

	-- 저장
	CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.SetInt(self.item.FirstEnterKeyString, 1)
	CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.Save()

	-- 첫번째 스테이지로 설정
	self:force_world_sprite_move(1)

	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine(prev_stage_name, next_stage_name, is_stage_cleared)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(next_stage_name)

	local prevStage = stage_data:GetStage(prev_stage_name)
	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prevStage.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))

	local stageState = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stageState & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (is_stage_cleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출 루틴으로 이동후 종료
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName))

		coroutine.yield(self:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name))

		return
	end

	if self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	end

	-- 다음스테이지가 이번에 오픈될 경우에는 Open 연출
	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		coroutine.yield(self:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name))
	end
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine(clear_stage_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local clear_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, clear_stage_name)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local prevStage = stage_data:GetStage(clear_stage_name)

	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prevStage.Id)
	local stage_num = clear_stage_btn.StageNum

	--effect 출력
	-- clear_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:show_effect(self.fx_aw_soul_absorb);

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.clear_sfx_Handle_Name)

	coroutine.yield(self:menu_clear_animation(stage_num))

	if self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	end

	self:stage_post_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName)
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine(stage_state)
	local prevStageButton = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, self.item.states.PrevStageName)

	local de_active_vector = vector(-4000, -4000, 0)

	local effect_1 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)
	local effect_2 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)
	local effect_3 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)

	local effect_table = {}
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_1)
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_2)
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_3)

	coroutine.yield(prevStageButton:ShowStarGradeAnimation(self.item.states.StageStateDiff, effect_table))

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.item.states.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	-- 보상 연출
	coroutine.yield(event_story_world_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, self.item.SceneManager))
end

function local_class:stage_post_clear_routine(clear_stage_name)
	local clearStageBtn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, clear_stage_name)
	local stageNum = clearStageBtn.StageNum
	--FIXME: 스테이지 추가시
	if stageNum == self.messenger_stage_four then
		if self.item.IsLocked then
			self.item:ShowEventStoryClearPopup()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name)
	local nextButton = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, next_stage_name)

	user_progress:SetStageOpened(next_stage_name)

	local stage_num = nextButton.StageNum

	-- 넘어가는 연출 전에 표시되는 UI On
	nextButton.GetControllerLuaTable:open()
	nextButton.GetControllerLuaTable:set_arrow_obj(false)

	coroutine.yield(self:move_menu(stage_num, self.direct_next, true))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
end

--region BG spine Anim
function local_class:bg_idle_animation()
	-- 스토리 idle_m_01 ~ idle_m_04
	local animation_name = self.bg_idle_handle_Name .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num

	self.item.bgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, true)
end

function local_class:bg_move_animation(bg_direct)
	local animation_name = ''
	local direct_number = self.current_click_stage_num

	if bg_direct == self.direct_prev then
		direct_number = direct_number + 1
		-- 스토리 prev
		animation_name = self.bg_prev_handle_name .. '_0' .. direct_number .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num

	elseif bg_direct == self.direct_next then
		direct_number = direct_number - 1
		-- 스토리 next
		animation_name = self.bg_next_handle_name .. '_0' .. direct_number .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num
	end

	self.item.bgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
end

--endregion

--region menu Spine Anim
function local_class:menu_idle_animation()
	local activate_name = 'deactivated'

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum == self.current_click_stage_num then
			if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then
				activate_name = 'activated'
			end
			break
		end
	end

	-- 스토리 idle_m_01 ~ idle_m_04
	local animation_name = self.menu_idle_handle_Name .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num .. '_' .. activate_name
	self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, true)
end

function local_class:menu_move_animation(menu_direct)
	local animation_name = ''
	local direct_number = self.current_click_stage_num

	if menu_direct == self.direct_prev then
		direct_number = direct_number + 1
		-- 스토리 prev
		animation_name = self.menu_prev_handle_name .. '_0' .. direct_number .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num
	elseif menu_direct == self.direct_next then
		direct_number = direct_number - 1
		-- 스토리 next
		animation_name = self.menu_next_handle_name .. '_0' .. direct_number .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num
	end

	self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
	local duration = self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	wait_for_sec(duration - 0.1)
end

function local_class:menu_active_animation(stage_num)
	-- 스토리 idle_m_01 ~ idle_m_04
	local animation_name = self.menu_activate_handle_Name .. '_0' .. stage_num
	self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
	local duration = self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

function local_class:menu_clear_animation(stage_num)
	-- 스토리 idle_m_01 ~ idle_m_04
	local animation_name = self.menu_deactivate_handle_Name .. '_0' .. stage_num

	self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
	local duration = self.item.menuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	wait_for_sec(duration - 0.5)
end
--endregion

--region select
function local_class:pre_select_stage()
	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
end

function local_class:post_select_stage()
	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
end
--endregion

-- 스테이지 UI로 이동
function local_class:force_world_sprite_move(stage_number)
	self.current_click_stage_num = stage_number

	self:bg_idle_animation()
	self:menu_idle_animation()
	self:refresh_story_button()
end

function local_class:update_new_stage()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then

			-- new 스테이지일 경우 이펙트 출력
			--local effect = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_new_movie']:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero);
			--self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:show_red_dot_effect(effect);
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_menu(stage_num, direct, is_skip)
	if is_skip == nil then
		is_skip = false
	end

	if not is_skip then
		self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
		self.item.IsTransition = true
		get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	end

	self.current_click_stage_num = stage_num
	self:refresh_button()

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.move_menu_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.bg_move_animation, self, direct))
	coroutine.yield(self:menu_move_animation(direct))

	if is_skip then
		self:bg_idle_animation()
		self:refresh_story_button()

		local current_button = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, self.item.states.NextStageName)

		--effect 출력
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.new_open_sfx_Handle_Name)

		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		current_button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_arrow_obj(true)

		coroutine.yield(self:menu_active_animation(stage_num))

		self:menu_idle_animation()
	else
		self:bg_idle_animation()
		self:menu_idle_animation()

		self:refresh_story_button()
	end

	if not is_skip then
		self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
		self.item.IsTransition = false
		get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_button()
	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_prev(true)
	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_next(true)

	-- 첫번째 스테이지 위치면 prev 버튼을 off 함
	if self.current_click_stage_num == self.messenger_stage_one then
		self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_prev(false)
	end

	local new_stage = -1
	local last_open_stage_num = -1
	local first_num = 0
	--FIXME: 스테이지 4추가시 수정
	local last_num = self.messenger_stage_four

	if self.story_button_length < last_num then
		last_num = self.story_button_length
	end

	for i = first_num, last_num - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:is_open_function() then
			last_open_stage_num = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum
		end

		if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then
			new_stage = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum
		end
	end

	-- 마지막 스테이지 위치면 next 버튼을 off 함
	if self.current_click_stage_num == last_open_stage_num then
		self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_next(false)
	end

	self.item.bridgeStoryMessengerEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:refresh_stage_num(self.current_click_stage_num, new_stage)
end

function local_class:refresh_story_button()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum == self.current_click_stage_num then
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
		else
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown then
		self.on_prev_button()
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown or
		    e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown then
		self.on_next_button()
	elseif not CS.Oak.VirtualCursor.Enabled and e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then
		for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
			if self.item.storyButtons[i].gameObject.activeSelf then
				self.on_button_click(self.item.storyButtons[i])
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:finish()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i]:Finish()
	end

	self.pool_table = nil
end

function local_class:select_stage_transition(select_stage_spec)
	coroutine.yield(self.item:SelectStageTransition(select_stage_spec))
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	local current_state = int_stage_state & unlocked
	local current_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(current_state)

		self.item.stars:SetActive(true)

		local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length
		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			local star_grade_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.StarGradeStates[i])
			local grade_state = int_stage_state & star_grade_state
			local grade_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(grade_state)

			if grade_state_int ~= 0 then
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(true)
				self.item.starOffList[i]:SetActive(false)
			else
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
				self.item.starOffList[i]:SetActive(true)
			end
		end

		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)

		if not is_unity_null(self.item.starEmpty) then
			self.item.starEmpty:SetActive(false)
		end
	else
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
			if not is_unity_null(self.item.starEmpty) then
				self.item.starEmpty:SetActive(true)
			end
		end

		-- 이벤트가 진행 중일 때 첫 번째 스테이지인 경우 무조건 별을 켜줌
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState and self.item.StageNum == self.item.FirstStageNum then
			self.item.stars:SetActive(true)
		else
			self.item.stars:SetActive(false)
		end

		local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length
		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_point_and_cost_obj(is_active)
	self.item.pointObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.costInfoObj:SetActive(false)

	if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
		self.item.pointObj:SetActive(is_active)
	else
		self.item.costInfoObj:SetActive(is_active)
	end
end

function local_class:set_active(is_active)
	self.item.buttonCollider.enabled = is_active
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)

	if is_active then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.display_obj_start_animation, self, 1.0))
		self.item.transform.localPosition = self.local_default_pos
	else
		self.item.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end
end

function local_class:display_obj_start_animation(target_alpha)
	if is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) or not self.item.displayObj.gameObject.activeSelf then
		return
	end

	self.item.displayObj.alpha = 0

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.UI.UIAnimations.Alpha(self.item.displayObj, self.alpha_change_duration, target_alpha))
end

function local_class:open()
	self.is_open = true

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) then
		self.item.displayObj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.item:SetEventCallback()

	-- 외전일 경우
	if not self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
		local flag = not self.item.stars.activeSelf
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(flag)
		return
	end

	-- 별이 활성화된 상태이면
	if self.item.stars.activeSelf then
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)
		return
	end

	local stage_one = 1
	local sub_stage_one = 5

	-- 첫번째 스테이지는 제외
	if self.item.StageNum ~= stage_one and self.item.StageNum < sub_stage_one then
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(true)

		local live_event
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
			live_event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.LiveEvents[self.event_id]
		else
			live_event = nil
		end

		if is_unity_null(live_event) then
			return
		end

		local stage_point = self.item.StagePoint:GetDecrypted()
		local live_event_point = live_event.Points:GetDecrypted()

		local check_point = stage_point > live_event_point

		if check_point then
			self.item.pointLabel.text = '[ff0000]'..stage_point..'[-]'
		else
			self.item.pointLabel.text = ''..stage_point
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_red_dot_effect(pooled_obj)
	if pooled_obj == nil then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.arrow_obj) then
		pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.arrow_obj
	else
		pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.item.transform
	end

	pooled_obj.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	pooled_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	pooled_obj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:show_effect(pooled_obj)
	if pooled_obj == nil then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.effect_obj) then
		pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.effect_obj
	else
		pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.item.transform
	end

	pooled_obj.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	pooled_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	pooled_obj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:set_arrow_obj(is_active)
	if self.arrow_obj ~= nil then
		self.arrow_obj.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
	end

	if self.glow_obj ~= nil then
		self.glow_obj.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.item:UnSetEventCallback()
end

function local_class:is_open_function()
	return self.is_open
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
