		self.pooled_unity_obj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.spine_animation_name = animation_name
end

function local_class:get_active_next()
	if not is_unity_null(self.item.nextButtonBoxCollider) then
		return self.item.nextButtonBoxCollider.enabled
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_active_prev()
	if not is_unity_null(self.item.prevButtonBoxCollider) then
		return self.item.prevButtonBoxCollider.enabled
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_active_prev(is_active)
	if not is_unity_null(self.item.prevButtonBoxCollider) then
		self.item.prevButtonBoxCollider.enabled = is_active
	end

	if is_active then
		self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
	else
		self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end
end

function local_class:set_active_next(is_active)
	if not is_unity_null(self.item.nextButtonBoxCollider) then
		self.item.nextButtonBoxCollider.enabled = is_active
	end

	if is_active then
		self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
	else
		self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end
end

function local_class:resume()
	local idle_ani_name = self.spine_animation_name
	local idle_new_ani_name = self.spine_animation_name .. '_new'

	self.item.prevSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_ani_name, true)
	self.item.prevNewSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_new_ani_name, true)

	self.item.nextSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_ani_name, true)
	self.item.nextNewSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_new_ani_name, true)
end

function local_class:set_active(is_active)

		self.item.btnParentObj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
	else
		self.item.btnParentObj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_stage_num(current_stage_num, new_stage)
	local current_red_dot = self.red_dot_direct_none

	if new_stage == -1 then
		self:arrow_animation(current_red_dot)
		return
	end

	if current_stage_num < new_stage then
		current_red_dot = self.red_dot_direct_next
	elseif current_stage_num > new_stage then
		current_red_dot = self.red_dot_direct_prev
	end

	self:arrow_animation(current_red_dot)
end

function local_class:arrow_animation(direct)
	if self.item.prevSpine == nil or self.item.prevSpine.AnimationState == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.item.nextSpine == nil or self.item.nextSpine.AnimationState == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.red_dot_direct_next == direct then
		if self:get_active_prev() then
			self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self:get_active_next() then
			self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
			self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		end

		if self.pooled_unity_obj ~= nil then
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.parent = self.item.nextNewSpine.transform
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end
	elseif self.red_dot_direct_prev == direct then
		if self:get_active_prev() then
			self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
			self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		end

		if self:get_active_next() then
			self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self.pooled_unity_obj ~= nil then
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.parent = self.item.prevNewSpine.transform
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end
	else
		if self:get_active_prev() then
			self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self:get_active_next() then
			self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self.pooled_unity_obj ~= nil then
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		end
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarGimmickTableUI')

function local_class:init()

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_id = 360

	self.iron = false
	self.wood = false
	self.gunpowder = false
	self.rock = false
	self.parts = false

	self.item_state = {
		none = -1,
		iron = 0,
		wood = 1,
		gunpowder = 2,
		rock = 3,
		parts = 4,
	}
end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
end

function local_class:init_table_ui()
	self.item.itemObjs[0]:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemObjs[1]:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemObjs[2]:SetActive(false)

	self.item.backGroundParentObj:SetActive(false)

	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)
end

function local_class:set_active(active)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(active)
end

function local_class:start_init()
	-- 아이템 3개
	self.item.itemObjs[0]:SetActive(true)
	self.item.itemObjs[1]:SetActive(true)
	self.item.itemObjs[2]:SetActive(true)

	-- 백그라운드 부모
	self.item.backGroundParentObj:SetActive(true)

	-- 백그라운드 2개
	self.item.itemBackGroundSprites[0]:SetActive(true)
	self.item.itemBackGroundSprites[1]:SetActive(true)

	-- 중간 아이템 3개
	self.item.itemSecondSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemSecondSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemSecondSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 중간 물음표 3개
	self.item.itemFailSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemFailSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemFailSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 결과 아이템 3개
	self.item.itemResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemResultSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 결과 물음표 3개
	self.item.itemFailResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemFailResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemFailResultSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:start_ui(value)
	self:start_init()

	self.iron = false
	self.wood = false
	self.gunpowder = false
	self.rock = false
	self.parts = false

	-- 강철, 나무가 아닐경우엔 2개만 나옴. Bg 2개를 서로 토글형식 처리.
	if value ~= CS.Oak.IngredientType.Iron and value ~= CS.Oak.IngredientType.Wood then
		self.item.itemObjs[2]:SetActive(false)
		self.item.itemBackGroundSprites[0]:SetActive(false)
		self.item.itemBackGroundSprites[1]:SetActive(true)
	else
		self.item.itemBackGroundSprites[0]:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemBackGroundSprites[1]:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 아이템에 해당하는 테이블을 불러옴
	local gimmick_table, state = self:get_gimmick_table(value)

	-- 첫번째 스프라이트 출력
	self:first_sprite_insert(gimmick_table)

	-- 두번째 스프라이트 출력
	self:second_sprite_insert(gimmick_table, state)

	-- 결과 스프라이트 출력
	self:result_sprite_insert(gimmick_table, state)
end

function local_class:first_sprite_insert(table)
	local total = table.total
	local first_num = 1

	self.item.itemFirstSprites[0].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_1[first_num]
	self.item.itemFirstSprites[1].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_2[first_num]

	if total == 3 then
		self.item.itemFirstSprites[2].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_3[first_num]
	end
end

function local_class:second_sprite_insert(table, state)
	if state == self.item_state.iron or state == self.item_state.wood then
		self.gunpowder = self:get_is_craft(table.gunpowder)
		self.rock = self:get_is_craft(table.rock)
		self.parts = self:get_is_craft(table.parts)

		self:set_second_sprite(table, self.gunpowder, self.rock, self.parts)
	elseif state == self.item_state.gunpowder or state == self.item_state.rock or state == self.item_state.parts then
		self.iron = self:get_is_craft(table.iron)
		self.wood = self:get_is_craft(table.wood)

		self:set_second_sprite(table, self.iron, self.wood, false)
	end
end

function local_class:set_second_sprite(table, visible_1, visible_2, visible_3)
	local total = table.total
	local second_num = 2

	if visible_1 then
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[0].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_1[second_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if visible_2 then
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[1].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_2[second_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if total == 3 then
		if visible_3 then
			self.item.itemSecondSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.item.itemSecondSprites[2].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_3[second_num]
		else
			self.item.itemFailSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:result_sprite_insert(table, state)
	if state == self.item_state.iron or state == self.item_state.wood then
		self:set_result_sprite(table, self.gunpowder, self.rock, self.parts)
	elseif state == self.item_state.gunpowder or state == self.item_state.rock or state == self.item_state.parts then
		self:set_result_sprite(table, self.iron, self.wood, false)
	end
end

function local_class:set_result_sprite(table, visible_1, visible_2, visible_3)
	local total = table.total
	local result_num = 3

	if visible_1 then
		self.item.itemResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemResultSprites[0].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_1[result_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if visible_2 then
		self.item.itemResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemResultSprites[1].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_2[result_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if total == 3 then
		if visible_3 then
			self.item.itemResultSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.item.itemResultSprites[2].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_3[result_num]
		else
			self.item.itemFailResultSprites[2].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_gimmick_table(value)
	local return_table = {}
	local state = self.item_state.none

	if value == CS.Oak.IngredientType.Iron then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.iron
		state = self.item_state.iron
	elseif value == CS.Oak.IngredientType.Wood then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.wood
		state = self.item_state.wood
	elseif value == CS.Oak.IngredientType.Gunpowder then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.gunpowder
		state = self.item_state.gunpowder
	elseif value == CS.Oak.IngredientType.Rock then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.rock
		state = self.item_state.rock
	elseif value == CS.Oak.IngredientType.Parts then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.parts
		state = self.item_state.parts

	elseif gimmick_str == 'barrel' then

	end

	end

	if self.max_hp_bar_num < num then
		num = self.max_hp_bar_num
	end

	self.current_max_hp_bar_num = num

	local length = self.item.hpGauge.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if i < self.current_max_hp_bar_num then

	local ui_world_pos = self.ui_camera:ViewportToWorldPoint(ui_pos)

	local ray = self.ui_camera:ViewportPointToRay(ui_pos)
	local ray_max_distance = 100
	local count = CS.UnityEngine.Physics.RaycastNonAlloc(ray, self.raycast_hit_array, ray_max_distance, self.ray_casting_allow_layer)

	if count >= 1 then
		return true
	end

	-- UI 레이어에서 누른거면 동작하지 않도록.
	self.cross_hair_req_id = self.cross_hair_req_id + 1

	self:play_fps_hand_anim('shoot', false, 'idle')
	self:play_random_fire_sfx()

	if self.cross_hair_req_id == 100000 then
		self.cross_hair_req_id = 0
	end

	self.item.crossHairObj.transform.position = vector_util.get_xy0(ui_world_pos)

function local_class:cross_hair_playing()
	local req_id = self.cross_hair_req_id
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_time = 0.3

	-- 시작 시 0.3초 대기
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < start_time do
		if req_id ~= self.cross_hair_req_id then
			return
		end

		self.item.crossHairWidget.alpha = 1

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 0.3초간 서서히 투명
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < start_time do
		if req_id ~= self.cross_hair_req_id then
			return
		end

		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / start_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0, progress)

		self.item.crossHairWidget.alpha = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.item.crossHairWidget.alpha = 0
end

	local sfx = random_util.get_values_in_array(self.fire_sfx_list, { count = 1, overlap = true })[1]

	if game_string.IsRTL then
		local hand_scale = self.item.fpsHandSpine.transform.localScale
		local hand_pos = self.item.fpsHandSpine.transform.localPosition

		self.item.fpsHandSpine.transform.localPosition = vector(-hand_pos.x, hand_pos.y, hand_pos.z)
		self.item.fpsHandSpine.transform.localScale = vector(-hand_scale.x, hand_scale.y, hand_scale.z)

	local hand_moving_start_pos = hand_original_pos - vector(0, self.fps_hand_move_dist_y, 0)

	hand_transform.localPosition = hand_original_pos

	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:make_button()
	local bundle_name = "ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/worldmap/common"
	local button_prefab = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, bundle_name, 'worldmap_button_new_lua', function(prefab)
				button_prefab = prefab
			end)

	if is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		return
	end

	local buttons = self.item.stageParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder))
	local length = buttons.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local stage_name = buttons[i].name
		self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:Add(stage_name, buttons[i])

		local btn = buttons[i]
		local btn_t = btn.transform
		local savedRotation = btn_t.localRotation
		btn_t.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		local savedScale = btn_t.localScale
		btn_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		local button_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_prefab)
		local button_obj_t = button_obj.transform
		button_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
		button_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		local button = button_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

		if not is_unity_null(button) then
			button.StageName = btn.name

			local stage_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.worldmapParent, stage_name)

			if stage_obj ~= nil then
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj.gameObject)
			end

			-- 사울 지역일 경우 따로 체크를 위해 테이블에 삽입
			if table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.saul_stage, stage_name) then
				self.saul_stage_object_table[stage_name] = stage_obj.gameObject
			end

			self.stage_button_dic:Add(button.StageName, button)

			button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_gray_scale(self.is_gray_scale)
			button.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button_value(nil)

			button:SetButton(btn)

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(button.StageName) then
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

				if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(button.StageName) then
					button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
				end
			else
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
			end

			btn_t.localRotation = savedRotation
			btn_t.localScale = savedScale
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_path()
	self.path_placeholder_array = self.item.pathParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder))

	if self.path_placeholder_array == nil then
		return
	end

	local length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length
	local info_length = table_util.get_size(self.path_placeholder_info_table)

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local parent_name = self.path_placeholder_array[i].transform.parent.name

		if info_length ~= 0 or table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, parent_name) then
			local path_info = self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name]
			path_info[self.path_placeholder_array[i].name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

			self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name] = path_info
		else
			local world_map_path_placeholder_info = {}
			world_map_path_placeholder_info[self.path_placeholder_array[i].name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

			self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name] = world_map_path_placeholder_info
		end

		self:set_path_state(parent_name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name)
	end

	return
end

function local_class:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)
	if table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, parent_name) then

		local path_info = self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name]

		if table_util.contain_key(path_info, path_name) then
			return path_info[path_name]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, path_state)
	local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			value:Remove(path_name)
			value:Add(path_name, path_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from, to, path_state)
	if path_state == nil then
		path_state = self.path_state.none
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	if path_state == self.path_state.none then
		path_state = self:get_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from, to)
	end

	local points = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	local from_button = path_placeholder.From
	local to_button = path_placeholder.To

	if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
		if path_placeholder.Hidden then
			return
		end

		self.point_num = 0

		-- Straight path 일때 설정
		if path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight then
			-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
			local total_points = {}
			total_points[1] = from_button.transform.position

			local point_size = table_util.get_size(points)
			for i = 1, point_size do
				total_points[i + 1] = points[i]
			end

			total_points[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

			self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, total_points, path_placeholder.worldmapPathType, false)
		else

		end
	elseif path_state == self.path_state.closed then
		-- 해당 pathName 으로 생성되어있던 오브젝트 가 없다면 새로 생성한다.
		local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

		if has_value then
			self.path_name_dic:Remove(p_name)
			local path_table = self.path_table[parent_name]
			local path_size = table_util.get_size(path_table)
			local remove_pos = -1

			for i = 1, path_size do
				if path_table[i] == p_name then
					remove_pos = i
					break
				end
			end

			table.remove(path_table, remove_pos)
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(value)

			local line = self.straight_line_info[p_name]
			self.straight_line_info[p_name] = nil

			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(line)
		end

		self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.closed)
	end
end

function local_class:get_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from_stage_name, to_stage_name)
	local from_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(from_stage_name)
	local to_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(to_stage_name)

	local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			if value_2 == self.path_state.closed and string.find(path_name, 'default') then
				if from_stage_opened and to_stage_opened then
					value:Remove(path_name)
					value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

					return self.path_state.opened
				end
			end

			return value_2
		end
	end

	local stage_meta_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageMetaData')
	local from_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(from_stage_name)
	local stage_progress = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Instance:GetStageProgress(from_stage_spec)
	local is_no_exit = true

	if not is_unity_null(stage_progress) then
		local exit_store = stage_progress[CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.Exit]
		local key_value = stage_meta_data:GetExitIndex(from_stage_spec.Tilemap, path_name)
		local is_key = false
		if key_value ~= -1 then
			is_key = true
		end

		if is_key then
			if exit_store == nil then
				is_no_exit = true
			else
				is_no_exit = not exit_store:GetBoolean(key_value)
			end
		end
	end

	if is_no_exit then
		local dic = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
		dic:Add(path_name, self.path_state.none)

		if not self.path_state_dic:ContainsKey(parent_name) then
			self.path_state_dic:Add(parent_name, dic)
		else
			has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
			if has_value then
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.none)
			end
		end

		-- default path 면 나가지 않고 stageOpen 상태까지 체크함
		if not string.find(path_name, 'default') then
			return self.path_state.none
		end
	else
		local dic = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
		dic:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

		if not self.path_state_dic:ContainsKey(parent_name) then
			self.path_state_dic:Add(parent_name, dic)
		else
			has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
			if has_value then
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)
			end
		end
	end

	if from_stage_opened and to_stage_opened then
		has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
		if has_value then
			local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
			if has_value_2 then
				value:Remove(path_name)
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)
			end
		end

		--self.path_state_dic[parent_name][path_name] = self.path_state.opened
		return self.path_state.opened
	end

	has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			value:Remove(path_name)
			value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.closed)
		end
	end

	return self.path_state.closed
end

function local_class:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, point_table, path_type, new_line, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)

	if point_length == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 해당 pathName 으로 생성되어있던 오브젝트 가 없다면 새로 생성한다.
	local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name
	local has_value, path = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

	if not has_value then
		path = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject(p_name)
		self.path_name_dic:Add(p_name, path)

		if table_util.contain_key(self.path_table, parent_name) then
			local path_table = self.path_table[parent_name]
			table.insert(path_table, p_name)
			self.path_table[parent_name] = path_table
		else
			self.path_table[parent_name] = {}
			local path_table = {}
			table.insert(path_table, p_name)
			self.path_table[parent_name] = path_table
		end
	end

	local path_t = path.transform
	path_t:SetParent(self.item.pathParentT)

	path_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	path_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	if path_type == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve then
		self:make_curve_line(path_placeholder, p_name, point_table, progress)
	else
		self:make_straight_line(path_placeholder, p_name, point_table, new_line, progress)
	end
end

function local_class:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)
	local point_table = {}
	local way_points = path_placeholder.Path

	if way_points == nil or way_points.Length == 0 then
		if is_unity_null(path_placeholder.reversePathPlaceholder) then
			return nil
		end

		-- 반대 방향이 존재하면 해당 방향의 path를 가져옴 (추가 안한 상태)
	end

	for i = 0, way_points.Length - 1 do
		table.insert(point_table, way_points[i].position)
	end

	return point_table
end

function local_class:get_path_name(from, to)
	local path_placeholder_length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	-- from, to가 비어 있어서는 안된다
	if from == nil or to == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for i = 0, path_placeholder_length - 1 do
		-- from 스테이지와 to 스테이지가 같으면 from -> waypoins -> to 순서로 배열에 넣어 리턴한다.
		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, from) and string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, to) then
			return self.path_placeholder_array[i].name
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:make_curve_line(path_placeholder, path_name, point_table, progress)

end

function local_class:make_straight_line(path_placeholder, path_name, point_table, new_line, progress)
	if path_placeholder.Hidden then
		return
	end

	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	if new_line == nil then
		new_line = false
	end

	local point_value = 12
	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	local position_count = point_value * (point_length - 1)

	-- 현재 progress 를 기준으로 opened 로 표시해야할 길이를 구한다.
	local cur_progress = 1

	if progress >= 0 then
		cur_progress = progress
	end

	local temp_count = position_count * cur_progress
	local length = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(temp_count)
	local line_length = point_value
	local line = nil

	if not table_util.contain_key(self.straight_line_info, path_name) then
		local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line')

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
		end

		path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
		line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))

		self.straight_line_info[path_name] = line
		self:set_straight_line(line)
	elseif new_line then
		local path_name_transform = nil
		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path_name_transform = value.transform
		end

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(path_name_transform, 'line_new')

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path_transform.gameObject, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))
		else
			local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line_new')
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
			path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
			line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))
		end

		self:set_straight_line(line)
	else
		line = self.straight_line_info[path_name]
	end

	local vec_length = 1

	if point_length > 2 then
		vec_length = self:get_total_path_length(point_table) * self.path_straight_line_draw_factor
	end

	line.positionCount = length

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		local from = point_table[i]
		local to = point_table[i + 1]
		local line_index = (i - 1) * point_value

		local temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

		if temp_point_num == i then
			self.point_num = self.point_num + 1
			temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

			if not path_placeholder.Hidden and temp_point_num > 2 then
				if self.path_point ~= nil then
					local point_obj = game_object.Instantiate(self.path_point, line.transform.parent)
					point_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.path_point_rotation)
					point_obj.transform.localPosition = point_table[i]
					point_obj.transform.localScale = self.path_point_scale

					if progress > -1 then
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_path_point_sfx_handle_name)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for index = 0, line_length - 1 do
			local convert_value = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(index)
			local t =  convert_value / (line_length - 1)
			local point = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, t)

			if line_index >= length then
				return
			end

			line:SetPosition(line_index, point)
			line_index = line_index + 1

			line.material.mainTextureScale = vector(line_index * vec_length, 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_straight_line(line)
	line.material = self.line_material

	line.startWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.endWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.shadowBias = 0
	line.useWorldSpace = false

	line.sortingLayerName = 'Default'
	line.sortingOrder = 10
end

function local_class:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local total_length = 0

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	if way_point_table == nil or point_length == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		total_length = total_length + (way_point_table[i + 1] - way_point_table[i]).magnitude
	end

	return total_length
end

function local_class:setting_camera(camera)
	self.mobile_touch_camera = camera

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		return
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMin = self.camera_boundary_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMax = self.camera_boundary_max

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	else
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) and user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
		local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition

		self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)
	else
		local last_stage_position = self.item:GetPreviousStageButtonPosition()

		self:set_camera_local_pos(last_stage_position)
	end
end

function local_class:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)
	local new_pos = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = new_pos
end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	local cleared_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	self.is_routine = true

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
			and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	self.is_routine = false
end

function local_class:stage_second_enter_routine(parent_name, path_name)
	while self.item.IsSpineLoading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 해당 스테이지로 카메라 이동
	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))
	-- 오픈 연출
	self.world_map_controller:region_saul_open()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.saul_open_sfx_handle_name)

	-- 원할한 애니메이션을 위해 각 스테이지 애니메이터 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		if v ~= nil then
			if table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.saul_stage, v.StageName) and v.StageAnimator ~= nil then
				v.StageAnimator.enabled = false
			end
		end
	end

	local wait_time = self.world_map_controller:get_saul_open_animation_time()

	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(function()
		self.world_map_controller:after_region_saul_on(wait_time)
	end))

	-- 나머진 기존 그대로
	self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.opened)

	coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
			self.world_map_state.CustomEvent))
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine()
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prev_stage_spec.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	local stage_state = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stage_state & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출을 보여준다.
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

		user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
		self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local parent_name = path_transform.name
	local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName

	-- 이동할 스테이지가 이번에 오픈될 경우에는 Open 연출후에 이동한다.
	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		-- 2스테이지 최초 클리어시에 별도 연출
		if self.world_map_state.PrevStageName == self.check_enter_stage_name and path_name == self.check_exit_handle_name then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_second_enter_routine(parent_name, path_name))
		else
			coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

			self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.opened)

			coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
					self.world_map_state.CustomEvent))
		end

		-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
		-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
		user_progress:SetStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.AdditionalOpenStage)
	else
		-- 다음 스테이지가 오픈이 되어있다면, 스테이지 이동만 한다.
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

		local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)

		if has_value then
			local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
			if has_value_2 then
				local path_state = value_2

				if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
					coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName))
				else
					value:Remove(path_name)
					value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

					coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName,
							self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.CustomEvent))
				end
			else
				coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName))
			end
		else
			coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName))
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지 입장 패널 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_stage_enter_panel_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.focus_camera_size))
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
	-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
	self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
	self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	coroutine.yield(prev_stage_button:ShowGetStarGrade(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	-- 연출 처리를 위해 비워주기 전에 캐싱
	local stage_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	coroutine.yield(world_map_background_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, prev_stage_spec.ChapterCode, CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance.SceneManager, nil))
end

function local_class:clear_stage(cleared_stage)
	local clear_stage_bBtn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(cleared_stage)

	if clear_stage_bBtn ~= nil then
		clear_stage_bBtn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'victory_get', false)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
end

function local_class:hidden_stage(stage_name)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage_name)

	stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_is_idle_animation(false)
	stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden_active_false()

	--path도 숨겨야 할지 하면서 확인 예정
	local length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local parent_name = self.path_placeholder_array[i].transform.parent.name

		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, stage_name) or string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, stage_name) then
			self:set_path_state(parent_name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, self.path_state.closed)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:open_and_move_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event)
	local prev_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(prev_stage)
	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	local dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	if open_stage_btn.transform.parent.localPosition.x < prev_stage_btn.transform.parent.localPosition.x then
		dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'clap', true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = dir

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, false, custom_event))

	coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(prev_stage, open_stage))
end

function local_class:open_stage(param_list)
	return util.cs_generator(self.open_stage_start, self, param_list[0], param_list[1], param_list[2], param_list[3])
end

function local_class:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, wait_open_complete , custom_event)
	if wait_open_complete == nil then
		wait_open_complete = false
	end

	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	if custom_event then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_sub_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event))
		return
	end

	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	if open_stage_btn ~= nil then
		if not self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(open_stage) then
			coroutine.yield(open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가
			local effect_name = self.main_open_stage_effect_name
			local effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(open_stage_btn.transform.position)

			effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)

			effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	if not self.is_teleport_move then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_path(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event))
	end

	if wait_open_complete then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:open_sub_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event)
	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	if open_stage_btn == nil then
		return
	end

	coroutine.yield(open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.open_path, self, prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event))

	open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

	-- 이펙트 출력 추가

	local effect_name = self.main_open_stage_effect_name
	local effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(open_stage_btn.transform.position)

	effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)

	effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:open_path(from, to, custom_event)
	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, from)
	local parent_name = ''

	if path_transform ~= nil then
		parent_name = path_transform.name
	end

	-- from이 nil일 경우는 제일 처음 오픈 연출뿐
	if from == nil then
		return
	end

	local path_name = ''

	if custom_event then
		-- custom_event가 true 이면 newStageTheatre 중이기 때문에 default path 출력
		path_name = 'default_sub'
	elseif self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		-- exit로 나왔을 경우
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	else
		path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	if point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- straight path만 대응
	coroutine.yield(self:open_straight_path(path_placeholder, parent_name, path_name, point_table))
end

function local_class:open_straight_path(path_place, parent_name, path_name, point_table)
	local from_button = path_place.From
	local to_button = path_place.To

	-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
	local total_points = {}
	total_points[1] = from_button.transform.position

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		total_points[i + 1] = point_table[i]
	end

	total_points[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

	local time_passed = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local progress = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)

	self.point_num = 0

	while time_passed < time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(time_passed, 0, time)

		progress = time_passed / time

		self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, total_points, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, false, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_stage(from_stage, to_stage)
	-- 길이 hidden 상태일 때는 텔레포트로 이동 (해당 스테이지의 디폴트 위치로 간다)
	if self.is_teleport_move then
		wait_for_sec(self.character_mario_jump_duration)

		coroutine.yield(self:teleport_move_stage(to_stage))

		return
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, from_stage)
	local parent_name = ''

	if path_transform ~= nil then
		parent_name = path_transform.name
	end

	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from_stage, to_stage)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	local way_point_table = self:get_waypoints_full_path(parent_name, from_stage, to_stage)

	if path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve then
		--way_point_table = self:get_curve_waypoint_full_path(parent_name, from_stage, to_stage)
	end

	local total_length = self:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local speed = total_length / self.character_move_duration

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_walk_animation_name(character_info), true)

	-- 월드맵 걷는 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.world_map_walking_sfx_handle_name)

	if way_point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(way_point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	local way_point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	for i = 1, way_point_length - 1 do
		local spine_controller_transform = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform
		spine_controller_transform.localPosition = way_point_table[i]

		local dir = way_point_table[i+1] - spine_controller_transform.localPosition

		self.spine_controller.Direction = dir:GetX0z():ToDirection()

		local spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition
		local is_destination = spine_local_position:GetXz() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXz()

		while is_destination do
			local move_delta = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition

			local move_position = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(spine_local_position, way_point_table[i+1], move_delta)

			self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = move_position
			is_destination = move_position:GetXz() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXz()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
end

function local_class:teleport_move_stage(to_stage)

end

function local_class:get_waypoints_full_path(parent_name, from, to)
	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(from)
	local to_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(to)

	local way_point_pos_table = {}
	way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = point_table[i]
	end

	return way_point_pos_table
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress(param_list)
	local stage_name = param_list[0]
	local target_camera_size = param_list[1]
	local duration = param_list[2]
	local check_stage_opened = param_list[3]

	return util.cs_generator(self.set_focus_progress_start, self, stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress_start(stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
	if check_stage_opened then
		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)

	local targetPos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	targetPos = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(targetPos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(chapter_code)
	local stage = nil

	if target_stages == nil or target_stages.Length == 0 then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	local stage_length = target_stages.Length

	self:init_finger_object_table()

	for i = 0, stage_length - 1 do
		if target_stages[i] ~= nil then
			stage = self.stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[i])
		end

		if stage == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		if self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] == nil then
			local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] = { is_open = false, effect = nil }
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].is_open = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stages[i])

		local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

		if is_unity_null(button) then
			return false
		end

		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect.transform.parent = button.transform
		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		::continue::
	end

	self:show_finger(true)
	return true
end

function local_class:init_finger_object_table()
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v.is_open = false
			if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			local local_finger_obj = v.effect

			if v.is_open and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
			v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_spine_character(param_list)
	self.spine_controller = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_spine_character_start, self)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local characterPrefab = nil

	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
		characterPrefab = prefab
	end))

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(characterPrefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name
		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지를 방금 클리어한 상태
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
		local parent_name = ''

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			parent_name = path_transform.name
		end

		local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
		local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

		if path_placeholder == nil then
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
		else
			self.is_teleport_move = path_placeholder.Hidden

			local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

			if button_placeholder ~= nil then
				character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0()
			end
		end
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then

		-- 캐릭터 초기 세팅 (애니메이션, 방향, 상태등)
		self.world_map_util.init_spine_character(game_data_service, character, self.spine_controller, character_info, 55,
				self.character_weapon_attachment_shader_selector, vector(45, 0, 0), self.item.IsHideCharacter, self.item.SpineTopShader)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre(param_list)
	local scene_obj = param_list[0]
	local narrations = param_list[1]
	local field_ui_narration_box = param_list[2]
	local open_stage = param_list[3]
	local bgm_state = param_list[4]
	local prev_bgm_name = param_list[5]

	return util.cs_generator(self.new_stage_theatre_start, self, scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre_start(scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
	local shear_field_obj = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('shear')
	local shear_controller = nil
	local previous_shear = 0

	if shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		shear_controller = shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController))
		previous_shear = shear_controller.Shear
		shear_controller.Shear = 0
	end

	local cur_button_placeholder = nil

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		cur_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
	end

	local open_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(open_stage)

	self:hidden_stage(open_stage)

	-- 월드맵 카메라로 변경
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	local init_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local local_position = open_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition

	target_camera_position = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		local_position = cur_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
		init_camera_position = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)
	else
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		init_camera_position = target_camera_position
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = init_camera_position

	scene_obj:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 세팅이 끝나면 Fade In 해준다.
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeInAsync(0.75, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		local duration = 1.5
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_progress_start(open_stage, self.focus_camera_size, duration, false))
	end

	local shake_duration = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)
	local shake_magnitude = 0.06

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_earthquake_01')

	while shake_calculator.IsActive do
		shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local new_pos = target_camera_position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset:GetX0z()
		self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = new_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = target_camera_position

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(self.item.TargetStageName, open_stage, true, true))

	--서버 패킷 처리 및 연출이 종료된 후 UserProgress 를 업데이트 한다.
	user_progress:SetStageOpened(open_stage)

	if field_ui_narration_box ~= nil then
		local field_ui_narration_box_transform = field_ui_narration_box.transform
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.position = vector(0,0,10)
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		coroutine.yield(field_ui_narration_box:ContinuityShowHide(narrations, 0, 2))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	else
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeOutAsync(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(prev_bgm_name, bgm_state)

	if shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = self.previous_shear
	end

	if shear_controller ~= nil then
		shear_controller.Shear = self.previous_shear
	end
end

function local_class:get_last_open_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_main_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(spec_name) then
			stage_name = spec_name
		else
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:resume()
	if self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = false

		-- controller, 스테이지버튼 resume 처리
		if self.world_map_controller ~= nil then
			self.world_map_controller:resume(self.is_gray_scale, self.is_flowering)
		end

		-- 각 버튼 resume 처리
		for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.is_pause = true
end

function local_class:etc_setting()
	-- 검은 꽃 처리 (스케일 조정)
	local default_scale = 0.25
	local flower_scale_data = self.constants_data.flower_scale

	for k,v in pairs(flower_scale_data) do
		if user_progress:IsStageCleared(k) then
			if default_scale < v.scale then
				default_scale = v.scale
			end
		end
	end

	self.world_map_controller = self.item.worldmapParent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.CivilWarWorldMapController)).GetControllerLuaTable

	-- 해당 scale 값을 검은 꽃에 적용
	self.world_map_controller:set_flower_scale(default_scale)

	-- 현재 메인 진행상황을 가져와서 월드맵 상태 플래그를 조정
	self.is_gray_scale = false
	self.is_flowering = false

	if self.main_quest_progress == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.gray_scale_progress then
		-- 흑백 처리
		self.is_gray_scale = true
	end

	if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.flowering_progress then
		-- 꽃 개화 처리
		self.is_flowering = true
	end

	-- 특정 프로그레스 이후 bgm을 변경해준다.
	if self.is_gray_scale and CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance.CurrentWorldMapBgm = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_mono'
	end
end

function local_class:world_map_controller_setting()
	-- saul 스테이지가 전부 active 된 상태면 넘어간다.
	for k,v in pairs(self.saul_stage_object_table) do
		while true do
			if v.activeInHierarchy then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 사울 첫지역이 이미 오픈되어 있으면 애니메이터를 끈다.
	if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(self.default_saul_open_stage_name) then
		self.world_map_controller:region_saul_on()
	else
	-- 사울 오픈 안된 상태면 감추는 애니메이션 재생
		self.world_map_controller:set_region_saul_animator(true)
		self.world_map_controller:region_saul_off()
	end

	if self.is_gray_scale then
		-- 배경 gray
		self.world_map_controller:bg_gray_animation()
	end

	-- progress 상태에 따라 꽃 애니메이션 다르게 재생
	if self.is_flowering then
		self.world_map_controller:flowering_animation()
	elseif self.is_gray_scale then
		self.world_map_controller:flower_stop_idle_animation()
	else
		self.world_map_controller:flower_idle_animation()
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.pool_table = nil
	self.finger_object_table = nil
	self.path_state = nil
	self.saul_stage_object_table = nil
	self.world_map_controller = nil

	self.path_placeholder_array = nil
	self.path_placeholder_info_table = nil
	self.path_state_dic = nil
	self.straight_line_info = nil
	self.curve_line_info = nil
	self.curve_line_position_info = nil
	self.path_table = nil

	if self.spine_res_holder ~= nil then
		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:stage_setting()
	local length = self.item.landmarkOnObjs.Length

	-- 켜져있는 On 랜드마크 전부 끈다
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.item.landmarkOnObjs[i]:SetActive(false)
	end

	while not self.item.parentObj.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local animation_name = ''

	-- 스테이지 애니메이션 상태 전부 off로 변경
	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_animator_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			animation_name = k..'_off'
			v:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
		end
	end

	self:flower_idle_animation()
end

function local_class:stage_animation()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local start_size = self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView
	local end_size = self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView * 0.5
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local camera_time = 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, progress)

		self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView = end_size

	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine.yield(self:shake_ani(0.3, 0.06))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine.yield(self:shake_ani(0.3, 0.06))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.bg_demon_animator.speed = 0.8
	self.bg_saul_animator.speed = 0.8
	self.world_bg_animator.speed = 0.8
	self.world_bg_saul_animator.speed = 0.8

	self.bg_demon_animator:Play('bg_demon_gray_idle_change', -1, 0)
	self.bg_saul_animator:Play('bg_saul_gray_idle_change', -1, 0)
	self.world_bg_animator:Play('world_bg_gray_demon_idle_change', -1, 0)
	self.world_bg_saul_animator:Play('world_bg_gray_saul_idle_change', -1, 0)
	self.flower_animator:Play('black_flower_bloom', -1, 0)

	local animation_name = ''

	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_animator_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			animation_name = k..'_gray_off_change'

			v.speed = 0.8
			v:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
		end
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_blackflower_02')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.shake_ani, self, 6, 0.06))

	self.effect_obj:SetActive(true)

	start_size = self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView
	end_size = 22
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	camera_time = 4

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, progress)

		self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:flower_stop_idle_animation()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.flower_animator, 'black_flower_bloom_stop_idle'))
end

function local_class:shake_ani(duration, magnitude)
	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	shake_calculator:Shake(magnitude, duration)

	local target_camera_position = self.world_map_camera.transform.localPosition

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_blackflower_01')

	while shake_calculator.IsActive do
		shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local new_pos = target_camera_position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		self.world_map_camera.transform.localPosition = new_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--쉐이크
	self.world_map_camera.transform.localPosition = target_camera_position
end

function local_class:stage_camera_zoom()
	local start_size = self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView
	local end_size = 24
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local camera_time = 1.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, progress)

		self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.world_map_camera.fieldOfView = end_size
end

function local_class:get_animation_time(animator, animation_name)
	local ac = animator.runtimeAnimatorController

	local length = ac.animationClips.Length
	local time = 0

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if ac.animationClips[i].name == animation_name then
			time = ac.animationClips[i].length
			break
		end
	end

	return time
end

function local_class:set_region_saul_animator(enabled)
	self.region_saul_animator.enabled = enabled
end

function local_class:region_saul_off()
	self.current_region_saul_state = self.saul_state.off

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.region_saul_animator, 'saul_off'))
end

	self.current_region_saul_state = self.saul_state.on

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.region_saul_animator, 'saul_open'))
end

function local_class:region_saul_on()
	self.current_region_saul_state = self.saul_state.on

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.region_saul_animator, 'saul_on'))
end

function local_class:after_region_saul_on(wait_time)
	self.current_region_saul_state = self.saul_state.on

	if wait_time == nil then
		wait_time = 2
	end

	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.region_saul_animator, 'saul_on'))
end

function local_class:bg_gray_animation()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.bg_demon_animator, 'bg_demon_gray_idle'))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.bg_saul_animator, 'bg_saul_gray_idle'))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.world_bg_animator, 'world_bg_gray_demon_idle'))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.world_bg_saul_animator, 'world_bg_gray_saul_idle'))
end

function local_class:world_map_animation(animator, animation_name)
	if animator == nil then
		return
	end

	while not animator.gameObject.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
end

function local_class:set_flower_scale(scale_value)
	if scale_value > 1 then
		scale_value = 1
	end

	local scale = self.flower_max_scale * scale_value

	self.item.blackFlowerObj.transform.localScale = scale
end

function local_class:get_saul_open_animation_time()
	local time = self:get_animation_time(self.region_saul_animator, 'saul_open')

	return time
end

function local_class:flowering_animation()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.flower_animator, 'black_flower_no_cocoon_idle'))
end

function local_class:flower_idle_animation()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.world_map_animation, self, self.flower_animator, 'black_flower_bud_idle'))
end

function local_class:resume(is_gray_scale, is_flowering)
	if self.current_region_saul_state == self.saul_state.on then
		self:region_saul_on()
	else
		self:region_saul_off()
	end

	if is_gray_scale then
		self:bg_gray_animation()
	end

	if is_flowering then
		self:flowering_animation()
	elseif is_gray_scale then
		self:flower_stop_idle_animation()
	else
		self:flower_idle_animation()
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.shear_field_obj = nil
	self.shear_controller = nil
	self.mobile_touch_camera = nil
	self.touch_input = nil
	self.region_saul_animator = nil
	self.region_state = nil
	self.saul_state = nil
	self.stage_animator_table = nil

	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('CoopRaidMvpSymbol')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	wait_for_sec = function(delay)
		local s = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
		while CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - s < delay do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.on_spine_event_func = function(entry, event)
		local key = event.Data.Name

		if (key == "fx") then
			self:on_spine_event_fx()
		elseif (key == "hero") then
			self:on_spine_event_hero()
		end
	end
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
end

function local_class:show_animation(user, delay)
	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(
			self.item.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_animation_routine, self, user, delay))
end

-- mvp를 설정한다
function local_class:set_mvp(mvpType)
	self.item.mvpType = mvpType
end

function local_class:show_animation_routine(user, delay)
	self.item.bgAnimation.AnimationState:Event('+', self.on_spine_event_func)

	self.user = user
	local i = self.item

	i.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	i.textWidget.alpha = 0
	local p = i.textWidget.transform.localPosition
	p.y = -255
	i.textWidget.transform.localPosition = p

	wait_for_sec(delay)

	i.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	i.bgAnimation.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, i.mvpType .. "_start", false)

	wait_for_sec(i.bgAnimation.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration)

	i.bgAnimation.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, i.mvpType .. "_idle", true)
	self.item.bgAnimation.AnimationState:Event('-', self.on_spine_event_func)
end

function local_class:on_spine_event_fx()
	self.item.effect:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:on_spine_event_hero()
	local i = self.item
	i.userName.text = self.user.Name

	local c = i.mvpCharacter
	c.SortingLayer = "UI"
	c.SortingOrder = 10;
	c:UpdateCharacter(self.user.RepresentativeCharacter)

	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(i.gameObject, util.cs_generator(self.text_fade_in, self))
end

function local_class:text_fade_in()
	local i = self.item
	local t = i.textWidget.transform
	local p = t.localPosition

	local time = 0
	local duration = 0.08

	local to_go = -15

	while (time < duration) do
		local delta = CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

		p.y = p.y + to_go * delta / duration
		t.localPosition = p

		i.textWidget.alpha = time / duration

		time = time + delta
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	i.textWidget.alpha = 1
end

function local_class:finish()
	local i = self.item
	i.mvpCharacter:Dispose();
	i.bgAnimation:ClearState();
	i.effect:SetActive(false)
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()

end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

		util.cs_generator(self.make_button, self),
		util.cs_generator(self.make_path, self)
	})

	local has_value, value = self.item.User.PreviousStage:TryGetValue(self.item.ChapterName)
	self.prev_stage_name = value

	self:refresh_button_and_path(true)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EnterStageStartEvent), 'on_enter_stage_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EnterStageEndEvent), 'on_enter_stage_end_event')

	self.is_world_map_loading = false
end

function local_class:pre_load_resource()
	local bundle_name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/worldmap/common'

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'worldmap_point_on'), function(prefab)
				self.path_point = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'worldmap_point_on_circle'), function(prefab)
				self.path_point_circle = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'worldmap_dot'), function(prefab)
				local material_container = prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MaterialContainer))

					self.line_material = material_container.MaterialList[0]
				end
			end))
		end),

		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/worldmap/common', 'WorldMapLoopChange'), function(prefab)
				self.change_loop_prefab = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(get_ui_scene_manager().UIRootTransform, prefab)
				self.change_loop_ui = self.change_loop_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapLoopChange))

				local next_button = self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:get_next_button()
				local prev_button = self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:get_prev_button()

				event_delegate.Set(next_button.onClick, self.on_next_button)
				event_delegate.Set(prev_button.onClick, self.on_prev_button)
			end))
		end)
	})

function local_class:load_effect_pool_progress()

	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_worldmap_stage_on')

	coroutine.yield(self:is_pool_loading())
end

function local_class:add_object_pool(preset_name)
