	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:is_pool_loading()
	local is_loaded_all = true
	while true do
		is_loaded_all = true

		for k,v in pairs(self.pool_table) do
			if v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded and
					v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.LoadFailed then
				is_loaded_all = false
			end
		end

		if is_loaded_all then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:make_button()
	local chapter_data = CS.Oak.ChapterData.Value:GetChapterData(self.item.ChapterCode)
	local chapter_name = chapter_data.ChapterName
	local bundle_name = "ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/worldmap/common"

	local button_prefab = nil

	--local sw = CS.System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, bundle_name, 'worldmap_button_new_lua', function(prefab)
				button_prefab = prefab
			end)

	--print('worldmap_button LoadPrefabAsync, '..sw.ElapsedMilliseconds..'ms')

	--sw = CS.System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew()

	if is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		return
	end

	local buttons = self.item.stageParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder))
	local length = buttons.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local stage_name = buttons[i].name
		self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:Add(stage_name, buttons[i])

		local btn = buttons[i]
		local btn_t = btn.transform
		local savedRotation = btn_t.localRotation
		btn_t.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		local savedScale = btn_t.localScale
		btn_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		local button_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_prefab)
		--local button_obj = buttons[i].transform:GetChild(0)
		local button_obj_t = button_obj.transform
		button_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
		button_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		local button = button_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

		if not is_unity_null(button) then
			button.StageName = btn.name

			local world_map_stage_name = self:get_world_map_stage_name(button.StageName)
			local stage = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.worldmapParent, world_map_stage_name)

			button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage.gameObject)

			self.stage_button_dic:Add(button.StageName, button)

			button.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button_value(nil)
			button:SetButton(btn)

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(button.StageName) then
				local button_stage_num = button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_stage_num()

				if self.last_open_stage_num < button_stage_num then
					self.last_open_stage_num = button_stage_num
				end
			end

			btn_t.localRotation = savedRotation
			btn_t.localScale = savedScale
		end
	end

	--print('Make Button for loop, '..length..' buttons, '..sw.ElapsedMilliseconds..'ms')

	self.current_loop_num = self:get_current_loop_num(self.last_open_stage_num)
end

function local_class:make_path()
	--local sw = CS.System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew()

	self.path_placeholder_array = self.item.pathParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder))

	local length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length
	local info_length = table_util.get_size(self.path_placeholder_info_table)

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local parent_name = self.path_placeholder_array[i].transform.parent.name

		if info_length ~= 0 or table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, parent_name) then
			local path_info = self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name]
			path_info[self.path_placeholder_array[i].name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

			self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name] = path_info
		else
			local world_map_path_placeholder_info = {}
			world_map_path_placeholder_info[self.path_placeholder_array[i].name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

			self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name] = world_map_path_placeholder_info
		end

		self:set_path_state(parent_name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name)
	end

	--print('MakePath , '..sw.ElapsedMilliseconds..'ms')
	return
end

function local_class:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)
	if table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, parent_name) then

		local path_info = self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name]

		if table_util.contain_key(path_info, path_name) then
			return path_info[path_name]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, path_state)
	local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			value:Remove(path_name)
			value:Add(path_name, path_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from, to, path_state)
	if path_state == nil then
		path_state = self.path_state.none
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	if path_state == self.path_state.none then
		path_state = self:get_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from, to)
	end

	local points = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	local from_button = path_placeholder.From
	local to_button = path_placeholder.To

	if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
		self.point_num = 0

		if path_placeholder.Hidden then
			return
		end

		-- Straight path 일때 설정
		if path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight then
			-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
			local total_points = {}
			total_points[1] = from_button.transform.position

			local point_size = table_util.get_size(points)
			for i = 1, point_size do
				total_points[i + 1] = points[i]
			end

			total_points[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

			self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, total_points, path_placeholder.worldmapPathType, false)
		else
			local local_point_1 = {}
			local local_point_2 = {}
			local local_point_3 = {}
			-- 시작부터 path0까지 Straight path
			local_point_1[1] = from_button.transform.position
			local_point_1[2] = points[1]

			-- 설정한 Curve path
			local_point_2[1] = points[1]
			local_point_2[2] = points[2]

			-- path1부터 도착지점까지 Straight path
			local_point_3[1] = points[2]
			local_point_3[2] = to_button.transform.position

			self.point_num = self.no_path_point_num
			self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, local_point_1, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, false)
			self.point_num = 0
			self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, local_point_2, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve, false)
			self.point_num = self.no_path_point_num
			self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, local_point_3, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, true)
		end
	elseif path_state == self.path_state.closed then
		-- 해당 pathName 으로 생성되어있던 오브젝트 가 없다면 새로 생성한다.
		local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

		if has_value then
			self.path_name_dic:Remove(p_name)
			table.remove(self.path_table, parent_name)
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(value)
		end

		self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.closed)
	end
end

function local_class:get_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from_stage_name, to_stage_name)
	local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			return value_2
		end
	end

	local stage_meta_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageMetaData')
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local from_stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(from_stage_name)
	local stage_progress = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Instance:GetStageProgress(from_stage_spec)
	local is_no_exit = true

	if not is_unity_null(stage_progress) then
		local exit_store = stage_progress[CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.Exit]
		local key_value = stage_meta_data:GetExitIndex(from_stage_spec.Tilemap, path_name)
		local is_key = false
		if key_value ~= -1 then
			is_key = true
		end

		if is_key then
			if exit_store == nil then
				is_no_exit = true
			else
				is_no_exit = not exit_store:GetBoolean(key_value)
			end
		end
	end

	if is_no_exit then
		local dic = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
		dic:Add(path_name, self.path_state.none)

		if not self.path_state_dic:ContainsKey(parent_name) then
			self.path_state_dic:Add(parent_name, dic)
		else
			has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
			if has_value then
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.none)
			end
		end

		if not string.find(path_name, 'default') then
			return self.path_state.none
		end
	else
		local dic = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
		dic:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

		if not self.path_state_dic:ContainsKey(parent_name) then
			self.path_state_dic:Add(parent_name, dic)
		else
			has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
			if has_value then
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)
			end
		end
	end

	local from_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(from_stage_name)
	local to_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(to_stage_name)

	if from_stage_opened and to_stage_opened then
		has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
		if has_value then
			local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
			if has_value_2 then
				value:Remove(path_name)
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)
			end
		end

		--self.path_state_dic[parent_name][path_name] = self.path_state.opened
		return self.path_state.opened
	end

	has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			value:Remove(path_name)
			value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.closed)
		end
	end

	--self.path_state_dic[parent_name][path_name] = self.path_state.closed
	return self.path_state.closed
end

function local_class:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, point_table, path_type, new_line, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)

	if point_length == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 해당 pathName 으로 생성되어있던 오브젝트 가 없다면 새로 생성한다.
	local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name

	local has_value, path = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

	if not has_value then
		path = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject(p_name)
		self.path_name_dic:Add(p_name, path)

		if table_util.contain_key(self.path_table, parent_name) then
			local path_table = self.path_table[parent_name]
			table.insert(path_table, p_name)
			self.path_table[parent_name] = path_table
		else
			self.path_table[parent_name] = {}
			local path_table = {}
			table.insert(path_table, p_name)
			self.path_table[parent_name] = path_table
		end
	end

	local path_t = path.transform
	path_t:SetParent(self.item.pathParentT)

	path_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	path_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	if self:check_reverse_path(path_placeholder) then
		return
	end

	if path_type == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve then
		self:make_curve_line(path_placeholder, p_name, point_table, progress)
	else
		self:make_straight_line(path_placeholder, p_name, point_table, new_line, progress)
	end
end

function local_class:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)
	local point_table = {}

	local way_points = path_placeholder.Path

	if way_points == nil or way_points.Length == 0 then
		if is_unity_null(path_placeholder.reversePathPlaceholder) then
			return nil
		end

		-- 반대 방향이 존재하면 해당 방향의 path를 가져옴
		local reverse_parent_name = path_placeholder.To.name
		local reverse_path_name = path_placeholder.reversePathPlaceholder.name
		local reverse_path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(reverse_parent_name, reverse_path_name)

		way_points = reverse_path_placeholder.Path

		if way_points == nil or way_points.Length == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		for i = 0, way_points.Length - 1 do
			table.insert(point_table, way_points[way_points.Length - i - 1].position)
		end

		return point_table
	end

	for i = 0, way_points.Length - 1 do
		table.insert(point_table, way_points[i].position)
	end

	return point_table
end

function local_class:get_path_name(from, to)
	local path_placeholder_length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	-- from, to가 비어 있어서는 안된다
	if from == nil or to == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for i = 0, path_placeholder_length - 1 do
		-- from 스테이지와 to 스테이지가 같으면 from -> waypoins -> to 순서로 배열에 넣어 리턴한다.
		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, from) and string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, to) then
			return self.path_placeholder_array[i].name
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:check_reverse_path(path_placeholder)
	if is_unity_null(path_placeholder.reversePathPlaceholder) then
		return false
	end

	local reverse_parent_name = path_placeholder.To.name
	local reverse_path_name = path_placeholder.reversePathPlaceholder.name
	local reverse_path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(reverse_parent_name, reverse_path_name)
	local reverse_p_name = reverse_path_name..'_'..reverse_parent_name

	if reverse_path_placeholder == nil or reverse_path_placeholder.Hidden then
		return false
	end

	if reverse_path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve then
		if table_util.contain_key(self.curve_line_info, reverse_p_name) then
			return true
		end
	else
		if table_util.contain_key(self.straight_line_info, reverse_p_name) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:make_curve_line(path_placeholder, path_name, point_table, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	if path_placeholder.Hidden then
		return
	end

	local line = nil
	if not table_util.contain_key(self.curve_line_info, path_name) then
		local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line')

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
		end

		path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')

		line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))

		self:set_straight_line(line)
		self.curve_line_info[path_name] = line
	else
		line = self.curve_line_info[path_name]
	end

	local position_count = 25

	if path_placeholder.PositionCount ~= 0 then
		position_count = path_placeholder.PositionCount
	end

	local cur_progress = 1

	if progress > 1 then
		cur_progress = 1
	elseif 	progress >= 0 then
		cur_progress = progress
	end

	local center = (point_table[1] + point_table[2]) * 0.5
	center.y = center.y + 2

	if not CS.FloatExtensions.IsAlmostZero(path_placeholder.LineHeight) then
		center.y = path_placeholder.LineHeight
	end

	local temp_count = position_count * cur_progress
	local length = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(temp_count)
	line.positionCount = length

	local vec_length = self:get_total_path_length(point_table) * self.path_curve_line_draw_factor

	local curve_position_info = {}

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local convert_value = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(i)
		local time = convert_value / (position_count - 1)
		local point = self:get_bezier_curve(point_table[1], center, point_table[2], time)

		line:SetPosition(i, point)

		curve_position_info[i] = point

		local b_point = self.point_num == 0 and i == self.point_num
		local b_point_2 = self.point_num == 1 and i == position_count - 1
		-- 시작과 끝 point에 추가
		if b_point or b_point_2 then
			self.point_num = self.point_num + 1

			if not path_placeholder.Hidden then
				if self.path_point_circle ~= nil then
					local point_obj = game_object.Instantiate(self.path_point_circle, line.transform.parent)
					point_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.path_point_rotation)
					point_obj.transform.localPosition = point_table[self.point_num]
					point_obj.transform.localScale = self.path_point_scale

					if progress > -1 then
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_path_point_sfx_handle_name)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		line.material.mainTextureScale = vector(i * vec_length, 1)
	end

	self.curve_line_position_info[path_name] = curve_position_info
end

function local_class:make_straight_line(path_placeholder, path_name, point_table, new_line, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	if new_line == nil then
		new_line = false
	end

	local point_value = 12
	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	local position_count = point_value * (point_length - 1)

	-- 현재 progress 를 기준으로 opened 로 표시해야할 길이를 구한다.
	local cur_progress = 1

	if progress >= 0 then
		cur_progress = progress
	end

	local temp_count = position_count * cur_progress
	local length = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(temp_count)
	local line_length = point_value

	if path_placeholder.Hidden then
		return
	end

	local line = nil

	if not table_util.contain_key(self.straight_line_info, path_name) then
		local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line')

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
		end

		path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
		line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))

		self.straight_line_info[path_name] = line
		self:set_straight_line(line)
	elseif new_line then
		local path_name_transform = nil
		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path_name_transform = value.transform
		end

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(path_name_transform, 'line_new')

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path_transform.gameObject, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))
		else
			local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line_new')
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
			path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
			line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))
		end

		self:set_straight_line(line)
	else
		line = self.straight_line_info[path_name]
	end

	local vec_length = 1

	if point_length > 2 then
		vec_length = self:get_total_path_length(point_table) * self.path_straight_line_draw_factor
	end

	line.positionCount = length

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		local from = point_table[i]
		local to = point_table[i + 1]
		local line_index = (i - 1) * point_value

		local temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

		if temp_point_num == i then
			self.point_num = self.point_num + 1
			temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

			if not path_placeholder.Hidden and temp_point_num > 2 then
				if self.path_point ~= nil then
					local point_obj = game_object.Instantiate(self.path_point, line.transform.parent)
					point_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.path_point_rotation)
					point_obj.transform.localPosition = point_table[i]
					point_obj.transform.localScale = self.path_point_scale

					if progress > -1 then
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_path_point_sfx_handle_name)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for index = 0, line_length - 1 do
			local convert_value = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(index)
			local t =  convert_value / (line_length - 1)
			local point = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, t)

			if line_index >= length then
				return
			end

			line:SetPosition(line_index, point)
			line_index = line_index + 1

			line.material.mainTextureScale = vector(line_index * vec_length, 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_straight_line(line)
	line.material = self.line_material

	line.startWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.endWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.shadowBias = 0
	line.useWorldSpace = false

	line.sortingLayerName = 'Default'
	line.sortingOrder = 10
end

function local_class:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local total_length = 0

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	if way_point_table == nil or point_length == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		total_length = total_length + (way_point_table[i + 1] - way_point_table[i]).magnitude
	end

	return total_length
end

function local_class:setting_camera(camera)
	self.mobile_touch_camera = camera

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		return
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMin = self.camera_boundary_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMax = self.camera_boundary_max

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
		not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then

		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	else
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) and user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
		local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition

		self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)
	else
		local last_stage_position = self.item:GetPreviousStageButtonPosition()

		self:set_camera_local_pos(last_stage_position)
	end
end

function local_class:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)
	local new_pos = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = new_pos
end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	local cleared_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	self.is_routine = true

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
		and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	self.is_routine = false
	self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine()
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local is_opened_next_dtage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)

	local prev_stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prev_stage_spec.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	local stage_state = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stage_state & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출을 보여준다.
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

		user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
		self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local parent_name = path_transform.name
	local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName

	-- 이동할 스테이지가 이번에 오픈될 경우에는 Open 연출후에 이동한다.
	if not is_opened_next_dtage then
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

		self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.opened)

		coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
				self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, true))

		-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
		-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
		user_progress:SetStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.AdditionalOpenStage)
	else
	-- 다음 스테이지가 오픈이 되어있다면, 스테이지 이동만 한다.
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
		local open_stage_num = open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_stage_num()

		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

		local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
		if has_value then
			local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
			if has_value_2 then
				local path_state = value_2

				if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
					coroutine.yield(self:change_stage_start(open_stage_num))
					coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName, 1))
				else
					value:Remove(path_name)
					value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

					coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName,
							self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, false))
				end
			else
				coroutine.yield(self:change_stage_start(open_stage_num))
				coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName, 1))
			end
		else
			coroutine.yield(self:change_stage_start(open_stage_num))
			coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName, 1))
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지 입장 패널 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_stage_enter_panel_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.focus_camera_size))
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local prev_stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
	-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
	self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
	self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine()
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local prev_stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	coroutine.yield(prev_stage_button:ShowGetStarGrade(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	-- 연출 처리를 위해 비워주기 전에 캐싱
	local stage_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	coroutine.yield(world_map_background_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, prev_stage_spec.ChapterCode, CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance.SceneManager, nil))
end

function local_class:open_and_move_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event, is_open)
	local prev_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(prev_stage)
	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	local dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	if open_stage_btn.transform.parent.localPosition.x < prev_stage_btn.transform.parent.localPosition.x then
		dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'clap', true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = dir

	-- 루프 전환 연출이 추가되어야함
	-- 연출시 캐릭터 안보이게 멀리 이동 -> 장면전환 -> 다음 루프 스테이지 on,off -> 캐릭터 텔레포트로 이동
	local open_stage_num = open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_stage_num()

	-- 막 스테이지가 오픈된 상태면 마지막 스테이지 넘버를 갱신해 줌
	if is_open then
		self.last_open_stage_num = open_stage_num
	end

	coroutine.yield(self:change_stage_start(open_stage_num))

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, false, custom_event))

	coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, 1))
end

function local_class:clear_stage(cleared_stage)
	local clear_stage_bBtn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(cleared_stage)

	if clear_stage_bBtn ~= nil then
		clear_stage_bBtn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'victory_get', false)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
end

function local_class:change_stage_start(open_stage_num)
	local open_stage_loop_num = self:get_current_loop_num(open_stage_num)

	-- 현재 루프와 같은 루프의 스테이지 일 경우 연출 진행하지 않음
	if self.current_loop_num == open_stage_loop_num then
		return
	end

	-- 장면 전환 시작 (페이드 아웃)
	coroutine.yield(self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:background_fade_out(0.7))

	-- 스파인 캐릭터 멀리 이동
	self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- button, path refresh
	self.current_loop_num = open_stage_loop_num

	self:refresh_button_and_path()

	-- 연출 끝 (페이드 인)
	coroutine.yield(self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:background_fade_in(0.5))
end

function local_class:open_stage(param_list)
	return util.cs_generator(self.open_stage_start, self, param_list[0], param_list[1], param_list[2], param_list[3])
end

function local_class:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, wait_open_complete , custom_event)
	if wait_open_complete == nil then
		wait_open_complete = false
	end

	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	if open_stage_btn ~= nil then
		if not self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(open_stage) then
			coroutine.yield(open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가
			local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
			local stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(open_stage_btn.StageName)
			local effect_name = self.main_open_stage_effect_name

			if stage_spec.IsSubStage then
				effect_name = self.sub_open_stage_effect_name
			end

			local effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)

			open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:show_open_effect(effect)

			wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)

			effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	if not self.is_teleport_move then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_path(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event))
	end

	if wait_open_complete then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:move_stage(from_stage, to_stage, duration)
	-- 길이 hidden 상태일 때는 텔레포트로 이동 (해당 스테이지의 디폴트 위치로 간다)
	if self.is_teleport_move then
		wait_for_sec(self.character_mario_jump_duration)

		coroutine.yield(self:teleport_move_stage(to_stage))

		return
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, from_stage)
	local parent_name = ''

	if path_transform ~= nil then
		parent_name = path_transform.name
	end

	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from_stage, to_stage)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	local way_point_table = self:get_waypoints_full_path(parent_name, from_stage, to_stage)

	if path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve then
		way_point_table = self:get_curve_waypoint_full_path(parent_name, from_stage, to_stage)
	end

	local total_length = self:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local speed = total_length / self.character_move_duration

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_walk_animation_name(character_info), true)

	-- 월드맵 걷는 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.world_map_walking_sfx_handle_name)

	if way_point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(way_point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	local way_point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	for i = 1, way_point_length - 1 do
		local spine_controller_transform = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform
		spine_controller_transform.localPosition = way_point_table[i]

		local dir = way_point_table[i+1] - spine_controller_transform.localPosition

		self.spine_controller.Direction = dir:GetX0z():ToDirection()

		local spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition
		local is_destination = spine_local_position:GetXz() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXz()

		while is_destination do
			local move_delta = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition

			local move_position = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(spine_local_position, way_point_table[i+1], move_delta)

			self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = move_position
			is_destination = move_position:GetXz() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXz()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
end

function local_class:teleport_move_stage(to_stage)
	local animation_name = world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(self.item.CharacterInfo)

	self.spine_controller.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, self.spine_controller:MarioJump(CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 0.3, 0.6, animation_name))
	wait_for_sec(0.01)

	local effect = self.pool_table['FX_reset_object']:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	effect.transform.parent = self.spine_controller.transform
	effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_guild_warp_01')

	-- 텔레포트로 이동 시엔 바로 toStage 위치로
	local character_t = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(to_stage)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.29)

	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', false)
	self.spine_controller.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

function local_class:open_path(from, to, custom_event)
	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, from)
	local parent_name = ''

	if path_transform ~= nil then
		parent_name = path_transform.name
	end

	-- from이 nil일 경우는 제일 처음 오픈 연출뿐
	if from == nil then
		return
	end

	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	-- customEvent가 true 이면 newStageTheatre 중이기 때문에 default path 출력
	if custom_event then
		path_name = 'default'
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	if self:check_reverse_path(path_placeholder) then
		return
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	if point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	if path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_straight_path(path_placeholder, parent_name, path_name, point_table))
	else
		coroutine.yield(self:open_curve_path(path_placeholder, parent_name, path_name, point_table))
	end
end

function local_class:open_straight_path(path_place, parent_name, path_name, point_table)
	local from_button = path_place.From
	local to_button = path_place.To

	-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
	local total_points = {}
	total_points[1] = from_button.transform.position

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		total_points[i + 1] = point_table[i]
	end

	total_points[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

	local time_passed = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local progress = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)

	self.point_num = 0

	while time_passed < time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(time_passed, 0, time)

		progress = time_passed / time

		self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, total_points, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, false, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:open_curve_path(path_place, parent_name, path_name, point_table)
	local from_button = path_place.From
	local to_button = path_place.To

	local local_point_1 = {}
	local local_point_2 = {}
	local local_point_3 = {}
	-- 시작부터 path0까지 Straight path
	local_point_1[1] = from_button.transform.position
	local_point_1[2] = point_table[1]

	-- 설정한 Curve path
	local_point_2[1] = point_table[1]
	local_point_2[2] = point_table[2]

	-- path1부터 도착지점까지 Straight path
	local_point_3[1] = point_table[2]
	local_point_3[2] = to_button.transform.position

	local passed_time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local progress = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local speed = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(3)
	local duration = 0.34

	self.point_num = self.no_path_point_num

	while passed_time < duration do
		passed_time = passed_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		passed_time = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(passed_time, 0, duration)

		progress = passed_time * speed

		self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, local_point_1, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, false, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.point_num = 0
	passed_time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)

	while passed_time < duration do
		passed_time = passed_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		passed_time = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(passed_time, 0, duration)

		progress = passed_time * speed

		self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, local_point_2, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Curve, false, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.point_num = self.no_path_point_num
	passed_time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)

	while passed_time < duration do
		passed_time = passed_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		passed_time = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(passed_time, 0, duration)

		progress = passed_time * speed

		self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, local_point_3, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, true, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:get_waypoints_full_path(parent_name, from, to)
	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	if self.is_path_move then
		return point_table
	end

	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(from)
	local to_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(to)

	if self.is_exit_center_move then
		local way_point_pos_table = {}
		way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

		local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
		for i = 1, point_size do
			way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = point_table[i]
		end

		way_point_pos_table[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

		return way_point_pos_table
	else
		local way_point_pos_table = {}
		way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

		local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
		for i = 1, point_size do
			way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = point_table[i]
		end

		return way_point_pos_table
	end
end

function local_class:get_curve_waypoint_full_path(parent_name, from, to)
	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local position_count = 25

	if path_placeholder.PositionCount ~= 0 then
		position_count = path_placeholder.PositionCount
	end

	local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name
	local way_point_table = {}
	local line = nil

	if not table_util.contain_key(self.curve_line_info, p_name) then
		-- 곡선이 hidden이라서 정보가 없음, 여기서 계산해서 넣어줌
		local paths = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)
		local center = (paths[1] + paths[2]) * 0.5

		center.y = center.y + 2

		if not CS.FloatExtensions.IsAlmostZero(path_placeholder.LineHeight) then
			center.y = path_placeholder.LineHeight
		end

		for i = 0, position_count - 1 do
			local convert_value = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(i)
			local time = convert_value / (position_count - 1)
			local point = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator.GetBezierCurve(paths[1], center, paths[2], time)

			way_point_table[i + 1] = point
		end

	else
		line = self.curve_line_info[p_name]

		position_count = line.positionCount

		local position_info = self.curve_line_position_info[p_name]

		way_point_table = position_info
	end

	if self.is_path_move then
		local way_point_pos_table = {}

		local point_size = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)
		for i = 1, point_size do
			way_point_pos_table[i] = way_point_table[i]
		end

		return way_point_pos_table
	end

	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(from)
	local to_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(to)

	if self.is_exit_center_move then
		local way_point_pos_table = {}
		way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

		local point_size = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

		for i = i, point_size do
			way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = way_point_table[i]
		end

		way_point_pos_table[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

		return way_point_pos_table
	else
		local way_point_pos_table = {}
		way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

		local point_size = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

		for i = 1, point_size do
			way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = way_point_table[i]
		end

		return way_point_pos_table
	end
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress(param_list)
	local stage_name = param_list[0]
	local target_camera_size = param_list[1]
	local duration = param_list[2]
	local check_stage_opened = param_list[3]

	return util.cs_generator(self.set_focus_progress_start, self, stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress_start(stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
	if check_stage_opened then
		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)

	local targetPos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	targetPos = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(targetPos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stage = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStage(chapter_code)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local stage = nil

	if target_stage ~= nil then
		stage = stage_data:GetStage(target_stage)
	else
		stage = stage_data:GetStage(0)
	end

	if stage == nil then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.finger_object) then
		local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

		if stage.IsSubStage then
			effect_name = self.sub_new_stage_effect_name
		end

		self.finger_object = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end

	local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

	if is_unity_null(button) then
		return false
	end

	self.finger_object.transform.parent = button.transform
	self.finger_object.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if target_stage ~= nil then
		self.is_new_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stage)
	else
		self.is_new_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(0)
	end

	self:show_finger(self.is_new_stage)
	return true
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	local local_finger_obj = self.finger_object

	if self.is_new_stage and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
		self:set_finger_object(is_show)
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	if is_unity_null(self.finger_object) then
		return
	end

	self.finger_object.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
end

function local_class:refresh_button_and_path(is_target_stage)
	if is_target_stage == nil then
		is_target_stage = false
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 button 다 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		v.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 path 다 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.path_name_dic) do
		v:SetActive(false)
	end

	local loop_start_num = 0
	local loop_end_num = 0

	if is_target_stage and self.prev_stage_name ~= nil then
		local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.prev_stage_name)

		if prev_stage_button ~= nil then
			self.current_loop_num = self:get_current_loop_num(prev_stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_stage_num())
		else
			self.current_loop_num = self:get_current_loop_num(self.last_open_stage_num)
		end
	end

	if self.current_loop_num == 0 then
		loop_start_num = self.loop_0_start
		loop_end_num = self.loop_0_end
	elseif self.current_loop_num == 1 then
		loop_start_num = self.loop_1_start
		loop_end_num = self.loop_1_end
	elseif self.current_loop_num == 2 then
		loop_start_num = self.loop_2_start
		loop_end_num = self.loop_2_end
	elseif self.current_loop_num == 3 then
		loop_start_num = self.loop_3_start
		loop_end_num = self.loop_3_end
	end

	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		local button_stage_num = v.GetControllerLuaTable:get_stage_num()

		-- 현재 루프에 해당하는 스테이지 버튼인지 확인
		if button_stage_num >= loop_start_num and button_stage_num <= loop_end_num then
			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(k) then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

				-- 해당 루프 마지막 스테이지는 텔레포트로 이동이기때문에 path가 없음
				if button_stage_num < loop_end_num and self.path_table[v.StageName] ~= nil then
					-- path 출력 처리
					local path_table =  self.path_table[v.StageName]
					local size = table_util.get_size(path_table)

					for i = 1, size do
						local p_name = path_table[i]
						local has_value, path = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

						if has_value then
							path:SetActive(true)
						end
					end
				end

				if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(k) then
					v.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- loop 버튼 처리 추가
	self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_prev(true)
	self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_next(true)

	-- 0회차이면 prev 버튼을 off 함
	if self.current_loop_num == 0 then
		self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_prev(false)
	end

	local last_loop_num = self:get_current_loop_num(self.last_open_stage_num)

	-- 마지막 회차면 next 버튼을 off 함
	if self.current_loop_num == last_loop_num then
		self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_next(false)
	end

	-- 마지막 스테이지가 아직 0회차면 루프 UI를 보여주지 않는다
	if last_loop_num == 0 then
		self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_etc(false)
	else
		self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_etc(true)
	end

	-- 루프 숫자 표시
	self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_loop_num(self.current_loop_num)
end

function local_class:move_loop(loop_num, direct)
	self.is_transition = true
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	-- 루프 연출 진행
	coroutine.yield(self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:background_fade_out(0.7))

	self.current_loop_num = loop_num
	self:refresh_button_and_path()

	-- 스파인 캐릭터 이동
	local stage_num = self:get_loop_last_stage_num(loop_num)
	local stage_name = ''

	if stage_num > self.last_open_stage_num then
		stage_num = self.last_open_stage_num
	end

	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		local button_stage_num = v.GetControllerLuaTable:get_stage_num()

		if stage_num == button_stage_num then
			stage_name = v.StageName
			break
		end
	end

	self:set_character_default_position(self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform, stage_name)

	-- 카메라를 캐릭터 위치로 이동
	local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition
	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)

	-- 루프 연출 끝
	coroutine.yield(self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:background_fade_in(0.5))

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	self.is_transition = false
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:get_current_loop_num(stage_num)
	local loop_num = 0

	if stage_num >= self.loop_0_start and stage_num <= self.loop_0_end then
		loop_num = 0
	elseif stage_num >= self.loop_1_start and stage_num <= self.loop_1_end then
		loop_num = 1
	elseif stage_num >= self.loop_2_start and stage_num <= self.loop_2_end then
		loop_num = 2
	elseif stage_num >= self.loop_3_start and stage_num <= self.loop_3_end then
		loop_num = 3
	end

	return loop_num
end

function local_class:get_loop_last_stage_num(loop_num)
	local stage_num = 0

	if loop_num == 0 then
		stage_num = self.loop_0_end
	elseif loop_num == 1 then
		stage_num = self.loop_1_end
	elseif loop_num == 2 then
		stage_num = self.loop_2_end
	elseif loop_num == 3 then
		stage_num = self.loop_3_end
	end

	return stage_num
end

function local_class:get_world_map_stage_name(stage_name)
	if table_util.contain_value(self.demonshire_plaza_table, stage_name) then
		return self.demonshire_plaza
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.demonshire_prison_table, stage_name) then
		return self.demonshire_prison
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.demonshire_pyramid_table, stage_name) then
		return self.demonshire_pyramid
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.demonshire_vampiretown_table, stage_name) then
		return self.demonshire_vampiretown
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.demonshire_sunlab_table, stage_name) then
		return self.demonshire_sunlab
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.demonshire_passage_table, stage_name) then
		return stage_name
	end

	return ''
end

function local_class:get_pad_select_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local loop_start_id, loop_end_id

	if self.current_loop_num == 0 then
		loop_start_id = self.loop_0_start_id
		loop_end_id = self.loop_0_end_id
	elseif self.current_loop_num == 1 then
		loop_start_id = self.loop_1_start_id
		loop_end_id = self.loop_1_end_id
	elseif self.current_loop_num == 2 then
		loop_start_id = self.loop_2_start_id
		loop_end_id = self.loop_2_end_id
	elseif self.current_loop_num == 3 then
		loop_start_id = self.loop_3_start_id
		loop_end_id = self.loop_3_end_id
	end

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local check_stage_name = ''

	-- NextStageName이 있을시
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) then
		check_stage_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
	else
		-- 현재 회전된 기준으로 손가락이 가리키는 스테이지를 선택
		local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(self.item.ChapterCode)

		if target_stages ~= nil and target_stages.Length > 0 then
			local stage = stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[0])
			check_stage_name = stage.Name
		end
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(check_stage_name) then
		for i = loop_start_id, loop_end_id do
			local stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(i)
			local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

			if spec_name == check_stage_name then
				stage_name = spec_name
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.prev_stage_name) then
		for i = loop_start_id, loop_end_id do
			local stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(i)
			local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

			if spec_name == self.prev_stage_name then
				stage_name = spec_name
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		-- 현재 회전된 기준으로 마지막 메인 스테이지를 반환
		for i = loop_start_id, loop_end_id do
			local stage_spec = stage_data:GetStage(i)
			local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(spec_name) then
				stage_name = spec_name
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:load_spine_character(param_list)
	self.spine_controller = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_spine_character_start, self)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local characterPrefab = nil

	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
		characterPrefab = prefab
	end))

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(characterPrefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name
		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self.item:GetLastOpenStageName()
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지를 방금 클리어한 상태
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
		local parent_name = ''

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			parent_name = path_transform.name
		end

		local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName

		local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

		if path_placeholder == nil then
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
		else
			self.is_teleport_move = path_placeholder.Hidden

			local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

			if button_placeholder ~= nil then
				character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0()
			end
		end
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then
		--  캐릭터 태생 스킨이 있는 경우 생성하자마자 지정
		if character_info.SkinName ~= nil then
			self.spine_controller.SkinName = character_info.SkinName
		end

		local create_desc = CS.Oak.WeaponAttachmentCreateDesc()
		CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(self.spine_controller, character_info, create_desc)

		local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

		self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetSubIdleAnimation(self.spine_controller)
		self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)

		self.spine_controller:SetSortingLayer('Default', 55)
		self.spine_controller.IsShadowActive = true
		self.spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localEulerAngles = vector(45, 0, 0)

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character_t, 'SpecialEvents')

		if self.item.IsHideCharacter then
			self.spine_controller.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		-- 캐릭터가 어떠한 상황에서라도 더 위에 그려질 수 있도록 함
		if self.item.SpineTopShader ~= nil then
			self.spine_controller.CustomShader = self.item.SpineTopShader
		end
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

function local_class:on_enter_stage_start_event(e)
	--self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_enter_stage_end_event(e)
	--self.change_loop_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
	return true
end

function local_class:resume()
	if not self.is_routine then
		self.change_loop_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.change_loop_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:get_bezier_curve(p0, p1, p2, t)
	local a = p0
	local b = p1
	local c = p2

	local aa = a + (b - a) * t
	local bb = b + (c - b) * t
	return aa + (bb - aa) * t
end

function local_class:finish()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EnterStageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.EnterStageEndEvent))

	self.pool_table = nil
	self.path_placeholder_array = nil
	self.path_placeholder_info_table = nil
	self.path_state_dic = nil
	self.straight_line_info = nil
	self.curve_line_info = nil
	self.curve_line_position_info = nil

	self.path_state = nil
	self.path_table = nil

	self.demonshire_plaza_table = nil
	self.demonshire_prison_table = nil
	self.demonshire_pyramid_table = nil
	self.demonshire_vampiretown_table = nil
	self.demonshire_sunlab_table = nil
	self.demonshire_passage_table = nil

	if self.spine_res_holder ~= nil then
		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.change_loop_prefab)
	self.change_loop_prefab = nil
	self.change_loop_ui = nil
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()

end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end

		for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
			local obj = stage_obj_transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
			local obj_name = obj.name

			if string.find(obj_name, 'landmark') then
				if string.find(obj_name, '_on') then
					self.land_mark_on = obj

					if self.init_landmark_sorting_order then
						self:set_land_mark_sorting_order(self.land_mark_on)
					end
				elseif string.find(obj_name, '_off') then
					self.land_mark_off = obj

					if self.init_landmark_sorting_order then
						self:set_land_mark_sorting_order(self.land_mark_off)
					end
				end

				self.is_land_mark = true
			end
		end
	end

	if string.find(self.item.StageName, 'passage') then
		self.is_passage = true
	end

	if string.find(self.item.StageName, 'substage') then
		self.is_sub_stage = true
	end

	self.item.Enabled = true

	-- 설정해준 스케일에 맞게 콜라이더 사이즈 세팅

	local scaleVec2 = vector(button_placeholder.PostitScale.x * button_placeholder.Main2PostitDefaultSize.x,
			button_placeholder.PostitScale.y * button_placeholder.Main2PostitDefaultSize.y)
	local currentScale = self.item.buttonParent.localScale

	-- 0으로 나누면 안되므로 체크
	if not float_util.is_almost_zero(currentScale.x) and not float_util.is_almost_zero(currentScale.y) then
		local boxSizeX = scaleVec2.x / currentScale.x
		local boxSizeY = scaleVec2.y / currentScale.y
		self.item.BoxCollider.size = vector(boxSizeX, boxSizeY, 0)
	end

	local postit_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.transform, 'postit')

	self.postit_sprite = postit_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimatedSprite))

	local starOffset = button_placeholder.LevelOffset
	local star_pos = self.item.starContainerSprite.transform.localPosition

	star_pos = star_pos + starOffset:GetXy0()
	self.item.starContainerSprite.transform.localPosition = star_pos

	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self:set_active_land_mark(false)

	if self.item.StageSpec.IsMainStageType then
		self.item.stageNumber.text = ''..self.item.StageSpec.StageNumber
	else
		self.item.numberCubeAnimator.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.stage_num = self.item.StageSpec.StageNumber

	-- 별 or 커피 출력
	if self.item.StageSpec.StarPieces > 0 then
		self.item.costIcon.SpriteName = 'starpiece.png'
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..self.item.StageSpec.StarPieces
	else
		self.item.costIcon.SpriteName = 'coffee.png'
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..self.item.StageSpec.StageStamina
	end


	self.item.numberCubeAnimator:SaveOriginalStatData()
	self.item.cubeAnimator:SaveOriginalStatData()

	local stageState = user_progress:GetStageState(self.item.StageSpec.Id)
	self:set_stage_state(stageState)
end

function local_class:set_stage_state(stage_state)
	local unlocked = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Unlocked)
	local int_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(stage_state)
	local current_state = int_stage_state & unlocked
	local current_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(current_state)

	local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length

	if current_state_int ~= 0 then
		self.item.stars:SetActive(true)
		self.item.costInfo:SetActive(false)

		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			local star_grade_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.StarGradeStates[i])
			local grade_state = int_stage_state & star_grade_state
			local grade_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(grade_state)

			if grade_state_int ~= 0 then
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(true)
			else
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	else
		self.item.stars:SetActive(false)
		self.item.costInfo:SetActive(true)

		-- 서브스테이지는 starList 가 설정이 안 되어있다.
		if self.item.starList == nil or self.item.starList.Length == 0 then
			return
		end

		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:open(immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.open

	self:set_active_land_mark(true)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(self.is_passage)
	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(self.is_sub_stage)
	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(self.is_land_mark)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	if self.land_mark_on ~= nil and not self.init_landmark_sorting_order then
		self:set_land_mark_sorting_order(self.land_mark_on)
	end

	local idle_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.idle_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)

	if immediate then
		self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, idle_animation_routine)
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, idle_animation_routine)

		if not is_unity_null(self.item.numberCubeAnimator) then
			self.item.numberCubeAnimator.enabled = true
		end

		local disable_open_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.disable_open_animator, self, 1)):Catch(function (e)	end)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, disable_open_routine)
	end
end

function local_class:clear(immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.clear

	if immediate then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.change_cube, self, 0, true))
	else
		-- 월드맵 클리어 SFX Play
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.stage_clear_flag_sfx_handle_name)

		if not is_unity_null(self.item.cubeAnimator) then
			self.item.cubeAnimator:Play("clear")
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.change_cube, self, 0.25, false))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.disable_clear_fx, self, 1.3))
	end
end

function local_class:idle_animation()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	if self.exception_stage_obj then
		self.stage_obj:SetActive(true)
	end

	while not self.stage_obj.activeInHierarchy do
		if not self.is_idle_animation then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_open_animation and self.add_open_animation_time < 0 then
		local wait_time = self.add_open_animation_time * -1
		wait_for_sec(wait_time)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		local animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_idle'

		if self.is_gray_scale then
			animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_gray_idle'
		end

		self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	if self.exception_stage_obj then
		self.stage_obj:SetActive(true)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_handle_name)

	if is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		return
	else
		self.item.StageAnimator.enabled = true
	end

	self.is_open_animation = true

	local animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_open'

	if self.is_gray_scale then
		animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_gray_open'
	end

	local time = self.item:GetAnimationTime(animation_name) + self.add_open_animation_time

	self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name)

	wait_for_sec(time)
end

function local_class:change_cube(delay, immediate)
	if delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.cubeRenderer) then
		self.item.cubeRenderer.enabled = false
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.stageNumber) then
		self.item.stageNumber.color = unity_color({0.58, 0.24, 0.16})
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.clearCube) then
		self.item.clearCube:SetActive(true)

		if not immediate and self.item.clearCubeFx ~= nil then
			self.item.clearCubeFx:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:disable_clear_fx(delay)
	if delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.clearCubeFx) then
		self.item.clearCubeFx:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:hidden()
	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.hidden

	if self.exception_stage_obj then
		self.stage_obj:SetActive(true)
	end

	self:set_active_land_mark(false)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = false

	local hidden_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.hidden_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, hidden_animation_routine)
end

function local_class:hidden_animation()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		return
	end

	while not self.stage_obj.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_button_state ~= self.button_state.hidden then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		self.item.StageAnimator.enabled = true

		local animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_off'

		if self.is_gray_scale then
			animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_gray_off'
		end

		self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.hidden

	self:set_active_land_mark(false)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = false

	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		return
	end

	if self.exception_stage_obj then
		self.stage_obj:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:disable_open_animator(delay)
	if delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.numberCubeAnimator) then

		meshRenderer.sortingOrder = self.item.glowSprite.SortingOrder + 1
	end

		end

		if self.land_mark_off ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_off:SetActive(false)
		end
	else
		if self.land_mark_on ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_on:SetActive(false)
		end

		if self.land_mark_off ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_off:SetActive(true)
		end
	end

	self.stage_obj.transform.localPosition = self.stage_obj_local_position + self.press_force
	self.item.transform.localPosition = self.press_force

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 버튼 클릭 SFX Play

	elseif self.current_button_state == self.button_state.open or self.current_button_state == self.button_state.clear then

end

	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end

	local contents_widget = self.item.uiContent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIWidget))

	-- 생성될때 기본 위치보다 700픽셀 아레에서 생성되도록 앵커 위치 조정
	contents_widget.topAnchor.absolute = -700;
	contents_widget.bottomAnchor.absolute = -700;

	self:show_ranking_board_mini()

	-- 아래에서 올라오는 Sfx
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ui_transition_01')

	-- 보드가 아래에서부터 올라오는 연출
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local up_time = 0.7

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < up_time do
		local cur_y_pos = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, -700, 700, up_time)

		contents_widget.cachedTransform.localPosition = vector(0, cur_y_pos, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	contents_widget.cachedTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	-- 옮겼던 위치 초기화
	contents_widget.topAnchor.absolute = 0
	contents_widget.bottomAnchor.absolute = 0

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		self:hide_ranking_board_mini()

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_blink_01')

		self:show_ranking_board_mini()

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

end

function local_class:on_control_change()
	self:refresh_position()
end

end

end

end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

require('base/class')

	self.after_world_direct_prev = 0

	self.after_story_mode = 0

	self.mode_state = 0

	-- 빛이 들어가는거, 빠지는거 두가지 추가 ?

	self.bg_start_open_handle_Name = "open"

	self.menu_next_challenge_handle_name = "pg_next_c"
	self.menu_prev_handle_name = "pg_pre_m"
	self.menu_prev_challenge_handle_name = "pg_pre_c"

	self.bg_next_handle_name = "BG_next_m"
	self.bg_next_challenge_handle_name = "BG_next_c"
	self.bg_prev_handle_name = "BG_pre_m"
	self.bg_prev_challenge_handle_name = "BG_pre_c"

	self.open_event_sfx_handle_name = "01_worldmap_aw_01"
	self.move_menu_sfx_handle_name = "01_worldmap_aw_02"
	self.ui_transition_sfx_Handle_Name = "01_ui_transition_01"
	self.open_sfx_Handle_Name = "01_worldmap_aw_03"
	self.clear_sfx_Handle_Name = "01_lobby_ghost_01"
	self.new_open_sfx_Handle_Name = "01_lobby_ghost_02"

	self.fx_aw_soul_release = nil

		if self.item.IsTransition then

			return
		end

		-- 현재 마지막 위치인지
		local next_stage = self.current_click_stage_num + 1

		if self.mode_state == self.after_story_mode then
			if self.boss_after_world_stage < next_stage then
				return
			end
		elseif self.mode_state == self.after_challenge_mode then
			if self.sub_stage_four < next_stage then
				return
			end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.move_menu, self, next_stage, self.after_world_direct_next))

		if self.item.IsTransition then
			return
		end

		if not self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:get_active_prev() then
			return
		end

		-- 현재 첫번째 위치인지
		local prev_stage = self.current_click_stage_num - 1

		if self.mode_state == self.after_story_mode then
			if prev_stage <= 0 then
				return
			end
		elseif self.mode_state == self.after_challenge_mode then
			if prev_stage < self.sub_stage_one then
				return
			end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.move_menu, self, prev_stage, self.after_world_direct_prev))
	end

		if self.item.IsTransition then
			return
		end

		if self.mode_state == self.after_challenge_mode then
			return
		end

		if not self.item:CheckChallengeOpen() then
			return
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.after_challenge_mode))
	end

	self.on_close_challenge_mode = function()
		if self.item.IsTransition then
			return
		end

		if self.mode_state == self.after_story_mode then
			return
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.after_story_mode))
	end

	self.on_button_click = function(item)
		if not self.item:OnButtonClick(item) then
			return false
		end

		local select_stage_spec = self.item.eventStageSpecs[item.StageNum - 1]
		if not self.item:CheckSelectStageTransition(select_stage_spec.Id, item) then
			return false
		end

		-- 진입가능하면 EventEnterStage 출력

		return true

function local_class:initialize(item)

	self.item.ChallengeModeKeyString = "eventStoryAfterWorldChallengeModeOn"
	self.item.FirstEnterKeyString = "afterWorldFirstEnterStageOn"
