		self.story_button_length = self.item.storyButtons.Length
	end

	event_delegate.Set(self.item.nextButton.onClick, self.on_next_button)
	event_delegate.Set(self.item.prevButton.onClick, self.on_prev_button)
	event_delegate.Set(self.item.challengeButton.onClick, self.on_open_challenge_mode)
	event_delegate.Set(self.item.storyButton.onClick, self.on_close_challenge_mode)

	if CS.GameStrings.Instance.IsRTL then
		local s = self.item.menuWidget.localScale
		s.x = -1
		self.item.menuWidget.localScale = s;
	end
end

function local_class:post_load()
	return util.cs_generator(self.post_load_routine, self)
end

function local_class:post_load_routine()
	coroutine.yield(self:load_effect_pool_progress())

	self:init_world_container()

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SettingLocked(self.item.eventStoryUnLock))

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:init_button(self.item.states.Texture, self.item.states.EventId)
	end
end

function local_class:load_effect_pool_progress()
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_challenge_stage_new_movie')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_liveevent_story_nextbutton_alarm')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_aw_soul_absorb_blue')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_aw_soul_absorb_red')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_aw_soul_release_blue')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_aw_soul_release_red')

	coroutine.yield(self:is_pool_loading())
end

function local_class:add_object_pool(preset_name)
	local object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_name)
	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:is_pool_loading()
	local is_loaded_all = true
	while true do
		is_loaded_all = true

		for k,v in pairs(self.pool_table) do
			if v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded and
					v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.LoadFailed then
				is_loaded_all = false
			end
		end

		if is_loaded_all then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:init_world_container()
	local parent_transform = self.item.transform.parent

	self.mode_state = self.after_story_mode

	self.item.challengeMode:InitContainer(parent_transform)
	self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button(self.mode_state)
end

function local_class:begin()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].OnClickedLua = self.on_button_click
	end

	local effect = self.pool_table['fx_ui_liveevent_story_nextbutton_alarm']:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:init_etc(effect, "idle")

	self:init_story_button()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function local_class:init_story_button()
	-- 스테이지 스펙에 맞게 셋팅
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if i >= self.item.eventStageSpecs.Count then
			break
		end

		self.item.storyButtons[i]:SetButton(self.item.eventStageSpecs[i])
	end

	local clear_stage_btn
	local states = self.item.states

	local cleared_state = states.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	if states.IsStageCleared then
		if cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
			clear_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, states.PrevStageName)
		end
	end

	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, states.PrevStageName)

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		local stage_num = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum

		if not self.item:CheckChallengeStoryButton(clear_stage_btn, stage_num) then
			break
		end
		--
		if stage_num == self.after_world_stage_one then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				if not self.item.IsFirstEnter then
					self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
				end
			end
		elseif stage_num == self.after_world_stage_two or stage_num == self.after_world_stage_three or
				stage_num == self.boss_after_world_stage then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		elseif stage_num == self.sub_stage_one then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				if clear_stage_btn == nil and states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
					-- 일반 스토리에서 별만 획득한 경우엔 챌린지모드로 셋팅하지 않음
					if prev_stage_button.StageNum >= self.sub_stage_one then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.after_challenge_mode, true))
					end
				else
					-- 첫번째 서브 스테이지가 오픈된 상태일때 기존 마커나 위치 다시 셋팅
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.after_challenge_mode, true))
				end

				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		elseif stage_num == self.sub_stage_two or stage_num == self.sub_stage_three or stage_num == self.sub_stage_four then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 별만 추가로 획득한 경우
	if states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
		local stage = stage_data:GetStage(states.PrevStageName)

		local stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(stage.Id))
		local state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(states.StageStateDiff))

		local stageState = stage_state & state_diff

		-- 연출에 의해 StageGrade 가 변화할 예정이므로 변하기 전의 값으로 별 상태를 업데이트 한다.
		prev_stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_state(stageState)
		if clear_stage_btn == nil and prev_stage_button.StageNum <= self.boss_after_world_stage then
			self:force_world_sprite_move(prev_stage_button.StageNum)
		elseif self.item.IsNotStageState then
		-- 아무 행동없이 그냥 나온 경우
			if prev_stage_button.StageNum <= self.boss_after_world_stage then
				self:force_world_sprite_move(prev_stage_button.StageNum)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:resume()
	if self.event_story_main == nil then
		return
	end

	local worldmap_bgm_name = self.event_story_main.CurrentLiveEventSpec.WorldMapBgmName

	music_player.SoundState = CS.Oak.SoundState.Lobby
	music_player.LobbyBgmName = worldmap_bgm_name

	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
end

function local_class:pause()

end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local cleared_state = self.item.states.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	-- 이벤트에 처음 입장했을때 연출 작동
	if self.item.IsFirstEnter then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_first_enter_routine())
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.NextStageName)
		and self.item.states.PrevStageName ~= self.item.states.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName, self.item.states.NextStageName, self.item.states.IsStageCleared))
	elseif self.item.states.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		-- 스테이지 클리어 연출 작동
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName))
	elseif self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	else
		self.item.IsRoutine = false
	end

	self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 챌린지 언락 연출
	local is_challenge_mode_open = false
	if self.item.IsLocked then

		coroutine.yield(self.item:StartChallengeModeOpenShow(self.item.eventStoryUnLock, self.sub_stage_one, function(b)
			is_challenge_mode_open = b
		end))

		if is_challenge_mode_open then
			coroutine.yield(self:first_challenge_stage_routine())
		end
	end

	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)

	self:update_new_stage()

	if not is_challenge_mode_open then
		self:refresh_button()
	end
end

-- 이벤트 처음 입장했을 때 연출
function local_class:stage_first_enter_routine()
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	end

	self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.transform.localPosition = vector(999,0,999)

	-- bg start
	self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, self.bg_start_open_handle_Name, false)
	local duration = self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_event_sfx_handle_name)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	-- menu start
	local animation_name = self.menu_open_handle_Name .. '_01'
	self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
	duration = self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

	animation_name = self.bg_open_handle_Name .. '_01'
	self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

	wait_for_sec(0.02)

	self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

	wait_for_sec(duration - 0.02)

	--local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	--sfx_info.sfxName = self.open_event_sfx_handle_name

function local_class:stage_move_routine(prev_stage_name, next_stage_name, is_stage_cleared)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(next_stage_name)

	local prevStage = stage_data:GetStage(prev_stage_name)
	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prevStage.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))

	local stageState = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stageState & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (is_stage_cleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출 루틴으로 이동후 종료
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName))

		coroutine.yield(self:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name))

		return
	end

	if self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	end

	-- 다음스테이지가 이번에 오픈될 경우에는 Open 연출
	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		coroutine.yield(self:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name))
	end
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine(clear_stage_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local clear_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, clear_stage_name)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local prevStage = stage_data:GetStage(clear_stage_name)

	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prevStage.Id)

	local stage_num = clear_stage_btn.StageNum
	local effect_name = ''

	if stage_num < self.sub_stage_one then
		effect_name = 'fx_aw_soul_absorb_blue'
	else
		effect_name = 'fx_aw_soul_absorb_red'
	end

	--effect 출력
	self.fx_aw_soul_absorb = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero);
	clear_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:show_effect(self.fx_aw_soul_absorb);

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.clear_sfx_Handle_Name)

	coroutine.yield(self:menu_clear_animation(stage_num))

	if self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	end

	self:stage_post_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName)
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine(stage_state)
	local prevStageButton = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, self.item.states.PrevStageName)

	local de_active_vector = vector(-4000, -4000, 0)

	local effect_1 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)
	local effect_2 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)
	local effect_3 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)

	local effect_table = {}
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_1)
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_2)
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_3)

	coroutine.yield(prevStageButton:ShowStarGradeAnimation(self.item.states.StageStateDiff, effect_table))

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.item.states.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	-- 보상 연출
	coroutine.yield(event_story_world_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, self.item.SceneManager))
end

function local_class:stage_post_clear_routine(clear_stage_name)
	local clearStageBtn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, clear_stage_name)
	local stageNum = clearStageBtn.StageNum

	if self.fx_aw_soul_absorb ~= nil then
		self.fx_aw_soul_absorb.transform.localPosition = vector(-4000, -4000, 0)
		self.fx_aw_soul_absorb.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	if stageNum == self.boss_after_world_stage then
		if self.item.IsLocked then
			self.item:ShowEventStoryClearPopup()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name)
	local nextButton = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, next_stage_name)

	user_progress:SetStageOpened(next_stage_name)

	local stage_num = nextButton.StageNum

	-- 서브 스테이지 첫 번째는 챌린지 오픈 연출에 포함되어서 여기서는 안 함
	if stage_num == self.sub_stage_one then
		return
	end

	-- 넘어가는 연출 전에 표시되는 UI On
	nextButton.GetControllerLuaTable:open()
	nextButton.GetControllerLuaTable:set_arrow_obj(false)

	coroutine.yield(self:move_menu(stage_num, self.after_world_direct_next, true))

	if self.fx_aw_soul_release ~= nil then
		self.fx_aw_soul_release.transform.localPosition = vector(-4000, -4000, 0)
		self.fx_aw_soul_release.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
end

function local_class:first_challenge_stage_routine()

	-- 첫번째 스테이지만 open 설정
	self.item.storyButtons[self.item.FirstChallengeStageButtonNum].GetControllerLuaTable:open()

	coroutine.yield(self:stage_mode_change(self.after_challenge_mode))
end

function local_class:bg_idle_animation()
	local animation_name = ''

	if self.current_click_stage_num <= self.boss_after_world_stage then
		-- 스토리 idle_m_01 ~ idle_m_04
		animation_name = self.bg_idle_handle_Name .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num
	elseif self.current_click_stage_num > self.boss_after_world_stage then
		-- 챌린지 idle_c_01 ~ idle_c_04
		local bg_num = self.current_click_stage_num - self.boss_after_world_stage
		animation_name = self.bg_idle_challenge_handle_Name .. '_0' .. bg_num
	end

	self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, true)
end

function local_class:menu_idle_animation()
	local activate_name = 'deactivated'

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum == self.current_click_stage_num then
			if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then
				activate_name = 'activated'
			end
			break
		end
	end

	local animation_name = ''

	if self.current_click_stage_num <= self.boss_after_world_stage then
		-- 스토리 idle_m_01 ~ idle_m_04
		animation_name = self.menu_idle_handle_Name .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num .. '_' .. activate_name
	elseif self.current_click_stage_num > self.boss_after_world_stage then
		-- 챌린지 idle_c_01 ~ idle_c_04
		local menu_num = self.current_click_stage_num - self.boss_after_world_stage
		animation_name = self.menu_idle_challenge_handle_Name .. '_0' .. menu_num .. '_' .. activate_name
	end

	self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, true)
end

function local_class:bg_move_animation(bg_direct)
	local animation_name = ''
	local direct_number = self.current_click_stage_num

	if bg_direct == self.after_world_direct_prev then
		direct_number = direct_number + 1
		if self.current_click_stage_num > self.boss_after_world_stage then
			-- 챌린지 prev
			local prev_num = direct_number - self.boss_after_world_stage
			local page_num = self.current_click_stage_num - self.boss_after_world_stage

			animation_name = self.bg_prev_challenge_handle_name .. '_0' .. prev_num .. '_0' .. page_num
		else
			-- 스토리 prev
			animation_name = self.bg_prev_handle_name .. '_0' .. direct_number .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num
		end
	elseif bg_direct == self.after_world_direct_next then
		direct_number = direct_number - 1
		if self.current_click_stage_num > self.boss_after_world_stage then
			-- 챌린지 next
			local prev_num = direct_number - self.boss_after_world_stage
			local page_num = self.current_click_stage_num - self.boss_after_world_stage

			animation_name = self.bg_next_challenge_handle_name .. '_0' .. prev_num .. '_0' .. page_num
		else
			-- 스토리 next
			animation_name = self.bg_next_handle_name .. '_0' .. direct_number .. '_0' .. self.current_click_stage_num
		end
	end

	self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
end

function local_class:pre_select_stage()
	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:post_select_stage()
	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
	self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:force_world_sprite_move(stage_number)
	self.current_click_stage_num = stage_number

	self:bg_idle_animation()
	self:menu_idle_animation()
	self:refresh_story_button()
end

function local_class:update_new_stage()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then
			-- 챌린지 스테이지일 경우엔 현재 이용 가능한 상태인지 체크
			if self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum >= self.sub_stage_one and (not self.item.IsChallengeAvailable or not self.item.IsMainCleared) then
				return
			end

			-- new 스테이지일 경우 이펙트 출력
			local effect = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_new_movie']:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero);
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:show_red_dot_effect(effect);
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_menu(stage_num, direct, is_skip)
	if is_skip == nil then
		is_skip = false
	end

	if not is_skip then
		self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
		self.item.IsTransition = true
		get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	end

	self.current_click_stage_num = stage_num
	self:refresh_button()

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.move_menu_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.bg_move_animation, self, direct))
	coroutine.yield(self:menu_move_animation(direct))

	if is_skip then
		self:bg_idle_animation()
		self:refresh_story_button()

		local effect_name = ''
		if stage_num < self.sub_stage_one then
			effect_name = 'fx_aw_soul_release_blue'
		else
			effect_name = 'fx_aw_soul_release_red'
		end

		local current_button = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, self.item.states.NextStageName)

		--effect 출력
		self.fx_aw_soul_release = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		current_button.GetControllerLuaTable:show_effect(self.fx_aw_soul_release)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.new_open_sfx_Handle_Name)

		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		current_button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_arrow_obj(true)

		coroutine.yield(self:menu_active_animation(stage_num))

		self:menu_idle_animation()
	else
		self:bg_idle_animation()
		self:menu_idle_animation()

		self:refresh_story_button()
	end

	if not is_skip then
		self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
		self.item.IsTransition = false
		get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_button()
	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_prev(true)
	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_next(true)

	-- 첫번째 스테이지 위치면 prev 버튼을 off 함
	if self.current_click_stage_num == self.after_world_stage_one or
			self.current_click_stage_num == self.sub_stage_one then
		self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_prev(false)
	end

	local new_stage = -1
	local last_open_stage_num = -1
	local first_num = 0
	local last_num = self.boss_after_world_stage

	-- 챌린지 모드 면 순회 위치 변경
	if self.mode_state == self.after_challenge_mode then
		first_num = self.item.FirstChallengeStageButtonNum
		last_num = self.sub_stage_four
	end

	if self.story_button_length < last_num then
		last_num = self.story_button_length
	end

	for i = first_num, last_num - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:is_open_function() then
			last_open_stage_num = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum
		end

		if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then
			new_stage = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum
		end
	end

	-- 마지막 스테이지 위치면 next 버튼을 off 함
	if self.current_click_stage_num == last_open_stage_num then
		self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_next(false)
	end

	self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:refresh_stage_num(self.current_click_stage_num, new_stage)
end

function local_class:refresh_story_button()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum == self.current_click_stage_num then
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
		else
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stage_mode_change(state, immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	if not immediate then
		self.item.IsTransition = true
	end

	local transition_sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	transition_sfx_info.sfxName = self.ui_transition_sfx_Handle_Name
	transition_sfx_info.delayedTime = 0.1

	self.mode_state = state

	if self.mode_state == self.after_story_mode then
		if immediate then
			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button(self.mode_state)
		else
			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

			self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)

			music_player:PlaySfx(transition_sfx_info)

			for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
			end

			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_start_animation(self.mode_state))

			self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.transform.localPosition = vector(999,0,999)

			local animation_name = self.bg_open_handle_Name .. '_0' .. self.boss_after_world_stage
			self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)

			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_end_animation(self.mode_state))

			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_challenge_obj(false)

			animation_name = self.menu_open_handle_Name .. '_0' .. self.boss_after_world_stage
			self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
			local duration = self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

			wait_for_sec(0.02)

			self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

			wait_for_sec(duration - 0.02)

			self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)

			self:force_world_sprite_move(self.boss_after_world_stage)

			self:refresh_button()

			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
		end
	elseif 	self.mode_state == self.after_challenge_mode then
		if immediate then
			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button(self.mode_state)
		else
			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

			self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)

			music_player:PlaySfx(transition_sfx_info)

			for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
			end

			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_start_animation(self.mode_state))

			self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.transform.localPosition = vector(999,0,999)

			local sub_open_count = self.item:GetStageOpenCount(self.item.FirstChallengeStageButtonNum)
			local animation_name = self.bg_open_challenge_handle_Name .. '_0' .. sub_open_count
			self.item.afterWorldBgSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)

			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_end_animation(self.mode_state))

			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_challenge_obj(false)

			animation_name = self.menu_open_challenge_handle_Name .. '_' .. sub_open_count
			self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, animation_name, false)
			local duration = self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.AnimationState.Tracks.Items[0].Animation.Duration

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

			wait_for_sec(0.02)

			self.item.afterWorldMenuSpine.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

			wait_for_sec(duration - 0.02)

			self.item.afterWorldEtc.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)

			local open_sub_stage_num = self.boss_after_world_stage + sub_open_count

			self:force_world_sprite_move(open_sub_stage_num)

			self:refresh_button()

			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
		end
	end

	if not immediate then
		self.item.IsTransition = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown then
		self.on_prev_button()
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown or
		    e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown then
		self.on_next_button()
	elseif not CS.Oak.VirtualCursor.Enabled and e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then
		for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
			if self.item.storyButtons[i].gameObject.activeSelf then
				self.on_button_click(self.item.storyButtons[i])
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:finish()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i]:Finish()
	end

function local_class:set_button(spec)
	-- 별 or 커피 출력
	if spec.StarPieces > 0 then
		self.item.costIcon.spriteName = self.item.StarPieceSpriteName
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..spec.StarPieces
	else
		self.item.costIcon.spriteName = self.item.CoffeeSpriteName
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..spec.StageStamina
	end

	--if not is_unity_null(self.item.stageLabel) then
	--	local stage_num = self.item.StageNum
	--	if spec.IsMainStageType then
	--		self.item.stageLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("xm_stage") .. stage_num
	--	else
	--		stage_num = self.item.StageNum - self.item.LastStageNum
	--		self.item.stageLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("xm_stage") .. stage_num
	--	end
	--end

	self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)
	local stage_state = user_progress:GetStageState(spec.Id)
	self:set_stage_state(stage_state)
end

function local_class:set_stage_state(stage_state)
	local unlocked = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Unlocked)
	local int_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(stage_state)
	local current_state = int_stage_state & unlocked
	local current_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(current_state)

	if current_state_int ~= 0 then
		self.item.stars:SetActive(true)

		local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length
		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			local star_grade_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.StarGradeStates[i])
			local grade_state = int_stage_state & star_grade_state
			local grade_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(grade_state)

			if grade_state_int ~= 0 then
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(true)
				self.item.starOffList[i]:SetActive(false)
			else
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
				self.item.starOffList[i]:SetActive(true)
			end
		end

		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)

		if not is_unity_null(self.item.starEmpty) then
			self.item.starEmpty:SetActive(false)
		end
	else
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
			if not is_unity_null(self.item.starEmpty) then
				self.item.starEmpty:SetActive(true)
			end
		end

		-- 이벤트가 진행 중일 때 첫 번째 스테이지인 경우 무조건 별을 켜줌
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState and self.item.StageNum == self.item.FirstStageNum then
			self.item.stars:SetActive(true)
		else
			self.item.stars:SetActive(false)
		end

		local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length
		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_point_and_cost_obj(is_active)
	self.item.pointObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.costInfoObj:SetActive(false)

	if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
		self.item.pointObj:SetActive(is_active)
	else
		self.item.costInfoObj:SetActive(is_active)
	end
end

function local_class:set_active(is_active)
	self.item.buttonCollider.enabled = is_active
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)

	if is_active then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.display_obj_start_animation, self, 1.0))
		self.item.transform.localPosition = self.local_default_pos
	else
		self.item.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end
end

function local_class:display_obj_start_animation(target_alpha)
	if is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) or not self.item.displayObj.gameObject.activeSelf then
		return
	end

	self.item.displayObj.alpha = 0

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.UI.UIAnimations.Alpha(self.item.displayObj, self.alpha_change_duration, target_alpha))
end

function local_class:open()
	self.is_open = true

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) then
		self.item.displayObj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.item:SetEventCallback()

	-- 외전일 경우
	if not self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
		local flag = not self.item.stars.activeSelf
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(flag)
		return
	end

	-- 별이 활성화된 상태이면
	if self.item.stars.activeSelf then
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)
		return
	end

	local stage_one = 1
	local sub_stage_one = 5

	-- 첫번째 스테이지는 제외
	if self.item.StageNum ~= stage_one and self.item.StageNum < sub_stage_one then
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(true)

		local live_event
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
			live_event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.LiveEvents[self.event_id]
		else
			live_event = nil
		end

		if is_unity_null(live_event) then
			return
		end

		local stage_point = self.item.StagePoint:GetDecrypted()
		local live_event_point = live_event.Points:GetDecrypted()

		local check_point = stage_point > live_event_point

		if check_point then
			self.item.pointLabel.text = '[ff0000]'..stage_point..'[-]'
		else
			self.item.pointLabel.text = ''..stage_point
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_red_dot_effect(pooled_obj)
	if pooled_obj == nil then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.arrow_obj) then
		pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.arrow_obj
	else
		pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.item.transform
	end

	pooled_obj.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	pooled_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

function local_class:set_active_prev(is_active)

	end

	if is_active then

		self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end

	end

	if is_active then
		self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
	else

		self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end

function local_class:resume()
	local idle_ani_name = self.spine_animation_name
	local idle_new_ani_name = self.spine_animation_name .. '_new'

	self.item.prevSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_ani_name, true)
	self.item.prevNewSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_new_ani_name, true)

	self.item.nextSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_ani_name, true)
	self.item.nextNewSpine.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, idle_new_ani_name, true)

	end

function local_class:refresh_stage_num(current_stage_num, new_stage)
	local current_red_dot = self.red_dot_direct_none

	if new_stage == -1 then
		self:arrow_animation(current_red_dot)
		return
	end

	if current_stage_num < new_stage then
		current_red_dot = self.red_dot_direct_next
	elseif current_stage_num > new_stage then
		current_red_dot = self.red_dot_direct_prev
	end

	self:arrow_animation(current_red_dot)
end

function local_class:arrow_animation(direct)
	if self.item.prevSpine == nil or self.item.prevSpine.AnimationState == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.item.nextSpine == nil or self.item.nextSpine.AnimationState == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.red_dot_direct_next == direct then
		if self:get_active_prev() then
			self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self:get_active_next() then
			self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
			self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		end

		if self.pooled_unity_obj ~= nil then
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.parent = self.item.nextNewSpine.transform
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end
	elseif self.red_dot_direct_prev == direct then
		if self:get_active_prev() then
			self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
			self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		end

		if self:get_active_next() then
			self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self.pooled_unity_obj ~= nil then
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.parent = self.item.prevNewSpine.transform
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end
	else
		if self:get_active_prev() then
			self.item.prevNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.prevSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self:get_active_next() then
			self.item.nextNewSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
			self.item.nextSpine.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.ActivePosition
		end

		if self.pooled_unity_obj ~= nil then
			self.pooled_unity_obj.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
		end
	end
end

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('EventStoryBlossom')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	self.event_story_main = CS.Oak.UI.EventStoryMain.Instance

	self.blossom_stage_one = 1
	self.blossom_stage_two = 2
	self.sub_stage_one = 3
	self.sub_stage_two = 4

	self.current_click_stage_num = 0

	self.mode_state = {
		story_mode = 0,
		challenge_mode = 1
	}

	self.cur_mode_state = self.mode_state.story_mode

	self.ui_transition_sfx_Handle_Name = '01_ui_transition_01'
	self.open_sfx_Handle_Name = '01_worldmap_aw_03'

	self.story_button_length = 0

	self.pool_table = {}

	self.on_open_challenge_mode = function()
		if self.item.IsTransition then
			return
		end

		if self.cur_mode_state == self.mode_state.challenge_mode then
			return
		end

		if not self.item:CheckChallengeOpen() then
			return
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.mode_state.challenge_mode))
	end

	self.on_close_challenge_mode = function()
		if self.item.IsTransition then
			return
		end

		if self.cur_mode_state == self.mode_state.story_mode then
			return
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.mode_state.story_mode))
	end

	self.on_button_click = function(item)
		if not self.item:OnButtonClick(item) then
			return false
		end

		local select_stage_spec = self.item.eventStageSpecs[item.StageNum - 1]
		if not self.item:CheckSelectStageTransition(select_stage_spec.Id, item) then
			return false
		end

		-- 진입가능하면 EventEnterStage 출력
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.select_stage_transition, self, select_stage_spec))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.item.ChallengeModeKeyString = 'eventStoryBlossomChallengeModeOn'
	self.item.FirstEnterKeyString = 'blossomFirstEnterStageOn'

	if self.item.storyButtons ~= nil then
		self.story_button_length = self.item.storyButtons.Length
	end

	event_delegate.Set(self.item.challengeButton.onClick, self.on_open_challenge_mode)
	event_delegate.Set(self.item.storyButton.onClick, self.on_close_challenge_mode)
end

function local_class:post_load()
	return util.cs_generator(self.post_load_routine, self)
end

function local_class:post_load_routine()
	coroutine.yield(self:load_effect_pool_progress())

	self:init_world_container()

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SettingLocked(self.item.eventStoryUnLock))

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:init_button(self.item.states.EventId)
	end
end

function local_class:load_effect_pool_progress()
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm_red')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm_blue')
	self:add_object_pool('fx_worldmap_bs_jewel_open_specialevents')

	coroutine.yield(self:is_pool_loading())
end

function local_class:add_object_pool(preset_name)
	local object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_name)
	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:is_pool_loading()
	local is_loaded_all = true
	while true do
		is_loaded_all = true

		for k,v in pairs(self.pool_table) do
			if v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded and
					v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.LoadFailed then
				is_loaded_all = false
			end
		end

		if is_loaded_all then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:init_world_container()
	local parent_transform = self.item.transform.parent

	self.cur_mode_state = self.mode_state.story_mode

	self.item.challengeMode:InitContainer(parent_transform)
	self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button(self.cur_mode_state)
end

function local_class:begin()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].OnClickedLua = self.on_button_click
	end

	self:init_story_button()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function local_class:init_story_button()
	-- 스테이지 스펙에 맞게 셋팅
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if i >= self.item.eventStageSpecs.Count then
			break
		end

		self.item.storyButtons[i]:SetButton(self.item.eventStageSpecs[i])
	end

	local clear_stage_btn
	local states = self.item.states

	local cleared_state = states.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	if states.IsStageCleared then
		if cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
			clear_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, states.PrevStageName)
		end
	end

	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, states.PrevStageName)

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		local stage_num = self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum

		if not self.item:CheckChallengeStoryButton(clear_stage_btn, stage_num) then
			break
		end

		if stage_num == self.blossom_stage_one then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				if not self.item.IsFirstEnter then
					self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
				end
			end
		elseif stage_num == self.blossom_stage_two then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		elseif stage_num == self.sub_stage_one then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				if clear_stage_btn == nil and states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
					-- 일반 스토리에서 별만 획득한 경우엔 챌린지모드로 셋팅하지 않음
					if prev_stage_button.StageNum >= self.sub_stage_one then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.mode_state.challenge_mode, true))
					end
				else
					-- 첫번째 서브 스테이지가 오픈된 상태일때 기존 마커나 위치 다시 셋팅
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_mode_change, self, self.mode_state.challenge_mode, true))
				end

				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		elseif stage_num == self.sub_stage_two then
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.storyButtons[i].StageName) then
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:open()
				self:force_world_sprite_move(stage_num)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 별만 추가로 획득한 경우
	if states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
		local stage = stage_data:GetStage(states.PrevStageName)

		local stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(stage.Id))
		local state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(states.StageStateDiff))

		local stageState = stage_state & state_diff

		-- 연출에 의해 StageGrade 가 변화할 예정이므로 변하기 전의 값으로 별 상태를 업데이트 한다.
		prev_stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_state(stageState)
		if clear_stage_btn == nil and prev_stage_button.StageNum <= self.blossom_stage_two then
			self:force_world_sprite_move(prev_stage_button.StageNum)
		elseif self.item.IsNotStageState then
			-- 아무 행동없이 그냥 나온 경우
			if prev_stage_button.StageNum <= self.boss_after_world_stage then
				self:force_world_sprite_move(prev_stage_button.StageNum)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:resume()
	if self.event_story_main == nil then
		return
	end

	local worldmap_bgm_name = self.event_story_main.CurrentLiveEventSpec.WorldMapBgmName

	music_player.SoundState = CS.Oak.SoundState.Lobby
	music_player.LobbyBgmName = worldmap_bgm_name

	if not self.item.IsFirstEnter then
		self:bg_idle_animation()
	end
end

function local_class:pause()

end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local cleared_state = self.item.states.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	-- 이벤트에 처음 입장했을때 연출 작동
	if self.item.IsFirstEnter then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_first_enter_routine())
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.NextStageName) and
			self.item.states.PrevStageName ~= self.item.states.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName, self.item.states.NextStageName,
				self.item.states.IsStageCleared))
	elseif self.item.states.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		-- 스테이지 클리어 연출 작동
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName))
	elseif self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	else
		self.item.IsRoutine = false
	end

	if not self.item.challengeMode.IsOpen then
		self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	-- 챌린지 언락 연출
	local is_challenge_mode_open = false
	if self.item.IsLocked then

		coroutine.yield(self.item:StartChallengeModeOpenShow(self.item.eventStoryUnLock, self.sub_stage_one, function(b)
			is_challenge_mode_open = b
		end))

		if is_challenge_mode_open then
			coroutine.yield(self:first_challenge_stage_routine())
		end
	end

	self:update_new_stage()

	if not is_challenge_mode_open then
		self:refresh_button()
	end
end

function local_class:show_open_fx()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_limit_break_06')
	local open_fx = self.pool_table['fx_worldmap_bs_jewel_open_specialevents']:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	open_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one / 360
end

--- 이벤트 처음 입장했을 때 연출
function local_class:stage_first_enter_routine()
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	end

	self:show_open_fx()
	local duration = self:bg_on_animation(self.item.blossomStage1Animator)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.item.storyButtons[0].GetControllerLuaTable:show_sprite()
	wait_for_sec(duration - 1)

	CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.SetInt(self.item.FirstEnterKeyString, 1)
	CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.Save()

	-- 첫번째 스테이지로 설정
	self.item.storyButtons[0].GetControllerLuaTable:active_display_object()
	self:force_world_sprite_move(self.blossom_stage_one)

	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine(prev_stage_name, next_stage_name, is_stage_cleared)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(next_stage_name)

	local prevStage = stage_data:GetStage(prev_stage_name)
	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prevStage.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))

	local stageState = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stageState & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (is_stage_cleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출 루틴으로 이동후 종료
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName))

		coroutine.yield(self:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name))

		return
	end

	if self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	end

	-- 다음스테이지가 이번에 오픈될 경우에는 Open 연출
	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		coroutine.yield(self:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name))
	end
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine(clear_stage_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local prevStage = stage_data:GetStage(clear_stage_name)

	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prevStage.Id)

	if self.item.states.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine(self.item.states.StageStateDiff))
	end

	self:stage_post_clear_routine(self.item.states.PrevStageName)
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine(stage_state)
	local prevStageButton = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, self.item.states.PrevStageName)

	-- 클리어 연출을 위한 pool 들을 넘겨줘야함
	local de_active_vector = vector(-4000, -4000, 0)

	local effect_1 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)
	local effect_2 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)
	local effect_3 = self.pool_table['fx_ui_challenge_stage_rank_star_active']:Instantiate(de_active_vector)

	local effect_table = {}
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_1)
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_2)
	table.insert(effect_table, effect_3)

	coroutine.yield(prevStageButton:ShowStarGradeAnimation(self.item.states.StageStateDiff, effect_table))

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.item.states.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	-- 보상 연출
	coroutine.yield(event_story_world_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, self.item.SceneManager))
end

function local_class:stage_post_clear_routine(clear_stage_name)
	local clearStageBtn = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, clear_stage_name)
	local stageNum = clearStageBtn.StageNum

	if stageNum == self.blossom_stage_two then
		if self.item.IsLocked then
			self.item:ShowEventStoryClearPopup()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:next_stage_open_routine(next_stage_name)
	local next_button = self.item:GetStageButton(self.item.storyButtons, next_stage_name)

	user_progress:SetStageOpened(next_stage_name)

	local stage_num = next_button.StageNum

	-- 서브 스테이지 첫 번째는 챌린지 오픈 연출에 포함되어서 여기서는 안 함
	if stage_num == self.sub_stage_one then
		return
	end

	self:show_open_fx()

	if stage_num == self.blossom_stage_two then
		self:bg_on_animation(self.item.blossomStage2Animator)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.item.storyButtons[stage_num - 1].GetControllerLuaTable:show_sprite()
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	next_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
end

function local_class:first_challenge_stage_routine()
	-- 첫번째 스테이지만 open 설정
	self.item.storyButtons[self.item.FirstChallengeStageButtonNum].GetControllerLuaTable:open()

	coroutine.yield(self:stage_mode_change(self.mode_state.challenge_mode))
end

--- animator_util.play_async 로직 사용
function local_class:bg_on_animation(animator)
	local anim_name = 'on'
	animator:Play(anim_name)

	while not animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0):IsName(anim_name) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	return animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).length
end

function local_class:bg_idle_animation()
	local anim_name = 'idle'
	self.item.blossomStage1Animator:Play(anim_name)

	if self.item.storyButtons[self.blossom_stage_two - 1].GetControllerLuaTable:is_open_function() then
		self.item.blossomStage2Animator:Play(anim_name)
	end
end

function local_class:force_world_sprite_move(stage_number)
	self.current_click_stage_num = stage_number

	self:refresh_button()
	self:bg_idle_animation()
end

--- 버튼을 눌러 스테이지 진입 UI 창이 떴을 때 불리는 함수
function local_class:pre_select_stage()
	if not self.item.challengeMode.IsOpen then
		self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

--- 스테이지 진입 UI 창을 닫았을 때 불리는 함수
function local_class:post_select_stage()
	if not self.item.challengeMode.IsOpen then
		self.item.challengeMode.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:update_new_stage()
	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].IsNewStage then
			-- 챌린지 스테이지일 경우엔 현재 이용 가능한 상태인지 체크
			if self.item.storyButtons[i].StageNum >= self.sub_stage_one and (not self.item.IsChallengeAvailable or not self.item.IsMainCleared) then
				return
			end

			-- new 스테이지일 경우 이펙트 출력
			local red_dot_fx_list = {
				'fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm',
				'fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm',
				'fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm_red',
				'fx_ui_blossom_challenge_stage_alarm_blue',
			}

			-- 해당 위치가 reddot 이펙트
			local effect = self.pool_table[red_dot_fx_list[i + 1]]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:show_red_dot_effect(effect)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_button()
	local start_stage = self.blossom_stage_one
	local last_stage = self.sub_stage_two

	if self.cur_mode_state == self.mode_state.story_mode then
		last_stage = self.blossom_stage_two
	else
		start_stage = self.sub_stage_one
	end

	for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
		self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
	end

	for i = start_stage - 1, last_stage - 1 do
		if self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:is_open_function() then
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
		elseif self.cur_mode_state == self.mode_state.challenge_mode then
			self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:active_button_bg(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stage_mode_change(state, immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	if not immediate then
		self.item.IsTransition = true
	end

	local transition_sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	transition_sfx_info.sfxName = self.ui_transition_sfx_Handle_Name
	transition_sfx_info.delayedTime = 0.1

	self.cur_mode_state = state

	if self.cur_mode_state == self.mode_state.story_mode then
		if immediate then
			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button(self.cur_mode_state)
			self.item.gradationObj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.item.dimBgSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		else
			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

			music_player:PlaySfx(transition_sfx_info)

			for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
			end

			self:show_open_fx()
			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_start_animation(self.cur_mode_state))

			wait_for_sec(1)

			self:force_world_sprite_move(self.blossom_stage_two)
			self.item.gradationObj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.item.dimBgSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)

			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_end_animation(self.cur_mode_state))

			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_challenge_obj(false)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

			wait_for_sec(0.02)

			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
		end
	elseif self.cur_mode_state == self.mode_state.challenge_mode then
		if immediate then
			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button(self.cur_mode_state)
			self.item.gradationObj.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.item.dimBgSprite.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		else
			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

			music_player:PlaySfx(transition_sfx_info)

			for i = 0, self.story_button_length - 1 do
				self.item.storyButtons[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)
			end

			self:show_open_fx()
			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_start_animation(self.cur_mode_state))

			local sub_open_count = self.item:GetStageOpenCount(self.item.FirstChallengeStageButtonNum)

			wait_for_sec(1)

			local open_sub_stage_num = self.blossom_stage_two + sub_open_count

			self:force_world_sprite_move(open_sub_stage_num)
			self.item.gradationObj.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.item.dimBgSprite.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			coroutine.yield(self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:change_end_animation(self.cur_mode_state))

			self.item.challengeMode.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active_challenge_obj(false)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_Handle_Name)

			wait_for_sec(0.02)

			get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
		end
	end

	if not immediate then
		self.item.IsTransition = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	--if not CS.Oak.VirtualCursor.Enabled and e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('EventStoryBlossomButton')

function local_class:init()
	self.event_story_main = CS.Oak.UI.EventStoryMain.Instance

	self.local_default_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.is_open = false
	self.alpha_change_duration = 0.12
	self.event_id = 107
end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
	self.item.LastStageNum = 2
end

function local_class:init_button(event_id)
	self.is_open = false
	self.local_default_pos = self.item.transform.localPosition
	self.event_id = event_id

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.starEmpty) then
		self.item.starEmpty:SetActive(false)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.iconTexture) then
		self.item.iconTexture.mainTexture = texture
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.knightSpriteList) and self.item.knightSpriteList.Length > 0 then
		if user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.KnightMale, true) ~= nil then
			self.item.knightSpriteList[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
		else
			self.item.knightSpriteList[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)
	self.item:UnSetEventCallback()
end

function local_class:set_button(spec)
	-- 별 or 커피 출력
	if spec.StarPieces > 0 then
		self.item.costIcon.spriteName = self.item.StarPieceSpriteName
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..spec.StarPieces
	else
		self.item.costIcon.spriteName = self.item.CoffeeSpriteName
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..spec.StageStamina
	end

	self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)
	local stage_state = user_progress:GetStageState(spec.Id)
	self:set_stage_state(stage_state)
end

function local_class:set_stage_state(stage_state)
	local unlocked = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Unlocked)
	local int_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(stage_state)
	local current_state = int_stage_state & unlocked
	local current_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(current_state)

	if current_state_int ~= 0 then
		self.item.stars:SetActive(true)

		local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length
		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			local star_grade_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.StarGradeStates[i])
			local grade_state = int_stage_state & star_grade_state
			local grade_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(grade_state)

			if grade_state_int ~= 0 then
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(true)
				self.item.starOffList[i]:SetActive(false)
			else
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
				self.item.starOffList[i]:SetActive(true)
			end
		end
	else
		-- IsLiveEventState 는 라이브 이벤트가 진행중인지를 체크하는 용도
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
			if not is_unity_null(self.item.starEmpty) then
				self.item.starEmpty:SetActive(true)
			end
		end

		-- 이벤트가 진행 중일 때 첫 번째 스테이지인 경우 무조건 별을 켜줌
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState and self.item.StageNum == self.item.FirstStageNum then
			self.item.stars:SetActive(true)
		else
			self.item.stars:SetActive(false)
		end

		local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length
		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_point_and_cost_obj(is_active)
	self.item.pointObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.costInfoObj:SetActive(false)

		self.item.transform.localPosition = self.local_default_pos

		self:sprite_animation_start()
	else
		self.item.transform.localPosition = event_story_world_utils.DeActivePosition
	end

function local_class:display_obj_start_animation(target_alpha)
	if is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) or not self.item.displayObj.gameObject.activeSelf then

	end

	self.item.displayObj.alpha = 0

end

	if is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) then
		return
	end

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self:active_button_bg(true)
	self.item.displayObj.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

--- 첫 번째 스테이지 unlock 연출 시 displayObj 켜주는 함수
function local_class:active_display_object()
	if not is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) then
		self.item.displayObj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

--- 버튼의 잠금 표시 or 활성화 표시를 띄우기 위해 list로 분리
function local_class:active_button_bg(is_active)
	if is_unity_null(self.item.defaultObjList) or is_unity_null(self.item.lockObjList) then
		return
	end

	if is_active then
		for i = 0, self.item.defaultObjList.Length - 1 do
			self.item.defaultObjList[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end

		for i = 0, self.item.lockObjList.Length - 1 do
			self.item.lockObjList[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	else
		self.item.buttonCollider.enabled = false
		self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.transform.localPosition = self.local_default_pos

		for i = 0, self.item.defaultObjList.Length - 1 do
			self.item.defaultObjList[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		for i = 0, self.item.lockObjList.Length - 1 do
			self.item.lockObjList[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

--- 버튼 내부의 sprite animator idle 재생
function local_class:sprite_animation_start()
	if is_unity_null(self.item.spriteAnimator) then
		return
	end

	self.item.spriteAnimator:Play('idle')
end

function local_class:open()
	self.is_open = true

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.displayObj) then
		self.item.displayObj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.item:SetEventCallback()

	-- 외전일 경우
	if not self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
		local flag = not self.item.stars.activeSelf
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(flag)
		return
	end

	-- 별이 활성화된 상태이면
	if self.item.stars.activeSelf then
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(false)
		return
	end

	local stage_one = 1
	local sub_stage_one = 3

	-- 첫번째 스테이지는 제외
	if self.item.StageNum ~= stage_one and self.item.StageNum < sub_stage_one then
		self:set_point_and_cost_obj(true)

		local live_event
		if self.event_story_main.IsLiveEventState then
			live_event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.LiveEvents[self.event_id]
		else
			live_event = nil
		end

		if is_unity_null(live_event) then
			return
		end

		local stage_point = self.item.StagePoint:GetDecrypted()
		local live_event_point = live_event.Points:GetDecrypted()

		local check_point = stage_point > live_event_point

		if check_point then
			self.item.pointLabel.text = '[ff0000]'..stage_point..'[-]'
		else
			self.item.pointLabel.text = ''..stage_point
		end
	end
end

	if pooled_obj == nil then

	end

	pooled_obj.transform.parent = self.item.transform
	pooled_obj.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	pooled_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	pooled_obj.gameObject:SetActive(true)

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('FallenQueenGimmickUI')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	wait_for_sec = function(delay)
		local s = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
		while CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - s < delay do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	blink = function(obj)
		obj:SetActive(false)
		obj:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.radius = 5
	self.gauge_length = 260
	self.dots = {}
	self.index = 0
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
	self.item.gameObject.name = 'FallenQueenGimmickUI'

	self.left_icon_t = self.item.leftIconWidget.transform
	self.right_icon_t = self.item.rightIconWidget.transform

	self.distance = self.gauge_length / (self.radius * 2)

	local dot = self.item.dot
	local base_pos = dot.localPosition

	self.dots[0] = dot

	for i = -self.radius, -1 do
		local new_dot = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(dot, dot.parent)
		base_pos.x = i * self.distance
		new_dot.localPosition = base_pos
		new_dot:GetComponent("UISprite").spriteName = "ch16_boss_gage_point_00"
		self.dots[i] = new_dot
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(self.item.redDotEffectPrefab, new_dot)
	end

	for i = 1, self.radius do
		local new_dot = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(dot, dot.parent)
		base_pos.x = i * self.distance
		new_dot.localPosition = base_pos
		new_dot:GetComponent("UISprite").spriteName = "ch16_boss_gage_point_01"
		self.dots[i] = new_dot
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(self.item.blueDotEffectPrefab, new_dot)
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(self.item.purpleDotEffectPrefab, dot)
end

function local_class:move_left()
	if self.index == -self.radius then
		return
	end

	self.index = self.index - 1
	self:set_arrow()
end

function local_class:move_right()
	if self.index == self.radius then
		return
	end

	self.index = self.index + 1
	self:set_arrow()
end

function local_class:reset_arrow()
	self.index = 0
	self:set_arrow()
end

function local_class:set_arrow()
	local arrow = self.item.arrow

	local dot = self.dots[self.index]
	local pos = arrow.localPosition
	pos.x = dot.localPosition.x
	arrow.localPosition = pos
end

function local_class:blink_current_dot()
	blink(self.dots[self.index]:GetChild(0).gameObject)
end

function local_class:show(delay)
	wait_for_sec(delay)

	self.item.content.alpha = 0
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.item.arrow.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local duration = 0.3
	local time = 0

	local min_bar_width = 40
	local max_bar_width = 172

	local width = min_bar_width

	self.item.leftBarSprite.width = min_bar_width
	self.item.rightBarSprite.width = min_bar_width

	self.item.leftBarInnerSprite.width = min_bar_width - 30
	self.item.rightBarInnerSprite.width = min_bar_width - 30

	local icon_pos = self.left_icon_t.localPosition

	icon_pos.x = -56
	self.left_icon_t.localPosition = icon_pos

	icon_pos.x = 56
	self.right_icon_t.localPosition = icon_pos

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.item.content.alpha = 1

	self.dots[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	local cur_dot_idx = 0

	while true do
		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

		width = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(time, min_bar_width, max_bar_width - min_bar_width, duration)

		if (width > max_bar_width) then
			break
		end

		if (time > duration) then
			break
		end

		self.item.leftBarSprite.width = math.floor(width)
		self.item.rightBarSprite.width = math.floor(width)

		self.item.leftBarInnerSprite.width = math.floor(width) - 30
		self.item.rightBarInnerSprite.width = math.floor(width) - 30

		icon_pos.x = -width - 16
		self.left_icon_t.localPosition = icon_pos

		icon_pos.x = -icon_pos.x
		self.right_icon_t.localPosition = icon_pos

		local dot_idx = math.floor((width - 38) / self.distance)

		if (dot_idx <= self.radius and dot_idx ~= cur_dot_idx) then
			cur_dot_idx = dot_idx
			self.dots[cur_dot_idx].gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.dots[-cur_dot_idx].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.item.leftBarSprite.width = max_bar_width
	self.item.rightBarSprite.width = max_bar_width

	self.item.leftBarInnerSprite.width = max_bar_width - 30
	self.item.rightBarInnerSprite.width = max_bar_width - 30

	-- 혹시 타이밍 상 안 켜졌을 수도 있으니 코루틴이 끝나면 명시적으로 전부 켜 준다.
	for i = 1, self.radius do
		self.dots[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.dots[-i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	icon_pos.x = -188
	self.left_icon_t.localPosition = icon_pos

	icon_pos.x = 188
	self.right_icon_t.localPosition = icon_pos

	wait_for_sec(0.04)

	self.item.arrow.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:blink_left_effect()
	blink(self.item.leftIconEffect)
end

function local_class:blink_right_effect()
	blink(self.item.rightIconEffect)
end

function local_class:left_loop_effect(active)
	self.item.leftIconLoopEffect:SetActive(active)
end

function local_class:right_loop_effect(active)
	self.item.rightIconLoopEffect:SetActive(active)
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

end

function local_class:begin(state)
	self.item.states = state

	self.item.isCallEnd = false
	self.item.openFailed = false
	self.item.unknonwnStateTime = 0
	self.item.unknownCheckStart = false

	self.item.widget.transform.localScale = vector(1,0,1)
	self.item.widget.transform.localPosition = vector(5000,0,0)

	self.item.background.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:finish()
	-- 영상닫기 및 종료시 불리는 콜백 해제
	self.item.mediaPlayer:Rewind(true)
	self.item.mediaPlayer:CloseMedia()

	-- 만약 EndFadeOut이 불리지 않고 종료되는 경우 CloseCb를 호출해준다.
	-- 영상을 열던 안열던 콜백들은 항상 실행이 되야한다.
	if not self.item.isCallEnd then
		self.item.isCallEnd = true
		self.item.states.CloseCb()
	end
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	return util.cs_generator(self.open_animation_routine, self)
end

function local_class:open_animation_routine()
	coroutine.yield(self.item:MediaStart())

	-- time 이 0보다 작을 경우 open_animation을 하지 않도록
	if self.item.states.TimeToEndFadeOut <= 1 then
		self.item.mediaPlayer.AudioMuted = true
		return
	else
		self.item.mediaPlayer.AudioMuted = false
	end

	coroutine.yield(self:play_open_animation())
end

function local_class:play_open_animation()
	if self.item.states ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.AnimationKey) then
		-- 새로운 애니메이션 작업이 생길때마다 추가
		if self.item.states.AnimationKey == 'scale' then
			coroutine.yield(self:open_scale())
		else
			self.item.widget.transform.localPosition = vector(0,0,0)
			self.item.widget.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		end
	end
end

function local_class:open_scale()
	self.item.widget.transform.localPosition = vector(0,0,0)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.UI.UIAnimations.Scale(self.item.widget.transform, 0.1, unity_class.vector3.one))
end

function local_class:close_animation()
	return util.cs_generator(self.close_animation_routine, self)
end

function local_class:close_animation_routine()
	self.item.isCallEnd = true

	if self.item.states.BeforeCloseCb ~= nil then
		self.item.states.BeforeCloseCb()
	end

	coroutine.yield(self:play_close_animation())

	self.item.mediaPlayer:CloseMedia()
	self.item.mediaPlayer:ForceDispose()

	self.item.states.CloseCb()
end

function local_class:play_close_animation()
	if self.item.states ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.states.AnimationKey) then
		-- 새로운 애니메이션 작업이 생길때마다 추가
		if self.item.states.AnimationKey == 'scale' then
			coroutine.yield(self:close_scale())
		end
	end
end

function local_class:close_scale()
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.UI.UIAnimations.Scale(self.item.widget.transform, 0.1, vector(1,0,1)))
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}
