require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldMapController')

function local_class:init()
	self.mobile_touch_camera = nil
	self.touch_input = nil
	self.world_map_camera = nil

	self.robot_animator = nil

	self.monster_animator_table = {}
	self.current_object_table = {}

	self.world_state = {
		default = 0,
		labose = 1
	}

	self.is_robot_landmark = false

	self.current_world_state = self.world_state.default
end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.cameraObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	self.touch_input = self.item.cameraObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.BitBenderGames.TouchInputController))
	self.world_map_camera = self.item.cameraObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	self.robot_animator = self.item.robotObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	local length = self.item.monsterObj.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if self.item.monsterObj[i] ~= nil then
			self.monster_animator_table[i + 1] = self.item.monsterObj[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:init_controller()
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShearToggleEvent.Create(self.item, false))
	-- 추가 세팅 내역
end

function local_class:end_controller()
	-- 추가 해제 내역
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShearToggleEvent.Create(self.item, true))

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:set_world_state(state)
	local length = self.item.worldObjs.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.item.worldObjs[i]:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.current_world_state = state

	if state == self.world_state.labose then
		self.item.worldObjs[self.world_state.labose]:SetActive(true)
		return
	end

	self.item.worldObjs[self.world_state.default]:SetActive(true)
	return
end

function local_class:resume()
	self:refresh_animation()
end

function local_class:refresh_animation()
	-- 현재 idle 애니메이션이 재생 중이면 갱신하지 않음
	if not is_unity_null(self.robot_animator) then
		local normalizedTime = self.robot_animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime

		if normalizedTime > 0 then
			return
		end
	end

	self:object_idle_animation()
end

function local_class:set_flower_change(on_effect, on_change)
	-- 검은꽃 이펙트 on,off
	self.item.blackFlowerEffectObj:SetActive(on_effect)

	self.item.blackFlowerObjs[0]:SetActive(false)
	self.item.blackFlowerObjs[1]:SetActive(false)

	if on_change then
		self.item.blackFlowerObjs[1]:SetActive(true)
	else
		self.item.blackFlowerObjs[0]:SetActive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:set_object_position(object_table)
	-- 수치에 따라 라보스 갯수 출력, 각 pos에 배치
	--object_table.value 라보스 갯수
	--object_table.main_pos 부유성 로봇 좌표
	--object_table.clone_x_pos 각 라보스 좌표
	self.current_object_table = object_table
	-- 몬스터 출력
	local monster_length = self.item.monsterObj.Length

	for i = 0, monster_length - 1 do
		if i < self.current_object_table.value then
			self.item.monsterObj[i]:SetActive(true)
		else
			self.item.monsterObj[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	-- 위치 처리
	self.item.robotObj.transform.localPosition = self.current_object_table.main_pos

	-- 몬스터 출력이 없으면 리턴
	if self.current_object_table.value <= 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.current_object_table.value - 1 do
		self.item.monsterObj[i].transform.localPosition = self.current_object_table.clone_pos[i + 1]
	end
end

function local_class:robot_animation(animation_name)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.object_animation, self, self.robot_animator, animation_name))
end

function local_class:object_idle_animation()
	if self.current_world_state ~= self.world_state.default then
		return
	end

	if self.is_robot_landmark then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.object_animation, self, self.robot_animator, 'robot_landmark_idle'))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.object_animation, self, self.robot_animator, 'robot_stand_idle'))
	end

	for i = 1, self.current_object_table.value do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.object_animation, self, self.monster_animator_table[i], self.current_object_table.clone_dir[i]))
	end
end

function local_class:object_animation(animator, animation_name)
	if animator == nil then
		return
	end

	while not animator.gameObject.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
end

function local_class:get_robot_object()
	return self.item.robotObj
end

function local_class:set_robot_landmark(state)
	self.is_robot_landmark = state
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.mobile_touch_camera = nil
	self.touch_input = nil
	self.monster_animator_table = nil
	self.current_object_table = nil

	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local local_class = newclass('MarbleEventFloor')
local util = require('xlua/util')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	self.dance_coroutine_id = 0
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	local con = CS.Oak.EventDataHelper.GetMarbleConstants()

	set_offset_scale(self.item.dancingStage:GetComponent('Transform'), con.MarbleDancestageOffset, con.MarbleDancestageSize, false)
	set_offset_scale(self.item.drum:GetComponent('Transform'), con.MarbleStagedrumOffset, con.MarbleStagedrumSize, false)
	set_offset_scale(self.item.leftBigSpeaker:GetComponent('Transform'), con.MarbleStagespeaker2Offset, con.MarbleStagespeaker2Size, false)
	set_offset_scale(self.item.leftSmallSpeaker:GetComponent('Transform'), con.MarbleStagespeaker1Offset, con.MarbleStagespeaker1Size, false)
	set_offset_scale(self.item.rightBigSpeaker:GetComponent('Transform'), con.MarbleStagespeaker2Offset, con.MarbleStagespeaker2Size, true)
	set_offset_scale(self.item.rightSmallSpeaker:GetComponent('Transform'), con.MarbleStagespeaker1Offset, con.MarbleStagespeaker1Size, true)
end

function get_dir(index)
	local i = index % 24
	if i < 7 or i > 18 then
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	else
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

function get_next_corner_idx(index)
	local i = index % 24

	if i < 7 then
		return 7
	elseif i < 12 then
		return 12
	elseif i < 19 then
		return 19
	else
		return 24
	end
end

function set_offset_scale(transform, offset_array, scale, flip_x)
	local pos = transform.localPosition
	if flip_x then
		pos.x = -offset_array[0]
	else
		pos.x = offset_array[0]
	end

	pos.z = offset_array[1]

	transform.localPosition = pos
	transform.localScale = transform.localScale * scale
end

function local_class:load()
	return util.cs_generator(self.load_internal, self)
end

function local_class:load_internal()
	-- 메인 캐릭터 로드
	local main_character = self.item.mainCharacter

	main_character.SortingLayer = "Default"
	main_character.SortingOrder = 100

	local runningCostume = CS.Oak.ItemData.Value:GetSpec(self:event_spec().RunningCostumes)

	if (runningCostume ~= nil) then
		coroutine.yield(main_character:UpdateCharacterAsync(runningCostume))
	else
		coroutine.yield(main_character:UpdateCharacterAsync(CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetById(self:event_spec().RunningCharacters)))
	end

	main_character:SetShadowRotation(CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity)

	-- 스테이지에서 춤추는 캐릭터 로드
	local dancing_character = self.item.dancingCharacter

	dancing_character.SortingLayer = "Default"
	dancing_character.SortingOrder = 210

	local dancingCostume = CS.Oak.ItemData.Value:GetSpec(self:event_spec().DancingCostumes)

	if (dancingCostume ~= nil) then
		coroutine.yield(dancing_character:UpdateCharacterAsync(dancingCostume))
	else
		coroutine.yield(dancing_character:UpdateCharacterAsync(CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetById(self:event_spec().DancingCharacters)))
	end

	dancing_character:SetShadowRotation(CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity)

	local event = self:user_event()
	self.sum_number = event.SumNumber
	self:set_main_character()

	for i = 0, 23 do
		self.item.items[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_level_text(event:GetTileLevel(i))
	end

	local spec = self:event_spec()

	-- 기타 NPC 로드
	local routines = {}

	for i = 0, spec.Phase1NpcCharactersId.Count - 1 do
		local char = self.item.phase1Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(char.set_character, char, spec.Phase1NpcCharactersId[i]))
	end

	for i = 0, spec.Phase2NpcCharactersId.Count - 1 do
		local char = self.item.phase2Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(char.set_character, char, spec.Phase2NpcCharactersId[i]))
	end

	for i = 0, spec.Phase3NpcCharactersId.Count - 1 do
		local char = self.item.phase3Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(char.set_character, char, spec.Phase3NpcCharactersId[i]))
	end

	for i = 0, spec.Phase4NpcCharactersId.Count - 1 do
		local char = self.item.phase4Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(char.set_character, char, spec.Phase4NpcCharactersId[i]))
	end

	self.no_input_alpha = 0

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitAll(table.unpack(routines)))

	self.item.dancingStage:SetAnimation(0, 'idle_dancestage1', true)
	self.item.drum:SetAnimation(0, 'idle', true)
	self.item.leftBigSpeaker:SetAnimation(0, 'idle', true)
	self.item.leftSmallSpeaker:SetAnimation(0, 'idle', true)
	self.item.rightBigSpeaker:SetAnimation(0, 'idle', true)
	self.item.rightSmallSpeaker:SetAnimation(0, 'idle', true)

	self.item.dancingStageSmokeEffect:SetActive(false)
	self.item.leftSpeakerSmokeEffect:SetActive(false)
	self.item.rightSpeakerSmokeEffect:SetActive(false)
	self.item.drumSmokeEffect:SetActive(false)

	self:set_stage()

	self.all_spines = self.item:GetAllSpineController()

	for i = 0, 23 do
		self.item.items[i].GetControllerLuaTable:test_rebuild()
	end
end

-- 이팩트 등 재정비용
function local_class:resume()
	for i = 0, 23 do
		self.item.items[i].GetControllerLuaTable:reset_effect()
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.phase1Characters.Length - 1 do
		self.item.phase1Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:off_fall_effect()
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.phase2Characters.Length - 1 do
		self.item.phase2Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:off_fall_effect()
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.phase3Characters.Length - 1 do
		self.item.phase3Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:off_fall_effect()
	end

	self.item.monopolyFirework:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:pause()
end

-- 외부에서 IEnumerator로 부르는 함수
function local_class:play_dice_once(param_list)
	local index = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.play_dice_once_internal, self, index)
end

-- 외부에서 IEnumerator로 부르는 함수
function local_class:play_dice_five(param_list)
	local indexs = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.play_dice_five_internal, self, indexs)
end

function local_class:play_dice_once_internal(index)
	self.item.diceObject:SetActive(true)
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_gatcha_box_02")

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.4))

	local dice = self.item.oneDiceAnimator
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_dice_01")
	dice.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	dice:Play("marble_dice_" .. index)

	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.play_dice_sound, self))

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(2))
	dice.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.diceObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:play_dice_five_internal(indexs)
	self.item.diceObject:SetActive(true)
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_gatcha_box_02")

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.4))

	local dices = self.item.fiveDiceAnimator

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_dice_01")
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local index = indexs[i]
		local dice = dices[i]

		dice.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		dice:Play("marble_dice_" .. index)

		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.play_dice_sound, self))

		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.1))
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(2))

	for i = 0, 4 do
		dices[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.item.diceObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:play_dice_sound()
	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.75))

	if CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 2) < 1 then
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_dice_02")
	else
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_dice_03")
	end
end

-- 외부에서 IEnumerator로 부르는 함수
function local_class:move(param_list)
	local amounts = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.move_internal, self, amounts)
end

function local_class:move_internal(amounts)
	local is_once = amounts.Count == 1

	for i = 0, amounts.Count - 1 do
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_worldmap_walk_01")

		-- 주사위 한 개만큼 움직이고
		for _ = 1, amounts[i] do
			self:move_one(is_once)
		end

		-- 밟은 곳 레벨업 처리
		self:floor_item(self.sum_number).GetControllerLuaTable:on_level_up()

		-- 잠시 딜레이
		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.33))
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.5))
end

function local_class:move_one(is_once)
	local char_transform = self.item.mainCharacter.SpineContainer.parent
	local from = char_transform.localPosition
	local to = self:floor_item(self.sum_number + 1).transform.localPosition

	local distance = (from - to).magnitude

	local time = 0

	local speed
	if is_once then
		speed = self.item.mainMoveSpeedOnce
	else
		speed = self.item.mainMoveSpeedFive
	end

	local finish_time = distance / speed
	local peak_height = distance * 6

	-- 밟는 느낌 나게 포물선 느낌으로 움직임
	while (time < finish_time) do
		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

		local pos = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(from, to, time / finish_time)

		pos.y = pos.y + get_jump_height(time, finish_time, peak_height)
		char_transform.localPosition = pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	char_transform.localPosition = to
	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(finish_time / 7))

	self.sum_number = self.sum_number + 1
	self.item.mainCharacter:SetDirection(get_dir(self.sum_number))
end

function get_jump_height(cur_time, finish_time, peak_height)
	finish_time = finish_time / 2
	local a = -peak_height / (finish_time * finish_time)
	return a * (cur_time - finish_time) * (cur_time - finish_time) + peak_height
end

-- 외부에서 IEnumerator로 부르는 함수
function local_class:do_monopoly(param_list)
	local monopoly = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.do_monopoly_internal, self, monopoly)
end

	fire:SetActive(false)

	-- 모서리 모노폴리는 연출 대신 스테이지에 변화가 있음

		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.5))

		local monopoly_count = self:get_corner_monopoly_count()

		self:set_stage()

		if monopoly_count == 1 then
			self.item.drumSmokeEffect:SetActive(true)
		elseif monopoly_count == 2 then
			self.item.leftSpeakerSmokeEffect:SetActive(true)
			self.item.rightSpeakerSmokeEffect:SetActive(true)
		end

		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.5))

	-- 모서리가 아닌 일반 모노폴리
	else
		-- 불꽃놀이 재생
		fire:SetActive(true)
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_firework_01")
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_crowd_clap_02")

		-- 동시에 모노폴리 연출을 해야 하는 NPC를 전부 긁어온다.
		local routines = {}

		for i = 0, self.item.phase1Characters.Length - 1 do
			local char = self.item.phase1Characters[i]

			if char.targetMonopoly == monopoly then
				local monopoly_char = char.GetControllerLuaTable
				table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(monopoly_char.do_monopoly, monopoly_char))
			end
		end

		for i = 0, self.item.phase2Characters.Length - 1 do
			local char = self.item.phase2Characters[i]

			if char.targetMonopoly == monopoly then
				local monopoly_char = char.GetControllerLuaTable
				table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(monopoly_char.do_monopoly, monopoly_char))
			end
		end

		for i = 0, self.item.phase3Characters.Length - 1 do
			local char = self.item.phase3Characters[i]

			end
		end

		-- 그 후 전부 동시에 진행
		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitAll(table.unpack(routines)))

		self:set_stage()
	end

	if self:user_event():IsAllMonopolyClaimed() then
		self:floor_item(0).GetControllerLuaTable:on_level_up_inn()
		coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.8))
		CS.Oak.PopUpUtil.ShowFanfarePopUp(CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('marble_all_monopoly_claimed'))

function local_class:set_stage()
	-- 연출이 3페이즈까지 고려되어있어서 3을 멕스로 가짐
	local phase = math.min(CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance:GetPhase(), 3)

	local dancing_character = self.item.dancingCharacter

	if (phase == 3) then
		-- 모서리 모노폴리 달성 카운트
		local monopoly_count = self:get_corner_monopoly_count()

		local stage_number = 1

		if monopoly_count == 3 then
			stage_number = 3
		elseif monopoly_count >= 1 then
			stage_number = 2
		end

		self.item.dancingStage:SetAnimation(0, 'idle_dancestage' .. stage_number, true)

		self.item.drum.gameObject:SetActive(monopoly_count >= 1)
		self.item.leftBigSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(monopoly_count >= 2)
		self.item.leftSmallSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(monopoly_count >= 2)
		self.item.rightBigSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(monopoly_count >= 2)
		self.item.rightSmallSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(monopoly_count >= 2)

		dancing_character.SpineContainer.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.dancingStage.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.do_dance, self))
	else
		-- 3페이즈 이하일 때 무대 장치 다 꺼줌
		dancing_character.SpineContainer.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.dancingStage.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.drum.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.leftBigSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.leftSmallSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.rightBigSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.rightSmallSpeaker.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

-- 모서리 모노폴리 달성 카운트
function local_class:get_corner_monopoly_count()
	local user_event = self:user_event()

	local monopoly_count = 0

	if (user_event:IsMonopolyFinished(10)) then
		monopoly_count = monopoly_count + 1
	end

	if (user_event:IsMonopolyFinished(11)) then
		monopoly_count = monopoly_count + 1
	end

	if (user_event:IsMonopolyFinished(12)) then
		monopoly_count = monopoly_count + 1
	end

	return monopoly_count
end

function local_class:do_dance()
	self.dance_coroutine_id = self.dance_coroutine_id + 1
	local this_id = self.dance_coroutine_id
	local char = self.item.dancingCharacter

	char:SetAnimation('dance', true)
	char:SetEmotion('smile', true, -1, true)

	local flip_interval = 1.075

	local next_flip_time = flip_interval
	local flip_count = 1

	local time = 0

	-- interval 간격으로 좌우로 뒤집는다.
	while true do
		if self.dance_coroutine_id ~= this_id then
			return
		end

		if (time > next_flip_time) then
			flip_count = flip_count + 1
			next_flip_time = flip_count * flip_interval

			local cur_dir = char.SpineController.Direction
			char:SetDirection(get_flip_dir(cur_dir))
		end

		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_input_change(no_input)
	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.bonus_fade, self, no_input))
end

function local_class:bonus_fade(no_input)
	if not no_input then
		for i = 0, self.item.phase4Characters.Length - 1 do
			local cha = self.item.phase4Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable
			CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(cha.runaway, cha))
		end

		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.phase4Characters.Length - 1 do
		local cha = self.item.phase4Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable

		cha:set_delay(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(4, 14))

		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(cha.fade_in, cha))
	end
end

function get_flip_dir(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	else
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item.mainCharacter:Dispose()

	self.dance_coroutine_id = self.dance_coroutine_id + 1
	self.item.dancingCharacter:Dispose()

	for i = 0, self.item.phase1Characters.Length - 1 do
		self.item.phase1Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:dispose()
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.phase2Characters.Length - 1 do
		self.item.phase2Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:dispose()
	end

	for i = 0, self.item.phase3Characters.Length - 1 do
		self.item.phase3Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:dispose()
	end
	
	for i = 0, self.item.phase4Characters.Length - 1 do
        self.item.phase4Characters[i].GetControllerLuaTable:dispose()
    end

	for i = 0, 23 do
		self.item.items[i].GetControllerLuaTable:dispose()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local local_class = newclass('MarbleEventFloorBonusCharacter')

	self.item = item
	self.orig_pos = item.transform.localPosition
	self.delay = 0
	self.stop_fade = false
	self.move_duration = 4
end

function local_class:set_character(spec_id)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(self:is_monopoly_finished())

	local char = self.item.character

	char.SortingLayer = "Default"
	char.SortingOrder = 210

	coroutine.yield(char:UpdateCharacterAsync(CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetById(spec_id)))

	char:SetShadowRotation(CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity)
	char:SetEmotion('smile', true, -1, true)
	char:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)

function local_class:activate()

end

function local_class:fade_in()
	self.move_time = 0
	self.stop_fade = false
	self.item.character:SetDirection(self.item.defaultDirection)

	local time = 0

	while time < self.delay do
		if self.stop_fade then
			return
		end

		self:set_alpha(0)

		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	while self.move_time < self.move_duration do
		if self.stop_fade then
			return
		end

		local progress = self.move_time * (1 / self.move_duration)

		self.item.transform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(self.orig_pos, self.item.runInsidePosition, progress)
		self:set_alpha(progress)

		self.move_time = self.move_time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:set_alpha(1)
	self.item.transform.localPosition = self.item.runInsidePosition
end

	self.item.character:SetDirection(get_flip_dir(self.item.defaultDirection))

		self.item.transform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(self.orig_pos, self.item.runInsidePosition, run_progress)
		self:set_alpha(run_progress)

		self.move_time = self.move_time - CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime * self.move_duration
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:set_alpha(0)
	self.item.transform.localPosition = self.orig_pos
end

function local_class:set_alpha(v)

	--self.item.character:Dispose()

	else
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end

require('base/class')
local local_class = newclass('MarbleEventFloorCharacter')
local util = require('xlua/util')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
	self.coroutine_id = 0
	self.fall_effect = item.transform:Find('fx_marble_smoke').gameObject
	self.fall_effect:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:set_character(spec_id)
	-- 연출이 3페이즈까지 고려되어있어서 3을 멕스로 가짐
	local phase = math.min(CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance:GetPhase(), 3)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(self.item.phase <= phase)

	local char = self.item.character

	char.SortingLayer = "Default"
	char.SortingOrder = 210

	coroutine.yield(char:UpdateCharacterAsync(CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetById(spec_id)))

	char:SetDirection(self.item.defaultDirection)
	char:SetShadowRotation(CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity)

	if self:is_monopoly_finished() then
		self.item.transform.localPosition = self.item.monopolyPosition
	end

	self:set_phase_behaviour()
end

-- 각 페이즈 별로 NPC가 할 행동을 세팅
function local_class:set_phase_behaviour()
	if not self.item.gameObject.activeSelf then
		return
	end

	if self:is_monopoly_finished() then
		self:set_behaviour(self.item.monopolyBehaviour)
		return
	end

	-- 연출이 3페이즈까지 고려되어있어서 3을 멕스로 가짐
	local phase = math.min(CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance:GetPhase(), 3)

	if phase == 1 then
		self:set_behaviour(self.item.phase1Behaviour)
	elseif phase == 2 then
		self:set_behaviour(self.item.phase2Behaviour)
	else
		self:set_behaviour(self.item.phase3Behaviour)
	end
end

-- 모노폴리 달성 시 연출
function local_class:do_monopoly()
	self:stop_behaviour()

	local char_transform = self.item.transform
	local from = char_transform.localPosition
	local to = self.item.runInsidePosition

	local time = 0
	local finish_time = 0.5

	self.item.character:SetAlphaFade(0, finish_time)

	-- 현재 위치에서 runInsidePosition까지 달려가면서 투명해짐
	while (time < finish_time) do
		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

		local progress = time * (1 / finish_time)

		char_transform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(from, to, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.3))

	local appear_time = 0.5

	-- 그 후 monopolyPosition에서 등장함
	char_transform.localPosition = self.item.monopolyPosition
	self.item.character:SetAlphaFade(1, appear_time)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(appear_time + 0.2))

	self.item.character:SetAnimation('victory_get', false)
	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.WaitForSeconds(0.8))

	self:set_phase_behaviour()
end

function local_class:off_fall_effect()
	self.fall_effect:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:fall()
	local char = self.item.character
	local char_transform = char.SpineContainer.parent
	local from = char_transform.localPosition
	local to = char_transform.localPosition
	self:off_fall_effect()
	from.z = from.z + 2.5

	char_transform.localPosition = from
	char:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)

	local time = 0
	local finish_time = 1

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.item.character:SetAlphaFade(1, finish_time)

	-- 위쪽에서 등속으로 떨어짐
	while (time < finish_time) do
		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

		local progress = time * (1 / finish_time)

		progress = progress * progress

		char_transform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(from, to, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	char_transform.localPosition = to
	self.fall_effect:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:set_behaviour(name)
	self:stop_behaviour()

	if name == 'hima' then
		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.behaviour_hima, self))
	elseif name == 'fun' then
		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.behaviour_fun, self))
	elseif name == 'monopoly' then
		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.behaviour_monopoly, self))
	end
end

function local_class:stop_behaviour()
	self.coroutine_id = self.coroutine_id + 1
end

function local_class:behaviour_hima()
	local this_id = self.coroutine_id
	local char = self.item.character
	local time = 0
	local behaviour_time = 2
	local rest_time = 3

	local ran_start_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 3)

	while time < ran_start_time do
		if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
			return
		end

		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	while true do
		local ran = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 3)
		if (ran < 1) then
			char:SetAnimation('question', false)
		elseif (ran < 2) then
			char:SetAnimation('seat')
		else
			char:SetAnimation('frustration', false)
		end

		char:SetEmotion('tired', true, -1, true)

		time = 0
		while time < behaviour_time do
			if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
				char:ClearEmotion()
				char:SetAnimation('idle')
				return
			end

			time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		char:ClearEmotion()
		char:SetAnimation('idle')

		time = 0
		while time < rest_time do
			if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
				return
			end

			time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:behaviour_fun()
	local this_id = self.coroutine_id
	local char = self.item.character
	local time = 0
	local behaviour_time = 2
	local rest_time = 3

	local ran_start_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 3)

	while time < ran_start_time do
		if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
			return
		end

		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	while true do
		local ran = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 2)
		if (ran < 1) then
			char:SetAnimation('victory_extra')
			char:SetEmotion('smile', true, -1, true)
		else
			char:SetAnimation('clap')
			char:SetEmotion('love', true, -1, true)
		end


		time = 0
		while time < behaviour_time do
			if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
				char:ClearEmotion()
				char:SetAnimation('idle')
				return
			end

			time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		char:ClearEmotion()
		char:SetAnimation('idle')

		time = 0
		while time < rest_time do
			if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
				return
			end

			time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:behaviour_monopoly()
	local this_id = self.coroutine_id
	local char = self.item.character
	local time = 0
	local behaviour_time = 2
	local rest_time = 3

	local ran_start_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 3)

	while time < ran_start_time do
		if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
			return
		end

		time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	while true do
		local ran = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 6)
		local do_flip = false
		if (ran < 1) then
			char:SetAnimation('dance')
			char:SetEmotion('awesome', true, -1, true)
			do_flip = true
		elseif (ran < 2) then
			char:SetAnimation('clap')
			char:SetEmotion('smile', true, -1, true)
		elseif (ran < 3) then
			char:SetAnimation('throw')
			char:SetEmotion('awesome', true, -1, true)
			do_flip = true
		elseif (ran < 4) then
			char:SetAnimation('dance')
			char:SetEmotion('smile', true, -1, true)
			do_flip = true
		elseif (ran < 5) then
			char:SetAnimation('victory-extra')
			char:SetEmotion('smile', true, -1, true)
		elseif (ran < 6) then
			char:SetAnimation('clap')
			char:SetEmotion('love', true, -1, true)
		end

		time = 0
		if do_flip then
			local flip_interval = 0.5

			local next_flip_time = flip_interval
			local flip_count = 1

			-- interval 간격으로 좌우로 뒤집는다.
			while time < behaviour_time do
				if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
					char:ClearEmotion()
					char:SetAnimation('idle')
					char:SetDirection(self.item.defaultDirection)
					return
				end

				if (time > next_flip_time) then
					flip_count = flip_count + 1
					next_flip_time = flip_count * flip_interval

					local cur_dir = char.SpineController.Direction
					char:SetDirection(get_flip_dir(cur_dir))
				end

				time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			char:SetDirection(self.item.defaultDirection)
		else
			while time < behaviour_time do
				if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
					char:ClearEmotion()
					char:SetAnimation('idle')
					return
				end

				time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		char:ClearEmotion()
		char:SetAnimation('idle')

		time = 0
		while time < rest_time do
			if self.coroutine_id ~= this_id then
				return
			end

			time = time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function get_flip_dir(dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	else
		return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end
end

function local_class:is_monopoly_finished()
	return CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.MarbleEvents[CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance.EventId]:IsMonopolyFinished(self.item.targetMonopoly)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:stop_behaviour()
	--self.item.character:Dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	self.label_default_color = self.label.color

	-- 레벨업 이펙트
	self.levelup_effect = item.transform:Find('levelup').gameObject
	self.maxlevel_effect = item.transform:Find('maxlevel').gameObject
	self.maxlevel_effect:SetActive(false)

	self.building_sprite.SpriteName = self.item.Spec.Building
	local t = self.building_sprite.transform

	local p = t.localPosition
	p.x = self.item.Spec.Offset[0]
	p.y = self.item.Spec.Offset[1]
	t.localPosition = p

	local scale = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.one * self.item.Spec.Scale
	local step = self.item.step

	-- 어차피 루아니까 매직넘버 하드코딩
	if step == 1 or step == 2 or step == 3 or step == 5 or step == 6 or step == 13 or step == 14 or step == 15 or step == 17 or step == 18 then
		scale.x = -scale.x
	end

	t.localScale = scale

	self:reset_sorting_order(0)
end

function local_class:reset_effect()
	self.levelup_effect:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:set_tint(tinted)
	local color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.white

	if tinted then
		color.r = color.r * 0.5
		color.g = color.g * 0.5
		color.b = color.b * 0.5
	end

	self.floor_sprite.color = color
	self.building_sprite.TintColor = color
	self.building_sprite:Rebuild()

	if tinted then
		self.label.color = self.label_tinted_color
	else
		self.label.color = self.label_default_color
	end

	if self.sign_sprite ~= nil then
		local custom_sprite = self.sign_sprite:GetComponent('SpriteRenderer')
		custom_sprite.color = color
	end
end

function local_class:test_rebuild()
	--self.building_sprite.Atlas:Clear()
	self.building_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:reset_sorting_order(offset)
	local order_base = math.abs(self.item.step - 12) + offset
	local building_order = order_base * 3 + 24

	self.floor_sprite.sortingOrder = order_base
	self.building_sprite.SortingOrder = building_order
	self.building_sprite:Rebuild()

	-- sign 간판 있는 곳은 플레이어블 케릭터 뎁스(100)보다 뎁스 위에 있어야 한다.
	if self.sign_sprite ~= nil then
		local sign_custom_sprite = self.sign_sprite:GetComponent('SpriteRenderer')
		sign_custom_sprite.sortingOrder = 120
		self.label.sortingOrder = 125
	else
		self.label.sortingOrder = 98
	end

	self:reset_levelup_effect_sorting_order(building_order)
end

function local_class:reset_levelup_effect_sorting_order(step)
	local target_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.levelup_effect.transform, 'back_a')
	local back_a = target_transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
	back_a.sortingOrder = step - 1

	target_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.levelup_effect.transform, 'back_b')
	local back_b = target_transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SortingLayer))
	back_b.Order = step - 1

	target_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.levelup_effect.transform, 'front_a')
	local front_a = target_transform.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
	front_a.sortingOrder = step + 1

	target_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.levelup_effect.transform, 'front_b')
	local front_b = target_transform.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SortingLayer))
	front_b.Order = step + 1
end

function local_class:set_level_text(level)
	local max_level = 5

	if level == max_level then
		self.maxlevel_effect:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.label.text = level
end

	self.maxlevel_effect:SetActive(false)

function local_class:set_maxlevel_effect()
	local event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.MarbleEvents[CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance.EventId]
	self:set_level_text(event:GetTileLevel(self.item.step))
end

function local_class:on_level_up()
	self.levelup_effect:SetActive(false)

	-- 첫 칸의 여관은 밟아서 레벨업하지 않는다.
	if self.item.step == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 이미 만렙이면 무시
	if self.maxlevel_effect.activeSelf then
		return
	end

	local event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.MarbleEvents[CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance.EventId]
	self:set_level_text(event:GetTileLevel(self.item.step))

	self.levelup_effect:SetActive(true)

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_arcade_number_01")

	if self.maxlevel_effect.activeSelf then
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("02_magic_heal_01")
	else
		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot("01_enhance_light_01", 0.6)
	end
end

-- 여관 전용 레벨업 이펙트 켜주는 함수
function local_class:on_level_up_inn()
	self.levelup_effect:SetActive(false)

	if self.item.step ~= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 이미 만렙이면 무시
	if self.maxlevel_effect.activeSelf then
		return
	end

	local event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.MarbleEvents[CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance.EventId]

	if event:IsAllMonopolyClaimed() then
		self:set_level_text(5)
	else
		self:set_level_text(event:GetPhase())
	end

	self.levelup_effect:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:get_level()
	local event = CS.Oak.UserEvent.Me.MarbleEvents[CS.Oak.UI.MarbleEventMain.Instance.EventId]
	return event.TileLevels[self.item.step]
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

		util.cs_generator(self.make_button, self),
