function local_class:make_button()
	local chapter_data = CS.Oak.ChapterData.Value:GetChapterData(self.item.ChapterCode)
	local chapter_name = chapter_data.ChapterName
	local bundle_name = "ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/worldmap/common"

	local button_prefab = nil

	--local sw = CS.System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, bundle_name, 'worldmap_button_new_lua', function(prefab)
				button_prefab = prefab
			end)

	--print('worldmap_button LoadPrefabAsync, '..sw.ElapsedMilliseconds..'ms')

	--sw = CS.System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew()

	if is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		return
	end

	self.world_map_controller = self.item.worldmapParent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenCastleWorldMapController)).GetControllerLuaTable

	local buttons = self.item.stageParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder))
	local length = buttons.Length
	local world_map_button_data = nil

	if self.world_map_data[chapter_name] ~= nil then
		world_map_button_data = self.world_map_data[chapter_name].world_map_button
	end

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local stage_name = buttons[i].name
		self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:Add(stage_name, buttons[i])

		local btn = buttons[i]
		local btn_t = btn.transform
		local savedRotation = btn_t.localRotation
		btn_t.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		local savedScale = btn_t.localScale
		btn_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		local button_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_prefab)
		local button_obj_t = button_obj.transform
		button_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
		button_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		local button = button_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

		if not is_unity_null(button) then
			button.StageName = btn.name

			local stage_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.worldmapParent, stage_name)

			if stage_obj ~= nil then
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj.gameObject)
			end

			self.stage_button_dic:Add(button.StageName, button)

			button.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button_value(world_map_button_data)
			button:SetButton(btn)

			btn_t.localRotation = savedRotation
			btn_t.localScale = savedScale
		end

		-- 악몽 1스테이지 인 경우 현황판 UI를 붙혀준다.
		if stage_name == self.check_path_stage_name then
			local parent = button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_button_parent()

			self.board_ui_prefab.transform:SetParent(parent)
			self.board_ui_prefab.transform.localPosition = vector(70, 65, 0)
			self.board_ui_prefab.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

			self.board_ui_prefab:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_path()
	self.path_placeholder_array = self.item.pathParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder))

	if self.path_placeholder_array == nil then
		return
	end

	local length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length
	local info_length = table_util.get_size(self.path_placeholder_info_table)

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local parent_name = self.path_placeholder_array[i].transform.parent.name

		if info_length ~= 0 or table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, parent_name) then
			local path_info = self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name]
			path_info[self.path_placeholder_array[i].name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

			self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name] = path_info
		else
			local world_map_path_placeholder_info = {}
			world_map_path_placeholder_info[self.path_placeholder_array[i].name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

			self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name] = world_map_path_placeholder_info
		end

		self:set_path_state(parent_name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name)
	end

	return
end

function local_class:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)
	if table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, parent_name) then

		local path_info = self.path_placeholder_info_table[parent_name]

		if table_util.contain_key(path_info, path_name) then
			return path_info[path_name]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, path_state)
	local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			value:Remove(path_name)
			value:Add(path_name, path_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from, to, path_state)
	if path_state == nil then
		path_state = self.path_state.none
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	if path_state == self.path_state.none then
		path_state = self:get_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from, to)
	end

	local points = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	local from_button = path_placeholder.From
	local to_button = path_placeholder.To

	if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
		if path_placeholder.Hidden then
			return
		end

		self.point_num = 0

		-- Straight path 일때 설정
		if path_placeholder.worldmapPathType == CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight then
			-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
			local total_points = {}
			total_points[1] = from_button.transform.position

			local point_size = table_util.get_size(points)
			for i = 1, point_size do
				total_points[i + 1] = points[i]
			end

			total_points[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

			self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, total_points, path_placeholder.worldmapPathType, false)
		else

		end
	elseif path_state == self.path_state.closed then
		-- 해당 pathName 으로 생성되어있던 오브젝트 가 없다면 새로 생성한다.
		local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

		if has_value then
			self.path_name_dic:Remove(p_name)
			local path_table = self.path_table[parent_name]
			local path_size = table_util.get_size(path_table)
			local remove_pos = -1

			for i = 1, path_size do
				if path_table[i] == p_name then
					remove_pos = i
					break
				end
			end

			table.remove(path_table, remove_pos)
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(value)

			local line = self.straight_line_info[p_name]
			self.straight_line_info[p_name] = nil

			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(line)
		end

		self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.closed)
	end
end

function local_class:get_path_state(parent_name, path_name, from_stage_name, to_stage_name)
	local from_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(from_stage_name)
	local to_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(to_stage_name)

	local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			if value_2 == self.path_state.closed and string.find(path_name, 'default') then
				if from_stage_opened and to_stage_opened then
					value:Remove(path_name)
					value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

					return self.path_state.opened
				end
			end

			return value_2
		end
	end

	local stage_meta_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageMetaData')
	local from_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(from_stage_name)
	local stage_progress = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Instance:GetStageProgress(from_stage_spec)
	local is_no_exit = true

	if not is_unity_null(stage_progress) then
		local exit_store = stage_progress[CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.Exit]
		local key_value = stage_meta_data:GetExitIndex(from_stage_spec.Tilemap, path_name)
		local is_key = false
		if key_value ~= -1 then
			is_key = true
		end

		if is_key then
			if exit_store == nil then
				is_no_exit = true
			else
				is_no_exit = not exit_store:GetBoolean(key_value)
			end
		end
	end

	if is_no_exit then
		local dic = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
		dic:Add(path_name, self.path_state.none)

		if not self.path_state_dic:ContainsKey(parent_name) then
			self.path_state_dic:Add(parent_name, dic)
		else
			has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
			if has_value then
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.none)
			end
		end

		-- default path 면 나가지 않고 stageOpen 상태까지 체크함
		if not string.find(path_name, 'default') then
			return self.path_state.none
		end
	else
		local dic = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
		dic:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

		if not self.path_state_dic:ContainsKey(parent_name) then
			self.path_state_dic:Add(parent_name, dic)
		else
			has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
			if has_value then
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)
			end
		end
	end

	if from_stage_opened and to_stage_opened then
		has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
		if has_value then
			local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
			if has_value_2 then
				value:Remove(path_name)
				value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)
			end
		end

		--self.path_state_dic[parent_name][path_name] = self.path_state.opened
		return self.path_state.opened
	end

	has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)
	if has_value then
		local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
		if has_value_2 then
			value:Remove(path_name)
			value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.closed)
		end
	end

	return self.path_state.closed
end

function local_class:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, point_table, path_type, new_line, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)

	if point_length == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 해당 pathName 으로 생성되어있던 오브젝트 가 없다면 새로 생성한다.
	local p_name = path_name..'_'..parent_name
	local has_value, path = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

	if not has_value then
		path = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject(p_name)
		self.path_name_dic:Add(p_name, path)

		if table_util.contain_key(self.path_table, parent_name) then
			local path_table = self.path_table[parent_name]
			table.insert(path_table, p_name)
			self.path_table[parent_name] = path_table
		else
			self.path_table[parent_name] = {}
			local path_table = {}
			table.insert(path_table, p_name)
			self.path_table[parent_name] = path_table
		end
	end

	local path_t = path.transform
	path_t:SetParent(self.item.pathParentT)

	path_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	path_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	self:make_straight_line(path_placeholder, p_name, point_table, new_line, progress)
end

function local_class:make_straight_line(path_placeholder, path_name, point_table, new_line, progress)
	if path_placeholder.Hidden then
		return
	end

	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	if new_line == nil then
		new_line = false
	end

	local point_value = 12
	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	local position_count = point_value * (point_length - 1)

	-- 현재 progress 를 기준으로 opened 로 표시해야할 길이를 구한다.
	local cur_progress = 1

	if progress >= 0 then
		cur_progress = progress
	end

	local temp_count = position_count * cur_progress
	local length = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(temp_count)
	local line_length = point_value

	local line = nil

	if not table_util.contain_key(self.straight_line_info, path_name) then
		local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line')

		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
		end

		path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
		line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))

		self.straight_line_info[path_name] = line
		self:set_straight_line(line)
	elseif new_line then
		local path_name_transform = nil
		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path_name_transform = value.transform
		end

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(path_name_transform, 'line_new')

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path_transform.gameObject, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))
		else
			local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line_new')
			path1.transform.parent = value.transform
			path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
			line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))
		end

		self:set_straight_line(line)
	else
		line = self.straight_line_info[path_name]
	end

	local vec_length = 1

	if point_length > 2 then
		vec_length = self:get_total_path_length(point_table) * self.path_straight_line_draw_factor
	end

	line.positionCount = length

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		local from = point_table[i]
		local to = point_table[i + 1]
		local line_index = (i - 1) * point_value

		local temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

		if temp_point_num == i then
			self.point_num = self.point_num + 1
			temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

			if not path_placeholder.Hidden and temp_point_num > 2 then
				if self.path_point ~= nil then
					local point_obj = game_object.Instantiate(self.path_point, line.transform.parent)
					point_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.path_point_rotation)
					point_obj.transform.localPosition = point_table[i]
					point_obj.transform.localScale = self.path_point_scale

					if progress > -1 then
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_path_point_sfx_handle_name)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for index = 0, line_length - 1 do
			local convert_value = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(index)
			local t =  convert_value / (line_length - 1)
			local point = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, t)

			if line_index >= length then
				return
			end

			line:SetPosition(line_index, point)
			line_index = line_index + 1

			line.material.mainTextureScale = vector(line_index * vec_length, 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_straight_line(line)
	line.material = self.line_material

	line.startWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.endWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.shadowBias = 0
	line.useWorldSpace = false

	line.sortingLayerName = 'Default'
	line.sortingOrder = 10
end

function local_class:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local total_length = 0

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	if way_point_table == nil or point_length == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		total_length = total_length + (way_point_table[i + 1] - way_point_table[i]).magnitude
	end

	return total_length
end

function local_class:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)
	local point_table = {}
	local way_points = path_placeholder.Path

	if way_points == nil or way_points.Length == 0 then
		if is_unity_null(path_placeholder.reversePathPlaceholder) then
			return nil
		end

		-- 반대 방향이 존재하면 해당 방향의 path를 가져옴 (추가 안한 상태)
	end

	for i = 0, way_points.Length - 1 do
		table.insert(point_table, way_points[i].position)
	end

	return point_table
end

function local_class:get_path_name(from, to)
	local path_placeholder_length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	-- from, to가 비어 있어서는 안된다
	if from == nil or to == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for i = 0, path_placeholder_length - 1 do
		-- from 스테이지와 to 스테이지가 같으면 from -> waypoins -> to 순서로 배열에 넣어 리턴한다.
		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, from) and string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, to) then
			return self.path_placeholder_array[i].name
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:setting_camera(camera)
	self.mobile_touch_camera = camera

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		return
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMin = self.camera_zoom_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMin = self.camera_boundary_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMax = self.camera_boundary_max

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	else
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) and user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
		local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition

		self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)
	else
		local last_stage_position = self.item:GetPreviousStageButtonPosition()

		self:set_camera_local_pos(last_stage_position)
	end
end

function local_class:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)
	local new_pos = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = new_pos
end

function local_class:get_waypoints_full_path(parent_name, from, to)
	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(from)

	local way_point_pos_table = {}
	way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = point_table[i]
	end

	return way_point_pos_table
end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	local cleared_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	self.is_routine = true
	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(false)

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
			and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	self.is_routine = false
	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_active(true)
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine()
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prev_stage_spec.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	local stage_state = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stage_state & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출을 보여준다.
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

		user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
		self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local parent_name = path_transform.name
	local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName

	-- 이동할 스테이지가 이번에 오픈될 경우에는 Open 연출후에 이동한다.
	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

		self:set_path_state_info(parent_name, path_name, self.path_state.opened)

		coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
				self.world_map_state.CustomEvent))

		-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
		-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
		user_progress:SetStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.AdditionalOpenStage)
	else
		-- 다음 스테이지가 오픈이 되어있다면, 스테이지 이동만 한다.
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

		local has_value, value = self.path_state_dic:TryGetValue(parent_name)

		if has_value then
			local has_value_2, value_2 = value:TryGetValue(path_name)
			if has_value_2 then
				local path_state = value_2

				if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
					coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName, 1))
				else
					value:Remove(path_name)
					value:Add(path_name, self.path_state.opened)

					coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName,
							self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.CustomEvent))
				end
			else
				coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName, 1))
			end
		else
			coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName, 1))
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지 입장 패널 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_stage_enter_panel_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.focus_camera_size))
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
	-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
	self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
	self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()

	local icon = nil
	-- board ui 처리
	for k,v in pairs(self.board_icon_table) do
		if k == self.world_map_state.PrevStageName then
			icon = v
			break
		end
	end

	if icon == nil then
		return
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.check_path_stage_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.board_sfx_handle_name)

	self.board_ui_effect.transform.localPosition = icon.transform.localPosition
	self.board_ui_effect:SetActive(true)

	icon.Alpha = self.board_off_value
	icon:Rebuild()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.board_ui_effect:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	coroutine.yield(prev_stage_button:ShowGetStarGrade(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	-- 연출 처리를 위해 비워주기 전에 캐싱
	local stage_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	coroutine.yield(world_map_background_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, prev_stage_spec.ChapterCode, CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance.SceneManager, nil))
end

function local_class:clear_stage(cleared_stage)
	local clear_stage_bBtn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(cleared_stage)

	if clear_stage_bBtn ~= nil then
		clear_stage_bBtn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'victory_get', false)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
end

function local_class:open_and_move_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event)
	local prev_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(prev_stage)
	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	local dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	if open_stage_btn.transform.parent.localPosition.x < prev_stage_btn.transform.parent.localPosition.x then
		dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'clap', true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = dir

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, false, custom_event))

	coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(prev_stage, open_stage, 1))
end

function local_class:open_stage(param_list)
	return util.cs_generator(self.open_stage_start, self, param_list[0], param_list[1], param_list[2], param_list[3])
end

function local_class:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, wait_open_complete , custom_event)
	if wait_open_complete == nil then
		wait_open_complete = false
	end

	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	if open_stage_btn ~= nil then
		if not self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(open_stage) then
			coroutine.yield(open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가
			local effect_name = self.main_open_stage_effect_name
			local effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(open_stage_btn.transform.position)

			effect.transform.localScale = self.main_open_stage_effect_scale
			effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)

			effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	if not self.is_teleport_move then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_path(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event))
	end

	if wait_open_complete then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:open_path(from, to, custom_event)
	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, from)
	local parent_name = ''

	if path_transform ~= nil then
		parent_name = path_transform.name
	end

	-- from이 nil일 경우는 제일 처음 오픈 연출뿐
	if from == nil then
		return
	end

	local path_name = ''

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		-- exit로 나왔을 경우
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	else
		path_name = self:get_path_name(from, to)
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(path_placeholder)

	if point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- straight path만 대응
	coroutine.yield(self:open_straight_path(path_placeholder, parent_name, path_name, point_table))
end

function local_class:open_straight_path(path_place, parent_name, path_name, point_table)
	local from_button = path_place.From
	local to_button = path_place.To

	-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
	local total_points = {}
	total_points[1] = from_button.transform.position

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		total_points[i + 1] = point_table[i]
	end

	total_points[point_size + 2] = to_button.transform.position

	local time_passed = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local progress = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)

	self.point_num = 0

	while time_passed < time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(time_passed, 0, time)

		progress = time_passed / time

		self:make_path_line(parent_name, path_name, total_points, CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder.WorldmapPathType.Straight, false, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_stage(from_stage, to_stage, duration)
	-- 길이 hidden 상태일 때는 텔레포트로 이동 (해당 스테이지의 디폴트 위치로 간다)
	if self.is_teleport_move then
		wait_for_sec(self.character_mario_jump_duration)

		coroutine.yield(self:teleport_move_stage(to_stage))

		return
	end

	local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, from_stage)
	local parent_name = ''

	if path_transform ~= nil then
		parent_name = path_transform.name
	end

	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from_stage, to_stage)

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName) then
		path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
	end

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	local way_point_table = self:get_waypoints_full_path(parent_name, from_stage, to_stage)
	local total_length = self:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local speed = total_length / self.character_move_duration

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_walk_animation_name(character_info), true)

	-- 월드맵 걷는 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.world_map_walking_sfx_handle_name)

	if way_point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(way_point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	local way_point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	for i = 1, way_point_length - 1 do
		local spine_controller_transform = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform
		spine_controller_transform.localPosition = way_point_table[i]

		local dir = way_point_table[i+1] - spine_controller_transform.localPosition

		self.spine_controller.Direction = dir:GetXy():GetX0z():ToDirection()

		local spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition
		local is_destination = spine_local_position:GetXy() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXy()

		while is_destination do
			local move_delta = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition

			local move_position = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(spine_local_position, way_point_table[i+1], move_delta)

			self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = move_position
			is_destination = move_position:GetXy() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXy()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress(param_list)
	local stage_name = param_list[0]
	local target_camera_size = param_list[1]
	local duration = param_list[2]
	local check_stage_opened = param_list[3]

	return util.cs_generator(self.set_focus_progress_start, self, stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress_start(stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
	if check_stage_opened then
		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(chapter_code)
	local stage = nil

	if target_stages == nil or target_stages.Length == 0 then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	local stage_length = target_stages.Length

	self:init_finger_object_table()

	for i = 0, stage_length - 1 do
		if target_stages[i] ~= nil then
			stage = self.stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[i])
		end

		if stage == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		if self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] == nil then
			local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] = { is_open = false, effect = nil }
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].is_open = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stages[i])
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].is_open = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stages[i])
		end

		local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

		if is_unity_null(button) then
			return false
		end

		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect.transform.parent = button.transform
		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		::continue::
	end

	self:show_finger(true)
	return true
end

function local_class:init_finger_object_table()
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v.is_open = false
			if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			local local_finger_obj = v.effect

			if v.is_open and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
			v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_spine_character(param_list)
	self.spine_controller = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_spine_character_start, self)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	local character_update = false

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		character_update = true

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local characterPrefab = nil

	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
		characterPrefab = prefab
	end))

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(characterPrefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name

		if character_update and self.is_move_even_once then
			local stage_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
			local stage_table_size = table_util.get_size(stage_table)

			stage_name = 'nightmare_queencastle_1'

			for i = 1, stage_table_size do
				if user_progress:IsStageOpened(stage_table[i]) then
					stage_name = stage_table[i]
				else
					break
				end
			end
		elseif stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지를 방금 클리어한 상태
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
		local parent_name = ''

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			parent_name = path_transform.name
		end

		local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
		local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

		if path_placeholder == nil then
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
		else
			self.is_teleport_move = path_placeholder.Hidden

			local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

			if button_placeholder ~= nil then
				character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0()
			end
		end
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then

		-- 캐릭터 초기 세팅 (애니메이션, 방향, 상태등)
		self.world_map_util.init_spine_character(game_data_service, character, self.spine_controller, character_info, 55,
				self.character_weapon_attachment_shader_selector, vector(45, 0, 0), self.item.IsHideCharacter, self.item.SpineTopShader)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

function local_class:resume()
	if not self.is_routine then
		self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = false

		-- controller, 스테이지버튼 resume 처리
		if self.world_map_controller ~= nil then
			self.world_map_controller:resume()
		end

		-- 각 버튼 resume 처리
		for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.is_pause = true
end

function local_class:etc_setting()
	local button_visible = false

	-- 1스테이지 개방 이벤트 이후 이면 on
	if self.main_quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.open_event_progress then
			button_visible = true
		end
	end

	self.board_ui_prefab:SetActive(button_visible)
	self.board_ui_effect:SetActive(false)

	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:change_sprite(self.current_rotation_num)
	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:button_visible(button_visible)

	for k,v in pairs(self.board_icon_table) do
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(k) then
			v.Alpha = self.board_off_value
		else
			v.Alpha = self.board_on_value
		end

		v:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:button_and_path_off(button_active_false, is_path_off)
	if button_active_false == nil then
		button_active_false = false
	end

	if is_path_off == nil then
		is_path_off = true
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 button 다 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		if button_active_false then
			v.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden_active_false()
		else
			v.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	end

	if is_path_off then
		-- 현재 존재하는 path 다 off
		for k,v in pairs(self.path_name_dic) do
			v:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_map(rotation_num, direct)
	self.is_transition = true
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local stage_button

	-- 회전 연출 시작
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			-- 회전 애니메이션, 이펙트 on
			self.world_map_controller:on_stage_effect(stage_button.StageName, true)
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:rotation_off()
		end
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 path 다 off, 동시에 없어져야 해서 먼저 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.path_name_dic) do
		v:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 캐릭터 안 보이는 곳으로 이동
	self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = vector(999,0,999)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			self.world_map_controller:on_stage_effect(stage_button.StageName, false)
		end
	end

	-- 완전 끔
	self:button_and_path_off(true, false)

	-- 회전 진행
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.rotation_sfx_handle_name)
	coroutine.yield(self.world_map_controller:world_map_rotation(direct))

	self.current_rotation_num = rotation_num

	-- 현재 회전된 상태에 출력될 스테이지를 가져온다.
	self.current_rotation_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
	self.current_rotation_table_size = table_util.get_size(self.current_rotation_table)

	-- 회전 연출 끝
	-- 스테이지 버튼 on 애니메이션 재생
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:rotation_on()
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.on_stage_sfx_handle_name)

	-- 버튼 이펙트 on
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			self.world_map_controller:on_stage_effect(stage_button.StageName, true)
		end
	end

	self:refresh_button_and_path()

	-- 캐릭터 on (메인 스테이지 위치에 배치)
	local stage_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
	local stage_table_size = table_util.get_size(stage_table)
	local character_stage_name = self.check_path_stage_name

	for i = 1, stage_table_size do
		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(stage_table[i]) then
			character_stage_name = stage_table[i]
		else
			break
		end
	end

	self:set_character_default_position(self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform, character_stage_name)

	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:change_sprite(self.current_rotation_num)
	self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.is_move_even_once = true

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	self.is_transition = false

	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:refresh_button_and_path(is_target_stage, force_rotation_num)
	if is_target_stage == nil then
		is_target_stage = false
	end

	if force_rotation_num == nil then
		force_rotation_num = -1
	end

	local rotation_num = -1

	if is_target_stage and self.prev_stage_name ~= nil then
		local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.prev_stage_name)

		if prev_stage_button ~= nil then
			rotation_num = self:get_current_rotation_num(prev_stage_button.StageName)
		end
	elseif force_rotation_num ~= -1 then
		-- 강제로 해당 로테이션에 맞는 스테이지를 보여주기 위함.
		rotation_num = force_rotation_num
	end

	-- 현재 회전된 상태에 출력될 스테이지를 가져온다.
	if rotation_num ~= -1 and rotation_num ~= self.current_rotation_num then
		self.current_rotation_num = rotation_num
		self.current_rotation_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
		self.current_rotation_table_size = table_util.get_size(self.current_rotation_table)
	end

	-- 회전 상태에 따라 스테이지 and path를 on해준다.
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		local stage_name = stage_button.StageName

		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

			if self.path_table[stage_name] ~= nil then
				-- path 출력 처리
				local path_table =  self.path_table[stage_name]
				local path_size = table_util.get_size(path_table)
				local path_on = true

				for index = 1, path_size do
					local p_name = path_table[index]

					-- 악몽 1스테이지의 경우엔 rotation 상태에 따라 출력 path가 달라짐
					if self.check_path_stage_name == stage_name then
						-- 먼저 전부 출력되는것 확인 후 적용 예정
						path_on = self:check_exception_rotation_stage(self.current_rotation_num, p_name)
					end

					if path_on then
						local has_value, path = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

						if has_value then
							path:SetActive(true)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(stage_name) then
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
			end
		else
			--stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end

		::continue::
	end
end

function local_class:get_current_rotation_num(stage_name)
	local rotation_num = 0

	if table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_1st_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 0
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_2nd_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 1
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_3rd_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 2
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_4th_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 3
	end

	return rotation_num
end

function local_class:get_rotation_stage_table(rotation_num)
	if rotation_num == 0 then
		return self.constants_data.world_map_1st_table
	elseif rotation_num == 1 then
		return self.constants_data.world_map_2nd_table
	elseif rotation_num == 2 then
		return self.constants_data.world_map_3rd_table
	else
		return self.constants_data.world_map_4th_table
	end
end

function local_class:check_exception_rotation_stage(rotation_num, path_name)
	local is_check = false

	if rotation_num == 0 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_1st_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	elseif rotation_num == 1 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_2nd_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	elseif rotation_num == 2 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_3rd_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	elseif rotation_num == 3 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_4th_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	end

	return is_check
end

function local_class:get_last_open_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	-- 현재 서브 오픈 이벤트 상태면 stage를 앞에서 클리어하지 않은 걸 가져오도록
	if self:is_open_event_progress() then
		stage_name = self:get_open_sub_stage_name()

		if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
			return stage_name
		end
	end

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_main_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(spec_name) then
			stage_name = spec_name
		else
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:get_open_sub_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	for i = self.first_sub_stage_id, self.last_sub_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(spec_name) and not user_progress:IsStageCleared(spec_name) then
			stage_name = spec_name
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:get_pad_select_stage_name()
	if self.is_transition then
		return ''
	end

	local stage_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
	local stage_table_size = table_util.get_size(stage_table)
	local stage_name = ''

	-- NextStageName이 있을시
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) then
		stage_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
	else
		-- 현재 회전된 기준으로 손가락이 가리키는 스테이지를 선택
		local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(self.item.ChapterCode)

		if target_stages ~= nil and target_stages.Length > 0 then
			local stage = self.stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[0])

			for i = 1, stage_table_size do
				if stage_table[i] == stage.Name then
					stage_name = stage_table[i]
				else
					break
				end
			end
		end

end

function local_class:is_pool_loading()
	local is_loaded_all = true
	while true do
		is_loaded_all = true

		for k,v in pairs(self.pool_table) do
			if v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded and
					v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.LoadFailed then
				is_loaded_all = false
			end
		end

		if is_loaded_all then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:pre_load_resource()
	wait_all({
		-- 폭탄, 코어 표시용 추가 UI 로드
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_49_queenship/worldmap/common', 'QueenShipWorldMapBackGroundEtc'), function(prefab)
				self.etc_prefab = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(get_ui_scene_manager().UIRootTransform, prefab)
				self.etc_ui = self.etc_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipWorldMapBackGroundEtc))
			end))
		end),
		-- 커스텀 데이터 세팅
		util.cs_generator(self.init_custom_state_setting, self)
	})

	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:resource_on_off(self.obstacle_state.bomb, true)
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:resource_on_off(self.obstacle_state.core, true)

	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.bomb, ''..0)
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.core, ''..0)
end

function local_class:init_custom_state_setting()
	if CS.Oak.QuestReplaySystem.IsReplaying then
		return
	end

	if self.data_quest_progress == nil then
		return
	end

	local check_length = self.data_quest_progress.CustomStates.Count

	-- 필요한 커스텀 데이터 개수만큼 저장되어 있는지 확인, 및 기본 값으로 세팅
	if check_length >= self.total_custom_data_num then
		return
	end

	local data_dictionary = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
	local state_val = -1

	data_dictionary:Add(self.all_open_obstacle_key_name, state_val)

	-- 장애물 관련 기본 데이터 세팅 총 17개
	for k,v in pairs(self.constants_data.obstacle) do
		if not data_dictionary:ContainsKey(k) then
			-- data_quest_progress에 키가 있으면 해당 값, 없으면 -1
			state_val = self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(k)
			data_dictionary:Add(k, state_val)
		end
	end

	local req = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendSetQuestCustomState(self.data_quest_progress.QuestId, data_dictionary)
				  :Then(function(res)
		for k,v in pairs(data_dictionary) do
			user_progress:SetQuestCustomState(self.data_quest_progress, k, v)
		end
	end)

	coroutine.yield(req)
end

function local_class:progress_setting()
	local cur_bomb = 0
	local cur_core = 0

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_stage_id do
		-- 각 스테이지 마다 폭탄, 코어, ammi 상태 가져와서 table에 저장
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local stage_progress = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Instance:GetStageProgress(stage_spec)
		local stage_name = stage_spec.Name

		if self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name] == nil then
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name] = {bomb = 0, core = 0, ammi_state = -1, open = false}
		end

		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].bomb ~= 0 then
			local bomb_num = stage_progress:GetCustomDataInt(self.bomb_id, 0)

			cur_bomb = cur_bomb + bomb_num
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].bomb = bomb_num
		end

		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].core ~= 0 then
			local core_num = stage_progress:GetCustomDataInt(self.core_id, 0)

			cur_core = cur_core + core_num
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].core = core_num
		end
	end

	-- 현재 장애물 전부 초기화
	for k,v in pairs(self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table) do
		self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[k] = false
	end

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local stage_name = stage_spec.Name

		-- 현재 월드맵 데이터용 퀘스트에 저장된 장애물 상태 값들을 불러와서 table에 저장
		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_enable and self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table ~= nil then
			local obstacle_list = self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table
			local size = table_util.get_size(obstacle_list)

			for index = 1, size do
				local obstacle_name = obstacle_list[index]

				-- 테이블에 없으면 추가 및 초기화
				if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] == nil then
					self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] = false
				end

				if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil then
					if self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.all_open_obstacle_key_name) == 1 or self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(obstacle_name) == 1 then
						if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
							self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] = true

							-- 잔해, 엘레베이터가 열려 있으면 각 폭탄, 코어 하나씩 마이너스
							if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
								cur_bomb = cur_bomb - 1
							else
								cur_core = cur_core - 1
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if cur_bomb < 0 then
		cur_bomb = 0
	end

	if cur_core < 0 then
		cur_core = 0
	end

	--cur_bomb = 20
	--cur_core = 20

	-- ui 갱신
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.bomb, ''..cur_bomb)
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.core, ''..cur_core)

	return cur_bomb, cur_core
end

function local_class:resume()
	if not self.is_routine then
		self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = false

		-- controller, 스테이지버튼 resume 처리
		if self.worldmap_controller ~= nil then
			self.worldmap_controller:resume()
		end

		for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end

		for k,v in pairs(self.obstacle_button_table) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.is_pause = true
end

function local_class:make_button()
	local bundle_name = "ondemand/v2_49_queenship/worldmap/common"

	local button_prefab = nil
	local button_etc_prefab = nil

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'queenship_button'), function(prefab)
				button_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'queenship_button_etc'), function(prefab)
				button_etc_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end)
	})

	if is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		return
	end

	self.worldmap_controller = self.item.worldmapParent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipWorldMapController)).GetControllerLuaTable

	local buttons = self.item.stageParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder))
	local length = buttons.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local stage_name = buttons[i].name
		local btn = buttons[i]
		local btn_t = btn.transform
		local savedRotation = btn_t.localRotation
		btn_t.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		local savedScale = btn_t.localScale
		btn_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		local stage_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.worldmapParent, stage_name)

		-- etc 타입이면 별도 처리, 아닐 경우엔 기존 방식으로 ?
		if buttons[i].postitType ~= CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder.StyleType.Etc then
			local button_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_prefab)
			local button_obj_t = button_obj.transform
			local button = button_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

			button_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
			button_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

			self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:Add(stage_name, buttons[i])

			if not is_unity_null(button) then
				button.StageName = stage_name

				if stage_obj ~= nil then
					button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj.gameObject)
				end

				self.stage_button_dic:Add(stage_name, button)

				button.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button_value()
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_obstacle(self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].bomb, self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].bomb,
						self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].core, self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].core)

				button:SetButton(btn)

				self:set_button(button, stage_name)
			end
		else
			-- etc 타입 처리
			local button_etc_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_etc_prefab)
			local button_etc_obj_t = button_etc_obj.transform
			local button = button_etc_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

			button_etc_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
			button_etc_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

			-- 장애물 이름
			local obstacle_name = btn.name
			self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table[obstacle_name] = buttons[i]

			if not is_unity_null(button) then

				-- 기존 로직과 호환성을 위해 실제 존재하는 더미 스테이지 이름을 넣어줌
				if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name] ~= nil then
					button.StageName = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].dummy_stage_name
				end

				self.obstacle_button_table[obstacle_name] = button

				if stage_obj ~= nil then
					button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj.gameObject)
				end

				--프리팹안에 이름으로 잔해 or 엘레베이터 구문 지어서 읽도록
				button:SetButton(btn)

				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_obstacle_name(obstacle_name)

				self:set_obstacle(button, obstacle_name)
			end
		end

		btn_t.localRotation = savedRotation
		btn_t.localScale = savedScale
	end

	if self:check_stage_event_routine() and self.worldmap_controller ~= nil then
		self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation('off')
	else
		self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation('idle')
	end
end

function local_class:set_button(stage_button, stage_name)
	if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name] == nil then
		-- 아직 Constants에 등록이 안된 상태
		stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		return
	end

	--기존처럼 open 할 건지
	if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].default_open then
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open = true

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(stage_name) then

				self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open = true
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

				if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(stage_name) then
					stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
				end
			else
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
			end
		else
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	end
end
