		--오픈 조건이 이전 장애물 처리 이면
		local open_obstacle_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].open_name
		--조건의 장애물이 처리된 상태이면
		if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[open_obstacle_name] then
			obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)
			--해당 장애물이 이미 처리된 상태인지
			if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
				obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
			end
		else
			obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name)
	local is_obstacle_clear = true
	--open시 체크해야하는 장애물들 확인 (하나라도 처리 안 되어있으면 false)
	if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_enable and self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table ~= nil then
		local obstacle_list = self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table
		local size = table_util.get_size(obstacle_list)

		for index = 1, size do
			if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_list[index]] then
				is_obstacle_clear = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return is_obstacle_clear
end

function local_class:show_popup(world_map_button, stage_name)
	-- 팝업 출력
	-- 인자 둘 중 하나만 존재하면 되도록
	-- ok시 재화 체크 후 open 및 연출 진행
	-- cancle시 그냥 넘어감
	local is_obstacle = false
	local obj_button = world_map_button

	self.cur_select_obstacle_name = ''

	if obj_button ~= nil then
		-- 해당 스테이지 입장 가능한지 조건 체크 안되면 뭐 열어야 된다고 팝업창 출력
		if self:check_stage(obj_button) then
			-- 일단 입장 조건은 충족
			if obj_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_obstacle() then
				-- 장애물
				is_obstacle = true
				self.cur_select_obstacle_name = obj_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_obstacle_name()

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.show_obstacle_popup, self))
			end
		else
			-- 조건 통과 못했으니 입장 못하게 막음
			is_obstacle = true
		end
	else
		-- 일반 스테이지가 오픈 상태인지
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			obj_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage_name)

			--스테이지 입장 조건 체크 (장애물 다 열었는지등)
			if not self:check_stage(obj_button) then
				is_obstacle = true
			end
		end
	end

	return is_obstacle
end

function local_class:check_stage(stage_button)
	local target_name = stage_button.StageName
	local obstacle_name = ''
	local is_fail = false

	if stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_obstacle() then
		-- 장애물일 경우 실제 장애물 이름을 얻어옴
		target_name = stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_obstacle_name()

		if self.constants_data.obstacle[target_name].is_stage_clear then
			-- 스테이지 클리어가 오픈 조건일 경우
		else
			local open_obstacle_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[target_name].open_name
			if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[open_obstacle_name] then
				is_fail = true
				obstacle_name = open_obstacle_name
			end
		end
	else
		-- 일반 스테이지
		if self.constants_data.stage[target_name].obstacle_enable and self.constants_data.stage[target_name].obstacle_table ~= nil then
			local obstacle_list = self.constants_data.stage[target_name].obstacle_table
			local size = table_util.get_size(obstacle_list)

			for index = 1, size do
				if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_list[index]] then
					is_fail = true
					obstacle_name = obstacle_list[index]
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 입장 실패시 팝업 창 출력
	if is_fail then
		local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopUpState()
		popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString('worldmap_popup_stage_fail_desc')

		get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup.Instance, popup_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup))

		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:show_obstacle_popup()
	local is_claimed = false

	--어떤 장애물인지 sprite 이름 설정
	local sprite_name = ''
	if self.constants_data.obstacle[self.cur_select_obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
		sprite_name = self.constants_data.bomb_name
	else
		sprite_name = self.constants_data.core_name
	end

	local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopUpState()
	popup_state.NoticePopUp = false
	popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString('worldmap_popup_remove_desc')
	popup_state.IsShowSprite = true
	popup_state.ConfirmButtonSpriteString = sprite_name
	popup_state.OnYesOrNoClicked = function (ok)
		if ok then
			get_ui_scene_manager():OverlayPopped('+', self.on_clear_obstacle_obj)
		end
		is_claimed = true
	end

	get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup.Instance, popup_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup))

	while not is_claimed do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_obj()
	-- 폭탄인지 코어 인지 확인
	-- 해당 오브젝트 오픈 처리 및 오픈 연출 작업
	-- 실패 시 부족하다는 메시지와 함께 팝업창 출력 후 끝
	get_ui_scene_manager():OverlayPopped('-', self.on_clear_obstacle_obj)

	local obstacle_name = self.cur_select_obstacle_name

	if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
		-- 이미 열려있으니 return
		--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('clear_obstacle_obj already open '..obstacle_name)
		return
	end

	local is_success = false
	local obstacle_state = 1

	-- 재 설정
	local bomb_num, core_num = self:progress_setting()

	if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
		obstacle_state = self.obstacle_state.bomb
		if bomb_num > 0 then
			is_success = true
		end
	else
		obstacle_state = self.obstacle_state.core
		if core_num > 0 then
			is_success = true
		end
	end

	if is_success then
		-- 성공시 오픈 연출 진행
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.clear_obstacle_routine, self, obstacle_name))
	else
		-- 실패시 뭐 때문 인지 팝업 창 출력
		local obstacle_str = ''
		if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
			obstacle_str = 'worldmap_popup_bomb_lack_desc'
		else
			obstacle_str = 'worldmap_popup_core_lack_desc'
		end

		local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopUpState()
		popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString(obstacle_str)

		get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup.Instance, popup_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup))
	end
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine(obstacle_name)
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance:SetButtonsActive(false)
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local check_name = obstacle_name

	self.cur_clear_obstacle_state = self.clear_obstacle_state.none

	-- 성공
	local on_success = function()
		self.cur_clear_obstacle_state = self.clear_obstacle_state.success
	end

	-- 실패
	local on_fail = function()
		self.cur_clear_obstacle_state = self.clear_obstacle_state.fail
	end

	local on_finally = function()
		self:clear_obstacle_routine_finally(check_name)
	end

	-- 장애물 데이터용 퀘스트 프로그래스에 저장
	if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetQuestCustomState, nil, self.data_quest_progress, check_name, 1,
				on_success, on_fail, on_finally)
	end
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine_success(obstacle_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 재 설정
	self:progress_setting()

	local camera_duration = self.camera_focus_duration * 0.6

	-- 장애물 오픈 연출 진행 (거리에 따른 시간 조정)
	local local_position = self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table[obstacle_name].transform.localPosition
	local obstacle_vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local camera_vec2 = vector(self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition.x, self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition.y)
	local speed = obstacle_vec2 - camera_vec2
	local duration = speed.magnitude * 0.55

	coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(obstacle_name, self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, duration))
	-- 장애물 제거 연출, 애니메이션 및 이펙트, 사운드 출력
	-- 이펙트 출력 추가
	local clear_obstacle_btn = self.obstacle_button_table[obstacle_name]
	local effect = nil

	if clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_bomb() then
		effect = self.pool_table['FX_Explosion_Bomb_new']:Instantiate(clear_obstacle_btn.transform.position)
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-90, 0, 0))
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_01')

		clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()

		wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)
	else
		effect = self.pool_table[self.ev_clear_effect_name]:Instantiate(clear_obstacle_btn.transform.position)
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 1.5, 0.5)
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_impact_09')

		coroutine.yield(clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear_animation())
		clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	if effect ~= nil then
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	local next_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].next_name
	local stage_state = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].next_stage_state
	-- 다음 장애물로 이동
	if stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(next_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, camera_duration, false))
	elseif stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, camera_duration))
	end

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(obstacle_name, next_name, true, stage_state))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance:SetButtonsActive(true)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine_fail()
	CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance:SetButtonsActive(true)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine_finally(obstacle_name)
	if self.cur_clear_obstacle_state == self.clear_obstacle_state.success then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.clear_obstacle_routine_success, self, obstacle_name))
	else
		self:clear_obstacle_routine_fail()
	end
end

function local_class:setting_camera(camera)
	self.mobile_touch_camera = camera

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		return
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMin = self.camera_zoom_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMin = self.camera_boundary_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMax = self.camera_boundary_max

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.camera_zoom_max
	else
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) and user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
		local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition

		self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)
	else
		local last_stage_position = self:get_previous_stage_button_position()

		self:set_camera_local_pos(last_stage_position)
	end
end

function local_class:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)
	local new_pos = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = new_pos
end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	local cleared_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.is_routine = true

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
			and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	self.is_routine = false
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:stage_first_enter_routine()
	while self.item.IsSpineLoading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_spaceship_06')

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.routine_camera_zoom_max

	local duration = 1.5

	-- 카메라를 함선 가운데 위치로 이동
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(self.default_camera_pos)
	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, self.routine_camera_zoom_max, duration, false, true, false, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 함선 등장 애니메이션 및 기타 출력
	local character_button_local_pos = self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition
	self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = vector(character_button_local_pos.x, character_button_local_pos.y + 100, character_button_local_pos.z)

	local transition_sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	transition_sfx_info.sfxName = '01_impact_08'
	transition_sfx_info.delayedTime = 0.1

	music_player:PlaySfx(transition_sfx_info)

	self.worldmap_controller:set_stage_obj_visible(true)
	coroutine.yield(self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation_start('open'))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.9)


	-- 2스테이지로 카메라 이동
	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration * 0.7, false))

	-- 스테이지 출력
	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
			self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, self.open_stage_state.stage))

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max

	-- 캐릭터 연출
	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	local emotion_pool = self.pool_table['human_emotion']
	emotion_pool.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'cliff', true)

	coroutine.yield(self:fall_players_inner(self.world_map_state.NextStageName))

	-- 캐릭터 상태 원상 복귀
	self.spine_controller:ClearEmotion()
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)

	emotion_pool.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine()
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출을 보여준다.
	if self:get_is_prev_stage_cleared_newly() then
		coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

		user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
		self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()
	end

	local next_name = ''
	local stage_state = 1

	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		-- 1스테이지 최초 클리어시에 별도 연출
		if self.world_map_state.PrevStageName == self.diff_begin_routine_stage_name and self:check_stage_event_routine(true) then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_first_enter_routine())

			next_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
			stage_state = self.open_stage_state.stage
		else
			-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
			self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()

			if self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
				-- 다음 스테이지가 일반 스테이지 이면 기존 루틴 그대로
				coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

				next_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
				stage_state = self.open_stage_state.stage
			else
				-- 다음이 장애물일 경우 장애물 관련 루틴 타도록
				local next_obj_name = self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_name

				coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_obj_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration))

				next_name = next_obj_name
				stage_state = self.open_stage_state.obstacle
			end

			coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, next_name,
					self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, stage_state))
		end

		-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
		-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
		user_progress:SetStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.AdditionalOpenStage)
	else
		-- 다음 스테이지가 오픈이 되어있다면, 스테이지 이동만 한다.
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
		self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()

		next_name = self.world_map_state.PrevStageName
		stage_state = self.open_stage_state.stage

		-- 장애물일 경우
		if self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
			local next_obj_name = self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_name
			local open_obstacle_btn = self.obstacle_button_table[next_obj_name]

			if not open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_open() then
				coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_obj_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration))

				next_name = next_obj_name
				stage_state = self.open_stage_state.obstacle

				coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, next_name,
						self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, stage_state))
			end
		elseif self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.prev_stage then
			coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

			next_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지 입장 패널 SFX Play
	if stage_state ~= self.open_stage_state.none then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_stage_enter_panel_sfx_handle_name)
	end

	if stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(next_name, self.focus_camera_size))
	elseif stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_name, self.focus_camera_size, 0.5))
	end
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
	-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
	self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	coroutine.yield(prev_stage_button:ShowGetStarGrade(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	-- 연출 처리를 위해 비워주기 전에 캐싱
	local stage_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	coroutine.yield(world_map_background_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, prev_stage_spec.ChapterCode, CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance.SceneManager))
end

function local_class:open_stage_and_obstacle(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event, open_stage_state)
	if open_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, false, custom_event))
	elseif open_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_obstacle_routine(open_stage))
	end
end

function local_class:clear_stage(cleared_stage)
	local clear_stage_bBtn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(cleared_stage)

	if clear_stage_bBtn ~= nil then
		clear_stage_bBtn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'victory_get', false)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
end

function local_class:hidden_stage(stage_name)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage_name)

	stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
end

function local_class:open_stage(param_list)
	return util.cs_generator(self.open_stage_start, self, param_list[0], param_list[1], param_list[2], param_list[3])
end

function local_class:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, wait_open_complete , custom_event)
	if wait_open_complete == nil then
		wait_open_complete = false
	end

	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	if open_stage_btn ~= nil then
		if not self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(open_stage) or custom_event then
			coroutine.yield(open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가
			local effect_name = self.main_open_stage_effect_name
			local effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(open_stage_btn.transform.position)

			effect.transform.localScale = self.main_open_stage_effect_scale
			effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)

			effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	if wait_open_complete then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:open_obstacle_routine(obstacle_name)
	local open_obstacle_btn = self.obstacle_button_table[obstacle_name]

	if open_obstacle_btn == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].is_stage_clear then
		-- 아직 열려 있지 않으면
		if not open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_open() then
			-- 오픈 연출 진행
			coroutine.yield(open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가 ?
			-- effect
		end
	else
		--오픈 조건이 이전 장애물 처리 이면
		local open_obstacle_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].open_name
		--조건의 장애물이 처리된 상태이면
		if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[open_obstacle_name] then
			if not open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_open() then
				-- 오픈 연출 진행
				coroutine.yield(open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

				open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

				-- 이펙트 출력 추가 ?
				-- effect
			end
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress(param_list)
	local stage_name = param_list[0]
	local target_camera_size = param_list[1]
	local duration = param_list[2]
	local check_stage_opened = param_list[3]

	return util.cs_generator(self.set_focus_progress_start, self, stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress_start(stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
	if check_stage_opened then
		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:set_focus_obstacle(obstacle_name, target_camera_size, duration)
	-- 장애물 오픈 연출 진행
	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local obstacle_button_holder = self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table[obstacle_name]
	local local_position = obstacle_button_holder.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stage = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStage(chapter_code)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local stage = nil

	if target_stage ~= nil then
		stage = stage_data:GetStage(target_stage)
	else
		stage = stage_data:GetStage(0)
	end

	if stage == nil then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.finger_object) then
		local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

		if stage.IsSubStage then
			effect_name = self.sub_new_stage_effect_name
		end

		self.finger_object = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end

	local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

	if is_unity_null(button) then
		return false
	end

	self.finger_object.transform.parent = button.transform
	self.finger_object.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if target_stage ~= nil then
		self.is_new_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stage)
	else
		self.is_new_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(0)
	end

	self:show_finger(self.is_new_stage)
	return true
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	local local_finger_obj = self.finger_object

	if self.is_new_stage and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
		self:set_finger_object(is_show)
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	if is_unity_null(self.finger_object) then
		return
	end

	self.finger_object.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character(param_list)
	self.spine_controller = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_spine_character_start, self)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local characterPrefab = nil

	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
		characterPrefab = prefab
	end))

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(characterPrefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name
		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지를 방금 클리어한 상태
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		-- 혹시 사용할지 몰라서 일단 남겨 둠
		if self:get_is_prev_stage_cleared_newly() and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName == self.diff_begin_routine_stage_name then
		else
		end

		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		-- 해당 스테이지 장애물 체크 후 안되 있으면 이전 스테이지로 이동 해야함
		if self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open and self:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name) then
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
		else
			local last_stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, last_stage_name)
		end
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then
		--  캐릭터 태생 스킨이 있는 경우 생성하자마자 지정
		if character_info.SkinName ~= nil then
			self.spine_controller.SkinName = character_info.SkinName
		end

		local shader_selector_type = CS.System.Enum.Parse(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachmentShaderSelector), self.character_weapon_attachment_shader_selector, true)
		local create_desc = CS.Oak.WeaponAttachmentCreateDesc(shader_selector_type)
		CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(self.spine_controller, character_info, create_desc)

		local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

		self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetSubIdleAnimation(self.spine_controller)
		self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)

		self.spine_controller:SetSortingLayer('Default', 55)
		self.spine_controller.IsShadowActive = true
		self.spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localEulerAngles = vector(45, 0, 0)

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character_t, 'SpecialEvents')

		if self.item.IsHideCharacter then
			self.spine_controller.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		-- 캐릭터가 어떠한 상황에서라도 더 위에 그려질 수 있도록 함
		if self.item.SpineTopShader ~= nil then
			self.spine_controller.CustomShader = self.item.SpineTopShader
		end
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

function local_class:get_is_prev_stage_cleared_newly()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prev_stage_spec.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	local stage_state = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stage_state & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	return is_prev_stage_cleared_newly
end

function local_class:get_last_open_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_main_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if self.cur_stage_state_table[spec_name].open then
			stage_name = spec_name
		else
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:get_pad_select_stage_name()
	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name
		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self.item:GetLastOpenStageName()
		end
	end

	if self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open and self:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name) then
		--self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:get_previous_stage_button_position()
	local stage_name = self.prev_stage_name

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

		if button_placeholder ~= nil then
			return button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
		end

		-- 한번 더 시도
		stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

		if button_placeholder ~= nil then
			return button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
		end
	end

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then
		return self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition
	end

	return unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:check_stage_event_routine(clear_flag)
	if clear_flag == nil then
		clear_flag = false
	end

	if not clear_flag then
		-- 1스테이지 클리어 상태면 연출 false
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(self.diff_begin_routine_stage_name) then
			return false
		end
	end

	for i = self.first_stage_id + 1, self.last_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local stage_name = stage_spec.Name

		-- 1 이후 한 스테이지가 하나라도 open 이면 false
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--1스테이지 클리어 후 2스테이지 오픈 연출시 화면 밖에서 2스테이지로 떨어지는 듯한 연출 진행
function local_class:fall_players_inner(stage_name)
	self:set_character_default_position(self.spine_controller.transform, stage_name)

	-- 버튼 바로 위에 있는 캐릭터 위치
	local center = self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition

	local bounce_cb = function(bounce)
		-- 첫 착지 일때 처리
		if bounce == 1 then
			--Shake(0.015f, 0.1f)
			local effect = self.pool_table['FX_Common_Jump_small']:Instantiate(self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
			effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-90, 0, 0))
			effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	end

	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 3, 7, 2, bounce_cb)

	y_calculator:ScaleTime(3)
	y_calculator:SetElasticity(0.35)

	local time_passed = 0
	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local old_time_passed = time_passed

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local all_done = true
		if y_calculator:IsDone() or time_passed < 0 then
			-- continue 대신으로 비워 둠
		else
			if old_time_passed >= 0 then
				y_calculator:Proceed(dt)
			else
				y_calculator:Proceed(time_passed)
			end

			if y_calculator:IsDone() then
				self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = center
			else
				all_done = false
				local change_pos = center + vector(0, y_calculator:GetDistance(), 0)
				self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = change_pos
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if all_done then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.pool_table = nil
	self.finger_object_table = nil
	self.cur_stage_state_table = nil
	self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table = nil
	self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table = nil
	self.obstacle_button_table = nil
	self.data_quest_progress = nil

	self.bg_obj = nil
	self.worldmap_controller = nil

	self.obstacle_state = nil
	self.open_stage_state = nil
	self.clear_obstacle_state = nil

	self.constants_data = nil

	if self.spine_res_holder ~= nil then
		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.etc_prefab)
	self.etc_prefab = nil
	self.etc_ui = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
end

function local_class:on_load(param_list)
	self.world_map_state = param_list[0]
	self.res_holder = param_list[1]
	self.path_name_dic = param_list[2]
	self.stage_button_dic = param_list[3]
	self.stage_button_placeholder_dic = param_list[4]
	self.path_state_dic = param_list[5]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_start, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_start()
	self.is_world_map_loading = true

	self.stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	self.chapter_data = CS.Oak.ChapterData.Value:GetChapterData(self.item.ChapterCode)
	self.first_enter_key_string = 'first_'..self.chapter_data.ChapterName

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		self.world_map_animator = self.item.worldmapParent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	end

	self.is_first = self:is_first_enter()

	coroutine.yield(self:pre_load_resource())

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.load_effect_pool_progress, self),
		util.cs_generator(self.make_button, self),
		util.cs_generator(self.make_path, self)
	})

	local has_value, value = self.item.User.PreviousStage:TryGetValue(self.item.ChapterName)
	self.prev_stage_name = value

	if self.is_first then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.first_enter_routine, self))
	else
		if not is_unity_null(self.world_map_animator) then
			self.world_map_animator.enabled = false
		end
	end

	self.is_world_map_loading = false
end

function local_class:load_effect_pool_progress()
	self:add_object_pool(self.main_new_stage_effect_name)
	self:add_object_pool('FX_reset_object')

	coroutine.yield(world_map_util.is_pool_loading(self.pool_table))
end

function local_class:add_object_pool(preset_name)
	local object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_name)
	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:pre_load_resource()
	local bundle_name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/worldmap/common'

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'worldmap_point_on'), function(prefab)
				self.path_point = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'worldmap_point_on_circle'), function(prefab)
				self.path_point_circle = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'worldmap_dot'), function(prefab)
				local material_container = prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MaterialContainer))
				if not is_unity_null(material_container) then
					self.line_material = material_container.MaterialList[0]
				end
			end))
		end)
	})
end

function local_class:make_button()
	local bundle_name = 'ondemand/v3_00_pixyworld/worldmap/common'
	local button_prefab

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, bundle_name, 'pixy_worldmap_button', function(prefab)
				button_prefab = prefab
			end)

	if is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		return
	end

	local buttons = self.item.stageParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder))
	local length = buttons.Length

	local background_data = self.world_map_background_data['chapter_19']

	if self.world_map_background_data[self.chapter_data.ChapterName] ~= nil then
		background_data = self.world_map_background_data[self.chapter_data.ChapterName]
	end

	local override_open_sfx_list = background_data.override_open_sfx

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local stage_name = buttons[i].name
		self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:Add(stage_name, buttons[i])

		local btn = buttons[i]
		local btn_t = btn.transform
		local savedRotation = btn_t.localRotation
		btn_t.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		local savedScale = btn_t.localScale
		btn_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		local button_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_prefab)
		local button_obj_t = button_obj.transform
		button_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
		button_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		local button = button_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

		if not is_unity_null(button) then
			button.StageName = btn.name

			local stage_obj = buttons[i].targetStage

			if stage_obj ~= nil then
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj)
			end

			-- 스테이지별 오버라이드 할 효과음 있으면 등록
			if override_open_sfx_list and background_data.override_open_sfx[button.StageName] then
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_override_open_sfx(background_data.override_open_sfx[button.StageName])
			end

			self.stage_button_dic:Add(button.StageName, button)

			button:SetButton(btn)

			button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_last_main_stage(self.chapter_data.LastStage)

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(button.StageName) then
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

				if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(button.StageName) then
					button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
				end
			else
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
			end

			btn_t.localRotation = savedRotation
			btn_t.localScale = savedScale
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_path()
	self.path_placeholder_array = self.item.pathParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapPathPlaceholder))

	if self.path_placeholder_array == nil then
		return
	end

	self.is_fixed_y_pos = false

	local background_data = self.world_map_background_data['chapter_19']

	if self.world_map_background_data[self.chapter_data.ChapterName] ~= nil then
		background_data = self.world_map_background_data[self.chapter_data.ChapterName]
	end

	if background_data.is_fixed_y_pos ~= nil then
		self.is_fixed_y_pos = background_data.is_fixed_y_pos
	end

	local length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local path_name = self.path_placeholder_array[i].name

		self.path_placeholder_info_table[path_name] = self.path_placeholder_array[i]

		if self.path_placeholder_array[i].Hidden then
			self:set_path_state(self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To, self.path_state.closed)
		else
			self:set_path_state(self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_path_state(path_name, from, to, path_state)
	if path_state == nil then
		path_state = self.path_state.none
	end

	if path_state == self.path_state.none then
		path_state = self:get_path_state(from.name, to.name)
	end

	local point_table = self:get_waypoints(from.name, to.name)

	if path_state == self.path_state.opened then
		self.point_num = 0

		local total_points = {}

		if self.is_fixed_y_pos then
			total_points[1] = vector(from.transform.position.x, self.path_y_pos, from.transform.position.z)
		else
			total_points[1] = from.transform.position
		end

		local point_size = table_util.get_size(point_table)
		for i = 1, point_size do
			total_points[i + 1] = point_table[i]
		end

		if self.is_fixed_y_pos then
			total_points[point_size + 2] = vector(to.transform.position.x, self.path_y_pos, to.transform.position.z)
		else
			total_points[point_size + 2] = to.transform.position
		end

		self:make_path_line(path_name, total_points)
	elseif path_state == self.path_state.closed then
		local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			self.path_name_dic:Remove(path_name)
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(value)
		end

		if table_util.contain_key(self.straight_line_info, path_name) then
			local line = self.straight_line_info[path_name]
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(line)

			self.straight_line_info[path_name] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_path_line(path_name, point_table, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		progress = -1
	end

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(point_table)

	if point_length == 0 then
		return
	end

	local has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

	if not has_value then
		value = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject(path_name)
		self.path_name_dic:Add(path_name, value)
	end

	local path_obj = value
	local path_t = path_obj.transform

	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(path_name)

	if path_placeholder == nil then
		return
	end

	path_t:SetParent(path_placeholder.transform)

	path_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	path_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	local point_value = 12
	local position_count = point_value * (point_length - 1)

	-- 현재 progress 를 기준으로 opened 로 표시해야할 길이를 구한다.
	local cur_progress = 1

	if progress >= 0 then
		cur_progress = progress
	end

	local temp_count = position_count * cur_progress
	local length = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(temp_count)
	local line_length = point_value
	local line = nil

	if not table_util.contain_key(self.straight_line_info, path_name) then
		local path1 = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('line')

		has_value, value = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(path_name)

		if has_value then
			path1.transform:SetParent(value.transform)
		end

		path1.gameObject.layer = CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('SpecialEvents')
		line = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(path1, typeof(CS.UnityEngine.LineRenderer))

		self.straight_line_info[path_name] = line
		self:set_straight_line(line)
	else
		line = self.straight_line_info[path_name]
	end

	local vec_length = 1

	if point_length > 2 then
		vec_length = self:get_total_path_length(point_table) * self.path_straight_line_draw_factor
	end

	line.positionCount = length

	local head = unity_class.vector3.one * 9999

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		local from = point_table[i]
		local to = point_table[i + 1]
		local line_index = (i - 1) * point_value

		local temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

		if temp_point_num == i then
			self.point_num = self.point_num + 1
			temp_point_num = self.point_num + 1

			if temp_point_num > 2 then
				if self.path_point ~= nil then
					local point_obj = game_object.Instantiate(self.path_point, line.transform.parent)
					point_obj.transform.position = point_table[i]
					point_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.path_point_rotation)
					point_obj.transform.localScale = self.path_point_scale

					if progress > -1 then
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_path_point_sfx_handle_name)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for index = 0, line_length - 1 do
			local convert_value = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(index)
			local t =  convert_value / (line_length - 1)
			local point = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, t)

			if line_index >= length then
				head = point
				return head
			end

			line:SetPosition(line_index, point)
			line_index = line_index + 1

			line.material.mainTextureScale = vector(line_index * vec_length, 1)
		end
	end

	return head
end

function local_class:set_straight_line(line)
	line.material = self.line_material

	line.startWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.endWidth = self.path_line_width
	line.shadowBias = 0
	line.useWorldSpace = false

	line.sortingLayerName = 'Default'
	line.sortingOrder = 0
end

function local_class:get_path_state(from_stage_name, to_stage_name)
	local from_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(from_stage_name)
	local to_stage_opened = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(to_stage_name)

	if from_stage_opened and to_stage_opened then
		return self.path_state.opened
	end

	return self.path_state.closed
end

function local_class:get_path_placeholder_info(path_name)
	if table_util.contain_key(self.path_placeholder_info_table, path_name) then
		return self.path_placeholder_info_table[path_name]
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_path_name(from, to)
	-- from, to가 비어 있어서는 안된다
	if from == nil or to == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local path_placeholder_length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	for i = 0, path_placeholder_length - 1 do
		-- from 스테이지와 to 스테이지가 같으면 from -> waypoins -> to 순서로 배열에 넣어 리턴한다.
		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, from) and string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, to) then
			return self.path_placeholder_array[i].name
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_waypoints(from, to)
	-- from, to가 비어 있어서는 안된다
	if from == nil or to == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local path_placeholder_length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length
	local path_array = nil

	for i = 0, path_placeholder_length - 1 do
		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, from) and string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, to) then
			path_array = self.path_placeholder_array[i].Path
			break
		end
	end

	local way_point_table = {}

	for i = 0, path_array.Length - 1 do
		table.insert(way_point_table, path_array[i].position)
	end

	return way_point_table
end

function local_class:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local total_length = 0

	local point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	if way_point_table == nil or point_length == 0 then
		return 0
	end

	for i = 1, point_length - 1 do
		total_length = total_length + (way_point_table[i + 1] - way_point_table[i]).magnitude
	end

	return total_length
end

function local_class:get_waypoints_full_path(from, to)
	local way_point_table = self:get_waypoints(from, to)
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(from)
	local to_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(to)

	local way_point_pos_table = {}
	way_point_pos_table[1] = from_button.transform.position

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		way_point_pos_table[i + 1] = way_point_table[i]
	end

	point_size = table_util.get_size(way_point_pos_table)

	way_point_pos_table[point_size + 1] = to_button.transform.position

	return way_point_pos_table
end

function local_class:hidden_stage(stage_name)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage_name)

	stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()

	local length = self.path_placeholder_array.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].From.name, stage_name) or string.find(self.path_placeholder_array[i].To.name, stage_name) then
			self:set_path_state(self.path_placeholder_array[i].name, self.path_placeholder_array[i].From, self.path_placeholder_array[i].To, self.path_state.closed)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:setting_camera(camera)
	self.mobile_touch_camera = camera

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		return
	end

	self.weak_focus_camera_size = self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax * 0.8
	self.focus_camera_size = self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax * 0.7
	self.default_camera_local_position_y = self.mobile_touch_camera.transform.localPosition.y

	local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.chapter_data.FirstStage)
	local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

	local first_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(spec_name)
	local local_pos_z = first_stage.transform.localPosition.z

	self.camera_z_controller = local_pos_z - self.mobile_touch_camera.transform.localPosition.z

	-- 첫 월드맵 진입시에는 따로 카메라 위치를 조정하지 않는다.
	if self.is_first then
		return
	end

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	else
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) and user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
		local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition

		self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)
	else
		local last_stage_position = self.item:GetPreviousStageButtonPosition()

		self:set_camera_local_pos(last_stage_position)
	end
end

function local_class:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)
	-- 버튼 위치로 카메라 위치 지정
	local new_pos = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = new_pos
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress(param_list)
	local stage_name = param_list[0]
	local target_camera_size = param_list[1]
	local duration = param_list[2]
	local check_stage_opened = param_list[3]

	return util.cs_generator(self.set_focus_progress_start, self, stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress_start(stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
	if check_stage_opened then
		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local targetPos = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(targetPos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	local cleared_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	self.is_routine = true

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
			and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	self.is_routine = false
end

function local_class:first_enter_routine()
	while self.item.IsSpineLoading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.world_map_animator) then
		return
	end

	while not self.world_map_animator.gameObject.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 시즌3 기본 챕터19로 설정
	local background_data = self.world_map_background_data['chapter_19']

	if self.world_map_background_data[self.chapter_data.ChapterName] ~= nil then
		background_data = self.world_map_background_data[self.chapter_data.ChapterName]
	end

	--CS.Oak.Game.Instance:OnBackButtonClicked('+', self.on_back_button_click)

	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	get_ui_scene_manager().UIRootTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local character_pos = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition

	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		v.GetControllerLuaTable:scale_animation('off', 0)
	end

	self.spine_controller.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

function local_class:stage_move_routine()
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prev_stage_spec.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	local stage_state = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stage_state & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출을 보여준다.
	if is_prev_stage_cleared_newly then
		coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

		user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
		self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()
	end

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_and_move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
				self.world_map_state.CustomEvent))
		-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
		-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
		user_progress:SetStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.AdditionalOpenStage)
	else
		coroutine.yield(self:move_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName))
	end

	-- 스테이지 입장 패널 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_stage_enter_panel_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.focus_camera_size))
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
	-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
	self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
	self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	coroutine.yield(prev_stage_button:ShowGetStarGrade(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	-- 연출 처리를 위해 비워주기 전에 캐싱
	local stage_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

end

function local_class:open_path(from_stage_name, to_stage_name, custom_event)
	-- from이 nil일 경우는 제일 처음 오픈 연출뿐
	if from_stage_name == nil then
		return
	end

	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	-- 해당 스테이지로 가는길은 한개 만 가능 하도록 보장 해야함
	local path_name = self:get_path_name(from_stage_name, to_stage_name)
	local way_point_table = self:get_waypoints(from_stage_name, to_stage_name)
	local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(path_name)

	-- 시작과 끝 위치를 넣어 준다
	local total_points = {}
	local transform = path_placeholder.From.transform

	if self.is_fixed_y_pos then
		total_points[1] = vector(transform.position.x, self.path_y_pos, transform.position.z)
	else
		total_points[1] = transform.position
	end

	local point_size = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)
	for i = 1, point_size do
		total_points[i + 1] = way_point_table[i]
	end

	transform = path_placeholder.To.transform

	if self.is_fixed_y_pos then
		total_points[point_size + 2] = vector(transform.position.x, self.path_y_pos, transform.position.z)
	else
		total_points[point_size + 2] = transform.position
	end

	local path_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local head_fx_obj
	local head_fx_transform
	local trail

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			path_res_holder, 'worldmap/common', 'FX_worldmap_road_head', function(prefab)
				head_fx_obj = game_object.Instantiate(prefab)
				head_fx_transform = head_fx_obj.transform
				head_fx_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.2
				CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(head_fx_transform, 'SpecialEvents')
				trail = head_fx_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.TrailRenderer))
				trail.widthMultiplier = 0.1
				head_fx_obj:SetActive(false)
			end)

	local time_passed = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local progress = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(0)
	local time = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)

	self.point_num = 0

	head_fx_obj:SetActive(true)

	while time_passed < time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(time_passed, 0, time)

		progress = time_passed / time

		head_fx_transform.localPosition = self:make_path_line(path_name, total_points, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if head_fx_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(head_fx_obj)
	end

	path_res_holder:Dispose()
	path_res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:move_stage(from_stage, to_stage)
	local way_point_table = self:get_waypoints_full_path(from_stage, to_stage)

	local total_length = self:get_total_path_length(way_point_table)
	local speed = total_length / self.character_move_duration

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_walk_animation_name(character_info), true)

	-- 월드맵 걷는 SFX Play
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.world_map_walking_sfx_handle_name)

	if way_point_table == nil or table_util.get_size(way_point_table) == 0 then
		return
	end

	local way_point_length = table_util.get_size(way_point_table)

	for i = 1, way_point_length - 1 do
		local spine_controller_transform = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform
		spine_controller_transform.localPosition = way_point_table[i]

		local dir = way_point_table[i+1] - spine_controller_transform.localPosition

		self.spine_controller.Direction = dir:GetX0z():ToDirection()

		local spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition
		local is_destination = spine_local_position:GetXz() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXz()

		while is_destination do
			local move_delta = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			spine_local_position = self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition

			local move_position = unity_class.vector3.MoveTowards(spine_local_position, way_point_table[i+1], move_delta)

			self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = move_position
			is_destination = move_position:GetXz() ~= way_point_table[i+1]:GetXz()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', false)
	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(chapter_code)
	local stage = nil

	if target_stages == nil or target_stages.Length == 0 then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	local stage_length = target_stages.Length

	self:init_finger_object_table()

	for i = 0, stage_length - 1 do
		if target_stages[i] ~= nil then
			stage = self.stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[i])
		end

		if stage == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		if self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] == nil then
			local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] = { is_open = false, effect = nil }
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].is_open = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stages[i])

		local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

		if is_unity_null(button) then
			return false
		end

		button.GetControllerLuaTable:show_open_effect(self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect)

		::continue::
	end

	self:show_finger(true)
	return true
end

function local_class:init_finger_object_table()
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v.is_open = false
			if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			local local_finger_obj = v.effect

			if v.is_open and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
			v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	local character_update = false

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		character_update = true

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local character_prefab
	--local effect_prefab

	wait_all({
		-- 캐릭터
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
				character_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end),
		--util.cs_generator(function()
		--	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('worldmap/common', 'FX_worldmap_player_marker'), function(prefab)
		--		effect_prefab = prefab
		--	end))
		--end)
	})

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(character_prefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name

		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		end
	end

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then

		local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

		if button_placeholder ~= nil then
			character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0()
		end
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	--local marker = game_object.Instantiate(effect_prefab)
	--local markerT = marker.transform
	--markerT:SetParent(character_t)
	--markerT.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	--markerT.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	--markerT.localScale = vector(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then

		-- 캐릭터 초기 세팅 (애니메이션, 방향, 상태등)
		world_map_util.init_spine_character(game_data_service, character, self.spine_controller, character_info, 55,
				self.character_weapon_attachment_shader_selector, vector(45, 0, 0), self.item.IsHideCharacter, self.item.SpineTopShader)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

function local_class:get_last_open_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	local first_main_stage_id = self.chapter_data.FirstStage
	local last_main_stage_id = self.chapter_data.LastStage

	for i = first_main_stage_id, last_main_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(spec_name) then
			stage_name = spec_name
		else
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:is_first_enter()
	if user_progress:IsStageUnlocked(self.chapter_data.FirstStage) then
		CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.DeleteKey(self.first_enter_key_string)
		return false
	end

	local is_first = CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.GetInt(self.first_enter_key_string)

	if is_first == 1 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre_start(scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShearToggleEvent.Create(self.item, false))

	local cur_button_placeholder = nil

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		cur_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
	end

	local open_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(open_stage)

	self:hidden_stage(open_stage)

	if self.change_ui ~= nil then
		self.change_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 월드맵 카메라로 변경
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	local init_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local local_position = open_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition

	target_camera_position = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		local_position = cur_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
		init_camera_position = vector(local_position.x, self.default_camera_local_position_y, local_position.z - self.camera_z_controller)
	else
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		init_camera_position = target_camera_position
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = init_camera_position

	scene_obj:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 세팅이 끝나면 Fade In 해준다.
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeInAsync(0.75, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		local duration = 1.5
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_progress_start(open_stage, self.focus_camera_size, duration, false))
	end

	local shake_duration = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)
	local shake_magnitude = 0.06

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_earthquake_01')

	while shake_calculator.IsActive do
		shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local new_pos = target_camera_position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset:GetX0z()
		self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = new_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition = target_camera_position

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(self.item.TargetStageName, open_stage, true, true))

	--서버 패킷 처리 및 연출이 종료된 후 UserProgress 를 업데이트 한다.
	user_progress:SetStageOpened(open_stage)

	if field_ui_narration_box ~= nil then
		local field_ui_narration_box_transform = field_ui_narration_box.transform
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.position = vector(0,0,10)
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		coroutine.yield(field_ui_narration_box:ContinuityShowHide(narrations, 0, 2))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	else
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeOutAsync(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(prev_bgm_name, bgm_state)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShearToggleEvent.Create(self.item, true))
end

function local_class:resume()
	if self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = false

		-- 각 버튼 resume 처리
		for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.is_pause = true
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.straight_line_info = nil
	self.path_placeholder_info_table = nil

	self.pool_table = nil
	self.finger_object_table = nil
	self.path_state_dic = nil

	if self.spine_res_holder ~= nil then
		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}
