		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(chapter_code)
	local stage = nil

	if target_stages == nil or target_stages.Length == 0 then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	local stage_length = target_stages.Length

	self:init_finger_object_table()

	for i = 0, stage_length - 1 do
		if target_stages[i] ~= nil then
			stage = self.stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[i])
		end

		if stage == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		if self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] == nil then
			local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name] = { is_open = false, effect = nil }
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].is_open = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stages[i])
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].is_open = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stages[i])
		end

		local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

		if is_unity_null(button) then
			return false
		end

		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect.transform.parent = button.transform
		self.finger_object_table[stage.Name].effect.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		::continue::
	end

	self:show_finger(true)
	return true
end

function local_class:init_finger_object_table()
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			v.is_open = false
			if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if v ~= nil then
			local local_finger_obj = v.effect

			if v.is_open and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
				v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	for k,v in pairs(self.finger_object_table) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.effect) then
			v.effect.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_spine_character(param_list)
	self.spine_controller = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_spine_character_start, self)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	local character_update = false

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		character_update = true

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local characterPrefab = nil

	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
		characterPrefab = prefab
	end))

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(characterPrefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name

		if character_update and self.is_move_even_once then
			local stage_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['only_main_stages']
			local stage_table_size = table_util.get_size(stage_table)

			stage_name = 'queencastle_1_1'

			for i = 1, stage_table_size do
				if user_progress:IsStageOpened(stage_table[i]) then
					stage_name = stage_table[i]
				else
					break
				end
			end
		elseif stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지를 방금 클리어한 상태
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then

		local path_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.pathParentT, self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
		local parent_name = ''

		if path_transform ~= nil then
			parent_name = path_transform.name
		end

		local path_name = self.world_map_state.ExitHandleName
		local path_placeholder = self:get_path_placeholder_info(parent_name, path_name)

		if path_placeholder == nil then
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
		else
			self.is_teleport_move = path_placeholder.Hidden

			local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

			if button_placeholder ~= nil then
				character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0()
			end
		end
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then

		-- 캐릭터 초기 세팅 (애니메이션, 방향, 상태등)
		self.world_map_util.init_spine_character(game_data_service, character, self.spine_controller, character_info, 55,
				self.character_weapon_attachment_shader_selector, vector(45, 0, 0), self.item.IsHideCharacter, self.item.SpineTopShader)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

--1스테이지 클리어 후 2스테이지 오픈 연출시 화면 밖에서 2스테이지로 떨어지는 듯한 연출 진행
function local_class:fall_players_inner(stage_name)
	self:set_character_default_position(self.spine_controller.transform, stage_name)

	-- 버튼 바로 위에 있는 캐릭터 위치
	local center = self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition

	local bounce_cb = function(bounce)
		-- 첫 착지 일때 처리
		if bounce == 1 then
			--Shake(0.015f, 0.1f)
			local effect = self.pool_table['FX_Common_Jump_small']:Instantiate(self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
			effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-90, 0, 0))
			effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	end

	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 3, 7, 2, bounce_cb)

	y_calculator:ScaleTime(3)
	y_calculator:SetElasticity(0.35)

	local time_passed = 0
	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local old_time_passed = time_passed

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local all_done = true
		if y_calculator:IsDone() or time_passed < 0 then
			-- continue 대신으로 비워 둠
		else
			if old_time_passed >= 0 then
				y_calculator:Proceed(dt)
			else
				y_calculator:Proceed(time_passed)
			end

			if y_calculator:IsDone() then
				self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = center
			else
				all_done = false
				local change_pos = center + vector(0, y_calculator:GetDistance(), 0)
				self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = change_pos
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if all_done then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre(param_list)
	local scene_obj = param_list[0]
	local narrations = param_list[1]
	local field_ui_narration_box = param_list[2]
	local open_stage = param_list[3]
	local bgm_state = param_list[4]
	local prev_bgm_name = param_list[5]

	return util.cs_generator(self.new_stage_theatre_start, self, scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre_start(scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
	local shear_field_obj = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('shear')
	local previous_shear = 0

	if shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		previous_shear = shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear
		shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0
	end

	local light_active_table = {}
	local light_field_obj_table = {}

	local light_field_obj = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('directional_light')
	local light_field_obj_1 = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('directional_light_1')
	local light_field_obj_2 = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('directional_light_2')
	local light_field_obj_3 = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('directional_light_3')

	if light_field_obj ~= nil then
		table.insert(light_field_obj_table, light_field_obj)
	end

	if light_field_obj_1 ~= nil then
		table.insert(light_field_obj_table, light_field_obj_1)
	end

	if light_field_obj_2 ~= nil then
		table.insert(light_field_obj_table, light_field_obj_2)
	end

	if light_field_obj_3 ~= nil then
		table.insert(light_field_obj_table, light_field_obj_3)
	end

	local light_size = table_util.get_size(light_field_obj_table)
	for i = 1, light_size do
		table.insert(light_active_table, light_field_obj_table[i].gameObject.activeSelf)

		light_field_obj_table[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	local cur_button_placeholder = nil
	local target_stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName

	if self.exception_sub_stage_name == open_stage then
		target_stage_name = self.check_path_stage_name

		self:button_and_path_off(true)
		self:refresh_button_and_path(false, 0)

		self.world_map_controller:set_rotation(self.current_rotation_num)
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(target_stage_name) then
		cur_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(target_stage_name)
	end

	local open_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(open_stage)

	self:hidden_stage(open_stage)

	if self.move_ui ~= nil then
		self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 월드맵 카메라로 변경
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	local init_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero

	target_camera_position = open_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		init_camera_position = cur_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
	else
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		init_camera_position = target_camera_position
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = vector(init_camera_position.x, init_camera_position.y)

	scene_obj:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 세팅이 끝나면 Fade In 해준다.
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeInAsync(0.75, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		local duration = 1
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_progress_start(open_stage, self.focus_camera_size, duration, false))
	end

	local shake_duration = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)
	local shake_magnitude = 0.06

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_earthquake_01')

	while shake_calculator.IsActive do
		shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local new_pos = target_camera_position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset:GetXy():GetXy0()
		self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = vector(new_pos.x, new_pos.y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = vector(target_camera_position.x, target_camera_position.y)

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(target_stage_name, open_stage, true, true))

	--서버 패킷 처리 및 연출이 종료된 후 UserProgress 를 업데이트 한다.
	user_progress:SetStageOpened(open_stage)

	if field_ui_narration_box ~= nil then
		local field_ui_narration_box_transform = field_ui_narration_box.transform
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.position = vector(0,0,10)
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		coroutine.yield(field_ui_narration_box:ContinuityShowHide(narrations, 0, 2))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	else
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeOutAsync(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(prev_bgm_name, bgm_state)

	if shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = self.previous_shear
	end

	for i = 1, light_size do
		light_field_obj_table[i].gameObject:SetActive(light_active_table[i])
	end

	light_active_table = nil
	light_field_obj_table = nil
end

function local_class:resume()
	if not self.is_routine then
		self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = false

		-- controller, 스테이지버튼 resume 처리
		if self.world_map_controller ~= nil then
			self.world_map_controller:resume()
		end

		-- 각 버튼 resume 처리
		for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.is_pause = true
end

function local_class:refresh_button_and_path(is_target_stage, force_rotation_num)
	if is_target_stage == nil then
		is_target_stage = false
	end

	if force_rotation_num == nil then
		force_rotation_num = -1
	end

	local rotation_num = -1

	if is_target_stage and self.prev_stage_name ~= nil then
		local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.prev_stage_name)
		rotation_num = self:get_current_rotation_num(prev_stage_button.StageName)
	elseif force_rotation_num ~= -1 then
		-- 강제로 해당 로테이션에 맞는 스테이지를 보여주기 위함.
		rotation_num = force_rotation_num
	end

	-- 현재 회전된 상태에 출력될 스테이지를 가져온다.
	if rotation_num ~= -1 and rotation_num ~= self.current_rotation_num then
		self.current_rotation_num = rotation_num
		self.current_rotation_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
		self.current_rotation_table_size = table_util.get_size(self.current_rotation_table)
	end

	-- 회전 상태에 따라 스테이지 and path를 on해준다.
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		local stage_name = stage_button.StageName

		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

			if self.path_table[stage_name] ~= nil then
				-- path 출력 처리
				local path_table =  self.path_table[stage_name]
				local path_size = table_util.get_size(path_table)
				local path_on = true

				for index = 1, path_size do
					local p_name = path_table[index]

					-- 3스테이지의 경우엔 rotation 상태에 따라 출력 path가 달라짐
					if self.check_path_stage_name == stage_name then
						-- 먼저 전부 출력되는것 확인 후 적용 예정
						path_on = self:check_exception_rotation_stage(self.current_rotation_num, p_name)
					end

					if path_on then
						local has_value, path = self.path_name_dic:TryGetValue(p_name)

						if has_value then
							path:SetActive(true)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(stage_name) then
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
			end
		else
			--stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end

		::continue::
	end
end

function local_class:etc_setting()
	local button_visible = false

	-- 3스테이지 개방 이벤트 이후 이면 on
	if self.main_quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.passage_opening_progress then
			button_visible = true
		end
	end

	self.board_ui_prefab:SetActive(button_visible)
	self.board_ui_effect:SetActive(false)

	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:change_sprite(self.current_rotation_num)
	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:button_visible(button_visible)

	for k,v in pairs(self.board_icon_table) do
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(k) then
			v.Alpha = 1
		else
			v.Alpha = 0.2
		end

		v:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:button_and_path_off(button_active_false)
	if button_active_false == nil then
		button_active_false = false
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 button 다 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
		if button_active_false then
			v.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden_active_false()
		else
			v.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 path 다 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.path_name_dic) do
		v:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:move_map(rotation_num, direct)
	self.is_transition = true
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 회전 연출 시작
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			-- 회전 애니메이션, 이펙트 on
			self.world_map_controller:on_stage_effect(stage_button.StageName, true)
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:rotation_off()
		end
	end

	-- 현재 존재하는 path 다 off
	for k,v in pairs(self.path_name_dic) do
		v:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 캐릭터 off
	self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform.localPosition = vector(999,0,999)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			self.world_map_controller:on_stage_effect(stage_button.StageName, false)
		end
	end

	-- 완전 끔
	self:button_and_path_off(true)

	-- 회전 진행
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.rotation_sfx_handle_name)
	coroutine.yield(self.world_map_controller:world_map_rotation(direct))

	self.current_rotation_num = rotation_num

	-- 현재 회전된 상태에 출력될 스테이지를 가져온다.
	self.current_rotation_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['default']
	self.current_rotation_table_size = table_util.get_size(self.current_rotation_table)

	-- 회전 연출 끝
	-- 스테이지 버튼 on 애니메이션 재생
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:rotation_on()
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.on_stage_sfx_handle_name)

	-- 버튼 이펙트 on
	for i = 1, self.current_rotation_table_size do
		local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.current_rotation_table[i])

		if stage_button ~= nil and self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_button.StageName) then
			self.world_map_controller:on_stage_effect(stage_button.StageName, true)
		end
	end

	self:refresh_button_and_path()

	-- 캐릭터 on (메인 스테이지 위치에 배치)
	local stage_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['only_main_stages']
	local stage_table_size = table_util.get_size(stage_table)
	local character_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_1'

	for i = 1, stage_table_size do
		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(stage_table[i]) then
			character_stage_name = stage_table[i]
		else
			break
		end
	end

	self:set_character_default_position(self.spine_controller.gameObject.transform, character_stage_name)

	self.move_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:change_sprite(self.current_rotation_num)
	self.move_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.is_move_even_once = true

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	self.is_transition = false
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:get_current_rotation_num(stage_name)
	local rotation_num = 0

	if table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_1st_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 0
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_2nd_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 1
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_3rd_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 2
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_4th_table['check_table_stage'], stage_name) then
		rotation_num = 3
	end

	return rotation_num
end

function local_class:get_rotation_stage_table(rotation_num)
	if rotation_num == 0 then
		return self.constants_data.world_map_1st_table
	elseif rotation_num == 1 then
		return self.constants_data.world_map_2nd_table
	elseif rotation_num == 2 then
		return self.constants_data.world_map_3rd_table
	else
		return self.constants_data.world_map_4th_table
	end
end

function local_class:check_exception_rotation_stage(rotation_num, path_name)
	local is_check = false

	if rotation_num == 0 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_1st_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	elseif rotation_num == 1 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_2nd_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	elseif rotation_num == 2 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_3rd_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	elseif rotation_num == 3 and table_util.contain_value(self.constants_data.world_map_4th_table['exception_path_name'], path_name) then
		is_check = true
	end

	return is_check
end

function local_class:get_last_open_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_main_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if user_progress:IsStageOpened(spec_name) then
			stage_name = spec_name
		else
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:get_pad_select_stage_name()
	if self.is_transition then
		return ''
	end

	local stage_table = self:get_rotation_stage_table(self.current_rotation_num)['only_main_stages']
	local stage_table_size = table_util.get_size(stage_table)
	local stage_name = ''

		-- NextStageName이 있을시
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) then
		stage_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
	else
		-- 현재 회전된 기준으로 손가락이 가리키는 스테이지를 선택
		local target_stages = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStages(self.item.ChapterCode)

		if target_stages ~= nil and target_stages.Length > 0 then
			local stage = self.stage_data:GetStage(target_stages[0])

			for i = 1, stage_table_size do
				if stage_table[i] == stage.Name then
					stage_name = stage_table[i]
				else
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		-- 현재 회전된 기준으로 마지막 메인 스테이지를 반환
		for i = 1, stage_table_size do
			if user_progress:IsStageOpened(stage_table[i]) then
				stage_name = stage_table[i]
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:show_popup(world_map_button, stage_name)
	-- 팝업 출력
	-- 인자 둘 중 하나만 존재하면 되도록
	-- 조건 체크 후 만족하지 않으면 팝업 출력
	local s_name = ''

	if world_map_button ~= nil then
		s_name = world_map_button.StageName
	else
		s_name = stage_name
	end

	-- 메인 퀘스트가 없으면 챕터16 첫 입장 이라고 간주 한다.
	if self.main_quest_progress == nil then
		return false
	end

		-- 첫번째 스테이지가 아니면 넘어 간다.
	if self.check_enter_stage_name ~= s_name then
		return false
	end

	-- 메인 섹션 and 통로5 스테이지 클리어 여부 후 팝업 출력
	if self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.first_stage_re_enter_progress then
		if user_progress:IsStageCleared(self.check_condition_stage_name) then
			return false
		end
		-- 해당 섹션이 안될 경우 입장 가능
	elseif self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress < self.first_stage_re_enter_progress then
		return false
		-- 메인 퀘스트 완료 상태면 입장 가능
	elseif self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return false
	end

	local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
	popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString('worldmap_chapter16_popup_desc')

	get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, popup_state)

	return true
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.world_map_util = nil
	self.world_map_data = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.pool_table = nil
	self.finger_object_table = nil
	self.path_state = nil
	self.world_map_controller = nil

	self.path_placeholder_array = nil
	self.path_placeholder_info_table = nil
	self.path_state_dic = nil
	self.straight_line_info = nil
	self.curve_line_info = nil
	self.curve_line_position_info = nil
	self.path_table = nil
	self.current_rotation_table = nil

	self.res_holder = nil

	if self.spine_res_holder ~= nil then
		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.move_ui_prefab ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.move_ui_prefab)
		self.move_ui_prefab = nil
	end

	self.move_ui = nil

	if self.board_ui_prefab ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.board_ui_prefab)
		self.board_ui_prefab = nil
	end

	self.board_ui_effect = nil
	self.board_icon_table = nil
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleWorldMapController')

function local_class:init()
	self.shear_field_obj = nil
	self.shear_controller = nil

	self.previous_shear = 0

	self.mobile_touch_camera = nil
	self.touch_input = nil

	self.camera_zoom_min = 18
	self.camera_zoom_max = 20

	self.cur_maker_num = -1
	self.stage_obj_length = 0

	self.open_Stage_name = 'passage_16_1'
	self.additional_open_stage = {'passage_16_2', 'passage_16_3', 'passage_16_4'}

	self.open_nm_stage_name = 'nightmare_queencastle_2'
	self.additional_nm_open_stage = {'nightmare_queencastle_3', 'nightmare_queencastle_4', 'nightmare_queencastle_5'}

	self.stage_effect_table = {}

	self.bg_transform = nil

	self.chapter_code = nil
end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.bg_transform = self.item.bgObj.transform

	self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.cameraObj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	self.touch_input = self.item.cameraObj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.BitBenderGames.TouchInputController))

	self.stage_obj_length = self.item.stageObjs.Length

	local object_name = ''
	local object = nil

	for i = 0, self.stage_obj_length - 1 do
		object_name = self.item.stageObjs[i].name
		object = self.item.stageObjs[i].transform:Find('fx_ui_worldmap_queencastle_trans_glow').gameObject

		self.stage_effect_table[object_name] = object

		object:SetActive(false)
	end

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance == nil then
		return
	end

	self.chapter_code = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Spec.ChapterCode
end

function local_class:init_controller()
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local field = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field

	self.shear_field_obj = field:GetFieldObject('shear')

	if self.shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		self.shear_controller = self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController))
		self.previous_shear = self.shear_controller.Shear
		self.shear_controller.Shear = 0
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMin = self.camera_zoom_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.camera_zoom_max

	self.mobile_touch_camera.enabled = false
	self.touch_input.enabled = false

	self.item.parentObj.transform.localPosition = vector(0,1,0)

	if self.item.stageObjs == nil then
		return
	end

	self.stage_obj_length = self.item.stageObjs.Length

	for i = 0, self.stage_obj_length - 1 do
		self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:end_controller()
	if self.shear_controller ~= nil then
		self.shear_controller.Shear = self.previous_shear
	end

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:world_map_rotation(direct)
	local add_val = 0

	if direct == 0 then
		add_val = -90
	else
		add_val = 90
	end

	local cur_angle = self.bg_transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y
	local next_angle = vector(0, cur_angle + add_val, 0)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.UI.UIAnimations.Rotation(self.bg_transform, 0.6, next_angle, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine))
end

function local_class:set_rotation(num)
	local next_angle = num * 90
	self.bg_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, next_angle, 0)
end

function local_class:stage_marker(stage_name)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_marker_start, self, stage_name))
end

function local_class:stage_marker_start(stage_name)
	local animator = nil

	self.cur_maker_num = -1

	for i = 0, self.stage_obj_length - 1 do
		self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(false)

		if self.item.stageObjs[i].name == stage_name then
			self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(true)
			self.cur_maker_num = i
			break
		end
	end

	if self.cur_maker_num ~= -1 then
		while not self.item.stageObjs[self.cur_maker_num].activeInHierarchy do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		animator = self.item.stageObjs[self.cur_maker_num]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		local animation_name = self.item.stageObjs[self.cur_maker_num].name..'_maker'
		animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:stage_marker_end()
	if self.stage_obj_length <= self.cur_maker_num then
		return
	end

	self.item.stageObjs[self.cur_maker_num]:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:new_open_stage()
	local open_Stage_name, additional_open_stage

	open_Stage_name = self.open_Stage_name
	additional_open_stage = self.additional_open_stage

	-- 악몽일 경우 처리 추가
	if self.chapter_code ~= nil and self.chapter_code.Difficulty ~= CS.Tilemaps.Difficulty.Normal then

	end

function local_class:on_stage_effect(stage_name, visible)
	if self.stage_effect_table[stage_name] == nil then
		return
	end

	self.stage_effect_table[stage_name]:SetActive(visible)

function local_class:resume()

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()

	self.touch_input = nil
	self.shear_field_obj = nil
	self.shear_controller = nil
	self.additional_open_stage = nil
	self.stage_effect_table = nil

	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:on_load_start()
	self.is_world_map_loading = true

	self.stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')

	-- 필요한 퀘스트 프로그레스 얻어옴
	self.main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	self.data_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data_quest_id)

	coroutine.yield(self:pre_load_resource())

	self:progress_setting()

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.load_effect_pool_progress, self),
		util.cs_generator(self.make_button, self),
		util.cs_generator(self.load_ammi, self)
	})

	self.prev_stage_name = value
