	self:add_object_pool(self.ev_clear_effect_name)
	self:add_object_pool('FX_reset_object')
	self:add_object_pool('FX_Common_Jump_small')
	self:add_object_pool('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new')
	self:add_object_pool("human_emotion")
	--self:add_object_pool('FX_levelup_new')

	coroutine.yield(self:is_pool_loading())
end

function local_class:add_object_pool(preset_name)
	local object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_name)
	self.pool_table[preset_name] = object_pool
end

function local_class:is_pool_loading()
	local is_loaded_all = true
	while true do
		is_loaded_all = true

		for k,v in pairs(self.pool_table) do
			if v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded and
					v.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.LoadFailed then
				is_loaded_all = false
			end
		end

		if is_loaded_all then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:pre_load_resource()
	wait_all({
		-- 폭탄, 코어 표시용 추가 UI 로드
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_49_queenship/worldmap/common', 'QueenShipWorldMapBackGroundEtc'), function(prefab)
				self.etc_prefab = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(get_ui_scene_manager().UIRootTransform, prefab)
				self.etc_ui = self.etc_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipWorldMapBackGroundEtc))
			end))
		end),
		-- 커스텀 데이터 세팅
		util.cs_generator(self.init_custom_state_setting, self)
	})

	local bomb_event = false
	local ev_event = false

	-- UI 상태 및 갯수 표시
	if self.main_quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.bomb_first_event_progress then
			bomb_event = true
		end

		if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.ev_first_event_progress then
			ev_event = true
		end
	end

	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:resource_on_off(self.obstacle_state.bomb, bomb_event)
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:resource_on_off(self.obstacle_state.core, ev_event)

	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.bomb, ''..0)
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.core, ''..0)
end

function local_class:init_custom_state_setting()
	if CS.Oak.QuestReplaySystem.IsReplaying then
		return
	end

	if self.data_quest_progress == nil then
		return
	end

	local check_length = self.data_quest_progress.CustomStates.Count

	-- 필요한 커스텀 데이터 개수만큼 저장되어 있는지 확인, 및 기본 값으로 세팅
	if check_length >= self.total_custom_data_num then
		return
	end

	local data_dictionary = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
	local state_val = -1

	data_dictionary:Add(self.all_open_obstacle_key_name, state_val)

	-- 장애물 관련 기본 데이터 세팅 총 17개
	for k,v in pairs(self.constants_data.obstacle) do
		if not data_dictionary:ContainsKey(k) then
			-- data_quest_progress에 키가 있으면 해당 값, 없으면 -1
			state_val = self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(k)
			data_dictionary:Add(k, state_val)
		end
	end

	-- ammi 관련 기본 데이터 세팅 총 3개
	for k,v in pairs(self.constants_data.ammi) do
		local key_name = v.data_key_name

		if not data_dictionary:ContainsKey(key_name) then
			-- data_quest_progress에 키가 있으면 해당 값, 없으면 -1
			state_val = self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name)
			data_dictionary:Add(key_name, state_val)
		end
	end

	local req = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendSetQuestCustomState(self.data_quest_progress.QuestId, data_dictionary)
	              :Then(function(res)
		for k,v in pairs(data_dictionary) do
			user_progress:SetQuestCustomState(self.data_quest_progress, k, v)
		end
	end)

	coroutine.yield(req)
end

function local_class:progress_setting()
	local cur_bomb = 0
	local cur_core = 0

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_stage_id do
		-- 각 스테이지 마다 폭탄, 코어, ammi 상태 가져와서 table에 저장
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local stage_progress = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Instance:GetStageProgress(stage_spec)
		local stage_name = stage_spec.Name

		if self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name] == nil then
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name] = {bomb = 0, core = 0, ammi_state = -1, open = false}
		end

		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].bomb ~= 0 then
			local bomb_num = stage_progress:GetCustomDataInt(self.bomb_id, 0)

			cur_bomb = cur_bomb + bomb_num
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].bomb = bomb_num
		end

		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].core ~= 0 then
			local core_num = stage_progress:GetCustomDataInt(self.core_id, 0)

			cur_core = cur_core + core_num
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].core = core_num
		end

		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].ammi_enable then
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].ammi_state = 0

			if stage_progress:GetCustomDataInt(self.ammi_id, 0) == 1 then
				self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].ammi_state = 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- 현재 장애물 전부 초기화
	for k,v in pairs(self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table) do
		self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[k] = false
	end

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local stage_name = stage_spec.Name

		-- 현재 월드맵 데이터용 퀘스트에 저장된 장애물 상태 값들을 불러와서 table에 저장
		if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_enable and self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table ~= nil then
			local obstacle_list = self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table
			local size = table_util.get_size(obstacle_list)

			for index = 1, size do
				local obstacle_name = obstacle_list[index]

				-- 테이블에 없으면 추가 및 초기화
				if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] == nil then
					self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] = false
				end

				if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil then
					if self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.all_open_obstacle_key_name) == 1 or self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(obstacle_name) == 1 then
						if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
							self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] = true

							-- 잔해, 엘레베이터가 열려 있으면 각 폭탄, 코어 하나씩 마이너스
							if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
								cur_bomb = cur_bomb - 1
							else
								cur_core = cur_core - 1
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if cur_bomb < 0 then
		cur_bomb = 0
	end

	if cur_core < 0 then
		cur_core = 0
	end

	--cur_bomb = 20
	--cur_core = 20

	-- ui 갱신
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.bomb, ''..cur_bomb)
	self.etc_ui.GetControllerLuaTable:set_resource_label(self.obstacle_state.core, ''..cur_core)

	return cur_bomb, cur_core
end

function local_class:resume()
	if not self.is_routine then
		self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = false

		-- controller, 스테이지버튼 resume 처리
		if self.worldmap_controller ~= nil then
			self.worldmap_controller:resume()
		end

		for k,v in pairs(self.stage_button_dic) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end

		for k,v in pairs(self.obstacle_button_table) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v.GetControllerLuaTable:resume()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pause()
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.is_pause = true
end

function local_class:make_button()
	local bundle_name = "ondemand/v2_49_queenship/worldmap/common"

	local button_prefab = nil
	local button_etc_prefab = nil

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'queenship_button'), function(prefab)
				button_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName(bundle_name, 'queenship_button_etc'), function(prefab)
				button_etc_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end)
	})

	if is_unity_null(self.item.worldmapParent) then
		return
	end

	self.worldmap_controller = self.item.worldmapParent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipWorldMapController)).GetControllerLuaTable

	local buttons = self.item.stageParentT:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder))
	local length = buttons.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local stage_name = buttons[i].name
		local btn = buttons[i]
		local btn_t = btn.transform
		local savedRotation = btn_t.localRotation
		btn_t.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		local savedScale = btn_t.localScale
		btn_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		local stage_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.worldmapParent, stage_name)

		-- etc 타입이면 별도 처리, 아닐 경우엔 기존 방식으로 ?
		if buttons[i].postitType ~= CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder.StyleType.Etc then
			local button_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_prefab)
			local button_obj_t = button_obj.transform
			local button = button_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

			button_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
			button_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

			self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:Add(stage_name, buttons[i])

			if not is_unity_null(button) then
				button.StageName = stage_name

				if stage_obj ~= nil then
					button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj.gameObject)
				end

				self.stage_button_dic:Add(stage_name, button)

				button.GetControllerLuaTable:change_button_value()
				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_obstacle(self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].bomb, self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].bomb,
						self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].core, self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].core)

				button:SetButton(btn)

				self:set_button(button, stage_name)
			end
		else
			-- etc 타입 처리
			local button_etc_obj = game_object.Instantiate(button_etc_prefab)
			local button_etc_obj_t = button_etc_obj.transform
			local button = button_etc_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapButtonLua))

			button_etc_obj_t:SetParent(btn_t)
			button_etc_obj_t.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

			-- 장애물 이름
			local obstacle_name = btn.name
			self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table[obstacle_name] = buttons[i]

			if not is_unity_null(button) then

				-- 기존 로직과 호환성을 위해 실제 존재하는 더미 스테이지 이름을 넣어줌
				if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name] ~= nil then
					button.StageName = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].dummy_stage_name
				end

				self.obstacle_button_table[obstacle_name] = button

				if stage_obj ~= nil then
					button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_stage_obj(stage_obj.gameObject)
				end

				--프리팹안에 이름으로 잔해 or 엘레베이터 구문 지어서 읽도록
				button:SetButton(btn)

				button.GetControllerLuaTable:set_obstacle_name(obstacle_name)

				self:set_obstacle(button, obstacle_name)
			end
		end

		btn_t.localRotation = savedRotation
		btn_t.localScale = savedScale
	end

	if self:check_stage_event_routine() and self.worldmap_controller ~= nil then
		self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation('off')
	else
		self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation('idle')
	end
end

function local_class:set_button(stage_button, stage_name)
	if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name] == nil then
		-- 아직 Constants에 등록이 안된 상태
		stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		return
	end

	--기존처럼 open 할 건지
	if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].default_open then
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open = true
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(stage_name) then
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
			end
		else
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	else
		--별도 처리 후 open
		local is_obstacle_clear = self:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name)

		--장애물 다 처리된 상태면 기존 default 루틴
		if is_obstacle_clear then
			if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
				self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open = true
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)

				if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(stage_name) then
					stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
				end
			else
				stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
			end
		else
			stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_obstacle(obstacle_button, obstacle_name)
	if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name] == nil then
		-- 아직 Constants에 등록이 안된 상태
		obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		return
	end

	-- 해당 장애물의 오픈 조건 체크
	if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].is_stage_clear then
		--오픈 조건이 스테이지 클리어 이면
		local open_stage_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].open_name

		local is_open = false

		if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].next_open_flag then
			--플래그 켜져 있으면 다음 스테이지 open만 체크
			local next_stage_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].next_name
			is_open = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(next_stage_name)
		else
			--조건의 스테이지가 클리어 상태인지 체크
			is_open = self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(open_stage_name)
		end

		if is_open then
			obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)
			--해당 장애물이 이미 처리된 상태인지
			if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
				obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
			end
		else
			obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	else
		local check_stage_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].dummy_stage_name

		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(check_stage_name) then

		end


		--오픈 조건이 이전 장애물 처리 이면
		local open_obstacle_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].open_name
		--조건의 장애물이 처리된 상태이면
		if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[open_obstacle_name] then
			obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:open(true)
			--해당 장애물이 이미 처리된 상태인지
			if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
				obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:clear(true)
			end
		else
			obstacle_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name)
	local is_obstacle_clear = true
	--open시 체크해야하는 장애물들 확인 (하나라도 처리 안 되어있으면 false)
	if self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_enable and self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table ~= nil then
		local obstacle_list = self.constants_data.stage[stage_name].obstacle_table
		local size = table_util.get_size(obstacle_list)

		for index = 1, size do
			if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_list[index]] then
				is_obstacle_clear = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return is_obstacle_clear
end

function local_class:show_popup(world_map_button, stage_name)
	-- 팝업 출력
	-- 인자 둘 중 하나만 존재하면 되도록
	-- ok시 재화 체크 후 open 및 연출 진행
	-- cancle시 그냥 넘어감
	local is_obstacle = false
	local obj_button = world_map_button

	self.cur_select_obstacle_name = ''

	if obj_button ~= nil then
		-- 해당 스테이지 입장 가능한지 조건 체크 안되면 뭐 열어야 된다고 팝업창 출력
		if self:check_stage(obj_button) then
			-- 일단 입장 조건은 충족
			if obj_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_obstacle() then
				-- 장애물
				is_obstacle = true
				self.cur_select_obstacle_name = obj_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_obstacle_name()

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.show_obstacle_popup, self))
			end
		else
			-- 조건 통과 못했으니 입장 못하게 막음
			is_obstacle = true
		end
	else
		-- 일반 스테이지가 오픈 상태인지
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			obj_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage_name)

			--스테이지 입장 조건 체크 (장애물 다 열었는지등)
			if not self:check_stage(obj_button) then
				is_obstacle = true
			end
		end
	end

	return is_obstacle
end

function local_class:check_stage(stage_button)
	local target_name = stage_button.StageName
	local obstacle_name = ''
	local is_fail = false

	if stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_obstacle() then
		-- 장애물일 경우 실제 장애물 이름을 얻어옴
		target_name = stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:get_obstacle_name()

		if self.constants_data.obstacle[target_name].is_stage_clear then
			-- 스테이지 클리어가 오픈 조건일 경우
		else
			local open_obstacle_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[target_name].open_name
			if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[open_obstacle_name] then
				is_fail = true
				obstacle_name = open_obstacle_name
			end
		end
	else
		-- 일반 스테이지
		if self.constants_data.stage[target_name].obstacle_enable and self.constants_data.stage[target_name].obstacle_table ~= nil then
			local obstacle_list = self.constants_data.stage[target_name].obstacle_table
			local size = table_util.get_size(obstacle_list)

			for index = 1, size do
				if not self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_list[index]] then
					is_fail = true
					obstacle_name = obstacle_list[index]
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 입장 실패시 팝업 창 출력
	if is_fail then
		local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopUpState()
		popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString('worldmap_popup_stage_fail_desc')

		get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup.Instance, popup_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup))

		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:show_obstacle_popup()
	local is_claimed = false

	--어떤 장애물인지 sprite 이름 설정
	local sprite_name = ''
	if self.constants_data.obstacle[self.cur_select_obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
		sprite_name = self.constants_data.bomb_name
	else
		sprite_name = self.constants_data.core_name
	end

	local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopUpState()
	popup_state.NoticePopUp = false
	popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString('worldmap_popup_remove_desc')
	popup_state.IsShowSprite = true
	popup_state.ConfirmButtonSpriteString = sprite_name
	popup_state.OnYesOrNoClicked = function (ok)
		if ok then
			get_ui_scene_manager():OverlayPopped('+', self.on_clear_obstacle_obj)
		end
		is_claimed = true
	end

	get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup.Instance, popup_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup))

	while not is_claimed do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_obj()
	-- 폭탄인지 코어 인지 확인
	-- 해당 오브젝트 오픈 처리 및 오픈 연출 작업
	-- 실패 시 부족하다는 메시지와 함께 팝업창 출력 후 끝
	get_ui_scene_manager():OverlayPopped('-', self.on_clear_obstacle_obj)

	local obstacle_name = self.cur_select_obstacle_name

	if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[obstacle_name] then
		-- 이미 열려있으니 return
		--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('clear_obstacle_obj already open '..obstacle_name)
		return
	end

	local is_success = false
	local obstacle_state = 1

	-- 재 설정
	local bomb_num, core_num = self:progress_setting()

	if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
		obstacle_state = self.obstacle_state.bomb
		if bomb_num > 0 then
			is_success = true
		end
	else
		obstacle_state = self.obstacle_state.core
		if core_num > 0 then
			is_success = true
		end
	end

	if is_success then
		-- 성공시 오픈 연출 진행
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.clear_obstacle_routine, self, obstacle_name))
	else
		-- 실패시 뭐 때문 인지 팝업 창 출력
		local obstacle_str = ''
		if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].state == self.obstacle_state.bomb then
			obstacle_str = 'worldmap_popup_bomb_lack_desc'
		else
			obstacle_str = 'worldmap_popup_core_lack_desc'
		end

		local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopUpState()
		popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString(obstacle_str)

		get_ui_scene_manager():PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup.Instance, popup_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.WorldMapBackGroundPopup))
	end
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine(obstacle_name)
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(false)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance:SetButtonsActive(false)
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local check_name = obstacle_name

	self.cur_clear_obstacle_state = self.clear_obstacle_state.none

	-- 성공
	local on_success = function()
		self.cur_clear_obstacle_state = self.clear_obstacle_state.success
	end

	-- 실패
	local on_fail = function()
		self.cur_clear_obstacle_state = self.clear_obstacle_state.fail
	end

	local on_finally = function()
		self:clear_obstacle_routine_finally(check_name)
	end

	-- 장애물 데이터용 퀘스트 프로그래스에 저장
	if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetQuestCustomState, nil, self.data_quest_progress, check_name, 1,
				on_success, on_fail, on_finally)
	end
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine_success(obstacle_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 재 설정
	self:progress_setting()

	local camera_duration = self.camera_focus_duration * 0.6

	-- 장애물 오픈 연출 진행 (거리에 따른 시간 조정)
	local local_position = self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table[obstacle_name].transform.localPosition
	local obstacle_vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local camera_vec2 = vector(self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition.x, self.mobile_touch_camera.Transform.localPosition.y)
	local speed = obstacle_vec2 - camera_vec2
	local duration = speed.magnitude * 0.55

	coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(obstacle_name, self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, duration))
	-- 장애물 제거 연출, 애니메이션 및 이펙트, 사운드 출력
	-- 이펙트 출력 추가
	local clear_obstacle_btn = self.obstacle_button_table[obstacle_name]
	local effect = nil

	if clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_bomb() then
		effect = self.pool_table['FX_Explosion_Bomb_new']:Instantiate(clear_obstacle_btn.transform.position)
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-90, 0, 0))
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_01')

		clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()

		wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)
	else
		effect = self.pool_table[self.ev_clear_effect_name]:Instantiate(clear_obstacle_btn.transform.position)
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 1.5, 0.5)
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_impact_09')

		coroutine.yield(clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear_animation())
		clear_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	if effect ~= nil then
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	local next_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].next_name
	local stage_state = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].next_stage_state
	-- 다음 장애물로 이동
	if stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(next_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, camera_duration, false))
	elseif stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, camera_duration))
	end

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(obstacle_name, next_name, true, stage_state))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance:SetButtonsActive(true)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine_fail()
	CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance:SetButtonsActive(true)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = false
	get_ui_scene_manager():SetUIEventReceive(true)
end

function local_class:clear_obstacle_routine_finally(obstacle_name)
	if self.cur_clear_obstacle_state == self.clear_obstacle_state.success then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.clear_obstacle_routine_success, self, obstacle_name))
	else
		self:clear_obstacle_routine_fail()
	end
end

function local_class:setting_camera(camera)
	self.mobile_touch_camera = camera

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.mobile_touch_camera) then
		return
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMin = self.camera_zoom_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMin = self.camera_boundary_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.BoundaryMax = self.camera_boundary_max

	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.weak_focus_camera_size
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.camera_zoom_max
	else
		self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) and user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		local focus_stage = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
		local local_pos = focus_stage.transform.localPosition

		self:set_camera_local_pos(local_pos)
	else
		local last_stage_position = self:get_previous_stage_button_position()

		self:set_camera_local_pos(last_stage_position)
	end
end

function local_class:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)
	local new_pos = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = new_pos
end

function local_class:begin_routine()
	return util.cs_generator(self.begin_routine_start, self)
end

function local_class:begin_routine_start()
	local cleared_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff & CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared
	local cleared_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(cleared_state)

	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.is_routine = true

	-- ammi 처치 연출을 가장 먼저 보여줌
	coroutine.yield(self:ammi_dead_routine())

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
			and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_move_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and cleared_state_int ~= 0 then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_clear_routine())
	elseif self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- ammi 등장연출 추가
	--if self.main_quest_progress ~= nil and self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.ammi_first_event_progress then
	--	-- ammi를 첫 조우한 이벤트 섹션 이후에 출력
	--	-- 연출 봤는지 저장 해야함
	--	if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil and self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.ammi_first_routine_key_name) ~= 1 then
	--		coroutine.yield(self:ammi_show_routine())
	--	end
	--end

	self.is_routine = false
	self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:stage_first_enter_routine()
	while self.item.IsSpineLoading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_spaceship_06')

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.routine_camera_zoom_max

	local duration = 1.5

	-- 카메라를 함선 가운데 위치로 이동
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(self.default_camera_pos)
	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, self.routine_camera_zoom_max, duration, false, true, false, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 함선 등장 애니메이션 및 기타 출력
	local character_button_local_pos = self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition
	self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = vector(character_button_local_pos.x, character_button_local_pos.y + 100, character_button_local_pos.z)

	-- 함선 위에 ammi 배치
	local size = table_util.get_size(self.ammi_controller_table)

	for i = 1, size do
		local character_t = self.ammi_controller_table[i].transform
		local button_placeholder = nil

		self.ammi_controller_table[i]:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)

		if self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_3'].num == i then
			button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_3'].button_name)
		elseif 	self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_4'].num == i then
			button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_4'].button_name)
		else
			button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_6'].button_name)
		end

		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + self.ammi_button_offset
	end

	local transition_sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	transition_sfx_info.sfxName = '01_impact_08'
	transition_sfx_info.delayedTime = 0.1

	music_player:PlaySfx(transition_sfx_info)

	self.worldmap_controller:set_stage_obj_visible(true)
	coroutine.yield(self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation_start('open'))

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, size do
		self.ammi_controller_table[i]:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.5)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.9)


	-- 2스테이지로 카메라 이동
	coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration * 0.7, false))

	-- 스테이지 출력
	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, self.world_map_state.NextStageName,
			self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, self.open_stage_state.stage))

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max

	-- 캐릭터 연출
	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	local emotion_pool = self.pool_table['human_emotion']
	emotion_pool.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'cliff', true)

	coroutine.yield(self:fall_players_inner(self.world_map_state.NextStageName))

	-- 캐릭터 상태 원상 복귀
	self.spine_controller:ClearEmotion()
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)

	emotion_pool.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
end

function local_class:stage_move_routine()
	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local is_opened_next_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName)
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이번에 클리어하는 스테이지의 경우 Clear 연출을 보여준다.
	if self:get_is_prev_stage_cleared_newly() then
		coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

		user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)
		self.item.CustomStageInfo = CS.Oak.WorldmapCustomStageInfo()
	end

	local next_name = ''
	local stage_state = 1

	if not is_opened_next_stage then
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		-- 1스테이지 최초 클리어시에 별도 연출
		if self.world_map_state.PrevStageName == self.diff_begin_routine_stage_name and self:check_stage_event_routine(true) then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_first_enter_routine())

			next_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
			stage_state = self.open_stage_state.stage
		else
			-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
			self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()

			if self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
				-- 다음 스테이지가 일반 스테이지 이면 기존 루틴 그대로
				coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

				next_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
				stage_state = self.open_stage_state.stage
			else
				-- 다음이 장애물일 경우 장애물 관련 루틴 타도록
				local next_obj_name = self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_name

				coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_obj_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration))

				next_name = next_obj_name
				stage_state = self.open_stage_state.obstacle
			end

			coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, next_name,
					self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, stage_state))
		end

		-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
		-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
		user_progress:SetStageOpened(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.world_map_state.AdditionalOpenStage)
	else
		-- 다음 스테이지가 오픈이 되어있다면, 스테이지 이동만 한다.
		if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
			coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
		end

		-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
		self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()

		next_name = self.world_map_state.PrevStageName
		stage_state = self.open_stage_state.stage

		-- 장애물일 경우
		if self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
			local next_obj_name = self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_name
			local open_obstacle_btn = self.obstacle_button_table[next_obj_name]

			if not open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_open() then
				coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_obj_name, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration))

				next_name = next_obj_name
				stage_state = self.open_stage_state.obstacle

				coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_and_obstacle(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName, next_name,
						self.world_map_state.CustomEvent, stage_state))
			end
		elseif self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].next_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.prev_stage then
			coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(self.world_map_state.NextStageName, self.weak_focus_camera_size, self.camera_focus_duration, false))

			next_name = self.world_map_state.NextStageName
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지 입장 패널 SFX Play
	if stage_state ~= self.open_stage_state.none then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_stage_enter_panel_sfx_handle_name)
	end

	if stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
		coroutine.yield(self.item:SetFocus(next_name, self.focus_camera_size))
	elseif stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_obstacle(next_name, self.focus_camera_size, 0.5))
	end
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	coroutine.yield(self:clear_stage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName))

	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	-- WorldMap Scene 이 로드되기 전에 불린 Game.EndStage 에서 SendEndStage 패킷을 통해 서버 정보는 업데이트가 되어있다.
	-- 클라이언트에서는 연출이 끝난 후에 해당 정보를 동기화한다.
	user_progress:SetStageCleared(prev_stage_spec.Id)

	if self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff ~= CS.Oak.StageState.None then
		coroutine.yield(self:stage_grade_routine())
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 모션을 idle 로 돌려준다.
	self.item:SetCharacterIdleAnimation()
end

function local_class:stage_grade_routine()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local prev_stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)

	coroutine.yield(prev_stage_button:ShowGetStarGrade(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	-- 연출 처리를 위해 비워주기 전에 캐싱
	local stage_state = self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff

	-- 스테이지 등급 보상 연출이 끝나면 StageStateDiff 를 비워준다.
	self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff = CS.Oak.StageState.None

	coroutine.yield(world_map_background_utils.StageClearNotice(stage_state, prev_stage_spec.ChapterCode, CS.Oak.UI.WorldMap.Instance.SceneManager, nil))
end

function local_class:open_stage_and_obstacle(prev_stage, open_stage, custom_event, open_stage_state)
	if open_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.stage then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, false, custom_event))
	elseif open_stage_state == self.open_stage_state.obstacle then
		coroutine.yield(self:open_obstacle_routine(open_stage))
	end
end

function local_class:clear_stage(cleared_stage)
	local clear_stage_bBtn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(cleared_stage)

	if clear_stage_bBtn ~= nil then
		clear_stage_bBtn.GetControllerLuaTable:clear()
	end

	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, 'victory_get', false)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('smile', false)

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
end

function local_class:hidden_stage(stage_name)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage_name)

	stage_button.GetControllerLuaTable:hidden()
end

function local_class:open_stage(param_list)
	return util.cs_generator(self.open_stage_start, self, param_list[0], param_list[1], param_list[2], param_list[3])
end

function local_class:open_stage_start(prev_stage, open_stage, wait_open_complete , custom_event)
	if wait_open_complete == nil then
		wait_open_complete = false
	end

	if custom_event == nil then
		custom_event = false
	end

	local open_stage_btn = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(open_stage)

	if open_stage_btn ~= nil then
		if not self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(open_stage) or custom_event then
			coroutine.yield(open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_stage_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가
			local effect_name = self.main_open_stage_effect_name
			local effect = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(open_stage_btn.transform.position)

			effect.transform.localScale = self.main_open_stage_effect_scale
			effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			wait_for_sec(self.stage_effect_duration)

			effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	if wait_open_complete then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:open_obstacle_routine(obstacle_name)
	local open_obstacle_btn = self.obstacle_button_table[obstacle_name]

	if open_obstacle_btn == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].is_stage_clear then
		-- 아직 열려 있지 않으면
		if not open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_open() then
			-- 오픈 연출 진행
			coroutine.yield(open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

			open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

			-- 이펙트 출력 추가 ?
			-- effect
		end
	else
		--오픈 조건이 이전 장애물 처리 이면
		local open_obstacle_name = self.constants_data.obstacle[obstacle_name].open_name
		--조건의 장애물이 처리된 상태이면
		if self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table[open_obstacle_name] then
			if not open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:get_is_open() then
				-- 오픈 연출 진행
				coroutine.yield(open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open_animation())

				open_obstacle_btn.GetControllerLuaTable:open()

				-- 이펙트 출력 추가 ?
				-- effect
			end
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:ammi_dead_routine()
	local ammi_stage_name = ''

	-- 월드맵 클리어를 통해 나올 경우 해당 스테이지 체크
	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and self.constants_data.stage[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].ammi_enable then
		-- PrevStageName이 ammi가 dead 상태인지 체크
		if self.cur_stage_state_table[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].ammi_state == 1 then
			local key_name = self.constants_data.ammi[self.world_map_state.PrevStageName].data_key_name
			-- PrevStageName이 ammi dead 연출을 봤는지 체크
			if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil and self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name) ~= 1 then
				ammi_stage_name = self.world_map_state.PrevStageName
			end
		end
	-- 나가기를 통해 나올 경우 연출을 안 봤으면 어디 ammi 인지 확인 후 진행
	else
		for k,v in pairs(self.constants_data.ammi) do
			if self.cur_stage_state_table[k].ammi_state == 1 then
				local key_name = self.constants_data.ammi[k].data_key_name
				-- ammi dead 연출을 봤는지 체크
				if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil and self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name) ~= 1 then
					ammi_stage_name = k
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(ammi_stage_name) then
		return
	end

	local from_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(ammi_stage_name)
	local local_position = from_button.transform.localPosition

	self:set_camera_local_pos(local_position)

	local key_name = self.constants_data.ammi[ammi_stage_name].data_key_name

	if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetQuestCustomState, nil, self.data_quest_progress, key_name, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local ammi_num = self.constants_data.ammi[ammi_stage_name].num
	local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	local animation_name = 'dead'

	-- 임시 슈퍼 인베이더용 애니메이션 넣어놈
	self.ammi_controller_table[ammi_num].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	self.ammi_controller_table[ammi_num]:SetAnimation(spine_track, animation_name, false)
	self.ammi_controller_table[ammi_num].TimeScale = 0.6

	local anim_duration = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.ammi_controller_table[ammi_num],
			animation_name)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ammi_10')

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration + 0.3)
end

function local_class:ammi_show_routine()
	-- 카메라 가운데로 간 다음 각각 ammi가 텔레포트 이펙트와 함께 팡팡팡 등장
	-- 연출 봤는지 저장
	if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetQuestCustomState, nil, self.data_quest_progress, self.ammi_first_routine_key_name, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local size = table_util.get_size(self.ammi_controller_table)
	local ammi_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_pos = unity_class.vector2.zero
	local camera_pos = unity_class.vector2.zero

	for i = 1, size do
		ammi_pos = self.ammi_controller_table[i].transform.localPosition
		target_pos = vector(ammi_pos.x, ammi_pos.y)
		camera_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(target_pos)
		coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(camera_pos, nil, self.focus_camera_size, 0.04, false, true, false, nil))

		-- ammi 블랙 칼라 제거 및 텔레포트 이펙트 출력
		self.ammi_controller_table[i]:RemoveColor('ammi_black', 0.3)

		local effect = self.pool_table['FX_reset_object']:Instantiate(self.ammi_controller_table[i].transform.localPosition)
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_guild_warp_01')

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress(param_list)
	local stage_name = param_list[0]
	local target_camera_size = param_list[1]
	local duration = param_list[2]
	local check_stage_opened = param_list[3]

	return util.cs_generator(self.set_focus_progress_start, self, stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
end

function local_class:set_focus_progress_start(stage_name, target_camera_size, duration, check_stage_opened)
	if check_stage_opened then
		target_camera_size = self.focus_camera_size
	end

	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local stage_button = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)
	local local_position = stage_button.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:set_focus_obstacle(obstacle_name, target_camera_size, duration)
	-- 장애물 오픈 연출 진행
	local target_size = unity_class.mathf.Min(self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom, target_camera_size)
	local obstacle_button_holder = self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table[obstacle_name]
	local local_position = obstacle_button_holder.transform.localPosition
	local vec2 = vector(local_position.x, local_position.y)
	local target_pos = self.mobile_touch_camera:GetTargetedCameraPosition(vec2)

	coroutine.yield(self.mobile_touch_camera:ZoomRoutine(target_pos, nil, target_size, duration, false, true, false, nil))
end

function local_class:check_new_stage(chapter_code, is_force_show, is_show)
	if is_force_show then
		self:show_finger(is_show)
		return false
	end

	local target_stage = CS.Oak.QuestTargetStageData.GetTargetStage(chapter_code)
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local stage = nil

	if target_stage ~= nil then
		stage = stage_data:GetStage(target_stage)
	else
		stage = stage_data:GetStage(0)
	end

	if stage == nil then
		self:set_finger_object(false)
		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.finger_object) then
		local effect_name = self.main_new_stage_effect_name

		if stage.IsSubStage then
			effect_name = self.sub_new_stage_effect_name
		end

		self.finger_object = self.pool_table[effect_name]:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end

	local button = self.item:GetStageButtonLua(stage.Name)

	if is_unity_null(button) then
		return false
	end

	self.finger_object.transform.parent = button.transform
	self.finger_object.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if target_stage ~= nil then
		self.is_new_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(target_stage)
	else
		self.is_new_stage = user_progress:IsStageOpened(0)
	end

	self:show_finger(self.is_new_stage)
	return true
end

function local_class:show_finger(is_show)
	local local_finger_obj = self.finger_object

	if self.is_new_stage and local_finger_obj ~= nil and local_finger_obj.gameObject.activeSelf == not is_show then
		self:set_finger_object(is_show)
	end
end

function local_class:set_finger_object(is_show)
	if is_unity_null(self.finger_object) then
		return
	end

	self.finger_object.gameObject:SetActive(is_show)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character(param_list)
	self.spine_controller = param_list[0]

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_spine_character_start, self)
end

function local_class:load_spine_character_start()
	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(true)

	-- 이미 로드된 스파인 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.spine_controller) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.spine_controller.gameObject)
		self.spine_controller = nil

		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	self.spine_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local character_info = self.item.CharacterInfo
	self.item.CharacterName = character_info.AssetName.assetName

	local characterPrefab = nil

	coroutine.yield(self.spine_res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(character_info.AssetName, function(prefab)
		characterPrefab = prefab
	end))

	while self.is_world_map_loading do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local character = game_object.Instantiate(characterPrefab)
	local character_t = character.transform

	character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
	character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.character_local_scale_factor

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name
		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		end
	end

	-- 스테이지를 방금 클리어한 상태
	if self.world_map_state ~= nil and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName) and
			not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.world_map_state.NextStageName) and
			self.world_map_state.PrevStageName ~= self.world_map_state.NextStageName then
		-- 혹시 사용할지 몰라서 일단 남겨 둠
		if self:get_is_prev_stage_cleared_newly() and self.world_map_state.PrevStageName == self.diff_begin_routine_stage_name then
		else
		end

		self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		-- 해당 스테이지 장애물 체크 후 안되 있으면 이전 스테이지로 이동 해야함
		if self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open and self:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name) then
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
		else
			local last_stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
			self:set_character_default_position(character_t, last_stage_name)
		end
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
		self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
		return
	end

	self.spine_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.item:SetSpineController(self.spine_controller)

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then
		--  캐릭터 태생 스킨이 있는 경우 생성하자마자 지정
		if character_info.SkinName ~= nil then
			self.spine_controller.SkinName = character_info.SkinName
		end

		local shader_selector_type = CS.System.Enum.Parse(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachmentShaderSelector), self.character_weapon_attachment_shader_selector, true)
		local create_desc = CS.Oak.WeaponAttachmentCreateDesc(shader_selector_type)
		CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(self.spine_controller, character_info, create_desc)

		local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

		self.spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetSubIdleAnimation(self.spine_controller)
		self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, world_map_util.get_idle_animation_name(character_info), true)

		self.spine_controller:SetSortingLayer('Default', 55)
		self.spine_controller.IsShadowActive = true
		self.spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localEulerAngles = vector(45, 0, 0)

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character_t, 'SpecialEvents')

		if self.item.IsHideCharacter then
			self.spine_controller.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		-- 캐릭터가 어떠한 상황에서라도 더 위에 그려질 수 있도록 함
		if self.item.SpineTopShader ~= nil then
			self.spine_controller.CustomShader = self.item.SpineTopShader
		end
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character)
	end

	self.item:SetIsSpineLoading(false)
end

function local_class:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

	if button_placeholder ~= nil then
		character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + button_placeholder.CharacterOffset:GetXy0() + self.character_button_offset
	end
end

function local_class:load_ammi()
	-- 일반 ammi
	local ammi_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetByName(self.ammi_name)
	local champion_ammi_spec = nil

	-- 페이 메이에 따라 ammi 스펙이 다름
	if user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.ChinaHeroBoy, true) ~= nil then
		champion_ammi_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetByName(self.champion_ammi_name_fei)
	else
		champion_ammi_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetByName(self.champion_ammi_name_mei)
	end

	local ammi_prefab = nil
	local champion_ammi_prefab = nil

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(ammi_spec.SpineAssetName, function(prefab)
				ammi_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(champion_ammi_spec.SpineAssetName, function(prefab)
				champion_ammi_prefab = prefab
			end))
		end)
	})

	local ammi_size = 3
	local champion_ammi_event = false
	local ammi_first_event = false

	if self.main_quest_progress ~= nil then
		-- 챔피언 ammi 메인 섹션 이후에 출력
		if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.champion_ammi_event_progress then
			champion_ammi_event = true
		end

		-- ammi를 첫 조우한 이벤트 섹션 이후에 출력
		if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete or self.main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.ammi_first_event_progress then
			ammi_first_event = true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, ammi_size do
		local character = nil

		-- 프로그레스 21 이후면 챔피언 ammi로 세팅
		if i == 3 and champion_ammi_event then
			character = game_object.Instantiate(champion_ammi_prefab)
		else
			character = game_object.Instantiate(ammi_prefab)
		end

		local character_t = character.transform

		character_t:SetParent(self.item.transform, false)
		character_t.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.ammi_local_scale_factor
		character_t.localPosition = vector(100,100,0)

		local stage_name = ''
		local animation_name = 'idle'

		-- 첫 1스테이지 클리어 연출 이후 스테이지에 배치
		if not self:check_stage_event_routine() then
			local button_placeholder = nil

			if self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_3'].num == i then
				stage_name = 'queenship_1_3'
				button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.constants_data.ammi[stage_name].button_name)
			elseif 	self.constants_data.ammi['queenship_1_4'].num == i then
				stage_name = 'queenship_1_4'
				button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.constants_data.ammi[stage_name].button_name)
			else
				stage_name = 'queenship_1_6'
				button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.constants_data.ammi[stage_name].button_name)
			end

			character_t.localPosition = button_placeholder.transform.localPosition + self.ammi_button_offset

			-- 죽는 연출을 봤는지 체크 후 봤으면 이후 부터는 기본 세팅을 죽는 애니메이션으로
			local key_name = self.constants_data.ammi[stage_name].data_key_name

			if self.data_quest_progress ~= nil and self.data_quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name) == 1 then
				-- 죽어 있는 idle 애니메이션
				animation_name = 'dead2'
			end
		end

		local ammi_controller = character:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
		self.ammi_controller_table[i] = ammi_controller

		if i == 3 and champion_ammi_event then
			if champion_ammi_spec.SpineSkinName ~= nil then
				self.ammi_controller_table[i].SkinName = champion_ammi_spec.SpineSkinName
			end
		else
			if ammi_spec.SpineSkinName ~= nil then
				self.ammi_controller_table[i].SkinName = ammi_spec.SpineSkinName
			end
		end

		local spine_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

		ammi_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		ammi_controller:SetAnimation(spine_track, animation_name, true)
		ammi_controller:SetSortingLayer('Default', 50)

		if not ammi_first_event then
			ammi_controller:AddColor('ammi_black', unity_class.color.black, 0.9, 0)
		end

		if self.item.SpineTopShader ~= nil then
			ammi_controller.CustomShader = self.item.SpineTopShader
		end

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character_t, 'SpecialEvents')
	end
end

function local_class:get_is_prev_stage_cleared_newly()
	local prev_stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(self.world_map_state.PrevStageName)
	local get_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(user_progress:GetStageState(prev_stage_spec.Id))
	local stage_state_diff = ~(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.world_map_state.StageStateDiff))

	local stage_state = get_stage_state & stage_state_diff
	local cleared_state = stage_state & CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Cleared)

	local is_cleared_prev_stage = cleared_state ~= 0
	local is_prev_stage_cleared_newly = (self.world_map_state.IsStageCleared and not is_cleared_prev_stage)

	return is_prev_stage_cleared_newly
end

function local_class:get_last_open_stage_name()
	local stage_name = ''
	local is_break = false

	for i = self.first_stage_id, self.last_main_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local spec_name = stage_spec.Name

		if self.cur_stage_state_table[spec_name].open then
			stage_name = spec_name
		else
			is_break = true
		end

		if is_break then
			break
		end
	end

	return stage_name
end

	local stage_name = nil

	if self.item.TargetStageName ~= nil and self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		stage_name = self.item.TargetStageName
	end

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self.prev_stage_name
		if stage_name == nil or not self.stage_button_placeholder_dic:ContainsKey(stage_name) then
			stage_name = self.item:GetLastOpenStageName()
		end
	end

	if self.cur_stage_state_table[stage_name].open and self:check_obstacle_stage_name(stage_name) then
		--self:set_character_default_position(character_t, stage_name)
	else
		stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
	end

	return stage_name
end

function local_class:get_previous_stage_button_position()
	local stage_name = self.prev_stage_name

	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
	end

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage_name) then
		local button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

		if button_placeholder ~= nil then
			return button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
		end

		-- 한번 더 시도
		stage_name = self:get_last_open_stage_name()
		button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(stage_name)

		if button_placeholder ~= nil then
			return button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
		end
	end

	if self.spine_controller ~= nil then
		return self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition
	end

	return unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:check_stage_event_routine(clear_flag)
	if clear_flag == nil then
		clear_flag = false
	end

	if not clear_flag then
		-- 1스테이지 클리어 상태면 연출 false
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageCleared(self.diff_begin_routine_stage_name) then
			return false
		end
	end

	for i = self.first_stage_id + 1, self.last_stage_id do
		local stage_spec = self.stage_data:GetStage(i)
		local stage_name = stage_spec.Name

		-- 1 이후 한 스테이지가 하나라도 open 이면 false
		if self.item.CustomStageInfo:IsStageOpened(stage_name) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--1스테이지 클리어 후 2스테이지 오픈 연출시 화면 밖에서 2스테이지로 떨어지는 듯한 연출 진행
function local_class:fall_players_inner(stage_name)
	self:set_character_default_position(self.spine_controller.transform, stage_name)

	-- 버튼 바로 위에 있는 캐릭터 위치
	local center = self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition

	local bounce_cb = function(bounce)
		-- 첫 착지 일때 처리
		if bounce == 1 then
			--Shake(0.015f, 0.1f)
			local effect = self.pool_table['FX_Common_Jump_small']:Instantiate(self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
			effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-90, 0, 0))
			effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	end

	local y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 3, 7, 2, bounce_cb)

	y_calculator:ScaleTime(3)
	y_calculator:SetElasticity(0.35)

	local time_passed = 0
	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local old_time_passed = time_passed

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local all_done = true
		if y_calculator:IsDone() or time_passed < 0 then
			-- continue 대신으로 비워 둠
		else
			if old_time_passed >= 0 then
				y_calculator:Proceed(dt)
			else
				y_calculator:Proceed(time_passed)
			end

			if y_calculator:IsDone() then
				self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = center
			else
				all_done = false
				local change_pos = center + vector(0, y_calculator:GetDistance(), 0)
				self.spine_controller.transform.localPosition = change_pos
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if all_done then
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre(param_list)
	local scene_obj = param_list[0]
	local narrations = param_list[1]
	local field_ui_narration_box = param_list[2]
	local open_stage = param_list[3]
	local bgm_state = param_list[4]
	local prev_bgm_name = param_list[5]

	return util.cs_generator(self.new_stage_theatre_start, self, scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
end

function local_class:new_stage_theatre_start(scene_obj, narrations, field_ui_narration_box, open_stage, bgm_state, prev_bgm_name)
	local shear_field_obj = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetFieldObject('shear')
	local previous_shear = 0

	if shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		previous_shear = shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear
		shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0
	end

	local cur_button_placeholder = nil

	if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(self.item.TargetStageName) then
		cur_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(self.item.TargetStageName)
	end

	local open_button_placeholder = self.item:GetStageButtonPlaceholder(open_stage)

	self:hidden_stage(open_stage)

	if self:check_stage_event_routine() and self.worldmap_controller ~= nil then
		self.worldmap_controller:appear_animation('idle')
		self.worldmap_controller:set_stage_obj_visible(true)
	end

	if self.etc_ui ~= nil then
		self.etc_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 월드맵 카메라로 변경
	self.mobile_touch_camera.Block = true

	local init_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_camera_position = unity_class.vector3.zero

	target_camera_position = open_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		init_camera_position = cur_button_placeholder.transform.localPosition
	else
		--카메라의 초기위치를 세팅한다.
		init_camera_position = target_camera_position
	end

	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = vector(init_camera_position.x, init_camera_position.y)

	scene_obj:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 세팅이 끝나면 Fade In 해준다.
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeInAsync(0.75, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	if cur_button_placeholder ~= nil then
		local duration = 1.5
		coroutine.yield(self:set_focus_progress_start(open_stage, self.focus_camera_size, duration, false))
	end

	local shake_duration = CS.System.Convert.ToSingle(1)
	local shake_magnitude = 0.06

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_magnitude, shake_duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_earthquake_01')

	while shake_calculator.IsActive do
		shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local new_pos = target_camera_position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset:GetXy():GetXy0()
		self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = vector(new_pos.x, new_pos.y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.ModifiedCameraPosition = vector(target_camera_position.x, target_camera_position.y)

	coroutine.yield(self:open_stage_start(self.item.TargetStageName, open_stage, true, true))

	--서버 패킷 처리 및 연출이 종료된 후 UserProgress 를 업데이트 한다.
	user_progress:SetStageOpened(open_stage)

	if field_ui_narration_box ~= nil then
		local field_ui_narration_box_transform = field_ui_narration_box.transform
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.position = vector(0,0,10)
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
		field_ui_narration_box_transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		coroutine.yield(field_ui_narration_box:ContinuityShowHide(narrations, 0, 2))
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	else
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:FadeOutAsync(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(prev_bgm_name, bgm_state)

	if shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = self.previous_shear
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.pool_table = nil
	self.finger_object_table = nil
	self.cur_stage_state_table = nil
	self.cur_stage_obstacle_state_table = nil
	self.obstacle_button_placeholder_table = nil
	self.obstacle_button_table = nil
	self.data_quest_progress = nil

	self.bg_obj = nil
	self.worldmap_controller = nil

	self.obstacle_state = nil
	self.open_stage_state = nil
	self.clear_obstacle_state = nil

	self.constants_data = nil

	if self.spine_res_holder ~= nil then
		self.spine_res_holder:Dispose()
		self.spine_res_holder = nil
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.etc_prefab)
	self.etc_prefab = nil
	self.etc_ui = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:set_obstacle(cur_bomb_num, total_bomb_num, cur_core_num, total_core_num)
	-- 폭탄,코어 둘다 존재 하지 않으면 끄고 넘김
	if total_bomb_num == 0 and total_core_num == 0 then
		self.obstacle_trans.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		return
	else
		self.obstacle_trans.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.obstacle_bomb.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.obstacle_core.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.obstacle_check.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.obstacle_small_check.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local clear_bomb = true
	local clear_core = true

	local flag_big = false
	local flag_small = false

	self.obstacle_bomb.localPosition = self.first_resource_ui_pos
	self.obstacle_core.localPosition = self.second_resource_ui_pos

	-- 폭탄, 코어 둘다 존재
	if total_bomb_num > 0 and total_core_num > 0 then
		flag_big = true
		flag_small = false

		self.obstacle_bomb.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.obstacle_bomb_label.text = cur_bomb_num..' / '..total_bomb_num
		clear_bomb = cur_bomb_num == total_bomb_num

		self.obstacle_core.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.obstacle_core_label.text = cur_core_num..' / '..total_core_num
		clear_core = cur_core_num == total_core_num
	elseif total_bomb_num > 0 then
		-- 폭탄만 존재
		flag_big = false
		flag_small = true

		self.obstacle_bomb.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.obstacle_bomb_label.text = cur_bomb_num..' / '..total_bomb_num
		clear_bomb = cur_bomb_num == total_bomb_num
	elseif total_core_num > 0 then
		-- 코어만 존재
		flag_big = false
		flag_small = true

		self.obstacle_core.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.obstacle_core_label.text = cur_core_num..' / '..total_core_num
		clear_core = cur_core_num == total_core_num

		-- 코어만 있는 경우 해당 스프라이트 위치 조정
		self.obstacle_core.localPosition = self.first_resource_ui_pos
	end

	if clear_bomb and clear_core then
		if flag_big then
			self.obstacle_check.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.obstacle_small_check.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		else
			self.obstacle_check.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.obstacle_small_check.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
	end

	self.obstacle_background_big.gameObject:SetActive(flag_big)
	self.obstacle_background_small.gameObject:SetActive(flag_small)
end

function local_class:set_button(button_placeholder)
	-- 설정해준 스케일에 맞게 콜라이더 사이즈 세팅
	local scaleVec2 = vector(button_placeholder.PostitScale.x * button_placeholder.Main2PostitDefaultSize.x,
			button_placeholder.PostitScale.y * button_placeholder.Main2PostitDefaultSize.y)
	local currentScale = self.item.buttonParent.localScale

	if not float_util.is_almost_zero(currentScale.x) and not float_util.is_almost_zero(currentScale.y) then
		local boxSizeX = scaleVec2.x / currentScale.x
		local boxSizeY = scaleVec2.y / currentScale.y
		self.item.BoxCollider.size = vector(boxSizeX, boxSizeY, 0)
	end

	local postit_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.transform, 'postit')
	local drawing_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.transform, 'drawing')

	self.postit_sprite = postit_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimatedSprite))
	self.postit_Animator = postit_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
	self.drawing_sprite = drawing_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	postit_obj.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.glow_rotation)

	if self.stage_obj ~= nil then
		local stage_obj_transform = self.stage_obj.transform
		local child_count = stage_obj_transform.childCount
		local animator = self.stage_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		if not is_unity_null(animator) then
			self.item.StageAnimator = animator
		end

		self.stage_obj_local_position = stage_obj_transform.localPosition

		for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
			local obj = stage_obj_transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
			local obj_name = obj.name

			if string.find(obj_name, 'landmark') then
				if string.find(obj_name, '_on') then
					self.land_mark_on = obj
				elseif string.find(obj_name, '_off') then
					self.land_mark_off = obj
				end

				self.is_land_mark = true
			end
		end
	end

	if string.find(self.item.StageName, 'passage') then
		self.is_passage = true
	end

	if string.find(self.item.StageName, 'substage') then
		self.is_sub_stage = true
	end

	self.item.Enabled = true

	local cubeOffset = button_placeholder.LevelOffset
	local cube_pos = self.item.numberCubeAnimator.transform.localPosition
	cube_pos = cube_pos + cubeOffset:GetXy0()
	self.item.numberCubeAnimator.transform.localPosition = cube_pos

	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self:set_active_land_mark(false)

	if self.item.StageSpec == nil then
		self.stage_obj:SetActive(false)
		self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		return
	end

	if self.item.StageSpec.IsMainStageType then
		self.item.stageNumber.text = ''..self.item.StageSpec.StageNumber
	else
		self.item.numberCubeAnimator.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.stage_num = self.item.StageSpec.StageNumber

	-- 별 or 커피 출력
	if self.item.StageSpec.StarPieces > 0 then
		self.item.costIcon.SpriteName = 'starpiece.png'
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..self.item.StageSpec.StarPieces
	else
		self.item.costIcon.SpriteName = 'coffee.png'
		self.item.costLabel.text = '-'..self.item.StageSpec.StageStamina
	end

	self.item.numberCubeAnimator:SaveOriginalStatData()
	self.item.cubeAnimator:SaveOriginalStatData()

	local stageState = user_progress:GetStageState(self.item.StageSpec.Id)
	self:set_stage_state(stageState)
end

function local_class:set_stage_state(stage_state)
	local unlocked = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.StageState.Unlocked)
	local int_stage_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(stage_state)
	local current_state = int_stage_state & unlocked
	local current_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(current_state)

	local grade_length = self.item.starList.Length

	if current_state_int ~= 0 then
		self.item.stars:SetActive(true)
		self.item.costInfo:SetActive(false)

		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			local star_grade_state = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(self.item.StarGradeStates[i])
			local grade_state = int_stage_state & star_grade_state
			local grade_state_int = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(grade_state)

			if grade_state_int ~= 0 then
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(true)
			else
				self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	else
		self.item.stars:SetActive(false)
		self.item.costInfo:SetActive(true)

		-- 서브스테이지는 starList 가 설정이 안 되어있다.
		if self.item.starList == nil or self.item.starList.Length == 0 then
			return
		end

		for i = 0, grade_length - 1 do
			self.item.starList[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:open(immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.open

	self:set_active_land_mark(true)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(self.is_passage)
	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(self.is_sub_stage)

	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(self.is_land_mark)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = true

	if self.land_mark_on ~= nil then
		self:set_land_mark_sorting_order(self.land_mark_on)
	end

	local idle_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.idle_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)

	if immediate then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, idle_animation_routine)
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, idle_animation_routine)

		if not is_unity_null(self.item.numberCubeAnimator) then
			self.item.numberCubeAnimator.enabled = true
		end

		local disable_open_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.disable_open_animator, self, 1)):Catch(function (e)	end)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, disable_open_routine)
	end
end

function local_class:clear(immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.clear

	if immediate then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.change_cube, self, 0, true))
	else
		-- 월드맵 클리어 SFX Play
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.stage_clear_flag_sfx_handle_name)

		if not is_unity_null(self.item.cubeAnimator) then
			self.item.cubeAnimator:Play("clear")
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.change_cube, self, 0.25, false))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.disable_clear_fx, self, 1.3))
	end
end

function local_class:idle_animation()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	while not self.stage_obj.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_open_animation and self.add_open_animation_time < 0 then
		local wait_time = self.add_open_animation_time * -1
		wait_for_sec(wait_time)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		local animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_idle'
		self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_sfx_handle_name)

	if is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		return
	end

	self.is_open_animation = true

	local animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_open'
	local time = self.item:GetAnimationTime(animation_name) + self.add_open_animation_time

	self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)

	wait_for_sec(time)
end

function local_class:change_cube(delay, immediate)
	if delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.cubeRenderer) then
		self.item.cubeRenderer.enabled = false
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.stageNumber) then
		self.item.stageNumber.color = unity_color({0.58, 0.24, 0.16})
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.clearCube) then
		self.item.clearCube:SetActive(true)

		if not immediate and self.item.clearCubeFx ~= nil then
			self.item.clearCubeFx:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:disable_clear_fx(delay)
	if delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.clearCubeFx) then
		self.item.clearCubeFx:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:hidden()
	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.hidden

	self:set_active_land_mark(false)
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.glowSprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.postit_sprite.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = false

	local hidden_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.hidden_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, hidden_animation_routine)
end

function local_class:hidden_animation()
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	self.hidden_req_id = self.hidden_req_id + 1

	local current_req_id = self.hidden_req_id

	while not self.stage_obj.activeInHierarchy do
		if current_req_id ~= self.hidden_req_id then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_button_state ~= self.button_state.hidden then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		local animation_name = self.stage_obj.name..'_off'
		self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:disable_open_animator(delay)
	if delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.numberCubeAnimator) then
		self.item.numberCubeAnimator.enabled = false
	end
end

function local_class:set_land_mark_sorting_order(landmark_obj)
	local meshRenderer = landmark_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

	if meshRenderer ~= nil then
		meshRenderer.sortingLayerName = self.item.glowSprite.SortingLayer
		meshRenderer.sortingOrder = self.item.glowSprite.SortingOrder + 1
	end
end

function local_class:set_active_land_mark(is_active)
	if is_active then
		if self.land_mark_on ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_on:SetActive(true)
		end

		if self.land_mark_off ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_off:SetActive(false)
		end
	else
		if self.land_mark_on ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_on:SetActive(false)
		end

		if self.land_mark_off ~= nil then
			self.land_mark_off:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_press_up()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.focus_animation, self))
end

function local_class:focus_animation()
	self.stage_obj.transform.localPosition = self.stage_obj_local_position + self.press_force
	self.item.transform.localPosition = self.press_force

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 버튼 클릭 SFX Play
	self.item.buttonClickSfx:Play()
	self:reset_stage_obj_local_position()
	self.item.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:reset_stage_obj_local_position()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	self.stage_obj.transform.localPosition = self.stage_obj_local_position
end

function local_class:set_active(is_active)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
end

function local_class:set_stage_obj(obj)
	self.stage_obj = obj
end

function local_class:get_stage_num()
	return self.stage_num
end

function local_class:get_is_obstacle()
	return false
end

function local_class:get_is_passage()
	return self.is_passage
end

function local_class:get_is_sub_stage()
	return self.is_sub_stage
end

function local_class:resume()
	if self.current_button_state ~= self.button_state.hidden then
		return
	end

	local hidden_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.hidden_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, hidden_animation_routine)
end

function local_class:finish()

end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

	create = function()
		return local_class()
