		self.item.BoxCollider.size = vector(boxSizeX, boxSizeY, 0)
	end

	if button_placeholder.postitType == CS.WorldmapButtonPlaceholder.StyleType.Etc then
		self.is_obstacle = true
	end

	if self.stage_obj ~= nil then
		local stage_obj_transform = self.stage_obj.transform
		local animator = self.stage_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		self.stage_obj_local_position = stage_obj_transform.localPosition

		if not is_unity_null(animator) then
			self.item.StageAnimator = animator
		end
	end

	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.is_bomb = false
	self.is_core = false

	if string.find(button_placeholder.name, 'ruin') then
		self.is_bomb = true
		self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.SpriteName = self.bomb_name
	elseif string.find(button_placeholder.name, 'ev') then
		self.is_core = true
		self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.SpriteName = self.core_name
	end
end

function local_class:open(immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.open

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local length = self.custom_sprites.Length
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.custom_sprites[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.custom_sprites[i].TintColor = self.custom_sprite_table[i].color
		self.custom_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
	end

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = true

	local open_idle_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.common_idle_animation, self, '_open_idle')):Catch(function (e)	end)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, open_idle_animation_routine)
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local animation_name = ''

	if self.is_bomb then
		animation_name = self.ruin_name..'_open'
	elseif self.is_core then
		animation_name = self.ev_name..'_open'
	end

	local time = self.item:GetAnimationTime(animation_name) + self.add_open_animation_time

	self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)

	-- 시간에 맞춰 아이콘 표시
	-- 대충 알파 애니메이션
	local length = self.custom_sprites.Length
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.custom_sprites[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.open_etc_sfx_handle_name)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.alpha_animation, self, 0.5, 0, 1))

	wait_for_sec(time)
end

function local_class:alpha_animation(duration, start_alpha, target_alpha)
	local time = 0
	local progress = 0
	local origin_alpha = start_alpha
	local cur_val = 0

	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.TintColor = unity_color({ start_alpha, start_alpha, start_alpha, start_alpha })

	local length = self.custom_sprites.Length
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if self.custom_sprite_table[i].name ~= 'landmark' then
			if start_alpha == 0 then
				self.custom_sprites[i].Alpha = start_alpha
			end
		end
	end

	while time < duration do
		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time, 0, 1, duration)
		cur_val = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(origin_alpha, target_alpha, progress)

		self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.TintColor = unity_color({ cur_val, cur_val, cur_val, cur_val })
		self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon:Rebuild()

		for i = 0, length - 1 do
			if self.custom_sprite_table[i].name ~= 'landmark' then
				if target_alpha == 0 then
					cur_val = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.custom_sprite_table[i].alpha, 0, progress)
				else
					cur_val = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, self.custom_sprite_table[i].alpha, progress)
				end

				self.custom_sprites[i].Alpha = cur_val
				self.custom_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon.TintColor = unity_color({ target_alpha, target_alpha, target_alpha, target_alpha })
	self.item.landMarkSubStageIcon:Rebuild()

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if self.custom_sprite_table[i].name ~= 'landmark' then
			if target_alpha == 0 then
				self.custom_sprites[i].Alpha = 0
			else
				self.custom_sprites[i].Alpha = self.custom_sprite_table[i].alpha
			end

			self.custom_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear(immediate)
	if immediate == nil then
		immediate = false
	end

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.clear

	local length = self.custom_sprites.Length
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.custom_sprites[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = false

	local clear_idle_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.common_idle_animation, self, '_clear_idle')):Catch(function (e)	end)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, clear_idle_animation_routine)
end

function local_class:clear_animation()
	local animation_name = ''

	if self.is_bomb then
		animation_name = self.ruin_name..'_clear'
	elseif self.is_core then
		animation_name = self.ev_name..'_clear'
	end

	local time = self.item:GetAnimationTime(animation_name)
	self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.alpha_animation, self, 0.25, 1, 0))

	wait_for_sec(time)
end

function local_class:hidden()
	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.hidden

	-- 기본 둘다 완전 보이지 않도록 어둡게 처리
	local length = self.custom_sprites.Length
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.custom_sprites[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.item.BoxCollider.enabled = false

	local hidden_animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.hidden_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, hidden_animation_routine)
end

function local_class:hidden_animation()
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	self.hidden_req_id = self.hidden_req_id + 1

	local current_req_id = self.hidden_req_id

	while not self.stage_obj.activeInHierarchy do
		if current_req_id ~= self.hidden_req_id then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_button_state ~= self.button_state.hidden then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		local animation_name = ''

		if self.is_bomb then
			animation_name = self.ruin_name..'_off'
		elseif self.is_core then
			animation_name = self.ev_name..'_off'
		end

		self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:common_idle_animation(key_name)
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	self.common_req_id = self.common_req_id + 1

	local current_req_id = self.common_req_id

	while not self.stage_obj.activeInHierarchy do
		if current_req_id ~= self.common_req_id then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.item.StageAnimator) then
		local animation_name = ''

		if self.is_bomb then
			animation_name = self.ruin_name..key_name
		elseif self.is_core then
			animation_name = self.ev_name..key_name
		end

		self.item.StageAnimator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:on_press_up()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.focus_animation, self))
end

function local_class:focus_animation()
	self.stage_obj.transform.localPosition = self.stage_obj_local_position + self.press_force
	self.item.transform.localPosition = self.press_force

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 버튼 클릭 SFX Play
	self.item.buttonClickSfx:Play()
	self:reset_stage_obj_local_position()
	self.item.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:reset_stage_obj_local_position()
	if is_unity_null(self.stage_obj) then
		return
	end

	self.stage_obj.transform.localPosition = self.stage_obj_local_position
end

function local_class:set_active(is_active)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
end

function local_class:set_stage_obj(obj)
	self.stage_obj = obj
end

function local_class:get_is_obstacle()
	return self.is_obstacle
end

function local_class:get_is_bomb()
	return self.is_bomb
end

function local_class:set_obstacle_name(obstacle_name)
	self.obstacle_name = obstacle_name
end

function local_class:get_obstacle_name()
	return self.obstacle_name
end

function local_class:get_is_open()
	if self.current_button_state ~= self.button_state.hidden then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:resume()
	local animation_routine = nil

	if self.current_button_state == self.button_state.hidden then
		animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.hidden_animation, self)):Catch(function (e)	end)
	elseif self.current_button_state == self.button_state.open then
		animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.common_idle_animation, self, '_open_idle')):Catch(function (e)	end)
	elseif self.current_button_state == self.button_state.clear then
		animation_routine = CS.Foundations.Coroutine(util.cs_generator(self.common_idle_animation, self, '_clear_idle')):Catch(function (e)	end)
	end

	if animation_routine == nil then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, animation_routine)
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.button_state = nil
	self.custom_sprite_table = nil
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipWorldMapController')

function local_class:init()
	self.ev_animator_array = nil
	self.ruin_animator_array = nil
	self.mobile_touch_camera = nil
	self.touch_input = nil
	self.shear_field_obj = nil
	self.animator = nil

	self.previous_shear = 0

	self.ev_on_name = 'EV'
	self.ev_off_name = 'off'

	self.ruin_on_name = 'ruin'
	self.ruin_off_name = 'off'

	self.camera_zoom_min = 10
	self.camera_zoom_max = 16

	self.animation_time_ratio = 0.9

	self.animation_state = {
		on = 1,
		off = 2
	}

	self.current_animation_state = self.animation_state.off

	self.nm_stage_table = {}

	self.maker_position_table = {
		queenship_1_2 = vector(-8, 2.6, 0),

		nightmare_queenship_2 = vector(4.7, 2.6, 0),
		nightmare_queenship_4 = vector(-1.15, 2.6, 0),

end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.ev_animator_array = self.item.evParentObj:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.ruin_animator_array = self.item.ruinParentObj:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	self.mobile_touch_camera = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	self.touch_input = self.item.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.BitBenderGames.TouchInputController))

	self.animator = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.item.transform, 'chapter_15'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	self.item.makerTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.appearanceObj:SetActive(false)

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance == nil then
		return
	end

	local chapter_code = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Spec.ChapterCode

	if chapter_code.Difficulty ~= CS.Tilemaps.Difficulty.Normal then
		local length = self.item.stageObjs.Length

		for i = 0, length - 1 do
			self.nm_stage_table[self.item.stageObjs[i].name] = i
		end
	end
end

function local_class:init_controller()
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local field = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field

	self.shear_field_obj = field:GetFieldObject('shear')

	if self.shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		self.previous_shear = self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear
		self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0
	end

	self.item.evParentObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.ruinParentObj:SetActive(false)

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMin = self.camera_zoom_min
	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoomMax = self.camera_zoom_max

	self.mobile_touch_camera.CamZoom = self.camera_zoom_max

	self.mobile_touch_camera.enabled = false
	self.touch_input.enabled = false

	if self.item.stageObjs == nil then
		return
	end

	local length = self.item.stageObjs.Length

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(false)
	end

function local_class:end_controller()

		self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = self.previous_shear
	end

end

function local_class:ev_on()

end

function local_class:ev_off()

end

function local_class:ev_animation(state)

		return
	end

	if state == self.animation_state.off then
		self.item.evParentObj:SetActive(false)
		return
	end

	self.item.evParentObj:SetActive(true)

	while not self.item.evParentObj.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local length = self.ev_animator_array.Length
	local animation_name = ''

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if state == self.animation_state.on then
			animation_name = self.ev_on_name
		else
			animation_name = self.ev_off_name
		end

		self.ev_animator_array[i]:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)

end

function local_class:ruin_off()

end

		return
	end

	if state == self.animation_state.off then
		self.item.ruinParentObj:SetActive(false)
		return
	end

	self.item.ruinParentObj:SetActive(true)

	while not self.item.ruinParentObj.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local length = self.ruin_animator_array.Length
	local animation_name = ''

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if state == self.animation_state.on then
			animation_name = self.ruin_on_name

end

function local_class:stage_marker_start(stage_name)
	local length = self.item.stageObjs.Length
	local cur_maker_num = -1
	local animator = nil

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		animator = self.item.stageObjs[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(false)

		if not is_unity_null(animator) then
			if self.item.stageObjs[i].name == stage_name then
				self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(true)
				cur_maker_num = i
			end
		end
	end

	if cur_maker_num ~= -1 then
		while not self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num].activeInHierarchy do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		animator = self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		local animation_name = self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num].name..'_maker'
		animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end

	self.item.makerTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local maker_table = self.maker_position_table

	local chapter_code = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Spec.ChapterCode

	if chapter_code.Difficulty ~= CS.Tilemaps.Difficulty.Normal then
		self.item.makerTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		return
	end

	if maker_table[stage_name] ~= nil then
		self.item.makerTransform.localPosition = maker_table[stage_name]
	else
		self.item.makerTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end
end

function local_class:nm_stage_marker(stage_name_table)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.nm_stage_marker_start, self, stage_name_table))
end

function local_class:nm_stage_marker_start(stage_name_table)
	local length = self.item.stageObjs.Length
	local cur_maker_num = -1
	local animator = nil

	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		animator = self.item.stageObjs[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(false)
	end

	for i = 1, #stage_name_table do
		cur_maker_num = self.nm_stage_table[stage_name_table[i]]

		self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num]:SetActive(true)

		while not self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num].activeInHierarchy do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		animator = self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		local animation_name = self.item.stageObjs[cur_maker_num].name..'_maker'
		animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:set_stage_obj_visible(active)
	local length = self.item.stageObjs.Length

	-- 1번 스테이지는 함선이 아니 라서 제외
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		if i ~= 0 then
			self.item.stageObjs[i]:SetActive(active)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:appear_animation(name)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.appear_animation_start, self, name))
end

function local_class:appear_animation_start(name)
	self.item.appearanceObj:SetActive(true)

	if name == 'idle' or name == 'open' then
		self.current_animation_state = self.animation_state.on
	else
		self.current_animation_state = self.animation_state.off
	end

	while not self.item.appearanceObj.activeInHierarchy do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local key_name = 'queenship_appearance'

	if not is_unity_null(self.animator) then
		local animation_name = key_name..'_'..name
		self.animator:Play(animation_name, -1, 0)
	end

	if name == 'open' then
		local time = self:get_animation_time(name) * self.animation_time_ratio
		wait_for_sec(time)
	end
end

function local_class:get_animation_time(name)
	if is_unity_null(self.animator) then
		return 0
	end

	local time = 0
	local ac = self.animator.runtimeAnimatorController
	local key_name = 'queenship_appearance'..'_'..name

	for i = 0, ac.animationClips.Length - 1 do
		if ac.animationClips[i].name == key_name then
			time = ac.animationClips[i].length
			break
		end
	end

	return time
end

function local_class:shake(duration, magnitude)
	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	shake_calculator:Shake(magnitude, duration)

	local target_camera_position = self.mobile_touch_camera.transform.localPosition

	while shake_calculator.IsActive do
		shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local new_pos = target_camera_position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		self.mobile_touch_camera.transform.localPosition = new_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--쉐이크
	self.mobile_touch_camera.transform.localPosition = target_camera_position
end

function local_class:resume()
	local ani_name = 'off'

	if self.current_animation_state == self.animation_state.on then
		ani_name = 'idle'
	end

	self:appear_animation(ani_name)
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.ev_animator_array = nil
	self.ruin_animator_array = nil
	self.mobile_touch_camera = nil
	self.touch_input = nil
	self.shear_field_obj = nil

	self.animation_state = nil
	self.nm_stage_table = nil

	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	i.buildingEffectLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_'..self.currentBuilding.BuildType..'_effect_lv'..currentLevel)
	i.buildingDescLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_'..self.currentBuilding.BuildType..'_desc_lv'..currentLevel)

	-- 영빈관 최대 레벨인지 확인 필요
	local isMaxLevel = self.currentBuilding.UpgradeId == -1

	i.upgradeButton.gameObject:SetActive(not isMaxLevel)
	i.disableUpgradeButton.gameObject:SetActive(isMaxLevel)

	i.buttonGrid:Reposition()

	-- 팝업 열자마자 도움말 팝업을 띄워야 할 경우
	if self.states.ShowHelpPopup then
		self:on_help_show()
	elseif not CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.HasKey('ShortStorySlimeGuardHelpViewed') then
		CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.SetInt('ShortStorySlimeGuardHelpViewed', 1)
		CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.Save()
		self:on_help_show()
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.states = nil
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	self.message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'game_pad_handler')
	return
end

function local_class:close_animation()
	self.message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	return
end

function local_class:on_click_back_button()
	self:on_exit_click()
end

function local_class:on_exit_click()
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
end

-- 도움말 버튼 클릭
function local_class:on_help_show()
	local i = self.item

	if i.helpButton ~= nil then
		i.helpButton:OnClickHelpButton()
	end
end

-- 관리자 관리 버튼 클릭
function local_class:on_manage_click()
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.SlimeHallStaffPopup.Instance, nil,
			typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SlimeHallStaffPopup))
end

-- 업그레이드 버튼 클릭
function local_class:on_upgrade_click()
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction
	local state = CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeBuildPopupState()
	local currentLevel = self.currentBuilding.Level
	local nextBuildingData = village_construction:get_next_guest_house_spec(currentLevel)

	if nextBuildingData == nil then
		CS.Debug.LogError('next building data is null')
		return
	end

	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')
	local nextBuildingName = nextBuildingData.name
	local nextBuildingMaxNum = 1
	local cost_list = CS.System.Collections.Generic.List(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeCraftCost))
	local cost_item_list = cost_list()

	for _, data in ipairs(nextBuildingData.resource_cost) do
		if data.value > 0 then
			local item_spec = item_data:GetSpec(data.id)
			local cost_data = CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeCraftCost.MakeData(item_spec, data.value)
			cost_item_list:Add(cost_data)
		end
	end

	-- nextBuildingData에 id가 없음
	local nextBuildingId = self.currentBuilding.UpgradeId
	local nextBuildingSpriteName = nextBuildingData.sprite_name

	local nextBuildingSpec = CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeBuildingSpec.MakeData(nextBuildingId, nextBuildingName,
			nextBuildingSpriteName, nextBuildingMaxNum, cost_item_list, nextBuildingData.guest_house_level,
			nextBuildingData.sprite_scale, nextBuildingData.level, nextBuildingData.happiness, nextBuildingData.build_type,
			nextBuildingData.upgrade_id, nextBuildingData.happiness_required
	)

	state.CurrentBuilding = self.currentBuilding
	state.NextBuilding = nextBuildingSpec
	state.OnConfirm = function()
		self:on_upgrade_callback()
	end

	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeBuildPopup.Instance, state,
			typeof(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeBuildPopup))
end

-- 업그레이드 팝업에서 확인 후 동작 플로우
function local_class:on_upgrade_callback()
	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.upgrade_routine, self))
end

function local_class:upgrade_routine()
	while CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance.CurrentOverlay ~= nil
			and CS.System.Object.ReferenceEquals(CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance.CurrentOverlay,
			CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeBuildPopup.Instance) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.states.OnUpgrade();
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
end

-- 비활성화 된 업그레이드 버튼 클릭 (동작이 있을 때 작업)
function local_class:on_disable_upgrade_click()

end

function local_class:game_pad_handler(e)
	-- 도움말 팝업이 위에 떠 있는 경우 닫아 준다
	if CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance.CurrentOverlay ~= nil
			and CS.System.Object.ReferenceEquals(CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance.CurrentOverlay,
			CS.Oak.UI.Help.Instance) then

		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown then
			CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:RunInNextFrame(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageGameObject, function()
				CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
			end)
			return true
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeBuildPopup')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	-- 목록 아이템 갱신
	self.on_update_item = function (item, index)
		if self.materialList ~= nil then
			-- 인덱스가 0보다 작거나 갯수이상의 인덱스면 종료
			if index < 0 or #self.materialList <= index then
				return
			end

			local data = self.materialList[index + 1]
			-- 실제 업데이트 아이템 로직 호출 (컴포넌트 얻어서 처리)
			local it = item:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeBuildPopupMaterialItem))
			it.GetControllerLuaTable:set_data(data)
		end
	end
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.item.scrollViewContent:ItemUpdated('+', self.on_update_item)
end

function local_class:begin(state)
	self.states = state

	self.defaultSpriteScale = 1.602

	self.currentBuilding = self.states.CurrentBuilding
	self.nextBuilding = self.states.NextBuilding

	-- 다음 건물 스펙이 있을 경우 업그레이드 팝업
	self.isUpgradePopup = self.nextBuilding ~= nil

	local i = self.item

	i.scrollViewContent:SetPanelDepth(i.panel.depth + 1)

	self:set_item()
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.states = nil
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	return
end

function local_class:close_animation()
	return
end

function local_class:on_click_back_button()
	self:on_cancel_click()
end

-- begin에서 ui 세팅
function local_class:set_item()
	local i = self.item
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction
	local costDataList = nil

	i.buildingSprite.spriteName = self.currentBuilding.SpriteName
	i.buildingSprite:MakePixelPerfect()

	-- TODO: 이 부분 가른 곳에서 이미 스케일로 쓰고 있어서 공통으로 적용가능할지 체크. 없으면 BuildType으로 체크
	if self.currentBuilding.SpriteScale > 0 then
		i.spriteScaleTransform.localScale = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.one * self.currentBuilding.SpriteScale
	else
		i.spriteScaleTransform.localScale = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.one * self.defaultSpriteScale
	end

	if self.isUpgradePopup then
		i.titleLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_upgrade_popup_title')

		i.nextLevelObj:SetActive(true)
		i.haveAndLimitObj:SetActive(false)

		-- 영빈관만 업그레이드 하지만 영빈관인지 혹시 모르니 체크 한다
		if self.nextBuilding.HappinessRequired > 0 then
			i.happinessConditionWidget.cachedGameObject:SetActive(true)
			i.happinessConditionLabel.text = self.nextBuilding.HappinessRequired

			local cur_happiness = village_construction:get_cur_happiness()

			if cur_happiness >= self.nextBuilding.HappinessRequired then
				i.happinessConditionLabel.color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(252 / 255.0, 246 / 255.0, 230 / 255.0, 1)
			else
				i.happinessConditionLabel.color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(249 / 255.0, 69 / 255.0, 69 / 255.0, 1)
			end
		else
			i.happinessConditionWidget.cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		-- 업그레이드 팝업
		local currentLevel = self.currentBuilding.Level
		local currentLevelStr = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format('lv_n', currentLevel)
		local currentLevelAndColor = '[c][BD9162]'..currentLevelStr..'[-][/c]'
		local nextLevel = self.nextBuilding.Level
		local nextLevelStr = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format('lv_n', nextLevel)
		local buildingNextLevelOffset = i.nextLevelLabel.leftAnchor.absolute;

		i.nameAndLevelLabel.text = string.format('%s %s', CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(self.currentBuilding.Name), currentLevelAndColor);
		i.nextLevelLabel.text = nextLevelStr;
		i.nameAndLevelLabel:AssumeNaturalSize()

		local nextLevelSize = i.nextLevelLabel.width + buildingNextLevelOffset;
		local nameLabelXPos = i.nameAndLevelLabel.width * 0.5 - (i.nameAndLevelLabel.width + nextLevelSize) * 0.5

		i.nameLabelTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(nameLabelXPos,i.nameLabelTransform.localPosition.y,i.nameLabelTransform.localPosition.z)

		i.nextArrowSprite:UpdateAnchors()
		i.nextLevelLabel:UpdateAnchors()

		i.descLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(self.currentBuilding.Name..'_level_'..nextLevel..'_effect')

		costDataList = self.nextBuilding.CostList

		i.spriteAndNamesTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
		i.descLabel.cachedTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0, -122, 0)
	else
		i.titleLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_build_popup_title')

		-- 건설 팝업 (nextBuilding nil)
		i.nextLevelObj:SetActive(false)
		i.haveAndLimitObj:SetActive(true)

		i.happinessConditionWidget.cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)

		local isHouse = self.currentBuilding.BuildType == 'house'

		local have = 0
		local max = 1

		-- 집은 영빈관 레벨에 따라서 지을 수 있는 건물 최대 수가 다름
		if isHouse then
			have = village_construction:get_cur_build_count()
			max = village_construction:get_max_build_count()
		end

		local haveStr = '[c][BD9162]'..have..'[-][/c]'
		i.haveLimitLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format('n_out_of_m', haveStr, max)

		local haveLimitLeftOffset = i.haveLimitLabel.leftAnchor.absolute;

		i.nameAndLevelLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(self.currentBuilding.Name)
		i.nameAndLevelLabel:AssumeNaturalSize()

		local nextLevelSize = i.haveLimitLabel.width + haveLimitLeftOffset;
		local nameLabelXPos = i.nameAndLevelLabel.width * 0.5 - (i.nameAndLevelLabel.width + nextLevelSize) * 0.5

		i.nameLabelTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(nameLabelXPos,i.nameLabelTransform.localPosition.y,i.nameLabelTransform.localPosition.z)

		i.haveLimitLabel:UpdateAnchors()

		i.descLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(self.currentBuilding.Name..'_desc')

		costDataList = self.currentBuilding.CostList

		i.spriteAndNamesTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0, -21, 0)
		i.descLabel.cachedTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0, -113, 0)
	end

	self.materialList = {}

	if costDataList ~= nil then
		for j = 1, costDataList.Count do
			if costDataList[j - 1].Cost > 0 then
				table.insert(self.materialList, {
					Name = costDataList[j - 1].Name,
					SpriteName = costDataList[j - 1].SpriteName,
					SpriteScale = costDataList[j - 1].SpriteScale,
					Have = village_construction:get_resource_by_id(costDataList[j - 1].Id),
					Need = costDataList[j - 1].Cost,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	self:update_scroll_view_content()
end

-- 스크롤뷰 컨텐츠 갱신 및 스크롤 초기화
function local_class:update_scroll_view_content()
	local i = self.item

	if self.materialList ~= nil then
		i.scrollViewContent.ItemCount = #self.materialList
	else
		i.scrollViewContent.ItemCount = 0
	end

	i.scrollViewContent:ResetScroll()
end

-- 제작에 필요한 재료 수치가 충족되어있는지 체크
function local_class:check_craft_material_condition()
	if self.materialList == nil then
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, #self.materialList do
		if self.materialList[i].Have < self.materialList[i].Need then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--[[-- 건축에 필요한 조건이 만족되어 있는지 체크 (재료 수치는 비교 안 함)
function local_class:check_guest_house_level_condition()
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction

	if not self.isUpgradePopup then
		local conditionLevel = self.currentBuilding.GuestHouseLevel
		local currentLevel = village_construction.get_data_storage():get_guest_house_level()

		if conditionLevel > 0 and conditionLevel > currentLevel then
			return false
		end
	else
		local conditionLevel = self.nextBuilding.GuestHouseLevel
		local currentLevel = village_construction.get_data_storage():get_guest_house_level()

		if conditionLevel > 0 and conditionLevel > currentLevel then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end]]

-- 영빈관 업그레이드시에 행복도 조건이 있는 경우 조건 체크
function local_class:check_craft_happiness_condition()
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction

	if self.isUpgradePopup and self.nextBuilding.HappinessRequired > 0 then
		local cur_happiness = village_construction:get_cur_happiness()

		if cur_happiness < self.nextBuilding.HappinessRequired then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 건물 건설시 최대치 도달했는지 체크 (집만 해당)
function local_class:check_max_build_count_condition()
	if not self.isUpgradePopup then
		local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
		local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction
		local isHouse = self.currentBuilding.BuildType == 'house'

		local have = 0
		local max = 1

		-- 집은 영빈관 레벨에 따라서 지을 수 있는 건물 최대 수가 다름
		if isHouse then
			have = village_construction:get_cur_build_count()
			max = village_construction:get_max_build_count()
		end

		if have >= max then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_confirm_click()
	-- 재료 부족 체크
	if not self:check_craft_material_condition() then
		CS.Oak.PopUpUtil.ShowPopup(CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_build_material_condition_insufficient'))
		return
	end

	-- 업그레이드시에 행복도 체크
	if self.isUpgradePopup and not self:check_craft_happiness_condition() then
		CS.Oak.PopUpUtil.ShowPopup(CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_upgrade_happiness_condition_insufficient'))
		return
	end

	-- 최대치까지 건물 건설한 경우
	if not self.isUpgradePopup and not self:check_max_build_count_condition() then
		CS.Oak.PopUpUtil.ShowPopup(CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_max_build_condition_insufficient'))
		return
	end

	if self.states.OnConfirm ~= nil then
		self.states.OnConfirm();
		self.states.OnConfirm = nil;
		CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel_click()
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item.scrollViewContent:ItemUpdated('-', self.on_update_item)
	self.on_update_item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

--- 템플릿: 이 템플릿 기반으로 코드를 작성 하기 시작 하면 됩니다.
require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeCraftTablePopup')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	self.select_item = function (item)
		local i = self.item

		if self.selectedCraftItemData ~= nil then
			i.itemContent.GetControllerLuaTable:deselect_item(self.selectedCraftItemData)
		end

		-- 현재 선택된 아이템의 데이터와 인덱스 캐시
		local selectedItem = item

		if selectedItem ~= nil then
			if self.states.CraftItemDataList ~= nil then
				self.selectedCraftItemData = selectedItem:get_data()
			end
		else
			self.selectedCraftItemData = nil
		end

		if selectedItem ~= nil then
			selectedItem:set_selected(true)

			if self.states.CraftItemDataList ~= nil then
				i.selectItemInfo.GetControllerLuaTable:set_data(self.selectedCraftItemData)
			end
		else
			i.selectItemInfo.GetControllerLuaTable:set_data(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item
end

function local_class:begin(state)
	-- message_system이 불리기 전이라 임시
	self.message_system = CS.Oak.LuaMessageSystemAdapter.GetOrCreate(CS.Oak.LuaMessageSystemLifeCycle.StageOnly)

	self.states = state

	local i = self.item

	-- 현재 선택중인 제작품 데이터
	self.selectedCraftItemData = nil

	-- NOTE: 타이틀 라벨 세팅
	i.titleLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_craft_table_popup_title')

	-- 스크롤뷰 컨텐츠가 있어서 해당 판넬 뎁스를 조정 필요
	i.itemContent.GetControllerLuaTable:set_panel_depth(i.panel.depth + 1)
	i.selectItemInfo.GetControllerLuaTable:set_panel_depth(i.panel.depth + 2)

	-- 팝업 열자마자 도움말 팝업을 띄워야 할 경우
	if self.states.ShowHelpPopup then
		self:on_help_show()
	elseif not CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.HasKey('ShortStorySlimeCraftHelpViewed') then
		CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.SetInt('ShortStorySlimeCraftHelpViewed', 1)
		CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.Save()
		self:on_help_show()
	end

	i.itemContent.GetControllerLuaTable:set_data(self.states.CraftItemDataList, self.select_item)
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.states = nil
	self.selectedCraftItemData = nil
end

function local_class:open_animation()
	self.message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'game_pad_handler')
	local i = self.item
	-- 팝업 열렸을 때 첫 아이템 터치
	i.itemContent.GetControllerLuaTable:select_item(0)
	return
end

function local_class:close_animation()
	self.message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	return
end

function local_class:on_click_back_button()
	self:on_exit_click()
end

-- 도움말 버튼 클릭
function local_class:on_help_show()
	local i = self.item

	if i.helpButton ~= nil then
		i.helpButton:OnClickHelpButton()
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit_click()
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
end

function local_class:on_craft_click()
	local i = self.item

	-- 조건이 맞지 않는 경우
	if not i.selectItemInfo.GetControllerLuaTable:check_craft_condition() then
		CS.Oak.PopUpUtil.ShowPopup(CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('ss_slime_craft_condition_insufficient'))

require('base/class')
local util = require('xlua/util')

local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeCraftTablePopupContent')

-- Constructor
function local_class:init()
	self.item_click = function (item)
		local luaTable = item
		local data = luaTable:get_data()
		local alreadySelect = self.currentItemData == data

		if not alreadySelect and self.targetSelectAction ~= nil then
			self.currentItemData = data
			self.targetSelectAction(luaTable)
		end
	end

	self.on_update_item = function (item, index)
		if self.dataList ~= nil then
			-- 인덱스가 0보다 작거나 갯수이상의 인덱스면 종료
			if index < 0 or self.dataList.Count <= index then
				return
			end

			local data = self.dataList[index]
			-- 실제 업데이트 아이템 로직 호출 (컴포넌트 얻어서 처리)
			local it = item:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeCraftTablePopupContentItem))
			it.GetControllerLuaTable:set_data(data, self.currentItemData ~= nil and data == self.currentItemData, self.item_click)
		end
	end

	local list = CS.System.Collections.Generic.List(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeCraftTablePopupContentItem)
	self.listItems = list()

	self.on_create_item = function ()
		local tempArr = self.item.scrollViewContent:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.ShortStorySlimeCraftTablePopupContentItem), true)

		-- 0번 원본 프리펩이라 안 씀
		if tempArr ~= nil then
			for i = 1, tempArr.Length - 1 do
				self.listItems:Add(tempArr[i])
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Initializer (Called in Awake)
function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.dataList = nil
	self.item = item
	self.item.scrollViewContent:ItemUpdated('+', self.on_update_item)
	self.item.scrollViewContent:OnCreateItemFinished('+', self.on_create_item)
end

-- 스크롤 뷰의 판넬 뎁스를 팝업 판넬 뎁스에 맞게 조정
function local_class:set_panel_depth(depth)
	local panel = self.item.scrollView:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIPanel))
	panel.depth = depth
end

-- 처음 세팅
function local_class:set_data(dataList, actionCallback)
	self.currentItemData = nil
	self.dataList = dataList
	self.targetSelectAction = actionCallback

	self:update_scroll_view_content()
end

-- 스크롤뷰 컨텐츠 갱신 및 스크롤 초기화
function local_class:update_scroll_view_content()
	local i = self.item

	if self.dataList ~= nil then
		i.scrollViewContent.ItemCount = self.dataList.Count
	else
		i.scrollViewContent.ItemCount = 0
	end

	i.scrollViewContent:ResetScroll()
end

-- 목록 아이템 선택
function local_class:select_item(index)
	if index < 0 or index >= self.dataList.Count or self.listItems == nil or self.listItems.Count == 0 then
		return
	end

	local targetData = self.dataList[index]
	local targetId = targetData.Id

	for i = 0, self.listItems.Count - 1 do
		local item = self.listItems[i]
		if item ~= nil and item.gameObject ~= nil then
			local luaTable = item.GetControllerLuaTable
			if luaTable ~= nil then
				local data = luaTable:get_data()
				if data ~= nil and data.Id == targetId then
					self.item_click(item.GetControllerLuaTable)
					self.item.scrollViewContent:SetScrollByIndex(index)
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- ui 리셋용
function local_class:reset_ui()
	self.currentItemData = nil
	self:update_scroll_view_content()
end

-- 해당 아이템 선택 해제
function local_class:deselect_item(targetData)
	if self.listItems == nil or self.listItems.Count == 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.listItems.Count - 1 do
		if self.listItems[i] ~= nil and self.listItems[i].GetControllerLuaTable:get_data() == targetData then
			self.listItems[i].GetControllerLuaTable:set_selected(false)
			return
		end
	end
end

-- 현재 선택 중인 아이템의 위치 반환
function local_class:find_current_item_index()
	if self.currentItemData == nil then
		return -1
	end

	for i = 0, self.dataList.Count - 1 do
		if self.dataList[i] == self.currentItemData then
			return i
		end
	end
end

-- 첫 아이템 인덱스 찾기
function local_class:find_first_item_index()
	--NOTE: 0번의 경우 스크롤 뷰 컨텐츠의 원본 오브젝트로 미사용되는것
	if self.listItems ~= nil and self.listItems.Count >= 2 then
		for i = 0, self.dataList.Count - 1 do
			if self.dataList[i] == self.listItems[1].GetControllerLuaTable:get_data() then
				return i
			end
		end
	end

	return -1
end

-- 게임패드 입력에 따라 선택되는 대상을 변경
function local_class:set_game_pad_item(eventType)
	local index = self:find_current_item_index()

	if index == -1 then
		index = self:find_first_item_index()
		self:select_item(index)
		return
	end

	if eventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickUpButtonDown then
		if index >= 3 then
			self:select_item(index - 3)
		end
		return
	elseif eventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
		if index < self.dataList.Count then
			self:select_item(index + 1)
		end
		return
	elseif eventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickDownButtonDown then
		if index < self.dataList.Count - 3 then
			self:select_item(index + 3)
		end
		return
	elseif eventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then
		if index >= 0 then
			self:select_item(index - 1)
		end
		return
	end
end

function local_class:finish()
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item.scrollViewContent:ItemUpdated('-', self.on_update_item)
	self.on_update_item = nil
	self.item_click = nil

	if self.listItems ~= nil then
		self.listItems:Clear()
	end

	self.listItems = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	local max = itemData.MaxNum
	local conditionLimited = self:check_craft_condition()
	local prefixHexColor = ''

		i.outBg.color = self.selectOutBgColor
		i.innerBg.color = self.selectInBgColor
		i.nameLabel.color = self.selectNameColor

		i.innerBg.color = self.limitInBgColor

		local left = i.haveLimitLabel.leftAnchor.absolute
		local right = i.haveLimitLabel.leftAnchor.absolute

		i.haveLimitLabel:AssumeNaturalSize()

		local calcWidth = i.haveLimitLabel.width
		local realHaveWidth = left - right + calcWidth

		if realHaveWidth ~= i.haveLimitWidget.width then
			if realHaveWidth < self.minHaveWidth then
				i.haveLimitWidget.width = self.minHaveWidth
			else
				i.haveLimitWidget.width = realHaveWidth
			end

			else
				i.haveAndLimitWidget.width = realHaveWidth
			end

			i.haveAndLimitLabel:UpdateAnchors()
			i.haveAndLimitBg:UpdateAnchors()
		end
	end
end

-- 재료 리스트 세팅
function local_class:set_resources()
	local i = self.item

	if self.materialList ~= nil then
		i.resourceScrollViewContent.ItemCount = #self.materialList
	else
		i.resourceScrollViewContent.ItemCount = 0
	end

	i.resourceScrollViewContent:ResetScroll()
end

-- 제작 최대치까지 제작된 경우 false
function local_class:check_max_condition()
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction
	local data_storage = village_construction.get_data_storage()

	local have = data_storage:get_product_item_value(self.targetData.Id)
	local max = self.targetData.MaxNum

	if have >= max then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 제작에 필요한 조건이 만족되어 있는지 체크 (재료 수치는 비교 안 함)
function local_class:check_craft_condition()
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction

	-- 조건 레벨 (영빈관 레벨)
	local conditionLevel = self.targetData.GuestHouseLevel
	local currentLevel = village_construction.get_data_storage():get_guest_house_level()

	if conditionLevel > 0 and conditionLevel > currentLevel then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 제작에 필요한 재료 수치가 충족되어있는지 체크
function local_class:check_craft_material_condition()
	local stage_event_controller = CS.Oak.LuaInstanceManager.Instance:GetStageEventController('ShortStorySlimeController')
	local village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction
	local costDataList = self.targetData.CostList

	if costDataList ~= nil then
		for j = 1, costDataList.Count do
			local have = village_construction:get_resource_by_id(costDataList[j - 1].Id)
			if costDataList[j - 1].Cost > 0 and costDataList[j - 1].Cost > have then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 아틀라스 데이터에서 패딩값 만큼 위치 조정
function local_class:set_sprite_offset(spriteScale)
	local i = self.item

	local data =  i.targetSprite:GetAtlasSprite()

	if data ~= nil then
		i.targetSprite.Offset = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0.5 * (data.paddingRight - data.paddingLeft), 0.5 * (data.paddingTop - data.paddingBottom)) * spriteScale
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item.resourceScrollViewContent:ItemUpdated('-', self.on_update_item)
	self.on_update_item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')

local local_class = newclass('ShuranGimmickUI')

function local_class:init()
	self.constants_data = require('Frontend/ShuranGimmickUIConstants')

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_id = 7001602

	self.insam = false
	self.seoryeon = false
	self.seokgok = false
	self.bock = false

	self.item_state = {
		none = -1,
		insam = 0,
		seoryeon = 1,
		seokgok = 2,
		bock = 3,
	}
end

function local_class:initialize(item)
	self.item = item

	self.item.resultTitleLabel.text = game_string:GetString('sr_ui_get_medicine')
end

function local_class:set_active(active)
	self.item.gameObject:SetActive(active)
end

function local_class:init_ui()
	self.item.tableUIObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.resultUIObj:SetActive(false)

	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)
end

function local_class:start_init()
	-- 조합 UI on, 결과 UI off
	self.item.tableUIObj:SetActive(true)
	self.item.resultUIObj:SetActive(false)

	-- 중간 아이템 3개
	self.item.itemSecondSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemSecondSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 중간 물음표 3개
	self.item.itemFailSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemFailSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 결과 아이템 3개
	self.item.itemResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 결과 물음표 3개
	self.item.itemFailResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.item.itemFailResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:on_gimmick_ui(value)
	self:start_init()

	self.insam = false
	self.seoryeon = false
	self.seokgok = false
	self.bock = false

	if value == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 아이템에 해당하는 테이블을 불러옴
	local gimmick_table, state = self:get_gimmick_table(value)

	-- 첫번째 스프라이트 출력
	self:first_sprite_insert(gimmick_table)

	-- 두번째 스프라이트 출력
	self:second_sprite_insert(gimmick_table, state)

	-- 결과 스프라이트 출력
	self:result_sprite_insert(gimmick_table, state)
end

function local_class:first_sprite_insert(table)
	local first_num = 1

	self.item.itemFirstSprites[0].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_1[first_num]
	self.item.itemFirstSprites[1].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_2[first_num]
end

function local_class:second_sprite_insert(table, state)
	if state == self.item_state.insam then
		self.seoryeon = self:get_is_craft(table.seoryeon)
		self.bock = self:get_is_craft(table.bock)

		self:set_second_sprite(table, self.seoryeon, self.bock)
	elseif state == self.item_state.seoryeon then
		self.insam = self:get_is_craft(table.insam)
		self.seokgok = self:get_is_craft(table.seokgok)

		self:set_second_sprite(table, self.insam, self.seokgok)
	elseif state == self.item_state.seokgok then
		self.seoryeon = self:get_is_craft(table.seoryeon)
		self.bock = self:get_is_craft(table.bock)

		self:set_second_sprite(table, self.seoryeon, self.bock)
	elseif state == self.item_state.bock then
		self.insam = self:get_is_craft(table.insam)
		self.seokgok = self:get_is_craft(table.seokgok)

		self:set_second_sprite(table, self.insam, self.seokgok)
	end
end

function local_class:set_second_sprite(table, visible_1, visible_2)
	local second_num = 2

	if visible_1 then
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[0].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_1[second_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if visible_2 then
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemSecondSprites[1].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_2[second_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:result_sprite_insert(table, state)
	if state == self.item_state.insam then
		self:set_result_sprite(table, self.seoryeon, self.bock)
	elseif state == self.item_state.seoryeon then
		self:set_result_sprite(table, self.insam, self.seokgok)
	elseif state == self.item_state.seokgok then
		self:set_result_sprite(table, self.seoryeon, self.bock)
	elseif state == self.item_state.bock then
		self:set_result_sprite(table, self.insam, self.seokgok)
	end
end

function local_class:set_result_sprite(table, visible_1, visible_2)
	local result_num = 3

	if visible_1 then
		self.item.itemResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemResultSprites[0].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_1[result_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailResultSprites[0].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	if visible_2 then
		self.item.itemResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.item.itemResultSprites[1].spriteName = table.sprite_list_table_2[result_num]
	else
		self.item.itemFailResultSprites[1].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:get_gimmick_table(value)
	local return_table = {}
	local state = self.item_state.none

	if value == 'insam' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.insam
		state = self.item_state.insam
	elseif value == 'seoryeon' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.seoryeon
		state = self.item_state.seoryeon
	elseif value == 'seokgok' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.seokgok
		state = self.item_state.seokgok
	elseif value == 'bock' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.gimmick_table.bock
		state = self.item_state.bock
	end

	return return_table, state
end

function local_class:get_is_craft(gimmick_str)
	local is_craft = false

	if gimmick_str == 'jump' then
		is_craft = self:is_unlock_craft(1)
	elseif gimmick_str == 'diamond' then
		is_craft = self:is_unlock_craft(2)
	elseif gimmick_str == 'sleepwalk' then
		is_craft = self:is_unlock_craft(3)
	elseif gimmick_str == 'break' then
		is_craft = self:is_unlock_craft(4)
	end

	return is_craft
end

function local_class:is_unlock_craft(craft_id)
	if self.quest_progress == nil then
		self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

		if self.quest_progress == nil then
			return false
		end
	end

	local bit = 1 << craft_id
	local current_state = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState('medicine_flag')
	local state = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(current_state ~= -1, current_state, 0)

	return (state & bit) == bit
end

function local_class:on_result_ui(value)
	-- 조합 UI off, 결과 UI on
	self.item.tableUIObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.resultUIObj:SetActive(true)

	-- 관련되서 해당 결과 아이템 출력 (테스트)
	local result_item = self:get_return_table(value)

	self.item.resultDescLabel.text = game_string:GetString(result_item.string)
	self.item.resultSprite.spriteName = result_item.sprite_name
end

function local_class:get_return_table(value)
	local return_table = {}

	if value == 'jump' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.result_table.jump
	elseif value == 'diamond' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.result_table.diamond
	elseif value == 'sleepwalk' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.result_table.sleepwalk
	elseif value == 'break' then
		return_table = self.constants_data.result_table.break_1
	end

	return return_table
end

function local_class:end_ui()
	self.item.tableUIObj:SetActive(false)
	self.item.resultUIObj:SetActive(false)
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item_state = nil

	self.item = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

		if index >= #self.staffs then return end

		local i = item:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SlimeHallStaffScrollItem))

		i.GetControllerLuaTable:set(index, self.selected_id)
	end

	self.village_construction = stage_event_controller.village_construction
	self.staffs = self.village_construction.constants_data.guard_info_list

	self.data_storage = self.village_construction:get_data_storage()

	self.staffs_active_data = self.data_storage.active_guard_save_data
	self.staffs_working_data = self.data_storage.guest_house_guard_data

	self.item = item
	self.item.staffScv:ItemUpdated('+', self.on_update_item)

end

function local_class:begin(state)
	self.selected_id = 1

	self.item.staffScv.ItemCount = #(self.staffs)
	self.item.staffScv:ResetScroll()
	self.item.staffScv:UpdateAll()

	-- 첫 아이템으로 UI 세팅을 해 둔다.
	-- 최대치 세팅
	self.max_set_guard_count = self.village_construction:get_max_set_guard_count()

	self.item.staffListPanel.depth = depth
	self.item.staffDescScroll.panel.depth = depth

	local max_staff_count = #(self.staffs)

	self.item.maxStaffCountLabel.text = '[FFFAD8]' .. active_staff_count .. '[-][9D7D50]/' .. max_staff_count .. '[-]'

function local_class:on_scout_click()
	-- 경비가 활성화 되었다면 구매할 필요가 없으니 return
	if self.village_construction:is_active_guard(self.selected_id) then
		return
	end

	-- 경비가 구매가능한 상태가 아니라면 return
	if not self.village_construction:is_scouting_possible_guard(self.selected_id) then
		return
	end

	if self.data_storage:get_dollar() < self.staffs[self.selected_id].price then
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot('01_dollars_01')

	self.village_construction:recruit_guard(self.selected_id)

	self:set_count_label()
	self:set_scout_button()
	self:set_confirm_button()
	self:set_right_ui()
	self.item.staffScv:UpdateAll()
end

function local_class:on_confirm_click()
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay()
end

function local_class:on_click_item(scroll_item)
	self.selected_id = scroll_item.id

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')

	-- 오른쪽 설정
	self:set_right_ui()

	-- 영입 버튼 설정
	self:set_scout_button()

	-- 배치 버튼 설정
	self:set_confirm_button()

	self.item.staffScv:UpdateAll()
end

function local_class:set_right_ui()
	local id = self.selected_id
	local data = self.staffs[id]

	local working_state = 0

	if self:is_working(id) then
		working_state = 2
	elseif not self.village_construction:is_active_guard(id) and self.village_construction:is_scouting_possible_guard(id) then
		working_state = 1
	end

	self.item.staffItem.GetControllerLuaTable:set(data, working_state, false)
	local label_height = self.item.staffItem.GetControllerLuaTable:get_label_height()

	local diff = 0

	if label_height > 114 then
		diff = label_height - 114
	end

	local staff_item_widget = self.item.staffItem:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIWidget))
	staff_item_widget.height = 176 + diff

	CS.NGUIExtenstions.UpdateAllAnchors(staff_item_widget)

	self.item.descLabels[0].text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(data.ability_spec.ability_name)
	self.item.descLabels[1].text = self.village_construction:get_guard_ability_text_string(data) .. '\n' ..
			CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(data.ability_spec.add_detail_desc)

	if data.available_condition_type == 'none' then
		self.item.descObjs[1]:SetActive(false)
	else
		self.item.descObjs[1]:SetActive(true)

		self.item.descLabels[2].text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(data.condition_name)
		self.item.descLabels[3].text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString(data.condition_text)
	end

	CS.NGUIExtenstions.UpdateAllAnchors(self.item.descWidget)

	self.item.staffDescScroll:ResetPosition()
end

function local_class:set_scout_button()
	local id = self.selected_id
	local data = self.staffs[id]

	-- 경비가 활성화가 되어있지 않으면서 구매가능한 상태에서 버튼 출력
	local is_active_scout = self.village_construction:is_scouting_possible_guard(id) and
			not self.village_construction:is_active_guard(id)

	self.item.scoutButtonObj:SetActive(is_active_scout)
	self.item.scoutCostLabel.text = data.price
	if self.data_storage:get_dollar() < data.price then
		self.item.scoutCostLabel.color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0, 0, 1)
	else
		self.item.scoutCostLabel.color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 243 / 255, 225 / 255, 1)
	end
end

function local_class:set_confirm_button()
	local id = self.selected_id

	if self.staffs_active_data[id] == 0 then
		self.item.confirmButtonLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("ss_slime_guard_in")
		self.item.confirmButtonBg.spriteName = 'slot_btn15_r6'
		return
	end

	if self:is_working(id) then
		self.item.confirmButtonLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("ss_slime_guard_in_cancle")
	else
		self.item.confirmButtonLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("ss_slime_guard_in")
	end

	if self:is_working(id) or self.village_construction:is_deploy_guard() then
		self.item.confirmButtonBg.spriteName = 'slot_btn9_r6'
	else
		self.item.confirmButtonBg.spriteName = 'slot_btn15_r6'
	end
end

function local_class:is_working(id)
	for i = 1, #(self.staffs_working_data) do
		if id == self.staffs_working_data[i] then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_confirm_click()
	local id = self.selected_id

	if self.staffs_active_data[id] == 0 then return end

	-- 일하고 있으면 배치 해제
	if self:is_working(id) then
		self.village_construction:pullout_guard(id)
	elseif self.village_construction:is_deploy_guard() then
		self.village_construction:deploy_guard(id)
	end

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot('01_armor_01')

	self.item.staffScv:UpdateAll()
	self:set_right_ui()
	self:set_confirm_button()
	self:set_count_label()
end

function local_class:game_pad_handler(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickUpButtonDown then
		if self.selected_id <= 2 then return end
		self.selected_id = self.selected_id - 2

	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
		if self.selected_id > #self.staffs - 1 then return end
		self.selected_id = self.selected_id + 1

	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickDownButtonDown then
		if self.selected_id > #self.staffs - 2 then return end
		self.selected_id = self.selected_id + 2

	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then
		if self.selected_id <= 1 then return end
		self.selected_id = self.selected_id - 1

	else
		return true
	end

	-- 오른쪽 설정
	self:set_right_ui()

	-- 영입 버튼 설정
	self:set_scout_button()

	-- 배치 버튼 설정
	self:set_confirm_button()

	self.item.staffScv:SetScrollByIndex(self.selected_id - 1)
	self.item.staffScv:UpdateAll()

	return false
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self.item.staffScv:ItemUpdated('-', self.on_update_item)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance.SoundState = CS.Oak.SoundState.Lobby
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance.LobbyBgmName = "ondemand/worldexplore/audio:bgm_worldexplore_lobby"

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.Title = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString("world_exploration")
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:BackButtonClick('+', self.on_back_button_click)

	self.item.worldExploreStageSelect:ResetUI()
	self.item.worldExploreMerchMaterials:UpdateMerchMaterialAmount(CS.Oak.User.Me)

	-- 특정 스테이지를 선택한채로 시작하기 위해 state값이 존재하는 경우
	if self.item.sceneState ~= nil then
		self.item.worldExploreStageSelect:SetSelectStageItem(self.item.sceneState.OpenStageId)
		self.item.sceneState = nil
	end

	CS.Oak.User.Me:Updated('+', self.on_user_updated)
end

function local_class:pause()
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:BackButtonClick('-', self.on_back_button_click)
	end

	CS.Oak.User.Me:Updated('-', self.on_user_updated)
end

function local_class:finish()
	self.item.sceneState = nil
	self.item.worldExploreStageSelect:Dispose()
	self:destroy_eva()
end

function local_class:show_stage_info(stage_id)
	if self.item.worldExploreStageInfo.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
		self.item.leftUiGameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.item.worldExploreStageInfo:OnShow()
		CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_info_animation, self, true))
	end

	local stageData = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("StageData")
	local stageSpec = stageData:GetStage(stage_id)
	self.item.worldExploreStageInfo:SetStageInfo(stageSpec)

end

function local_class:stage_info_animation(onOff)
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(self.item, false)

	local duration = 0.1
	local widget = self.item.worldExploreStageInfo.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIWidget))
	local start_pos = nil
	local end_pos = nil
	local origin_alpha = nil
	local alpha = nil

	if onOff == true then
		start_pos = self.stage_info_pos + CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0, -50, 0)
		end_pos = self.stage_info_pos
		origin_alpha = 0
		alpha = 1
	else
		start_pos = self.stage_info_pos
		end_pos = self.stage_info_pos + CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(0, -50, 0)
		origin_alpha = 1
		alpha = 0
	end

	local passed_time = 0

	while passed_time < duration do
		passed_time = passed_time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
		local progress =  CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(passed_time, 0, 1, duration)
		widget.cachedTransform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		widget.alpha = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(origin_alpha, alpha, progress);
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	widget.cachedTransform.localPosition = end_pos
	widget.alpha = alpha

	if onOff == false then
		widget.cachedGameObject:SetActive(false);
	end

	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(self.item, true)
end

function local_class:close_stage_info()
	self.item.leftUiGameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.item.worldExploreStageSelect:ReturnUI()
	self.item.worldExploreStageInfo:OnHide()
	CS.Foundations.CoroutineManager.Instance:StartCoroutine(self.item, util.cs_generator(self.stage_info_animation, self, false))
end

function local_class:close_scene()
	local ui_transition = CS.Oak.UI.UITransition()
	ui_transition.TransitionType = CS.Oak.TransitionType.Pop
	ui_transition.Animation = CS.Oak.UI.TransitionAnimation.Fade

	self.item.SceneManager:SetTransition(ui_transition)
end

function local_class:open_exchange_popup()
	local state = CS.Oak.UI.ResourceExchangePopupState()
	state.OpenIndex = CS.Oak.UI.ResourceExchangeTab.Reward
	state.ResourceExchange = CS.Oak.UI.WorldExploreResourceExchange.Instance
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.ResourceExchangePopup.Instance, state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.ResourceExchangePopup))
end

function local_class:init_bg_knight()

	if self.set_knight == true then
		return;
	end

	self.set_knight = true;

	local knight_character_info = CS.Oak.User.Me:GetKnightCharacter()
	local knight_female = self.item.transform:Find('exploration_menu/root/character_root/character_slot/slot_knight/knight_female_1')
	local knight_male = self.item.transform:Find('exploration_menu/root/character_root/character_slot/slot_knight/knight_male_1')
	-- 유저가 선택한 기사 성별에 따라 기사스파인케릭터 설정함
	if knight_character_info.RawCharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.KnightFemale then
		knight_female.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		knight_male.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	else
		knight_female.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		knight_male.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

end

function local_class:load_eva_spine_character()
	-- 만약 에바스파인케릭터가 있으면 파괴함
	self:destroy_eva();

	local asset_bundle = 'characters/knight_captain_2'
	local asset_name = 'knight_captain_2'

	-- 콩서비스일때 에바 리소스 교체
	if CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance.UseKongResources == true then
		asset_bundle = 'characters/knight_captain_2_kong'
		asset_name = 'knight_captain_2_kong'
	end

	self.resources_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder(CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance.SharedResourceHolder)

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync(
			self.resources_holder, asset_bundle, asset_name,
			function(prefab)
				self.eva_spine_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				local slot_eva = self.item.transform:Find('exploration_menu/root/character_root/character_slot/slot_eva')
				CS.NGUITools.SetLayer(self.eva_spine_object, CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer('UI'))
				self.eva_spine_object.transform:SetParent(slot_eva, false)
				self.eva_spine_object.transform.localPosition = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
			end))
end

function local_class:destroy_eva()
	if self.eva_spine_object ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.eva_spine_object)
		self.eva_spine_object = nil
	end

	if self.resources_holder ~= nil then
		self.resources_holder:Dispose()
		self.resources_holder = nil
	end
end

-- Called in OnDestroy
function local_class:dispose()
	self:destroy_eva()
	self.item.worldExploreStageSelect:onSelectedStage('-', self.on_stage_selected)
	self.item = nil
	self.stage_info_pos = nil
	self.on_stage_selected = nil
	self.on_back_button_click = nil
	self.on_click_exchange_button = nil
	self.on_user_updated = nil
	self.set_knight = nil
	self.resources_holder = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('AndroidController')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.effect_names = {
		activated = 'FX_BuffMagic_Target',
		deactivated = 'FX_BuffMagic_Target'
	}

	-- 사용할 이펙트 풀 테이블
	self.effect_pools = {
		activated = nil,
		deactivated = nil
	}

	-- 기믹 State
	self.android_state = {
		idle = 0,
		move = 1
	}

	self.dir_searching_queue_map = {
		[CS.Oak.Direction.Up] = {
			CS.Oak.Direction.Up,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		},
		[CS.Oak.Direction.Down] = {
			CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		},
		[CS.Oak.Direction.Right] = {
			CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Up,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		},
		[CS.Oak.Direction.Left] = {
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Up,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
			CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
		}
	}

	self.cur_android_state = self.android_state.idle

	-- 안드로이드의 스파인 컨트롤러
	self.spine_controller = nil

	-- 안드로이드의 스파인 컨테이너 GameObject
	self.spine_container = nil

	-- 메뉴얼 캐릭터용 안드로이드
	self.manual_android = nil

	-- 매뉴얼 캐릭터용 안드로이드 스파인 컨테이너 GameObject
	self.manual_android_spine_container = nil

	-- 안드로이드 기본 위치와 방향
	self.origin_pos = nil
	self.origin_dir = nil

	-- 안드로이드가 범위를 나갔다고 체크하는 존 이름
	self.event_zone_name = nil

	-- 기존 파티 저장
	self.leader = nil
	self.saved_party = nil

	-- 비활성화 상태때 출력해줄 스트링 키
	self.unavailable_notice_string_key = nil

	-- 안드로이드가 작동 할 수 있는 상태 인가?
	self.is_available = false

	-- 지금 작동 중인가?
	self.activated = false

	self.virtual_walls = {}

	self.range_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76)
	self.range_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)

	self.moving_sfx = nil
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	-- 안드로이드 상태 리셋
	self.cur_android_state = self.android_state.idle

	-- 안드로이드 초기 좌표 및 방향 세팅
	self.origin_pos = fo.Position
	self.origin_dir = self.data.android_data[fo.Name].origin_dir

	-- 체크할 이벤트 존 이름
	self.event_zone_name = self.data.android_data[fo.Name].event_zone_name

	-- 메뉴얼 캐릭터용 안드로이드 세팅
	self.manual_android = get_character(self.data.android_data[fo.Name].manual_android_name)
	self.manual_android.Position = self.fo.Position
	self.manual_android_spine_container = self.manual_android.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.gameObject
	self.manual_android_spine_container:SetActive(false)
	self.manual_android.Hitbox = self.fo.Hitbox
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.manual_android, false)

	--[PS-10801] 안드로이드 기믹 상태에서 죽는 상황은 없어야 하므로 immortal 처리
	character_util.set_immortal(self.manual_android, true)

	-- 이팩트 캐싱
	for key, name in pairs(self.effect_names) do
		self.effect_pools[key] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(name)
	end

	-- 기본 애니메이션 및 방향 지정
	self.spine_controller = self.fo.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	self.spine_container = self.spine_controller.SpineContainerTransform.gameObject

	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	self.spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'idle', false)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('damaged', false)
	self:set_direction(self.origin_dir)

	-- 사용할 수 있는지 여부 체크
	self:check_available()

	-- 이벤트 연출등의 이유로 안드로이드 조작을 일시적으로 못하게 만드는 용도
	self.disable_control = false
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self:unsubscribe_events()

	self.data = nil
	self.effect_names = nil
	self.effect_pools = nil
	self.spine_controller = nil
	self.spine_container = nil

	self.manual_android = nil
	self.manual_android_spine_container = nil
	self.saved_party = nil
	self.leader = nil

	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent) then
		return self:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageEndEvent) then
		return self:unsubscribe_events()
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		return self:on_move_fo_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- FIXED : [PS-9858] 엔티티 그룹이 Neutral인 경우 정상적으로 인터렉트를 할 수 없는 상황임
	if (user_party.Leader.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
		return false
	end

	--[PS-10801] 리더 invincible 걸기 전에 죽어 있는 상태로 인터렉트 했을 시 activate_android 루틴 진행 안되게 방어 코드
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

		-- 해당 기믹에 상호작용 했을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
		-- 익스클루시브 상태일 때는 조작 불가

		-- 전투 중일 때 사용 불가
		if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() ~= nil then
			-- 전투 중에는 사용이 불가능합니다.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.fo, { key = 'lilith_tower_android_notice_1' })
			return false
		end

		-- 조작할 수 없는 상태일 때 나레이션 출력
		if not self.is_available then
			-- 스트링키가 nil일 때의 방어 코드
			if self.unavailable_notice_string_key == nil then return false end

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.notice_unavailable, self)
			return false
		end

		-- 안드로이드의 상태가 조작중일 때는 불가능
		if self.cur_android_state ~= self.android_state.idle then
			return false
		else
			if not self.disable_control then
				-- 안드로이드 조작 시작
				self.cur_android_state = self.android_state.move

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_android, self))
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.cur_android_state ~= self.android_state.move then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		-- 조작중에 Action1 버튼 누를시 제자리에서 안드로이드 비활성화
		self.cur_android_state = self.android_state.idle
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.deactivate_android, self, false))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	-- activate_quest_id에 해당하는 퀘스트가 클리어 되었을 때 안드로이드를 작동시킬 수 있도록 변경
	if e.QuestId == self.data.activate_quest_id then
		self.is_available = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	-- 움직이는 중이 아니라면 체크할 필요 없음
	if self.cur_android_state ~= self.android_state.move then
		return false
	end

	-- 조작 안드로이드가 움직이면 기믹 안드로이드랑 좌표를 맞춰줌
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.manual_android) then
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.fo, (e.FieldObject.Position - e.OldPosition).normalized,
				(e.FieldObject.Position - e.OldPosition).magnitude)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- disable_control과 enable_control 사용 시 주의사항
--- 안드로이드 조작과 동시에 연출이 들어갈 때 생기는 문제를 막기 위해 있는 기능으로
--- 해당 기능을 사용해서 안드로이드 조작을 불가능하게 만든다면
--- 반드시 다시 조작을 가능하게 만들어 주어야 함
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'disable_android_control' then
		-- 안드로이드 조작 불가능 상태로 만들기
		self.disable_control = true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'enable_android_control' then
		-- 안드로이드 조작 가능 상태로 만들기
		self.disable_control = false
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'deactivate_android' then
		-- 안드로이드 조종 중단 시키기
		if self.cur_android_state == self.android_state.move then
			self.cur_android_state = self.android_state.idle
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == nil then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.deactivate_android, self, false, true))
			elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'camera_lerp_return' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.deactivate_android, self, false))
			elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'fix_camera' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.deactivate_android, self, false, false, true))
			end
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'hide_android_attack_range' then
		-- 안드로이드 AttackRange 감추기
		if self.activated then
			self:hide_range()
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'show_android_attack_range' then
		-- 안드로이드 AttackRange 보이기
		if self.activated then
			self:show_range()
		end
	end
end
