-- 구독 해지 함수
function local_class:unsubscribe_events()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	-- 움직이는 중이였다면 MoveFieldObjectEvent 구독했으니 구독해지
	if self.cur_android_state == self.android_state.move then
		self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	end
end

-- 조작불가 알림
function local_class:notice_unavailable()
	-- 전원이 꺼진 안드로이드, 기계에 대해 잘 아는 기술자가 있다면 움직일 수 있을지도 모른다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.unavailable_notice_string_key })
end

-- 안드로이드 작동 시작
function local_class:activate_android()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local function fade_activation_sfx(sfx)
		sfx:FadeOut(0.4)
	end

	-- 기존 파티 정보 저장
	self.leader = user_party.Leader
	self.saved_party = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.saved_party, user_party[i])
	end

	--[PS-10801] 리더가 안드로이드 기믹을 조종하는 상황에서 죽는 일은 없어야 하므로 invincible 처리
	if self.leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		self.leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 조작용 안드로이드를 파티원으로 추가
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.manual_android, param)
	self.manual_android.Hitbox = self.fo.Hitbox
	self.manual_android.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
	self.manual_android.Position = self.fo.Position
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.manual_android, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- 만약 위나 아래에 정렬했다면 캐릭터의 방향을 왼쪽으로 돌림 (위, 아래는 eat 모션이 없으므로)
	character_util.set_side_direction(self.leader)

	-- 기술자(또는 파티리더)가 eat 모션하면서 안드로이드 가동
	-- 쥐폭탄 시동 시간 0.65초 참고
	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	if self.cur_android_state == self.android_state.idle then
		fade_activation_sfx(sfx)
		return
	end

	-- 안드로이드 기믹의 눈 idle로 변경
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_light_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', true)
	self.effect_pools.activated:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	if self.cur_android_state == self.android_state.idle then
		fade_activation_sfx(sfx)
		return
	end

	-- 페이드 아웃
	fade_activation_sfx(sfx)

	-- 기믹 안드로이드 알파값 빼고 CrashBehaviour / Interactable 변경
	self.spine_container:SetActive(false)
	self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 조작용 안드로이드를 파티원으로 추가
	character_util.set_direction(self.manual_android, self.fo.Direction)

	self.manual_android_spine_container:SetActive(true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.manual_android)

	-- 상호작용 키 비활성화
	local manual_touch_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(self.manual_android.Position, 0.2)

	if self.cur_android_state == self.android_state.idle then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'success', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 움직이기 시작했으니 MoveFieldObjectEvent 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	stage_camera:SetTarget(self.manual_android)

	-- 걷기만 가능하도록 설정
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
		(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move)))
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	self.activated = true

	self:show_range()

	self:show_virtual_field_object()
end

-- 안드로이드의 조작을 멈출 때
function local_class:deactivate_android(reset_position, immediate_return, fix_camera)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local immediatereturn = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediate_return, false)
	local fixcamera = lua_helper.get_or_default(fix_camera, false)

	--[PS-10801] 리더 invincible 상태 해제 해줌
	if self.leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		self.leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 조작 멈추는 연출
	self.effect_pools.activated:Instantiate(self.manual_android.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_light_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.manual_android, { name = 'idle', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader)

	-- 기믹 안드로이드의 인터렉트 복귀
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 기믹 안드로이드의 알파값 및 방향 맞춰줌
	self:set_direction(reset_position and self.origin_dir or self.manual_android.Direction)
	self.spine_controller:SetEmotion('damaged', false)
	self.spine_container:SetActive(true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- NPC로 바꾸기 전에 플레이어로 EntityGroup 변경
	self.manual_android.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player1
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.manual_android)
	self.manual_android_spine_container:SetActive(false)

	-- 기존 파티원들 복구
	for i = 1, #self.saved_party do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.saved_party[i], self.leader) then
			local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
			param.MoveCamera = false

			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.leader, param)
		else
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.saved_party[i], user_party)
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.saved_party[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(self.saved_party[i], 'enabled')
	end

	self.activated = false

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 캐싱한 파티원 정보 초기화
	self.saved_party = nil
	self.leader = nil

	-- 영역을 나가서 포지션을 리셋해줘야 한다면 리셋
	if reset_position then
		self.fo.Position = self.origin_pos
	end

	-- 상호작용키 원래대로
	local manual_touch_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(user_party.Leader)
	end

	-- MoveFieldObjectEvent 구독해지
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not fixcamera then
		if not immediatereturn then
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		else
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	self:hide_range()

	self:hide_virtual_field_object()
end

-- 작동 가능한지 체크하는 함수
function local_class:check_available()
	-- activate_quest_id의 퀘스트를 클리어 했을 때만 작동
	local target_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data.activate_quest_id)
	self.is_available = target_quest ~= nil and target_quest.IsComplete

	-- 작동할 수 없는 상태라면 스트링키 세팅
	if not self.is_available then
		self.unavailable_notice_string_key = self.data.unavailable_notice_string_key
	end
end

function local_class:show_range()
	if is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		local zone = field:GetZone(self.event_zone_name)
		local decimal_num = zone.Bounds.center.y - math.floor(zone.Bounds.center.y)
		local sub_y_val = decimal_num > 0 and decimal_num * 0.75 or 0
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
				vector(zone.Bounds.center.x, zone.Bounds.center.y - sub_y_val, zone.Bounds.center.z ),
				unity_class.vector2(zone.Bounds.size.x, zone.Bounds.size.z),
				self.range_light_color,
				self.range_dark_color
		)
	end

	self.attack_range:Show()
end

function local_class:hide_range()
	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:show_virtual_field_object()
	if #self.virtual_walls <= 0 then

		function default_wall_setting(wall)
			wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
			-- wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
			wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end

		local bounds_thickness = 1
		local zone = field:GetZone(self.event_zone_name)
		local virtual_wall_left = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		virtual_wall_left.Name = 'range_left'
		virtual_wall_left.Position = vector(zone.Bounds.min.x - bounds_thickness * 0.5, 0, zone.Bounds.center.z)
		virtual_wall_left.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(bounds_thickness, 2, zone.Bounds.size.z))
		default_wall_setting(virtual_wall_left)
		table.insert(self.virtual_walls, virtual_wall_left)
		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(virtual_wall_left))

		local virtual_wall_right = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		virtual_wall_right.Name = 'range_right'
		virtual_wall_right.Position = vector(zone.Bounds.max.x + bounds_thickness * 0.5, 0, zone.Bounds.center.z)
		virtual_wall_right.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(bounds_thickness, 2, zone.Bounds.size.z))
		default_wall_setting(virtual_wall_right)
		table.insert(self.virtual_walls, virtual_wall_right)
		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(virtual_wall_right))

		local virtual_wall_top = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		virtual_wall_top.Name = 'range_top'
		virtual_wall_top.Position = vector(zone.Bounds.center.x, 0, zone.Bounds.max.z + bounds_thickness * 0.5)
		virtual_wall_top.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(zone.Bounds.size.x, 2, bounds_thickness))
		default_wall_setting(virtual_wall_top)
		table.insert(self.virtual_walls, virtual_wall_top)
		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(virtual_wall_top))

		local virtual_wall_bottom = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		virtual_wall_bottom.Name = 'range_bottom'
		virtual_wall_bottom.Position = vector(zone.Bounds.center.x, 0, zone.Bounds.min.z - bounds_thickness * 0.5)
		virtual_wall_bottom.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(zone.Bounds.size.x, 2, bounds_thickness))
		default_wall_setting(virtual_wall_bottom)
		table.insert(self.virtual_walls, virtual_wall_bottom)
		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(virtual_wall_bottom))

		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.virtual_walls do
		self.virtual_walls[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	end
end

function local_class:hide_virtual_field_object()
	for i = 1, #self.virtual_walls do
		self.virtual_walls[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
end

function local_class:start_sfx_moving()
	self:stop_sfx_moving()

	self.moving_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_aircraft_loop_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object'})
end

function local_class:stop_sfx_moving()
	if self.moving_sfx ~= nil then
		self.moving_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.moving_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:set_direction(dir)
	self.fo.Direction = dir
	self.spine_controller.Direction = dir
	self.spine_controller:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
end

function local_class:set_position(position)
	self.fo.Position = position
	self.manual_android.Position = position
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent) then
		self:on_interact_finish_event(e)

		if not self.is_launch_mode then
			self:setting_launch_mode()
			--스팅어 기믹은 안보이는 위치로 이동
			self.stinger_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		else
			self:release_launch_mode()
		end
		return false
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent) then
		if self.is_launch_mode then
			self:release_launch_mode()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:setting_launch_mode()
	--이동, 액션버튼을 제외하고 입력을 막는다.
	local manual_touch_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState

	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(user_party_leader,
				CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination
	| CS.Oak.DisabledControls.PartySupportBattleAction | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)
	end

	--액션버튼 이미지를 공격버튼으로 변경
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.CustomAttack

	local lock_dir = unity_class.vector3.right
	if self.boss_helicopter ~= nil then
		lock_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss_helicopter.Position - user_party_leader.Position).normalized
	end
	user_party_leader.LockedDirection = vector_util.to_side_dir(lock_dir)

	if user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.Weapon1 ~= nil then
		self.origin_weapon1_sprite_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
	end

	if user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.Weapon2 ~= nil then
		self.origin_weapon2_sprite_name = user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.Weapon2.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
	end

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(true)
	if self:is_animal_type_character() then
		user_party_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon3', 'stinger_cannon')
	else
		user_party_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'stinger_rifle')

		--인간형 캐릭터의 경우 Idle, Walk Animation변경을 위해 StingerMissileState로 ActionState변경
		local s = CS.Oak.StingerMissileState.Create(user_party_leader);
		message_system:SendSync(user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(s))
	end

	stage_camera:ResizeTo(5, 0.3)

	--스팅어 장착 정보를 이벤트로 헬리콥터에 보냄
	if self.boss_helicopter ~= nil then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BossStingerStepEvent.Create(self.character, self.boss_helicopter, CS.Oak.StingerStep.Get))
	end
	self.is_launch_mode = true
end

function local_class:fire_stinger_routine()
	--헬리콥터가 좌우만 존재
	local side_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	if self.boss_helicopter ~= nil then
		side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(
				vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss_helicopter.Position - user_party_leader.Position).normalized)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(user_party_leader, self.stinger_dealy_time))

	local shoot_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(side_dir)

	local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party_leader.Position,
			field:GetTileInfoAt(user_party_leader.Position):GetHeightAt(user_party_leader.Position) + 0.5)

	local ani_name = self.launch_ani_name

	--동물형의 발사 위치Offset, animation
	local shoot_offset = vector(0,0, 0)
	if self:is_animal_type_character() then
		if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			shoot_offset =  self.tiger_shot_right_offset
		else
			shoot_offset = self.tiger_shot_left_offset
		end
		ani_name = self.launch_ani_name_for_tiger
	else
		if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			shoot_offset = self.shot_right_offset
		else
			shoot_offset = self.shot_left_offset
		end
	end

	--락온된 상태일 경우 헬기방향으로 직접 발사
	if self.is_lock_on then
		shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss_helicopter.Position - (user_party_leader.Position + shoot_offset)).normalized
	else
		shoot_dir = shoot_dir + vector(0, 0, 0.15)
	end

	self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos + shoot_offset, shoot_dir)
	self.is_launch_stinger = true

	--발사 시 반동
	local target_direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(
			vector_util.get_x0z(self.boss_helicopter.Position - user_party_leader.Position).normalized)
	local target_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(target_direction)
	character_util.jump_move(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + (vector(-1.5, 0, 0) - target_dir_vector),
			5, 0.4, false, vector_util.to_side_dir(shoot_dir))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reaction_effect_name):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = ani_name, loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(self.launch_ani_duration)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
end

function local_class:check_position()
	local character_pos = user_party_leader.Position.z
	local target_pos = self.boss_helicopter.Position.z

	local diff = math.abs(target_pos - character_pos)

	if diff < self.helicopter_hit_bounds_size then
		if self.aim_effect ~= nil then
			self.aim_effect.transform.position = self.boss_helicopter.Position
		else
			self.aim_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.aim_effect_name):Instantiate(self.boss_helicopter.Position)
		end

		self.is_lock_on = true
	else
		if self.aim_effect ~= nil then
			self.aim_effect.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		self.is_lock_on = false
	end
end

function local_class:release_launch_mode()
	-- 캐릭터 액션 버튼 원래대로 되돌려줌.
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = nil

	local manual_touch_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState

	if 	self.origin_weapon1_sprite_name ~= nil then
		user_party_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', self.origin_weapon1_sprite_name)
	end

	if 	self.origin_weapon2_sprite_name ~= nil then
		user_party_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', self.origin_weapon2_sprite_name)
	end

	if self:is_animal_type_character() then
		user_party_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', self.origin_weapon1_sprite_name)
		user_party_leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', self.origin_weapon1_sprite_name)
	end

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)

	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(user_party_leader)
	end

	user_party_leader:HideWeapon(false)
	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.3)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party_leader, 'none')

	--에임 이펙트 해제
	if self.aim_effect ~= nil then
		self.aim_effect:Dispose()
		self.aim_effect = nil
	end

	--ActionState를 캐릭터 기본State로 변경
	message_system:Send(user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(nil))

	--스팅어 해제 정보를 이벤트로 보냄
	if self.boss_helicopter ~= nil then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BossStingerStepEvent.Create(self.character, self.boss_helicopter, CS.Oak.StingerStep.Drop))
	end

	self.is_launch_mode = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	self.interactor = e.Interactor

	if self.is_interacting then
		return false
	end

	if stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty() ~= nil and self.can_interact_in_battle == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.interactor, { key = 'err_cant_interact_in_battle' })
		end))
		return false
	end

	self:start_interacting()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	self:cancel()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	self:done()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.interactor ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.interactor) then
		self:cancel()
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_interacting then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		local progress = self.time_passed / self.interacting_duration
		local prev_progress = self.prev_time_passed / self.interacting_duration

		if self.event_publish_progress ~= nil then
			for i = 1, #self.event_publish_progress do
				if prev_progress < self.event_publish_progress[i] and progress >= self.event_publish_progress[i] then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'interacting', self.event_publish_progress[i] }))
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.interacting_duration then
			self.is_interacting = false

			local command = CS.Oak.InteractFinishCommand.Create(self.interactor, self.fo)
			command_util.execute_cmd(command)
		else
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		end

		self.prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	elseif self.timer_bar ~= nil then
		local interacting_reset_duration_scale = self.interacting_duration / self.interacting_reset_duration
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - (interacting_reset_duration_scale * dt)

		if self.time_passed > 0 then
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		else
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar = nil
		end
	end

	--TODO:타겟과의 위치 체크 후 에임표시
	if self.is_launch_mode and self.boss_helicopter ~= nil then
		self:check_position()
	end

	--TODO:스팅어 쿨타임 표시
	if self.is_launch_stinger then
		if self.stinger_time_passed >= self.stinger_dealy_time then
			self.is_launch_stinger = false
			self.stinger_time_passed = 0
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(user_party_leader))
		else
			self.stinger_time_passed = self.stinger_time_passed + dt
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_interacting()
	self.is_interacting = true

	local look_dir

	if self.interacting_direction_locked_side then
		if user_party.Position.x < self.fo.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end
	else
		look_dir = character_util.get_direction(user_party.Leader)
	end

	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, look_dir)

	local interact_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerInteractState.Create(user_party.Leader, self.fo)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(interact_state))

	self.interacting_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.interacting_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

	local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(self.interacting_animation_name, CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(user_party.Leader, req)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

	state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Gathering
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

	self:set_field_timer()
end

function local_class:is_animal_type_character()
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Pet or
			user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId == CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.WhiteTigerBaby then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.boss_helicopter) then
			--스팅어가 헬기를 타격함
			self:release_launch_mode()

			--스팅어가 헬기를 맞췄을 때 카메라 쉐이크 및 폭발 이펙트
			stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.stinger_hit_effect_name):Instantiate(self.boss_helicopter.Position)

			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(user_party_leader))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BossStingerStepEvent.Create(self.character, self.boss_helicopter, CS.Oak.StingerStep.Hit))
		end
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.interacting_sfx ~= nil then
		self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader) then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	else
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	if self.interacting_reset_duration == 0 then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil
	end

	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:done()
	self.interacting_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.interactor, 'none')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.interactor, user_party.Leader) then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	else
		message_system:SendSync(self.interactor, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	self.is_interacting = false
end

-- 채집 시간을 알려주는 타이머를 세팅한다.
function local_class:set_field_timer()
	local u_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	if self.timer_bar == nil then
		self.timer_bar = u_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, self.interacting_duration);
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

		self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true);

		self.time_passed = 0
		self.prev_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.stinger_object = nil
	self:change_state()

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	if self.aim_effect ~= nil then
		self.aim_effect:Dispose()
		self.aim_effect = nil
	end

	self.tiger_shot_offset = nil
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('AttackHammer')

--- 생성자
--- @param data_path string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 경로.
--- @param data_key string 해당 기믹이 사용할 Data의 Key.
--- @param cs_behaviour any 해당 기믹의 C# Behaviour.
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 기믹 데이터
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.fo = nil

	-- 애니메이터
	self.animator = nil

	-- AttackRange
	self.attack_range = nil

	-- 해머 활성화 여부
	self.is_hammer_active = false

	-- 플레이어와 이 오브젝트가 동일 그리드에 있는지?
	self.is_on_camera_grid = false

	-- 커스텀 이벤트 키
	self.pause_hammer_key = 'pause_hammer'
	self.resume_hammer_key = 'resume_hammer'
	self.hit_hammer_key = 'hit_hammer'

	-- 오브젝트 풀 프리셋
	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit"
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo

	self.animator = self.fo.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.animator:Play('aw_hammer_idle')

	self.is_hammer_active = true

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.cs_behaviour:UnSubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.fo = nil
	self.animator = nil

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range.gameObject)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_on_camera_grid and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) then
		self.is_on_camera_grid = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_on_camera_grid and e.CameraGrid:Contains(self.fo.Position) then
		self.is_on_camera_grid = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 메인 퀘스트 상태와 관계없이 강제로 켜고 꺼준다
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.pause_hammer_key then
		self.is_hammer_active = false
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.resume_hammer_key then
		self.is_hammer_active = true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

-- 기믹 해머 작동
function local_class:activate()
	wait_for_sec(self.data.delay)

	-- 비활성화 된 동안 대기
	while not self.is_hammer_active do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local timer = 0
	local is_animated = false
	local is_damaged = false

	local rotation = self.fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y
	local target_pos = self.fo.Position - vector(
			math.sin(math.rad(rotation)) * 1.55, 0, math.cos(math.rad(rotation)) * 1.55)

	target_pos = target_pos + vector(0, field:GetTileInfoAt(target_pos):GetHeightAt(target_pos), 0)

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Show(0)
	else
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(
				target_pos - vector(0, field:GetTileInfoAt(target_pos):GetHeightAt(target_pos) * 0.3, 0),
				self.data.damage_distance
		)

		self.attack_range:Show(0)
	end

	while self.is_on_camera_grid do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer > self.data.wait_duration then
			is_animated = false
			is_damaged = false

			timer = 0
		elseif not is_animated and timer >= self.data.animation_duration then
			is_animated = true

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_factory_02", play_pos = target_pos })

			self.animator:Play('aw_hammer_on')
		elseif not is_damaged and timer >= self.data.damage_duration then
			is_damaged = true

			self:hit_logic(target_pos)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.animator:Play('aw_hammer_idle')

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end
end

-- 피격 로직
function local_class:hit_logic(target_pos)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			target_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			target_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	self.animator:Play('aw_hammer_off')

	if (get_party_leader().Position - target_pos).magnitude < self.data.damage_distance then
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.fo
		damage_info.target = get_party_leader()
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.data.damage_per_hp)
		damage_info.notMortal = true

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomSendValueEvent.Create(self.fo, self.hit_hammer_key, -1, target_pos))
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('BarrelCharacterBehaviour')

function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	self.fo = nil

	self.follow_character = nil

	self.barrel_state = {
		idle = 0,
		firing = 1
	}

	self.cur_barrel_state = self.barrel_state.idle

	self.explosion_effect_offset = vector(0, 0.6, 0)

	-- 폭탄에 불이 붙은 후 걸리는 시간, 리스폰 시간 등을 재기 위한 타이머
	self.time_passed = 0

	local key = data_key == nil and 'default' or data_key
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, key)

	-- 폭발 반경
	self.explode_radius = self.data.explode_radius

	-- 심지에 불이 붙은 후 폭발할 때까지 걸리는 시간
	self.time_to_explode = self.data.time_to_explode

	-- 폭탄에 불이 붙은 후 깜빡이기 시작할때까지 걸리는 시간
	self.blink_threshold = self.data.blink_threshold

	-- 폭탄 빠른 폭발 SFX 핸들네임
	self.bomb_fast_count_sfx_handle_name = self.data.bomb_fast_count_sfx_handle_name
	self.bomb_fast_count_sfx = nil

	-- 폭탄 폭발 SFX 핸들네임
	self.bomb_explosion_sfx_handle_name = self.data.bomb_explosion_sfx_handle_name

	-- 폭발시 주변에 입히는 체력비례 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = self.data.damage_multiplier

	-- 통의 hp
	self.hp = self.data.hp

	self.origin_color = unity_color({
		self.data.origin_color.r,
		self.data.origin_color.g,
		self.data.origin_color.b,
		self.data.origin_color.a
	})

	self.purse_color = unity_color({
		self.data.purse_color.r,
		self.data.purse_color.g,
		self.data.purse_color.b,
		self.data.purse_color.a
	})
end

function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new')

	-- 기사면 성별에 따라 캐릭터 받아오도록 한다.
	local prefix_name = ''

	if self.data.is_follow_character_knight then
		prefix_name = user_util.has_knight_male() and 'male_' or 'female_'
	end

	local follow_character_name = prefix_name .. self.data.follow_character_name

	self.follow_character = get_character(follow_character_name)

	self.is_reset_event = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.is_reset_event, false)
	self.is_immune_to_fire = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.data.is_immune_to_fire, false)

	self.data = nil

	self.fo = fo
	self.fo.Hitbox = self.follow_character.Hitbox
	self.fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.HittableObstacle

	local fo_spec = CS.Oak.FieldObjectSpec()
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.SetFieldObjectSpecHpBase(fo_spec, self.hp)

	self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec = fo_spec

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
end

function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end

--- LuaMessageSystem(message_system)을 이용하여 콜백을 등록하였을 경우 이 곳에서 해제하여야 한다.
--- detach_from의 경우 LuaMessageSystem이 이미 날아간 상태이기 때문에 Leak발생함.
function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	self.fo = nil

	self:current_state()
end

function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:current_action()
	local current_state = self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		if current_state.DidLandOnFloor then
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.ImpactMoving
		else
			return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Held
	end

	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
end

--region event related
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local consumed = CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CastToEventListenerAndSendSync(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, e, false)

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		-- 자신이 들리는 상황일 때
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) then
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState.Create(self.fo, e.Holder))
		end
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEvent) then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState.Create(e.ThrowInfo))
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent) then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BombProvokeEvent) then
		-- 폭발 가능한 상태 체크
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) and
				self.cur_barrel_state == self.barrel_state.idle then

			if self.is_immune_to_fire and
					e.ProvokeType == CS.Oak.BombProvokeType.Fire then
				return true
			end

			local type_priority
			local player_priority

			-- 리더와 같은 그리드 안에 있을때는 우선순위를 높여줌
			if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, self.fo.Position) then
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
			else
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.default
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.default
			end

			self.bomb_fast_count_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = self.bomb_fast_count_sfx_handle_name,
				parent = self.fo,
				max_distance = 10,
				type_priority = type_priority,
				player_priority = player_priority
			})

			self.cur_barrel_state = self.barrel_state.firing
			self.time_passed = self.time_to_explode - 1

			-- 더 이상 때리거나 할 수 없도록 기폭 이벤트와 함께 사망상태(hp 0)로 변경한다.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

			damage_info.damage = self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP
			self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Damage(damage_info)
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent) and
			self.is_reset_event then
		self:reset_object()
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.fo) then
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.follow_character)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.follow_character)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.fo) then
		if self:is_character_followable() then
			self.follow_character.Position = self.fo.Position
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.cur_barrel_state == self.barrel_state.idle then
		if self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <= 1 then
			character_util.shake(self.follow_character, 0.02, 0.2)
		end
	elseif self.cur_barrel_state == self.barrel_state.firing then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		local magnitude = 0.025 * self.time_passed / self.time_to_explode
		character_util.shake(self.follow_character, magnitude, 0.2)

		if self.fo.Owner == CS.Oak.Player.Local or self.fo.Owner == CS.Oak.Player.None then
			-- 폭발까지 걸리는 시간보다 지난 시간이 길면 폭탄을 폭발시킴
			if self.time_passed >= self.time_to_explode then
				self:explode()
				return
			end
		end

		if (self.time_to_explode - self.time_passed <= self.blink_threshold) then
			local dur = self.time_to_explode - self.blink_threshold
			local cur_time = self.time_passed - self.blink_threshold
			local progress = cur_time / dur
			local lerp_cnt = 16
			local lerp_progress = (1 - math.cos(math.pi * 2 * lerp_cnt * progress)) / 2
			local target_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(self.origin_color, self.purse_color, lerp_progress)

			character_util.add_color(self.follow_character, self.fo.Name, target_color, 1, 0)
		end
	end

	if self:is_character_followable() then
		self.follow_character.Position = self.fo.Position
	elseif self.cur_barrel_state == self.barrel_state.firing then
		self:reset()
	end
end

function local_class:explode()
	if self.cur_barrel_state ~= self.barrel_state.firing then
		return
	end

	self.cur_barrel_state = self.barrel_state.idle

	-- 폭발 소리 적용
	local type_priority
	local player_priority

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, self.fo.Position) then
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	else
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.default
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.default
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = self.bomb_explosion_sfx_handle_name,
		play_pos = self.fo.Position,
		max_distance = 12,
		type_priority = type_priority,
		player_priority = player_priority
	})

	-- 주변에 데미지 적용
	local explosionPos = self.fo.Position
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(explosionPos, self.explode_radius)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = self.fo
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_multiplier)
			damage_info.direction = (fo.Position - explosionPos).normalized

			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	local explosion_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new')

	explosion_effect:Instantiate(explosionPos + self.explosion_effect_offset)

	self:reset()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.cur_barrel_state = self.barrel_state.idle
	self.time_passed = 0;

	character_util.add_color(self.follow_character, self.fo.Name, self.origin_color, 1, 0)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = self.fo
	heal_info.heal = self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true

	local cmd = CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info)

	command_util.publish_cmd(heal_info.Owner, cmd)

	if self.bomb_fast_count_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.bomb_fast_count_sfx)
		self.bomb_fast_count_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:reset_object()
	if self.fo.Holdable.IsHeld then
		local holder = self.fo.Holdable.Holder
		self.fo.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)

		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(self.cs_behaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		-- 날아가고 있다면 관련 상태 리셋
		message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	end

	do
		local effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')

		if (self.fo.ActiveState & active_state('visible')) ~= active_state('disabled') then
			effect_pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position)
		end
	end

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.fo, active_state_type.enabled)
	self.fo.Position = get_party_leader().Position
	self:reset()
end

-- 알아보기 쉬운 함수명으로 레핑해 조건 체크
function local_class:is_character_followable()
	return self.follow_character.ActiveState == active_state_type.visible
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

	-- 조작키 뒤에 타륜 이미지
	self.background_wheel_transform = nil

	-- 플레이어 CrashBehaviour 캐시
	self.leader_crash_behaviour = nil

	-- 보트의 플레이어 위치 보정 값
	self.boat_player_pos = nil

	-- 보트에 타고 있는 상태인지
	self.already_riding = false

	-- 해당 fo 보트에 타고 있는지
	self.is_riding_fo = false

	-- 가속 버튼을 누르고 있는지
	self.hold_accel_button = false

	-- 컨트롤을 하지 못하는 상황
	self.stop_control = false

	-- 충돌 상태인지
	self.is_crashing = false

	-- exit 버튼이 눌렸는지
	self.exit_button_clicked = false

	-- 튜토디얼이 필요한지
	self.play_tutorial = false

	-- 정지 버튼을 눌렀는지
	self.is_pause = false

	-- 움직일 때 실행할 sfx
	self.moving_sfx = nil

	self.dock_table = {}
end

--region IComponent
-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	-- 보트 fo, 트랜스폼 세팅
	self.fo = fo
	self.fo_transform = self.fo.transform
	self.fo_hitbox = self.fo.Hitbox

	-- 배에 타지 않을때는 ethereal로 바꾸고 히트박스 범위를 늘려준다.
	self:switch_crash_behaviour(false)

	-- 보트를 탄 플레이어 위치 보정
	self.boat_player_pos = vector(self.data.boat_player_pos.x, self.data.boat_player_pos.y, self.data.boat_player_pos.z)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	for i = 1, #self.data.dock_marker do
		table.insert(self.dock_table, field:GetMarker(self.data.dock_marker[i]).position)
	end
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
end
--endregion

--region IFieldObjectBehaviour
-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end
--endregion

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 이미 다른 보트를 타고 있는 상태면 무시한다.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo) and not self.already_riding then
		if self.play_tutorial then
			self.play_tutorial = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ride_boat, self, false, true))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ride_boat, self, false))
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	self.is_pause = true
end
function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	self.is_pause = false
	return true
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_pause then return end
	if not self.is_riding_fo then return end
	if self.exit_button_clicked then return end

	-- 가속 버튼
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.hold_accel_button = true
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
		self.hold_accel_button = false
		return true
	end

	-- 정박 버튼
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction1TouchDown then
		local dock_pos = self:check_dock()
		if dock_pos ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_off_boat, self, dock_pos, false))
		end
		return
	end

	-- 나가기 버튼
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction2TouchDown then
		return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.exit_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- ride_boat면 다른 보트들은 WallCrashBehaviour로 바꿔준다
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.fo) and e:GetParamAt(0) == 'ride_boat' then
		self:switch_crash_behaviour(true)
		return
	end

	-- get_off_boat면 다른 보트들은 EtherealCrashBehaviour로 바꿔준다
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.fo) and e:GetParamAt(0) == 'get_off_boat' then
		self:switch_crash_behaviour(false)
		return
	end

	-- 미니게임이나 연출 중 강제로 배에 태우거나 내리게 함
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'ride_boat_immediately' then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.fo.Name then
			if not self.already_riding then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ride_boat, self, true))
			end
		else
			self:switch_crash_behaviour(true)
		end
		return
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'get_off_boat_immediately' then
		if self.is_riding_fo then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_off_boat, self, self.fo.Position, true))
		else
			self:switch_crash_behaviour(false)
		end
		return
	end

	-- 미니게임이나 연출 중 보트 멈추기, 다시 컨트롤 되찾기
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stop_and_disable_boat_control' and self.is_riding_fo then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stop_and_disable_boat_control, self))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'reset_boat_controller' and self.is_riding_fo then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_boat_controller, self))
	end

	-- 배 탑승 후 튜토디얼 실행
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'play_boat_tutorial' and e:GetParamAt(1) == self.fo.Name then
		self.play_tutorial = true
	end
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_riding_fo then
		if not self.stop_control and not self.is_crashing then
			self:wheel_rotate(dt)
		end
		self:boat_movement(dt)
		self:set_leader_transform()
		self:set_parking_icon()
	end
end

-- 보트 이동
function local_class:boat_movement(dt)
	-- 속력 계산
	self:calculate_velocity()

	-- 충돌 체크, 오리배와 충돌체의 직교하는 방향이 있다면 벽에 막히지 않고 직교 방향으로 이동한다.
	local collider_orthogonal_vec = self:collision_check(dt)
	if self.velocity > 0 and not self.stop_control and not self.is_crashing then
		if collider_orthogonal_vec ~= nil then
			self.move_one_frame_stage_logic.ExecuteMove(self.fo,
					collider_orthogonal_vec.normalized, self.velocity * dt * collider_orthogonal_vec.magnitude)
		else
			self.move_one_frame_stage_logic.ExecuteMove(self.fo, -self.fo_transform.forward, self.velocity * dt)
		end
	end
end

-- 방향키에 방향으로 보트 회전
function local_class:wheel_rotate(dt)
	if self.wheel_button.Ratio.x > 0.1 or self.wheel_button.Ratio.x < -0.1 then
		self.fo_transform:Rotate(vector(0, 1, 0) * self.wheel_button.Ratio.x * self.data.wheel_rotation_force * dt)
		self.background_wheel_transform:Rotate(vector(0, 0, -1) * self.wheel_button.Ratio.x * self.data.wheel_rotation_force * dt)
	end
end

-- 보트에 맞게 캐릭터 위치, direction 수정
function local_class:set_leader_transform()
	self.leader.Position = self.fo.Position + self.boat_player_pos

	local angle = self.fo_transform.eulerAngles.y
	if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
		character_util.set_direction(self.leader, 'left')
	elseif angle >= 135 and angle < 225  then
		character_util.set_direction(self.leader, 'up')
	elseif angle >= 225 and angle < 315 then
		character_util.set_direction(self.leader, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(self.leader, 'down')
	end
end

-- 주변에 선착장이 있으면 정박 ui를 띄우고 없다면 띄우지 않음
function local_class:set_parking_icon()
	if self:check_dock() == nil then
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1, self.leader)
	else
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1, self.leader)
	end
end

-- 주변에 정박할 선착장이 있는지 체크
function local_class:check_dock()
	for i = 1, #self.dock_table do
		if (self.dock_table[i] - self.fo.Position).magnitude <= self.data.dock_distance then
			return self.dock_table[i]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- 충돌 체크
function local_class:collision_check(dt)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.fo.Bounds,  -self.fo_transform.forward * self.velocity * dt)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = fo_list[i]
		-- 자기 자신은 무시
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(obj, self.fo) then
			-- 스파이크면 충돌
			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour) and not self.is_crashing then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_boat_01', parent = self.fo,
				                             type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.knockback_boat, self, obj.Position))
				fo_list:Dispose()
				return nil
			-- 퍼플코인이면 획득
			elseif lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.PurpleCoinBehaviour)
					and obj.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
				message_system:SendSync(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(self.leader))
			-- 벽이면 사선으로 이동
			elseif lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
				fo_list:Dispose()
				return self:calculate_orthogonal(obj)
			end
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
	return nil
end

-- 충돌 fo와 직교하는 벡터 구하기
function local_class:calculate_orthogonal(obj)
	local x = obj.Bounds.extents.x + 1
	local z = obj.Bounds.extents.z + 1

	local shortest_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	local shortest_dst = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
	local diff = 0

	-- obj까지의 가장 가까운 방향 벡터 구함
	if field:GetTileInfoAt(obj.Bounds.center + (z * unity_class.vector3.forward)).types == CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None then
		diff = (self.fo.Position - obj.Bounds.center + (z * unity_class.vector3.forward)).sqrMagnitude
		if diff < shortest_dst then
			shortest_dst = diff
			shortest_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		end
	end
	if field:GetTileInfoAt(obj.Bounds.center - (z * unity_class.vector3.forward)).types == CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None then
		diff = (self.fo.Position - obj.Bounds.center - (z * unity_class.vector3.forward)).sqrMagnitude
		if diff < shortest_dst then
			shortest_dst = diff
			shortest_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end
	end
	if field:GetTileInfoAt(obj.Bounds.center + (x * unity_class.vector3.right)).types == CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None then
		diff = (self.fo.Position - obj.Bounds.center + (x * unity_class.vector3.right)).sqrMagnitude
		if diff < shortest_dst then
			shortest_dst = diff
			shortest_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		end
	end
	if field:GetTileInfoAt(obj.Bounds.center - (x * unity_class.vector3.right)).types == CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None then
		diff = (self.fo.Position - obj.Bounds.center - (x * unity_class.vector3.right)).sqrMagnitude
		if diff < shortest_dst then
			shortest_dst = diff
			shortest_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end
	end

	local fo_dir = -self.fo_transform.forward
	local wall_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.To4WayVector3(shortest_dir)

	-- 오리배와 충돌체의 각이 90도보다 크면 무시한다
	local dot = (fo_dir.x * wall_dir.x) + (fo_dir.z * wall_dir.z)
	if dot < 0 then
		return nil
	end

	-- 직교하는 벡터로 바꾸기
	local cross = vector(0, (fo_dir.z * wall_dir.x) - (fo_dir.x * wall_dir.z), 0)
	local collider_orthogonal_vec = vector(-(wall_dir.z * cross.y), 0, (wall_dir.x * cross.y))

	if collider_orthogonal_vec.magnitude == 0 then
		collider_orthogonal_vec = nil
	end
	return collider_orthogonal_vec
end

-- 보트 넉백
function local_class:knockback_boat(pos)
	-- 충돌 중인지
	self.is_crashing = true

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.leader, unity_class.color.red, 1, 1, 0.3)

	self.velocity = self.data.knockback_force
	local dir_vector = (self.fo.Position - pos).normalized
	while self.velocity > 0 do
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.fo, dir_vector, self.velocity * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		self.velocity = self.velocity - self.data.deceleration
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.velocity = 0

	self.is_crashing = false
end

-- 보트 탑승 is_imeeditately = true면 연출 스킵하고 바로 탑승한다
function local_class:ride_boat(is_immediately, is_tutorial)
	local is_tutorial_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_tutorial, false)
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 플레이어 ui 끔
	if not is_immediately or is_tutorial_val then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
	end

	if self.boat_start_rotation == nil then
		self.boat_start_rotation = self.fo_transform.localRotation
	end

	-- 배에 타면 히트박스 원래대로 되돌린다.
	self:switch_crash_behaviour(true)

	self.leader = user_party.Leader
	-- 기존 파티 정보 저장
	self.saved_party = {}
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.saved_party, user_party[i])
	end

	-- 플레이어 크래시비헤이비어를 저장하고 ethereal로 수정
	self.leader_crash_behaviour = self.leader.CrashBehaviour
	self.leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 필요한 구독 추가
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')

	-- 파티 제외하고 disable + 보트 타는 연출
	local duration = 0.5
	if is_immediately then
		duration = 0
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			for i = 1, #self.saved_party do
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.saved_party[i], 0, duration)
			end
			wait_for_sec(duration)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function ()
			if not is_immediately then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
				character_util.jump_move(self.leader, self.fo.Position + self.boat_player_pos,
						3, 1, true)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_boat_01')
			end
			self.leader:HideWeapon(true)
			character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'idle' })
		end)
	})
	for i = 1, #self.saved_party do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.saved_party[i], 'disabled')
	end

	self.leader.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	local is_contain_zone = true
	-- 보트 구역이 있으면 존에 포함되어 있는지 체크해서 존 안이 아니면 이동시켜줌
	if self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].boat_zone_name ~= nil then
		local boat_zone = field:GetZone(self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].boat_zone_name)
		if not boat_zone:Contains(self.fo.Position) then
			is_contain_zone = false
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			self.fo.Position = field:GetMarker(self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].boat_start_marker).position
		end
	end

	-- 현재 배 각도에 맞게 리더 direction 수정
	self:set_leader_transform()

	-- FX 활성화
	local animator_1 = self.fo_transform:Find('mesh/duck_wing'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
	local animator_2 = self.fo_transform:Find('mesh/duck_part'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))

	animator_1.TimeScale = 1
	animator_2.TimeScale = 1

	self.fo_transform:Find('FX').gameObject:SetActive(true)

	if not is_contain_zone then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	if is_tutorial_val then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'afterworld_duck_boat_minigame_'..i })
		end
	end

	self:reset_boat_controller()

	-- sfx 실행
	self:play_moving_sfx()

	self.is_riding_fo = true

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'ride_boat' }))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not is_immediately then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.boat_bgm, state = 'event' })
	end
	self:play_moving_sfx()
end

-- 보트에서 내리기
-- is_immediately이면 연출 중이라 판단하여 따로 stop_and_disable_control이나 reset_controllers 하지 않음
function local_class:get_off_boat(pos, is_immediately)
	self.is_riding_fo = false
	self.velocity = 0

	-- sfx 종료
	self:stop_moving_sfx()

	if not is_immediately then
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 보트 히트박스, CrashBehaviour 변경
	self:switch_crash_behaviour(false)

	-- 보트 인터랙터블 활성화
	self.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.Interactable()

	-- 버튼 삭제
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)

	local has_exit_button = self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].exit_boat_button
	if has_exit_button ~= nil and has_exit_button then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction2)
	end

	-- 구독 해제
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	-- FX 비활성화
	local animator_1 = self.fo_transform:Find('mesh/duck_wing'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
	local animator_2 = self.fo_transform:Find('mesh/duck_part'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))

	animator_1.TimeScale = 0
	animator_2.TimeScale = 0

	self.fo_transform:Find('FX').gameObject:SetActive(false)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.leader)
	self.leader:HideWeapon(false)
	self.leader.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true

	local duration = 0
	if not is_immediately then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_boat_01')
		duration = 0.5
		character_util.jump_move(self.leader, pos, 4, 1, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	end
	-- 기존 파티원들 복구
	for i = 1, #self.saved_party do
		self.saved_party[i].Position = pos
		character_util.set_active_state(self.saved_party[i], 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.saved_party[i], 1, duration)
	end
	wait_for_sec(duration)

	self.saved_party = nil

	self.leader.CrashBehaviour = self.leader_crash_behaviour
	self.leader_crash_behaviour = nil
	self.leader = nil

	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil

	if not is_immediately then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
		stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.fo, { 'get_off_boat'}))
end

-- 보트 ui 삭제하고 컨트롤 뺏기
function local_class:stop_and_disable_boat_control()
	self.stop_control = true
	self.hold_accel_button = false
	self.velocity = 0

	-- ui없애고 컨트롤 뺏음
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	local has_exit_button = self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].exit_boat_button
	if has_exit_button ~= nil and has_exit_button then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction2)
	end
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
end

-- 보트 컨트롤러 설정
function local_class:reset_boat_controller()
	-- ui들 다 없애줌
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	-- SidePad 추가
	if self.wheel == nil then
		local shoot_ui_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(field_ui_manager.Transform, 'shoot_pad(Clone)')
		local shoot_ui = shoot_ui_transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShotButton))

		shoot_ui:SetPosition(vector(230, 120), CS.Oak.Direction.DownLeft)

		field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)
		self.wheel = field_ui_manager:GetUI(self.leader)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad]
		self.wheel_button = self.wheel.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShotButton))

		-- 스크롤 버튼 위치 조정, 이미지 추가
		self.wheel_button:ChangeIcon('ic_ship_wheel_small.png', unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8)
		self.wheel_button:SettingBackSprite(true, 'ic_ship_wheel.png')

		self.background_wheel_transform = self.wheel_button.BackSpriteTransform

		if self.input_manager.GamepadEnabled then
			self.wheel_button:SetIconSpeed(self.data.pad_speed)
		else
			self.wheel_button:SetIconSpeed(self.data.touch_speed)
		end
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)
	else
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)
	end

	-- 보트 존에서 벗어나는 버튼이 있다면 나가기 버튼 추가
	local has_exit_button = self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].exit_boat_button
	if has_exit_button ~= nil and has_exit_button then
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction2)
		local special_func_ui_2 = field_ui_manager:GetUI(self.leader)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction2]
		local special_func_button_component_2 = special_func_ui_2.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUISpecialFunctionButton))
		special_func_button_component_2:SetButtonCoolTime(0)
		special_func_button_component_2:SetButtonSprite('actbtn_ic_act_exit.png', vector(1, 1, 1))
		-- 나가기 버튼 위치 조정
		local special2_positioner = special_func_ui_2.transform:Find('Touch').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
		special2_positioner.Position = vector(-110, 300)
		special2_positioner:Rebuild()
	end

	-- 정박 버튼 추가
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)
	local special_func_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(self.leader)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1]
	local special_func_button_component = special_func_ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUISpecialFunctionButton))

	end

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Run

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.stop_control = false
end

-- 나갈 것인지
function local_class:exit_routine()
	self.exit_button_clicked = true

	self:stop_and_disable_boat_control()

	-- 보트에서 내릴 지 묻는 나레이션
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.data.exit_narration_key })

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local pass = true

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('boat_ride_exit_yes'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('boat_ride_exit_no'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			pass = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if pass then
		self:exit_boat_zone()
	else
		self:reset_boat_controller()
	end

	self.exit_button_clicked = false
	self.stop_control = false
end

-- 보트존에서 나가기
function local_class:exit_boat_zone()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.fo.Position = field:GetMarker(self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].exit_boat_marker).position
	self.fo_transform.localRotation = self.boat_start_rotation
	self:set_leader_transform()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:get_off_boat(field:GetMarker(self.data.boat_data[self.fo.Name].exit_player_marker).position, false)
end

-- 가속도 계산
function local_class:calculate_velocity()
	if self.hold_accel_button then
		if self.velocity + self.data.acceleration > self.data.max_velocity then
			self.velocity = self.data.max_velocity
		else
			self.velocity = self.velocity + self.data.acceleration
		end
	else
		if self.velocity - self.data.deceleration > 0 then
			self.velocity = self.velocity - self.data.deceleration
		else
			self.velocity = 0
		end
	end
end

-- 보트 crash behaviour 상태를 바꾼다
function local_class:switch_crash_behaviour(activate_crash_behaviour)
	if activate_crash_behaviour then
		self.already_riding = true
		self.fo.Hitbox = self.fo_hitbox
		self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		self.already_riding = false
		self.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.data.boat_hitbox, 1, self.data.boat_hitbox))
		self.fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

-- sfx 시작
function local_class:play_moving_sfx()
	if self.moving_sfx == nil then
		self.moving_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{sfx_name = self.data.moving_sfx, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop',
				 player_priority = 'object', parent = self.fo})
	end
end

-- sfx 정지
function local_class:stop_moving_sfx()
	if self.moving_sfx ~= nil then
		self.moving_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.moving_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	if self.moving_sfx ~= nil then
		self.moving_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.moving_sfx = nil

	self.dock_table = nil
	self.fo = nil
	self.fo_hitbox = nil
	self.fo_transform = nil
	self.boat_player_pos = nil
	self.leader = nil
	self.saved_party = nil
	self.leader_crash_behaviour = nil

	self.wheel = nil
	self.wheel_button = nil
	self.background_wheel_transform = nil

	self:change_state()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('BuildingJumpGimmick')

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	local data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- fo Position 기준으로 점프 거리
	self.jump_distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['jump_distance'], 1)
	-- 점프 하는 방향
	self.jump_direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['jump_direction'], 'down')
	-- 착지점 다르게 할때 캐릭터간의 거리
	self.landing_pos_gap = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['landing_pos_gap'], 0)
	-- 속력
	self.inV = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['inV'], 10)
	-- 가속도
	self.inA = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['inA'], 25)
	-- 페이드 아웃/인 사용 하는지
	self.fade_out_in_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(data['fade_out_in_effect'], false)

	self.fade_state_enum = {
		-- 초기 상태
		none = 1,
		-- 페이드 아웃 한 상태
		fade_out = 2,
		-- 페이드 인 한 상태
		fade_in = 3
	}
	self.current_fade_state = nil

	self.interacting = false

	self.landed_member_num = 0

	self.last_member_landed = false
	-- 다음 파티원 뛰는 간견
	self.jump_time_gap = 0.2

	self.jump_dest_pos = nil

	-- 최대 빌딩 높이 (더 높은 건물이 있으면 갱신 필요)
	self.max_building_height = 100
end

--region IComponent
-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.current_fade_state = self.fade_state_enum.none

	-- 점프 도착 지점 위치 정하기
	self.jump_dest_pos = self.fo.Position + (direction_util.to_vector3(self.jump_direction) * self.jump_distance)
	self.jump_dest_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_dest_pos,
			stage_util.get_height(vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_dest_pos, self.max_building_height)))
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(fo)
	self.fo = nil
end
--endregion

--region IFieldObjectBehaviour
-- 현재 기본 스테이트 얻기(아이들, 걷기 등 전신 및 하체 상태)
function local_class:current_state()
	return nil
end

-- 현재 IFO가 취하고 있는 액션
function local_class:current_action()
	return CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.None
end
--endregion

--region event
-- 이벤트 호출
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.interacting or self.jump_dest_pos == nil then return false end
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.jump, self)
	return true
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트. attach_to가 불린 시점부터 detach_from 이 불린 시점까지 매 프레임 불린다.
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
end

function local_class:jump()
	self.interacting = true
	self.last_member_landed = false
	local leader_origin_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local gap = self.landing_pos_gap
	local party_num = user_party.Count

	if self.fade_out_in_effect then
		field.RooftopManager:LockVisible()
	end

	if self.fade_out_in_effect then
		camera_util.move(leader_origin_pos, 0)
	end

	for i = 0, party_num - 1 do
		local character = user_party[i]
		character_util.move_to_async(character, leader_origin_pos, self.jump_time_gap, nil, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(character, self.jump_direction)

		local dest_pos = nil
		if self.jump_direction == 'down' or self.jump_direction == 'up' then
			dest_pos = self.jump_dest_pos + vector(math.floor((party_num) * 0.5) * gap, 0, 0)
			dest_pos = vector(dest_pos.x - (i * gap), dest_pos.y, dest_pos.z)
		else
			dest_pos = self.jump_dest_pos + vector(0, 0, math.floor((party_num) * 0.5) * gap)
			dest_pos = vector(dest_pos.x , dest_pos.y, dest_pos.z - ((party_num - 1 - i) * gap))
		end

		if not self.fade_out_in_effect then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.free_falling, self, character, dest_pos, i))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.free_falling_fade, self, character, dest_pos, i))
		end
	end

	while self.landed_member_num ~= party_num do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.fade_out_in_effect then
		field.RooftopManager:ResetVisible()
	end

	self.landed_member_num = 0
	self.interacting = false
end

-- 일반 점프 연출
function local_class:free_falling(character, dest_pos, character_idx)
	local start_position = character.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
	local v = self.inV
	local a = self.inA
	local d = character.Position.y
	local duration = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.CalculateDurationIncludingBounces(v, a, d - dest_pos.y, 0)
	local time_passed = 0

	free_fall:SetParameters(v, a, d, 0)

	character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 1);
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'get', loop = false})

	while time_passed < duration and not free_fall:IsDone() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		free_fall:Proceed(dt)

		local y = free_fall:GetDistance()
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		if progress >= 0.5 then
			y = y >= self.jump_dest_pos.y and y or self.jump_dest_pos.y
		end

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(vector_util.get_x0z(start_position, y), vector_util.get_x0z(dest_pos, y), progress)
		character_util.set_position(character, pos, true)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
	character_util.set_position(character, character.Position, false)
	character_util.remove_anim(character)

	self.landed_member_num = self.landed_member_num + 1
	free_fall:Dispose()
end

-- 페이드 인/아웃 연출: 착지점이 보이지 않는 곳에서 뛰어 내릴 때만 사용 가능
function local_class:free_falling_fade(character, dest_pos, character_idx)
	local start_position = character.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
	local v = self.inV
	local a = self.inA
	local d = character.Position.y
	local duration = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.CalculateDurationIncludingBounces(v, a, d - dest_pos.y, 0)

	character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 1);
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'get', loop = false})

	self.current_fade_state = self.fade_state_enum.none

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 연출 분리 했기에 떨어지는 연출도 두 번 실행
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local time_passed = 0
		free_fall:SetParameters(v, a, d, 0)

		while time_passed < duration and not free_fall:IsDone() do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			time_passed = time_passed + dt
			free_fall:Proceed(dt)

			local y = free_fall:GetDistance()
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			if character_idx == 0 then
				if self.current_fade_state == self.fade_state_enum.fade_out and i == 2 then
					if progress > 0.2 then
						self.current_fade_state = self.fade_state_enum.fade_in
						camera_util.move(dest_pos, 0)
						screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')

						if d > dest_pos.y then
							field.RooftopManager:ResetVisible()
						else
							field.RooftopManager:ForceVisible(true)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if progress >= 0.5 then
				y = y >= self.jump_dest_pos.y and y or self.jump_dest_pos.y
			end

			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(vector_util.get_x0z(start_position, y), vector_util.get_x0z(dest_pos, y), progress)
			character_util.set_position(character, pos, true)

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 마지막 맴버가 칙지 하는 시점을 기준으로 페이드 아웃
		-- 동일한 연출을 위해 맴버별 뛰는 시간 갭 유지
		if i == 1 then
			if character_idx == user_party.Count - 1 then
				self.current_fade_state = self.fade_state_enum.fade_out
				screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
				self.last_member_landed = true
			end

			while true do
				if self.last_member_landed then
					character.Position = start_position
					wait_for_sec(self.jump_time_gap * character_idx)
					break
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
		end
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0);
	character_util.set_position(character, character.Position, false)
	character_util.remove_anim(character)

	self.landed_member_num = self.landed_member_num + 1
	free_fall:Dispose()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_behaviour:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:change_state()

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}
